‘śirorujanapradehāḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 32 . ‘amandadāhamantare|’ iti pā.| ↩ 33 . ‘ulbaṇamiti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 34 . ‘dhvaṃsakavikṣepakāvapi’ iti pā.| ↩ 35 . ‘pṛthak’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 36 . ‘saṅgrahītau’ iti pā.| ↩ 37 . ‘hikketyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 38 . ‘kaṇṭharodhaḥ sammohaśchardiraṅgarujā jvaraḥ|’ etatsthāne ‘kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaḥ sarvāsahiṣṇutā| nidrātandrātiyogaśca jñeyaṃ dhvaṃsakalakṣaṇam|| hṛtkaṇṭharodhaḥ sammohaḥ chardiraṅgarujā jvaraḥ|’ iti pā.| ↩ 39 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ pānātyaparamadapānājīrṇapānavibhramanidānam||18||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 19. dāhanidānam
text: atha dāhanidānam| tvacaṃ prāptaḥ sa pānoṣmā pittaraktābhimūrchitaḥ | dāhaṃ prakurute ghoraṃ pittavattatra bheṣajam ||1|| madātyaye'pi dāho bhavatyataḥ saptaprakāraṃ dāhamāha; tatra madyajamāha– tvacamityādi| pānoṣmā pā.| madyapānakupitapittasyauṣṇyaṃ; samānoṣmeti pāṭhāntaramayuktaṃ, suśrute pānātyaye ślokasyāsya pāṭhāt| pittajo'pyayaṃ hetubhedāt pṛthak paṭhitaḥ||1|| madātyaye dāho bhavatītyato madātyayānantaraṃ dāhanidānārambhaḥ| madyajadāhamāha– tvacamityādi| pānoṣmā madyapānakupitapittoṣmā, sa tvacaṃ prāpto ghoraṃ dāhaṃ prakarṣeṇa kuruta ityarthaḥ| kīdṛśaḥ pittaraktābhyāmabhivardhitaḥ| anye ‘samānoṣmā’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ paṭhanti| tanna yuktaṃ, suśrute pānātyaye ślokasyāsya pāṭhāt| pittajo'pyayaṃ hetubhedātpṛthak paṭhitaḥ||1|| kṛtsnadehānugaṃ raktamudriktaṃ dahati dhruvam | sa uṣyate tṛṣyate ca tāmrābhastāmralocanaḥ ||2|| lohagandhāṅgavadano vahninevāvakīryate | (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) | raktajamāha– kṛtsnetyādi| sa uṣyate samīpastheneva vahninā tapyate, ‘sandhūpyata’ iti pāṭhāntare sandhūpanavadvedanāmanubhavati| tāmrābha iti gātre| lohagandhāṅgavadana iti lohasyeva gandho'ṅge vadane ca yasya sa tathā||2-3||– raktajamāha– kṛtsnetyādi| udriktaṃ vṛddhaṃ raktaṃ kṛtsnadehānugaṃ sat dhruvaṃ sandahati, puruṣastena ūṣyate samīpasthena vahnineva tapyate| sañcūṣyate iti pāṭhāntare ācūṣaṇavadvedanāmanubhavati| tāmrābha iti tāmrābhagātraḥ| lohasyeva gandho'ṅge vadane ca yasya sa tathā|2-3|– pittajvarasamaḥ pittātsa cāpyasya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) | pittajamāha– pittetyādi| pittajvarasamaḥ pittajvaraliṅgayuktaḥ, pittajvare tvāmāśayaduṣṭyādayo'dhikā iti bhedaḥ| sa cāpyasya vidhiriti pittajvaracikitsā||3|| pittajamāha– pittajvaretyādi| pittajvare aratyāmāśayaduṣṭyādayo'dhikā iti bhedaḥ, anyāni samānalakṣaṇāni| sa cāpyasya vidhiriti pittajvaroktacikitsetyarthaḥ||3|| tṛṣṇānirodhādabdhātau kṣīṇe tejaḥ samuddhatam | sabāhyābhyantaraṃ dehaṃ pradahenmandacetasaḥ ||4|| saṃśuṣkagalatālvoṣṭho jihvāṃ niṣkṛṣya vepate | (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) | tṛṣṇānirodhajamāha– tṛṣṇetyādi| tejaḥsamuddhataṃ pittoṣmā vṛddha ityarthaḥ| niṣkṛṣya niḥsārya||4||– tṛṣṇānirodhajamāha– tṛṣṇetyādi| tṛṣṇāvidhāraṇādabdhātau rase kṣīṇe sati, tejaḥ samutthitaṃ pittoṣmā vṛddha ityarthaḥ| sa bāhyābhyantaraṃ dehaṃ pradahet| mandacetasaḥ visañjñasya| niṣkṛṣya niḥsārya kampate||4||– asṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasya dāho'nyaḥ syāt suduḥsahaḥ ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) | avagāḍhaśastraprahārajanitaraktapūrṇakoṣṭhajamāha– asṛja ityādi| na coktaraktajenāsya paunaruktyaṃ, kṛtsnadehānugamiti vacanāt kāraṇabhedācca| asṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasyeti ‘pūraṇaguṇasuhitārtha’ ityādinā jñāpakena kartari ṣaṣṭhī, raktena pūritakoṣṭhasyetyarthaḥ| koṣṭhaśabdena hṛdayādayo gṛhyante| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “sthānānyāmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca| hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaśca koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate||” (su. ci. a. 2) iti||5|| avagāḍhaśastraprahārajanitaraktapūrṇakoṣṭhajamāha– asṛja ityādi| asṛjaḥ rudhirasyeti “pūraṇaguṇasahita” ityādinā jñāpakena kartari ṣaṣṭhī; raktena pūritakoṣṭhasyetyarthaḥ| koṣṭhaśabdena hṛdayādayo gṛhyante| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “sthānānyāmāgnipākvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca| hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaśca koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate||” iti| na coktaraktaje nāsya paunaruktyaṃ, ‘kṛtsnadehānugam’ iti vacanāt, kāraṇabhedācceti||5|| dhātukṣayottho yo dāhastena mūrchātṛḍarditaḥ | kṣāmasvaraḥ kriyāhīnaḥ sa sīdedbhṛśapīḍitaḥ ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) | dhātukṣayajamāha– dhātvityādi| dhātavo rasādayaḥ| kriyāhīno niśceṣṭaḥ; kiṃvā bhṛśapīḍito dāhena kriyāhīnaścikitsāhīno yadi bhavettadā sīdenmriyeta ityarthaḥ||6|| dhātukṣayajamāha– dhātvityādi| dhātavo rasādayaḥ, teṣāṃ kṣayeṇa yo dāho bhavati tena dhātukṣayajadāhena| kṣāmasvaro durbalasvaraḥ, kriyāhīno niśceṣṭaḥ, bhṛśapīḍito dāhena cikitsāhīno yadi bhavettadā sīdenmriyata ityarthaḥ||6|| kṣatajo'naśnataścānnaṃ śocato vā'pyanekadhā | tenāntardahyate'tyarthaṃ tṛṣṇāmūrchāpralāpavān ||7|| marmābhighātajo'pyasti so'sādhyaḥ saptamo mataḥ | sarva eva ca varjyāḥ syuḥ śītagātrasya dehinaḥ ||8|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) | kṣatajamāha– kṣataja ityādi| marmābhighātajamāha– marmetyādi| marmāṇi śirohṛdayabastyādīni| jejjaṭastu saptatvamanyathā gaṇayati– ‘tvacaṃ prāpta’ ityādinā prathamaḥ, ‘kṛtsnadehānugaṃ raktam’ ityatra raktasthāne pittaṃ paṭhitvā etadādinā ‘sa cāpyasya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ’ ityantena paittiko dvitīyaḥ, tṛṣṇānirodhajastṛtīyaḥ, ‘asṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasya’ iti caturthaḥ, dhātukṣayajaḥ pañcamaḥ, ṣaṣṭhasya tu kṣatajasya lakṣaṇaṃ paṭhati– “kṣatajo'naśnataścānnaṃ śocataścāpyanekadhā| tenāntardahyate'tyarthaṃ tṛṣṇādāhapralāpavān|” iti, marmābhighātajastu saptama iti||7-8|| marmābhighātajamāha– marmetyādi| marmāṇi hṛdayaśirobastyādīni| ‘sa cāsādhyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ’ ityatrānye ‘so'sādhyaḥ saptamo mataḥ’ iti paṭhanti| jejjaṭastu saptatvamanyathā gaṇayati– tvacaṃ prāpta ityādinā prathamaḥ, ‘kṛtsnadehānugaṃ raktam’ ityatra raktasthāne pittaṃ paṭhitvā etadādinā ‘sa cāpyasya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ’ ityantena paittiko dvitīyaḥ, tṛṣṇānirodhajastṛtīyaḥ, ‘asṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasya’ iti caturthaḥ, dhātukṣayajaḥ pañcamaḥ, ṣaṣṭhasya kṣatajasya lakṣaṇaṃ paṭhati– “kṣatajenāśnataścānnaṃ śocato vā'pyanekadhā| tenāṅgaṃ dahyate'tyarthaṃ tṛṣṇādāhapralāpavān||” iti| asyārthaḥ– pūrvamasṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasyetyādinā koṣṭhasthena raktena dāhamabhidhāyedānīṃ prakārāntareṇāha– kṣatajena raktena, anaśnato bhojanaṃ kurvataḥ, śokaṃ kurvato vā'pi narasyānyo dāho raktena bhavatīti sambandhaḥ, tena dāhenābhyantaraṃ dahyate, tṛṣṇāmūrchāpralāpavān ‘naro bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| marmābhighātajastu saptamaḥ| sarveṣāmapi dāhānāmavasthāyāṃ varjanīyatvamāha– sarva iti| sarva eva hi ‘dāhā’ iti śeṣaḥ| śeṣaṃ sugamam||7-8|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne dāhanidānaṃ samāptam ||19|| iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ dāhanidānaṃ samāptam||19|| iti śrīvaidyavācaspatikṛte ātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāne dāhanidānam||19|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘pittaprakopadhānādi hetubhirjāyate gadaḥ ūṣmātmako'pi dāhākhyaḥ sa ca saptavidho mataḥ’ iti pā. | ↩ 2 . atra ‘sa’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 3 . atra ‘sa’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘pittaja evāyam’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘sañcūṣyata’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘ācūṣaṇa ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘sa dahati’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘ucyate tathā tṛṣyate’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘vahninā’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . ‘tāmrābhamātraḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘pittajvare'ratyāmāśaya ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘bāhyābhyantare’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘sudustaraḥ’ iti pā. | ↩ 14 . ‘dhātukṣayokto’ iti pā. | ↩ 15 . ‘dhātvityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 16 . atra ‘kiṃvā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 17 . ‘paittiko’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 18 . ‘pūrṇakoṣṭhajaścaturthaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 19 . ‘tṛṣṇāmūrchāpralāpavān’ pā.| ↩ 20 . ‘varjayannāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 21 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ dāhanidānam||19||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 20. unmādanidānam
text: athonmādanidānam | madayantyudgatā doṣā yasmādunmārgamāgatāḥ | mānaso'yamato vyādhirunmāda iti kīrtitaḥ ||1|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 62) | madātyaye ‘unmādamiva cāparam’ ityanena unmādasaṅkīrtanamunmādasādṛśyaṃ coktaṃ, tathā madātyaye'pi dāho bhavatīti svalpavaktavyatayā dāhamabhidhāyonmādārambhaḥ, tasya niruktimāha– madayantītyādi| madayanti manovibhramaṃ kurvanti, unmārgamāgatā vimārgamāgatā manovahādhamanīranuprāptāḥ| udgatā vṛddhāḥ, athavā ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ, etenotpūrveṇaiva doṣāṇāṃ vṛddhatvaṃ vimārgagatvaṃ ca darśitam||1|| madātyaye ‘unmādamiva cāparam’ ityanenonmādasaṅkīrtanamunmādasādṛśyaṃ coktaṃ, tathā madātyaye dāho bhavatīti tulyalakṣaṇatayā dāhamabhidhāyonmādārambhaḥ, tasya niruktimāha– madayantītyādi| yasmāddoṣā madayanti manovibhramaṃ kurvanti, ato'yaṃ mānaso vyādhirunmāda iti kīrtyata iti sambandhaḥ| kīdṛśāḥ? udgatā vṛddhāḥ, athavā ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ, unmārgamāgatā vimārgagāḥ, manovahadhamanīranuprāptāḥ, tena tataḥ pūrveṇaiva doṣāṇāṃ vṛddhatvaṃ vimārgagatvaṃ ca darśitam||1|| ekaikaśaḥ sarvaśaśca doṣairatyarthamūrchitaiḥ | mānasena ca duḥkhena sa ca pañcavidho mataḥ ||2|| viṣādbhavati ṣaṣṭhaśca yathāsvaṃ tatra bheṣajam | sa cāpravṛddhastaruṇo madasañjñāṃ bibharti ca ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 62) | prakārabhedamāha– ekaikaśa ityādi| mānasena ca duḥkheneti śokādinā| sa ceti ṣaḍvidho'pi| atrāpravṛddhapadamupādāyāpi taruṇapadaprayogaṃ kurvatā suśrutena svatantro'pi doṣajanito mado bhavatīti darśitam| ata eva carake vidhiśoṇitīyādhyāye (ca. sū. a. 24) unmādāt pṛthageva paṭhitaḥ sanidānacikitsita iti||2-3|| tasya saṅkhyāmāha– ekaikaśa ityādi| vātena pittena śleṣmaṇā sarvaśa iti sannipātena, atyarthamūrchitaiḥ atipravṛddhaiḥ, mānasena tu duḥkheneti śokādinā, viṣāt ṣaṣṭho bhavati| sa cāpravṛddha iti sa ca vikāraḥ, yāvat pravṛddho vṛddhiṃ gato na bhavati, yāvacca taruṇastāvanmada iti sañjñāṃ bibharti, mada iti kathyata ityarthaḥ| suśrute svatantro'pi doṣajanito mado bhavatīti vyākhyātam| ata eva carake vidhiśoṇitīyādhyāye unmādātpṛthageva paṭhitaḥ sa nidānacikitsita iti||2-3|| viruddhaduṣṭāśucibhojanani pradharṣaṇaṃ devagurudvijānām | unmādaheturbhayaharṣapūrvo mano'bhighāto viṣamāśca ceṣṭāḥ ||4|| (ca. ci. a. 9) | sāmānyahetumāha– viruddhetyādi| duṣṭaṃ garasahitamannādi| pradharṣaṇaṃ ‘dhṛṣa’ pradharṣaṇe, ityasmāt pradharṣaṇamabhibhavaḥ| bhayaharṣapūrvo mano'bhighāta iti bhayaharṣābhyāṃ manaso'bhibhavaḥ; bhayaharṣapūrva iti bhayaṃ harṣo dvau vā pūrvaṃ yasya sa tathā; pūrvaśabdo'tra kāraṇavācī, cakāro'tra luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena kāmakrodhalobhādayo'pi kāraṇamiti jejjaṭaḥ; anye tvāhuḥ– krodhādibhirapi bhayaharṣapūrvaka eva bhavatīti tena tau nirdiṣṭau| viṣamāśca ceṣṭā iti viṣamāṅganyāsabalavadvigrahādaya unmādahetava iti yojyam||4|| tasya sāmānyahetumāha– viruddhetyādi| duṣṭaṃ garaduṣṭamannādi, aśuci bhojanaṃ cāṇḍālādispṛṣṭaṃ, pradharṣaṇaṃ nindādyabhibhavanaṃ, manobhighāta iti bhayaharṣābhyāṃ manobhibhavaḥ, bhayaharṣapūrva iti bhayaharṣau pūrvau yasva sa tathā| pūrvaśabdo'tra kāraṇavācī, cakāro'tra luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena kāmakrodhalobhādayo'pi kāraṇamiti jejjaṭaḥ| anye tvāhuḥ– krodhādibhirapi bhayaharṣapūrvaka eva bhavatīti, tena tau nirdiṣṭāviti| viṣamāśceṣṭā iti viṣamāṅganyāsabalavadvigrahādayaḥ, unmādaheturiti yojyam||4|| tairalpasattvasya malāḥ praduṣṭā buddhernivāsaṃ hṛdayaṃ pradūṣya | srotāṃsyadhiṣṭhāya manovahāni pramohayantyāśu narasya cetaḥ ||5|| (ca. ci. a. 1) | samprāptimāha– tairityādi| tairuktahetubhiḥ| alpasattvasya alpasattvaguṇasyeti cakraḥ; jejjaṭastvāha– sattvaṃ manaḥ, tasya cālpatvaṃ rajastamobhyāmāvṛtatvenālpajñānajanakatvāt| malā vātādayaḥ| buddhernivāsaṃ hṛdayamityanena hṛdayasyāśrayasya duṣṭyā tadāśritajñānasyāpi duṣṭirbhavatīti darśayati| srotāṃsi manovahānīti hṛdayāśritā daśa dhamanyaḥ; etacca viśeṣeṇa bodhyaṃ, nikhiladehasrotasāmeva mano'dhiṣṭhānatvena carake darśitatvāt| adhiṣṭhāya vyāpyetyarthaḥ||5|| samprāptimāha– tairityādi| tairuktahetubhiralpasattvasya narasya malā vātādayaḥ praduṣṭāḥ santo buddhernivāsaṃ hṛdayaṃ pradūṣya manovahāni srotāṃsi adhiṣṭhāya vyāpya āśu cetaḥ pramohayanti| alpasattvasyālpasatvaguṇasyeti cakraḥ; jejjaṭastvāha– sattvaṃ manaḥ, tasya cālpatvaṃ rajastamobhibhūtatvenālpajñānajanakatvāt| buddhernivāsaṃ hṛdayamityanena hṛdayamāśritā dhamanyaḥ, etacca viśeṣeṇa bodhyaṃ, nikhiladehasrotasāmeva manodhiṣṭhānatvena carake darśitatvāt| adhiṣṭhāya vyāpya||5|| dhīvibhramaḥ sattvapariplavaśca paryākulā dṛṣṭiradhīratā ca | abaddhavāktvaṃ hṛdayaṃ ca śūnyaṃ sāmānyamunmādagadasya liṅgam ||6|| (ca. ci. a. 9) | sāmānyarūpamāha– dhīvibhrama ityādi| etat sāmānyaṃ pūrvarūpamiti jejjaṭaḥ, sāmānyarūpamiti cakraḥ| dhīvibhramo bhrāntajñānatvam| sattvapariplavo manasaścañcalatvam| adhīratā kātaratvam| abaddhavāktvamasambaddhavacanatvam| liṅgyate'neneti liṅga, tena pūrvarūpaṃ rūpaṃ ceti vyākhyātam||6|| pūrvarūpamāha– dhītyādi| dhīvibhramo bhrāntajñānatvaṃ, sattvapariplavo manasaścañcalatvam| anye sattvaguṇasyeti| paryākulā dṛṣṭiriti ākulābalokanam| adhīratā kātaratvam| abaddhavāktvaṃ asambaddhavacanatvam| hṛdayaṃ śūnyamityantaṃ dhīvibhramatvādi sāmānyalakṣaṇamevāha||6|| rūkṣālpaśītānnavirekadhātukṣayopavāsairanilo'tivṛddhaḥ | cintādiduṣṭaṃ hṛdayaṃ pradūṣya buddhiṃ smṛtiṃ cāpyupahanti śīghram ||7|| asthānahāsasmitanṛtyagītavāgaṅgavikṣepaṇarodanāni | pāruṣyakārśyāruṇavarṇatāśca jīrṇe balaṃ cānilajasya rūpam ||8|| (ca. ci. a. 9) | vātajamāha– rūkṣetyādi| virekaśabdenātra vāntirapyabhidhīyate, virecayati dehānmalaṃ pṛthakkarotīti vyutpattyā| asthānahāsetyādi asthāne'viṣaye hāso'sthānahāsaḥ; evamasthānaśabdaḥ smitādiṣu prayojyaḥ| smitamīṣaddhāsaḥ| aṅgavikṣepo viruddhaceṣṭā| jīrṇe balamiti jīrṇe āhāre vyādherbalaṃ bhavati||7-8|| vātikamāha– rūkṣetyādi| etadvātikonmādalakṣaṇam| rūkṣālpaśītānnairbhojyaiḥ| virekaśabdenātra vāntirapyabhidhīyate, virecayati dehānmalaṃ pṛthak karotīti vyākhyānāt| dhātukṣayo rasādidhātukṣayaḥ| etairduṣṭo vāyuścintāśokādiduṣṭaṃ hṛdayaṃ manaḥ praviśya buddhiṃ smṛtiṃ ca śīghramupahanti| anubhūtārthasmaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ| asthānahāsyaṃ aviṣaye hāsyam| evamasthānaśabdaḥ smitādiṣu yojyaḥ| smitamīṣaddhāsaḥ, aṅgavikṣepaṇaṃ viruddhaceṣṭā, pāruṣyaṃ raukṣyaṃ, kārśyaṃ kṛśatā, aruṇavarṇatā īṣadraktavarṇatā, jīrṇe balamiti jīrṇe āhāre vyādherbalaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ||7-8|| ajīrṇakaṭvamlavidāhyaśītairbhojyaiścitaṃ pittamudīrṇavegam | unmādamatyugramanātmakasya hṛdi sthitaṃ pūrvavadāśu kuryāt ||9|| amarṣasaṃrambhavinagnabhāvāḥ santarjanātidravaṇauṣṇyaroṣāḥ | pracchāyaśītānnajalābhilāṣaḥ pītā ca bhāḥ pittakṛtasya liṅgam ||10|| (ca. ci. a. 9) | pittajamāha– ajīrṇetyādi| aśītairiti uṣṇaiḥ| unmādamatyugramiti atyugraṃ tīvravegam, ‘unmādayatyugram’ iti pāṭhāntare ugraṃ yathā bhavati tathā unmādaṃ janayati| anātmakasya anātmavataḥ| pūrvavaditi cintādiduṣṭahṛdayasya buddhyādikamupahatyetyādisamprāptyā| kuryāditi vakṣyamāṇaṃ liṅgamiti śeṣaḥ| atra pakṣe kiṃ talliṅgamityāha– amarṣetyādi– amarṣo'sahiṣṇutvaṃ, na tu roṣaḥ; tasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt| saṃrambha ārabhaṭī; vinagnabhāvo nagnatvam| santarjanaṃ paritrāsanam, atidravaṇaṃ palāyanam, auṣṇyaṃ gātrasya; ‘auṣṭhyam iti pāṭhāntare vikṛtauṣṭhatvam| pracchāyaśītānnajalābhilāṣa iti chāyāyāṃ śītayorannajalayorabhilāṣaḥ||9-10|| paittikamāha– ajīrṇetyādi| ajīrṇādibhiścitaṃ sañcayatāṃ gatam| udīrṇavegaṃ pittaṃ pūrvavat cintādiduṣṭahṛdayasya buddhyādikamupahanti| ajīrṇamavidagdham, aśītaiḥ uṣṇaiḥ, ugraṃ tīvraṃ yathā bhavati tathā unmādaṃ janayati| anātmakasya anātmavataḥ| amarṣaṃ asahiṣṇutvaṃ, saṃrambha ārabhaṭī, hastapādādivikṣepaṇamityanye| vinagnabhāvo vastrādityāgaḥ| santarjanaṃ paritrāsanaṃ bhartsanamaparasyetyarthaḥ| abhidravaṇaṃ palāyanam| auṣṇyaṃ gātrasya, ‘auṣṭhyam’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatra vikṛtauṣṭhatvam| coṣo dāhaviśeṣaḥ| pracchāyetyādi chāyāyāḥ śītayoścānnajalayorabhilāṣaḥ| pītā ca bhāḥ pītavarṇatā||9-10|| sampūraṇairmandaviceṣṭitasya soṣmā kapho marmaṇi sampraduṣṭaḥ | buddhiṃ smṛtiṃ cāpyupahatya cittaṃ pramohayan sañjanayedvikāram ||11|| vākceṣṭitaṃ mandamarocakaśca nārīviviktapriyatā'tinidrā | chardiśca lālā ca balaṃ ca bhukte nakhādiśauklyaṃ ca kaphātmake syāt | (ca. ci. a. 9) ||12|| kaphajamāha– sampūraṇairityādi| mandaviceṣṭitasya āyāsaśūnyasya| sampūraṇairbhojanādibhiḥ, kapho duṣṭa iti sambandhaḥ| soṣmā sapittaḥ| kaphenāpi kriyamāṇa unmādo'vaśyaṃ sapittena kriyate vyādhimahimnā, yathā mūrchā| anye tvāhuḥ– kevalakaphenāpi kriyate, soṣmapadena tu dvandvajo'pi bhavatīti sūcyate| anye tvāhuḥ– ūṣmaśabdena śaktirucyate, tenotkṛṣṭaśaktikaḥ kapha ityarthaḥ| marmaṇīti hṛdaye| vikāramunmādam| vāgityādi nārīviviktapriyateti nārīpriyatā vijanapriyatā ca| balaṃ ca bhukte iti ‘vyādheḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| nakhādītyādiśabdena tvaṅmūtranetrādīnāṃ grahaṇam||11-12|| ślaiṣmikamāha– sampūraṇairityādi| mandaviceṣṭitasya āyāsaśūnyasya; sampūraṇairatibhojanādibhiḥ kapho duṣṭa iti sambandhaḥ| soṣmā sapittaḥ| kaphenāpi kriyamāṇa unmādo'vaśyaṃ sapittena kriyate vyādhimahimnā, yathā mūrchā| anye tvāhuḥ– kevalenāpi kaphena sa kriyate, soṣmapadena tu dvandvajo'pi bhavatīti sūcyate| anye tvāhuḥ– ūṣmaśabdena śaktirucyate, tenotkṛṣṭaśaktikaḥ kapha ityarthaḥ| marmaṇi hṛdaye| cittaṃ pramohayan buddhiṃ smṛtiṃ copahatya vikāramunmādam| vākceṣṭitaṃ mandam| alpam arocakatā| nārīviviktapriyatā nārīpriyatā, vijanapriyatā ca| nidrābāhulyaṃ tathā chardiḥ, lālāsrāvaśca balaṃ ca bhuṅkte nāśayati, ‘vyādheḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| nakhanetrādīnāṃ śauklyam||11-12|| yaḥ sannipātaprabhavo'tighoraḥ sarvaiḥ samastaiḥ sa ca hetubhiḥ syāt | sarvāṇi rūpāṇi bibharti tādṛgviruddhabhaiṣajyavidhirvivarjyaḥ ||13|| (ca. ci. a. 9) | sānnipātikamāha– ya ityādi| sarvaiḥ samastairiti sarvairiti kṛtvā'pi yat samastairiti karoti tenaivaṃ bodhayati– vātādayo'nekaiḥ svanidānaiḥ kupitā unmādaṃ janayanti, natu pratyekamekanidānakupitāḥ| viruddhabhaiṣajyavidhirvivarjya iti ayamabhisandhiḥ– tridoṣaje pratyekaṃ vātādipratyanīkā kriyā kāryā, sā ca parasparavirodhinī, tridoṣaharaṃ ca kiñcideva dravyamāmalakyādi, tattu nātra yaugikaṃ “na hi sarvāṇi sarvatra yaugikāni bhavanti” iti vacanāt| nanu, yadyevaṃ tadā sarva eva hi tridoṣajavikārā asādhyāḥ bhaveyurityata uktam– tādṛgiti| ko'pyayaṃ samprāptiviśeṣo rogaviśeṣo vā, yenāyaṃ viruddhabhaiṣajyavidhirna tu sarva ityarthaḥ| anye tvāhuḥ– sarvaiḥ samastairhetubhiryaiḥ kṛtaḥ sa evāsādhyaḥ, na tvalpahetukṛta iti||13|| sānnipātikamāha– ya ityādi| sannipātagrahaṇenaiva sarvātmakatvaṃ labdhaṃ punaḥ sarvairiti yadgrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tadrajastamograhaṇārthaṃ, tena rajastamomilitairityarthaḥ; tena vātādayo rajastamobhiḥ manodoṣairmilitāḥ samastaiśca nidānaiḥ kupitā unmādaṃ janayanti| sarvāṇi rūpāṇi sarvadoṣalakṣaṇāni bibharti| tādṛgiti tādṛśaḥ| ko'pyeṣa tridoṣasamprāptiviśeṣo rogaviśeṣo vā, yenāyaṃ viruddhabhaiṣajyavidhirvivarjyaḥ; viruddhabhaiṣajyavidhiriti ko'rthaḥ? tridoṣaje pratyekaṃ vātādipratyanīkā kriyā kāryā, sā ca parasparavirodhinī, tridoṣaharaṃ ca kiñcideva dravyamāmalakādi, tacca nātra yaugikamityarthaḥ||13|| corairnarendrapuruṣairaribhistathā'nyairvitrāsitasya dhanabāndhavasaṅkṣayādvā | gāḍhaṃ kṣate manasi ca priyayā riraṃsorjāyeta cotkaṭatamo manaso vikāraḥ ||14|| citraṃ bravīti ca mano'nugataṃ visañjño gāyatyatho hasati roditi cāpi mūḍhaḥ | (su. u. taṃ. a. 62) | śokādijamāha– corairityādi| kṣate upahate, priyayā riraṃsoḥ kāmukasya aprāptayā priyayā kṣate manasīti sambandhaḥ| tasya lakṣaṇamāha– citramityādi| citraṃ vividham| mano'nugataṃ gopyamapi| visañjño viparītajñānaḥ, ata eva mūḍhaḥ||14||– manoduḥkhajamāha– caurairityādi| narendrapuruṣaiḥ nṛpādhikāribhiḥ, aribhiḥ, anyairiti siṃhagajādibhiḥ, vitrāsitasya krodhaśastrādibhiḥ; dravyavināśāt putrādimaraṇādvā, tathā riraṃsoḥ kāmukasya priyāyā aprāptyā, gāḍhaṃ kṣate manasīti sambandhaḥ| tasya rūpamāha– citramityādinā| citraṃ vividhaṃ mano'nugataṃ gopyamapi bravīti| visañjño viparītajñānaḥ, ata eva mūḍhaḥ||14||– raktekṣaṇo hatabalendriyabhāḥ sudīnaḥ śyāvānano viṣakṛte'tha bhavedvisañjñaḥ ||15|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 62) | viṣajamāha– raktekṣaṇa ityādi| hatabalendriyabhā iti hataṃ balamindriyāṇi bhāśca yasya sa tathā| bhā dīptiḥ||15|| raktekṣaṇa ityādi| hataṃ balamindriyāṇi bhāḥ śarīradīptiśca yasya sa tathā| śyāvānanaḥ kṛṣṇamukhaḥ viṣajanitonmādena||15|| avāñcī vā'pyudañcī vā kṣīṇamāṃsabalo naraḥ | jāgarūko hyasandehamunmādena vinaśyati ||16|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 62) | asādhyalakṣaṇamāha– avāñcītyādi| avāñcī adhomukhaḥ, udañcī ūrdhvamukhaḥ, ata evānye ‘avāṅmukhastūnmukho vā’ iti paṭhanti| jāgarūko'nidraḥ||16|| asādhyalakṣaṇamāha– avāñcītyādi| avāñcī avāṅmukhaḥ, udañcī ūrdhvamukhaḥ| ‘avāṅmukhastūnmukho vā’ iti kecitpaṭhanti| kṣīṇaṃ māṃsaṃ balamojaśca yasya sa tathā| jāgarūkaḥ gatanidraḥ||16|| amartyavāgvikramavīryaceṣṭo jñānādivijñānabalādibhiryaḥ | unmādakālo'niyataśca tasya bhūtotthamunmādamudāharettam ||17|| (ca. ci. a. 9) | bhautikonmādasya sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha– amartyavāgityādi| amartyā amanuṣyā anucitā vā vāgādayo yasya sa tathā| vikramaḥ parākramaḥ, vīryaṃ śaktiḥ, ceṣṭā śārīrikī kriyā| jñānādivijñānabalādibhiriti upalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā| jñānaṃ tattvajñānaṃ, vijñānaṃ śilpādijñānaṃ; kiṃvā jñānaṃ śāstrajñānaṃ, vijñānaṃ tadarthaniścayaḥ; ādiśabdena smṛtyādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ, teṣāṃ balam| aniyata iti na vātajādivadāhārajīrṇādikālavat kālaniyamaḥ| niyata iti pāṭhe tu vakṣyamāṇaniyatatithyādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ “devagrahāḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ” ityādi| bhūtaśabdenātra sarva eva vakṣyamāṇā devadayo'bhidhīyante||17|| bhūtajamunmādamāha– amartyavāgityādi| amartyānāmamanuṣyāṇāmanucitā vāgādayo yasya sa tathā| vikramaḥ parākramaḥ, vīryaṃ śaktiḥ, ceṣṭā śarīrakriyā| jñānādivijñānabalādibhiriti upalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā| jñānaṃ tatvajñānaṃ, vijñānaṃ śilpādijñānaṃ, kiṃvā jñānaṃ śāstraṃ, vijñānaṃ tadarthaniścayaḥ| ādiśabdena smṛtyādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ, teṣāṃ balam| aniyata iti kadācinmadhyāhne, kadācitpradoṣe, na tu vātādijavadāhārajīrṇādikālaniyamaḥ, taṃ bhūtotthamunmādaṃ kathayet| ‘niyatā’ iti pāṭhe tu vakṣyamāṇaniyatatithyādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ, devagrahāḥ paurṇamāsyāmityādi| bhūtaśabdenātra sarve vakṣyamāṇā devādayo'bhidhīyante||17|| santuṣṭaḥ śuciratidivyamālyagandho nistandrīravitathasaṃskṛtaprabhāṣī | tejasvī sthiranayano varapradātā brahmaṇyo bhavati naraḥ sa devajuṣṭaḥ ||18|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) | devajuṣṭamāha– santuṣṭa ityādi| atidivyamālyagandha iti atimātro divyamālyasyeva gandho yasya sa tathā| nistandrīḥ anidraḥ| avitathaṃ satyam| videhe'pi “niḥsvapnaṃ satyasaṃskṛtabhāṣiṇam” iti paṭhitam| brahmaṇyo brāhmaṇānuraktaḥ| devajuṣṭo devagrahapīḍitaḥ| devagrahaṇena gaṇamātṛkādayo'pi grāhyāḥ| videhe'pi paṭhyate “krodhanaḥ srastasarvāṅgo lālāphenāvilānanaḥ| nidrāluḥ kampano mūko gaṇamātṛbhirarditaḥ||” iti||18|| devajuṣṭamāha– santuṣṭa ityādi| santuṣṭaḥ santoṣavān| śuciḥ snānācamanādinā| atimātraṃ divyamālyasyeva gandho yasya sa tathā| nistandrīḥ nidrārahitaḥ, avitathaṃ satyaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ ca prabhāṣata iti| videhe'pyuktam– “niḥsvapnaṃ satyasaṃskṛtabhāṣaṇam” iti| tejasvī tejoyuktaḥ, sthiranayanaḥ nimeṣarahitaḥ, varadātā yataḥ brahmaṇyaḥ brāhmaṇānuraktaḥ| devabhūtajuṣṭaḥ devagrahapīḍitaḥ| devagrahaṇena gaṇamātṛkādayo grāhyāḥ| yaduktaṃ videhe– “krodhanaḥ stabdhasarvāṅgo lālāphenāvilānanaḥ| nidrāluḥ kampano mūko gaṇamātṛbhirarditaḥ” iti||18|| saṃsvedī dvijagurudevadoṣavaktā jihmākṣo vigatabhayo vimārgadṛṣṭiḥ | santuṣṭo na bhavati cānnapānajātairduṣṭātmā bhavati sa devaśatrujuṣṭaḥ ||19|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) | devaśatrujuṣṭamāha– saṃsvedītyādi||19|| asurajuṣṭamāha– saṃsvedītyādi| yaḥ saṃsvedī svedavān, brāhmaṇagurudevānāṃ nindakaḥ, jihmākṣaḥ kuṭiladṛṣṭiḥ, vimārgadṛṣṭiḥ, śrutidharmanindakaḥ; annaṃ śālimāṃsādi, pānaṃ kṣīramadyādi, taiḥ santuṣṭo na bhavati| duṣṭātmā pāpabuddhiḥ| evaṃvidho devaśatrujuṣṭo bhavati||19|| hṛṣṭātmā pulinavanāntaropasevī svācāraḥ priyaparigītagandhamālyaḥ | nṛtyan vai prahasati cāru cālpaśabdaṃ gandharvagrahaparipīḍito manuṣyaḥ ||20|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) | gandharvāviṣṭamāha– hṛṣṭetyādi| pulinaṃ toyojjhitaṃ taṭam, antaraṃ madhyaṃ viśeṣo vā| svācāro'ninditācāraḥ| priyetyādi priyāṇi pari sarvato gītagandhamālyāni yasya sa tathā| nṛtyannityādi cāru (yathā bhavati tathā) nṛtyannalpaśabdaṃ yathā bhavati tathā prahasatīti yojyam||20|| gandharvāviṣṭamāha– hṛṣṭātmetyādi| hṛṣṭātmā cintādirahitaḥ santuṣṭātmā| pulinaṃ nadyāditaṭaṃ, vanamudyānaṃ, tayorantaraṃ madhyaṃ, tadviśeṣāt sevata iti| svācāraḥ aninditācāraḥ| priyāṇi pari samantatobhāvena gītagandhamālyāni yasya sa tathā| nṛtyannityādi cāru yathā bhavati tathā nṛtyan; alpaśabdo yathā bhavati tathā prahasanniti yojyam||20|| tāmrākṣaḥ priyatanuraktavastradhārī gambhīro drutagatiralpavāksahiṣṇuḥ | tejasvī vadati ca kiṃ dadāmi kasmai yo yakṣagrahaparipīḍito manuṣyaḥ ||21|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) | yakṣāviṣṭamāha– tāmrākṣa ityādi| priyetyādi priyaṃ śobhanaṃ, tanu sūkṣmaṃ raktaṃ ca vastraṃ dhartuṃ śīlaṃ yasya sa tathā||21|| yakṣajuṣṭamāha– tāmrākṣa ityādi| tāmrākṣo raktanetraḥ| priyaṃ śobhanaṃ tanu sūkṣmaṃ raktavastraṃ dhartuṃ śīlaṃ yasya sa tathā| gambhīraḥ anākulitāntaḥkaraṇaḥ, drutagatiḥ uttālagatiḥ; alpavāk alpabhāṣī, sahiṣṇuḥ sahanaśīlaḥ| kasmai kiṃ dadāmītyevaṃ vadati||21|| pretānāṃ sa diśati saṃstareṣu piṇḍān śāntātmā jalamapi cāpasavyavastraḥ | māṃsepsustilaguḍapāyasābhikāmastadbhakto bhavati pitṛgrahābhijuṣṭaḥ ||22|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) | pitṛjuṣṭamāha– pretānāmityādi| pretānāṃ mṛtapitṝṇāṃ, sambandhamātravivakṣayā na caturthī| diśati dadāti| saṃstareṣu kuśapatrādiracitāstaraṇeṣu| apasavyavastro vāmottarīyaḥ| māṃsepsurityādi| etadabhidhānaprayojanaṃ yasmin yasyecchā bhavati tasya tenaiva balirdātavyaḥ; evamanyatrāpi draṣṭavyam| tadbhaktaḥ pitṛbhaktaḥ||22|| pitṛgrahajuṣṭamāha– pretānāmityādi| pretānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ, sambandhamātrasya vivakṣitatvānna caturthī| diśati dadāti, saṃstareṣu kuśapatrādiracitasaṃstaraṇeṣu, piṇḍān annamayān, śāntātmā śāntasvabhāvaḥ, jalamapi ceti na paraṃ darbhasaṃstareṣu piṇḍān apasavyavastro vāmottarīyo dadāti kintu jalamapi cetyarthaḥ| ‘apasavyahastaḥ’ iti pāṭhe dakṣiṇahastaḥ| māṃsepsurityādi etadabhidhānaprayojanaṃ yasya yatrecchā bhavati tasya tenaiva balirdātavyaḥ| evamanyatrāpi draṣṭavyam| pāyasaḥ kṣīrasiddhāstaṇḍulāḥ, abhikāmo'bhilāṣukaḥ| tadbhaktaḥ pitṛbhaktaḥ; tadbhaktaḥ tilādibhojana iti ḍalhaṇaḥ||22|| yastūrvyāṃ prasarati sarpavat kadācit sṛkkaṇyau vilihati jihvayā tathaiva | krodhālurguḍamadhudugdhapāyasepsurjñātavyo bhavati bhujaṅgamena juṣṭaḥ ||23|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) | nāgāviṣṭamāha– yastvityādi| prasarati sarpavaditi urasā gacchati| sṛkkaṇyau oṣṭhaprāntau| sṛkkaṇīśabda īkārānto'pyastītyunneyam||23|| sarpagrahajuṣṭamāha– ya ityādi| urvyāṃ bhūmau sarpavadurasā gacchati, sṛkkaṇyau oṣṭhaprāntau jihvayā vilihati| krodhāluḥ kopanaḥ, guḍādipriyaḥ, bhujaṅgamagraheṇa juṣṭo jñeyaḥ||23|| māṃsāsṛgvividhasurāvikāralipsurnirlajjo bhṛśamatiniṣṭhuro'tiśūraḥ | krodhālurvipulabalo niśāvihārī śaucadviḍ bhavati sa rākṣasairgṛhītaḥ ||24|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) | rākṣasāviṣṭamāha– māṃsetyādi| niśāvihārī niśāyāmeva bhramaṇaśīlaḥ| rākṣasaśabdena brahmarākṣasādayo'pi grāhyāḥ| tathā rākṣasānantaraṃ videho'pi paṭhati– “devavipragurudveṣī vedavedāṅganindakaḥ| ātmapīḍākaro hāsī brahmarākṣasasevitaḥ||” iti||24|| rākṣasajuṣṭamāha– māṃsetyādi| vividhasurāvikārāḥ paiṣṭīprabhṛtayaḥ, bhṛśamatiśayena lajjārahitaḥ, atiniṣṭhuraḥ dayārahitaḥ, vipulabalaḥ annādvinā'pi prabhūtabalaḥ, niśāvihārī niśāyāmeva bhramaṇaśīlaḥ, śaucadviṭ aśuciḥ| rākṣasagrahaṇena brahmarākṣasādayo'pi gṛhyante| yato rākṣasānantaraṃ videhe paṭhyate– “devavipragurudveṣī vedavedāṅganindakaḥ| ātmapīḍākaro hāsī brahmarākṣasasevitaḥ” iti||24|| uddhastaḥ kṛśaparuṣo acirapralāpī durgandho bhṛśamaśucistathā'tilolaḥ | bahvāśī vijanavanāntaropasevī vyāceṣṭan bhramati rudan piśācajuṣṭaḥ ||25|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) | piśācāviṣṭamāha– uddhasta ityādi| uddhasta ūrdhvabāhuḥ; ‘udvastra’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ nyāyyaṃ, videhe'pi digambarapāṭhāt; udvastro nagnaḥ| paruṣo rūkṣaḥ| lolaḥ sarvasminnanne pāne ca satṛṣṇaḥ| ‘loluḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare sa evārthaḥ| vyāceṣṭanniti viruddhamāceṣṭan||25|| piśācajuṣṭamāha– uddhasta ityādi| uddhasta ūrdhvabāhuḥ| ‘udvastraḥ’ iti pāṭhe udvastro nagnaḥ, videhe'pi digambara iti pāṭhāt| kṛśo nirmāṃsaḥ, paruṣo rūkṣaḥ, viruddhalāpī viruddhabhāṣī| ‘acirapralāpī’ iti pāṭhāntaram| durgandhaḥ, atilolaḥ sarvasminnannapāne satṛṣṇaḥ, aticapala ityanye; ‘atiloluḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare aśanalolupa ityarthaḥ| bahvāśī pracurabhoktā| vijanaṃ nirjanasthānaṃ, himāmbu śītāmbu, tayoḥ sevī, rātreḥ sevī rātrivicārītyarthaḥ| ‘vijanavanāntaropasevī’ iti pāṭhāntaram| vyāceṣṭan vividhaṃ ceṣṭan; ‘vyāceṣṭam’ iti pāṭhāntare viruddhaceṣṭaṃ yathā bhavati tathā bhramati||25|| sthūlākṣo drutamaṭanaḥ sa phenalehī nidrāluḥ patati ca kampate ca yo hi | yaścādridviradanagādivicyutaḥ syāt so'sādhyo bhavati tathā trayodaśābde ||26|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) | trividhaṃ hi hiṃsākrīḍāpūjārthaṃ grahā gṛhṇanti| yaduktam– “aśuciṃ bhinnamaryādaṃ kṣataṃ vā yadi vā'kṣatam| hiṃsyurhiṃsāvihārārthaṃ satkārārthamathāpi ca||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) iti| tatra hiṃsārthaṃ gṛhīto'sādhyo bhavati, tasya ślokārdhadvayena lakṣaṇamāha– sthūlākṣa ityādi| sthūlākṣo vikṛtanetra iti jejjaṭaḥ| drutamaṭano drutagatiḥ, ata eva ‘tvaritagatiḥ’ iti jejjaṭena paṭhitam| yaścetyādi| parvatādipatitaḥ san yo gṛhyate so'pyasādhyaḥ, nago vṛkṣaḥ| sarva evonmādī trayodaśe'bde devatādigṛhīto'pyasādhyaḥ| videhe'dhikamapyasādhyalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhyate– “meḍhrapravṛttaḥ kṣatajaḥ sāsrākṣaḥ srutanāsikaḥ| rūkṣajihvaḥ pūtigarbho hatavāgatidurbalaḥ||” ityādi||26|| trividhaṃ hi hiṃsākrīḍāpūjārthaṃ grahā gṛhṇanti| yaduktam– “aśuciṃ bhinnamaryādaṃ kṣataṃ vā yadi vā'kṣatam| hiṃsyurhiṃsāvihārārthaṃ satkārārthamathāpi ca” iti| asyārthaḥ bhinnamaryādaṃ śrutismṛtyuditakarmaṇo'nyatra karmaṇi pravṛttaṃ abhakṣyāgamyāhiṃsādipravṛttatvāt| kṣataṃ savraṇaṃ, māṃsaśoṇitapriyatvāt| akṣatamapi śaucādirahitam| atra vihāraśabdena ratirabhidhīyate| satkāraḥ pūjā| tatra hiṃsārthaṃ gṛhīto'sādhyo bhavati| tasya lakṣaṇamāha– sthūlākṣa ityādi| sthūlākṣo vivṛtanetraḥ, vidrutagatiḥ, yaścātikampate so'sādhyaḥ| yaścaitebhyaḥ patitaḥ syāt so'pyasādhyaḥ| adriḥ parvataḥ, dvirado gajaḥ, nago vṛkṣaḥ| ādigrahaṇāt taṭaprāsādādayo gṛhyante sarvatronmādāditi śeṣaḥ| etebhyaḥ patitaḥ syādityarthaḥ| trayodaśe varṣe devādigṛhīto'pyasādhyaḥ| videhe'dhikamapyasādhyalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhitaṃ yathā– “meḍhrapravṛttaḥ kṣatajaḥ sāsrākṣaḥ srutanāsikaḥ| rūkṣajihvaḥ pūtigarbho hatavāgatidurbalaḥ” ityādi||26|| devagrahāḥ paurṇamāsyāmasurāḥ sandhyayorapi | gandharvāḥ prāyaśo'ṣṭamyāṃ, yakṣāśca pratipadyatha ||27|| pitryāḥ kṛṣṇakṣaye hiṃsyuḥ, pañcamyāmapi coragāḥ | rakṣāṃsi rātrau, paiśācāścaturdaśyāṃ viśanti hi ||28|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) | devādīnāṃ grahaṇakālamāha– devagrahāḥ ityādi| paurṇamāsyāṃ pūrṇimāyām| kṛṣṇakṣaye'māvāsyāyām| prāyograhaṇādanyatrāpi| tithyabhidhānaprayojanaṃ lakṣaṇārthaṃ, tattithau balidānārthaṃ ca||27-28|| idānīṃ devagrahāṇāṃ grahaṇakālamāha– devagrahā ityādi| devagrahāḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ viśanti anupraveśaṃ kurvanti| asurā asuragrahāḥ| sandhyayorapītyapiśabdaḥ pādapūraṇe; anye apiśabdāt paurṇamāsyāmapi gṛhṇantīti varṇayanti| prāyaśo'ṣṭamyāmiti prāyaḥśabdāt sandhyayorapi gandharvā viśantīti labhyate| pitryāḥ pitṛgrahāḥ| kṛṣṇakṣaye kṛṣṇapakṣakṣaye, amāvāsyāyāmityarthaḥ| prāyograhaṇādanyatrāpi| pañcamyāmapītyapiśabdāt kṛṣṇakṣaye'pi| uragā nāgagrahāḥ| tithyabhidhānaprayojanaṃ lakṣaṇārthaṃ, teṣāṃ tithau balidānārthaṃ ca| tathā coktam– “grahā gṛhṇanti ye yeṣu teṣāṃ teṣu viśeṣataḥ| dineṣu balihomādīn prayuñjīta cikitsakaḥ||” iti||27-28|| darpaṇādīn yathā chāyā śītoṣṇaṃ prāṇino yathā | svamaṇiṃ bhāskarārciśca yathā dehaṃ ca dehadhṛk | viśanti ca na dṛśyante grahāstadvaccharīriṇaḥ ||29|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) | praviśyāśu śarīraṃ hi pīḍāṃ kurvanti duḥsahām ||30|| nanu, yadi grahāviṣṭānāṃ puṃsāmunmādaḥ syāt, tadā viśanto grahāḥ kuto na lakṣyante? ityata āha– darpaṇādīnityādi| asmadādidarśanāyogyatvānna dṛśyanta ityarthaḥ| ādiśabdena prakāravācināṃ jalatailādīnāṃ grahaṇam| chāyā pratikṛtiḥ| śītoṣṇamiti kartṛpadaṃ, prāṇina iti karmapadam| svamaṇimiti sūryakāntam| dehadhṛk ātmā, mana iti jejjaṭaḥ| anekadṛṣṭāntaprayojanaṃ jejjaṭalikhitaṃ taccātrānupayuktatvena vistarabhayānna likhitam| devaśabdena cātra devasyānucarā devasadharmāṇo gṛhyante, devānāṃ manuṣyaśarīreṇāśucinā sambandhābhāvāt| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “na te manuṣyaiḥ saha saṃviśanti na te manuṣyān kvacidāviśanti| ye tvāviśantīti vadanti mohātte bhūtavidyāviṣayādapetāḥ||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 60) iti||29-30|| nanu, yadi grahāviṣṭānāṃ puṃsāmunmādaḥ syāt, tadā viśanto grahāḥ kuto na lakṣyante? ityata āha– darpaṇādīnityādi| asmadādidarśanāyogyatvānna dṛśyante| ādiśabdena prakāravācinā jalatailādīnāṃ grahaṇam| chāyā pratikṛtiḥ| śītoṣṇamiti kartṛpadaṃ, prāṇina iti karmapadam| svamaṇimiti sūryakāntam| dehadhṛk atmā, mana iti jejjaṭaḥ| anekadṛṣṭāntaprayojanaṃ jejjaṭena niścitaṃ, taccātrānupayuktatvena likhitaṃ vistarabhayācca| nanu bhūtaiḥ śarīre'nupraveśaḥ kriyate na tu śarīriṇi, tatkathaṃ śarīriṇa ityabhidhānaṃ na virudhyate? ucyate– śarīriśabdenātra śarīramabhipretaṃ, sthānini sthānopacārāt; yathā– mañcāḥ krośantīti| yathā chāyāśītoṣṇādayo darpaṇaprāṇiprabhṛtīn viśanto na dṛśyante tadvadgrahā ityarthaḥ| devādiśabdenātra devasyānucarā devasadharmāṇo gṛhyante, devādīnāṃ manuṣyaśarīreṇāśucinā sambandhābhāvāt| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “na te manuṣyaiḥ saha” ityādi||29-30|| tapāṃsi tīvrāṇi tathaiva dānaṃ vratāni dharmo niyamaśca satyam | guṇāstathā'ṣṭāvapi teṣu nityā vyastāḥ samastāśca yathāprabhāvam ||31|| na te manuṣyaiḥ saha saṃviśanti na vā manuṣyān kvacidāviśanti | ye tvāviśantīti vadanti mohātte bhūtavidyāviṣayādapohyāḥ ||32|| teṣāṃ grahāṇāṃ paricārakā ye koṭīsahasrāyutapadmasaṅkhyāḥ | asṛgvasāmāṃsabhujaḥ subhīmā niśāvihārāśca tathā''viśanti ||33|| idānīṃ grahāṇāṃ tīvratapādi yamādiyuktāṃ prabhāvavattāṃ suśrutoktena ślokatrayeṇa darśayitumāha– tapāṃsītyādi| tapastāpanalakṣaṇamupavāsādi, vratāni śāstroditavidhinā bhojanādiniyamanāni, karma kāyavāṅmanasāṃ sucaritam| guṇāstathāṣṭāviti aṇimā 1, mahimā 2, laghimā 3, prākāmyaṃ 4, prākāśyam 5, īśitvaṃ 6, vaśitvaṃ 7, yatra kāmāvasāyitvaṃ 8, ceti| anye tu– “āveśaścetaso jñānamarthānāṃ śabdanakriyā| dṛṣṭiḥ śrotraṃ smṛtiḥ kāntiriṣṭataścāpyadarśanam||” ityaṣṭavidhamaiśvaryamāhuḥ| teṣu graheṣu ete guṇā nityāḥ, na kādācitkāḥ, vyastā dvitricatvāra ityādi; samastāḥ sarve; yo yasya prabhāva iti yathāprabhāvaṃ; tatra vyastā guṇā asurādigrahāṇāṃ, samastā devagrahāṇām| atha te niyamādiyuktāścet kathamaśuciṃ dehamāviśanti, na kathañcana, ata evāha– netyādi| te devādayo manuṣyaiḥ saha na viśanti na ekībhavantītyarthaḥ| na vā manuṣyān mānuṣadehān, kvacidapyanupraviśantītyarthaḥ| ye punarvaidyā ‘āviśanti’ iti mohādajñānāt pravadanti, te vaidyā bhūtavidyāviṣayāttajjñānādapohyā apasāraṇīyāstyājyā ityarthaḥ| ke tarhi gṛhṇantītyāha– teṣāmiti teṣāṃ devādīnāṃ paricārakāḥ preṣyāḥ, karmakarā ityarthaḥ| koṭyaḥ śatalakṣapramāṇāḥ, ayutaṃ daśasahasram, etena koṭighnaṃ śatalakṣapramāṇaguṇitaṃ yat sahasraṃ tādṛśaiḥ daśabhiḥ sahasrairatrāyutaṃ boddhavyaṃ; teṣāṃ padmaṃ, padmaṃ caturdaśabindukaṃ, tadeva saṅkhyā yeṣāṃ te tathā| subhīmā atyarthaṃ bhayānakāḥ| niśāvihārā rātrau bhramaṇaśīlāḥ||31-33|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāna unmādanidānaṃ samāptam||20|| ||20|| iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāmunmādanidānaṃ samāptam||20|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāmunmādanidānam||20|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘ ... unmārgamāśritāḥ’ iti pā. | ↩ 2 . ‘alpavaktavyatayā’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘manovahādhamanīranuprāptāḥ unmārgamāgatā vimārgamāgatā|’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘tena tataḥ pūrveṇaiva’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘ityanyenonmāda ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . atra ‘dvau’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘asthānahāsyasmita ... ’ iti pā. | ↩ 8 . agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 9 . ‘hāsyo'sthānahāsyaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . ‘paratrāsanam’ iti pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘yadā’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘tadā’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘bhuṅkte’ iti pā. | ↩ 14 . ‘vāgityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 15 . ‘bhuṅkte’ iti pā.| ↩ 16 . ‘arocakatā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 17 . ‘nāśayati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 18 . ‘kṛtvā’ iti pā.| ↩ 19 . ‘vātātipratyanīkā’ iti pā.| ↩ 20 . atra ‘tu’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 21 . ‘cauraiḥ ... ’ iti pā. | ↩ 22 . ‘cauraiḥ ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 23 . ‘copahate’ iti pā.| ↩ 24 . ‘tathā’ iti pā.| ↩ 25 . ‘coraiḥ ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 26 . atra ‘raktekṣaṇa ityādi’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 27 . ‘avāṅmukhastūnmukho vā’ iti pā. | ↩ 28 . ‘balamojo’ iti pā.| ↩ 29 . ‘yasya’ iti pā. | ↩ 30 . ‘śāstram’ iti pā.| ↩ 31 . ‘kālaniścayaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 32 . ‘devagrahāḥ paurṇamāsyām’ ityasya sthāne ‘devagrahā paurṇamāsyādi’ iti pā.| ↩ 33 . ‘toyotthitataṭam’ iti pā.| ↩ 34 . ‘yathā bhavati tathā’ etadagrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 35 . ‘gandharvajuṣṭamāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 36 . ‘toyojjhitaṃ taṭam’ iti pā.| ↩ 37 . ‘pitṝṇām’ iti pā.| ↩ 38 . ‘sambandhavivakṣitatvāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 39 . ‘sṛkkiṇyau’ iti pā.| ↩ 40 . ‘rākṣasāntaram’ iti pā.| ↩ 41 . ‘ ... vicchuciḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 42 . ‘ ... viruddhalāpi’ iti pā. | ↩ 43 . ‘vijanavanāmburātrisevī’ iti pā. | ↩ 44 . ‘vyāceṣṭanan’ iti pā. | ↩ 45 . ‘udbāhuḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 46 . atra ‘nagnaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 47 . ‘salobhaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 48 . etacca– ‘vijanahimāmburātrisevī’ iti pā.|| ↩ 49 . ‘vivṛtanetra’ iti pā.| ↩ 50 . ‘yaścātikampate so'sādhyaḥ’ ityasya sthāne ‘kampate ca yo'ti’ iti pā.| ↩ 51 . atra ‘sarvatronmādāditi śeṣaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 52 . ‘nopalabhyante’ iti pā.| ↩ 53 . ‘ataḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 54 . ‘devādyanucarā’ iti pā.| ↩ 55 . ‘taccātrānupayogitvānna’ iti pā.| ↩ 56 . ‘tīvratamāni’ iti pā.| ↩ 57 . ‘dharmaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 58 . atra ‘teṣāmiti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 59 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāmunmādanidānam||20||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 21. apasmāranidānam
text: athāpasmāranidānam | (cintāśokādibhirdoṣāḥ kruddhā hṛtsrotasi sthitāḥ | kṛtvā smṛterapadhvaṃsamapasmāraṃ prakurvate) | tamaḥpraveśaḥ saṃrambho doṣodrekahatasmṛteḥ | apasmāra iti jñeyo gado ghoraścaturvidhaḥ ||1|| manoduṣṭisādharmyāt samānacikitsyatvādunmādānantaramapasmārārambhaḥ| tasya niruktiḥ suśrutena kṛtā– ‘‘smṛtirbhūtārthavijñānamapastatparivarjanam| apasmāra iti proktastato'yaṃ vyādhirantakṛt||’’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 61) iti| smṛtiśca jñānopalakṣaṇaṃ, tenānubhavāgamo'pi bodhyaḥ| tasya sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha– tamaḥpraveśa ityādi| tamaḥpraveśo'ndhakārapraveśa iva jñānābhāva ityarthaḥ| saṃrambho netravikṛtiḥ, hastapādādikṣepaṇādikaṃ ca||1|| manoduṣṭisādharmyāt samānacikitsyatvādunmādānantaramapasmārārambhaḥ| tasya niruktiḥ suśrutena kṛtā– “smṛtirbhūtārthavijñānamapastatparivarjanam| apasmāra iti proktastato'yaṃ vyādhirantakṛt” iti| smaraṇābhāvo jalādau praveśādibhiḥ| suśrutadapasmārasya nidānaṃ likhyate– “mithyādiyogīndriyārthakarmaṇāmabhisevanāt| viruddhamalināhāravihārakupitairmalaiḥ|| veganigrahaśīlānāmahitāśucibhojinām| rajastamobhibhūtānāṃ gacchatāṃ ca rajasvalām|| tathā kāmabhayodvegakrodhaśokādibhirbhṛśam| cetasyabhihate puṃsāmapasmāro'bhijāyate||” iti| asyārthaḥ– mithyādiyogeyuktānāmindriyārthānāṃ karmaṇāṃ cātisevanāditi jñeyaṃ; tatrendriyāṇāṃ śravaṇasparśanadarśanarasanaghrāṇānāmarthā viṣayāḥ śabdasparśarasarūpagandhāḥ, teṣāṃ mithyādisevanāt| tatra puruṣeṣṭavināśādiśravaṇaṃ mithyāyogaḥ, paṭahādīnāmatiśabdaśravaṇamatiyogaḥ, sarvaśo'śravaṇamayogaḥ; abhighātabhūtāśucisaṃsparśo mithyāyogaḥ, atimātraśītoṣṇādīnāṃ spṛśyānāṃ snānābhyaṅgādīnāṃ cātisevanamatiyogaḥ, tathā sarvaśo'sevanamayogaḥ; tathā atitejasāmatidarśanamatiyogaḥ, sarvathā'navalokanamayogaḥ, sūkṣmādidarśanaṃ mithyāyogaḥ; rasānāmatyādānamatiyogaḥ, anādānamayogaḥ, tathā ayogyarasānāmādānaṃ mithyāyogaḥ; tathā pūtyādyāghrāṇaṃ mithyāyogaḥ, atitīkṣṇādigandhāghrāṇamatiyogaḥ, sarvaśo'ghrāṇamayogaḥ; tathā kāyikakarmaṇo vyAyAmAderniShiddhakAlAdiShu sevanaṃ mithyāyogaḥ, atisevanamatiyogaḥ, sarvaśo'sevanamayogaḥ; tathā vācikakarmaṇaḥ paruṣānṛtādivacanaṃ mithyāyogaḥ, ativacanādikaścātiyogaḥ, sarvaśo maunamayogaḥ; tathā mānasakarmaṇaḥ śokādi cintanaṃ mithyāyogaḥ, atimātracintanādikamatiyogaḥ, sarvaśo'cintanamayogaḥ| malināhāraḥ pūtidviṣṭāmedhyaparyuṣitāhāraḥ, vihāro'pi malino dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthaḥ smṛtiṣu vijñātavya iti| vāgbhaṭatsamprāptirlikhyate– “unmādavatprakupitaiścittadehagatairmalaiḥ| hate sattve hṛdi vyāpte sañjñāvāhiṣu kheṣu ca|| tamoviśanmūḍhamatirbībhatsāḥ kurute kriyāḥ| dantān khādanvamanphenaṃ hastau pādau ca vikṣipan|| paśyanna santi rūpāṇi praskhalan patati kṣitau| vijihmākṣibhruvo doṣavege'tīte prabudhyate|| kālāntareṇa sa punaścaivameva viceṣṭate|” iti| tasya sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha– tama ityādi|| tamaḥpraveśo'ndhakārapraveśa iva jñānābhāva ityarthaḥ| saṃrambho netravikṛtirhastapādādivikṣepaṇaṃ ca|| tamaḥ praveśādilakṣaṇo ghoro'pasmārākhyo gado jñeyaḥ| sa caturvidha iti vātātpittātkaphātsannipātāñcaturvidha iti vidhānaṃ dvandvajapratiṣedhārthaṃ, dvandvajābhāvastu vyādhisvabhāvāt||1|| hṛtkampaḥ śūnyatā svedo dhyānaṃ mūrchā pramūḍhatā | nidrānāśaśca tasmiṃśca bhaviṣyati bhavatyatha ||2|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 61) | pūrvarūpamāha– hṛtkampa ityādi| śūnyatā hṛdayasyaiva| dhyānaṃ jihmāyanam| atra mūrchā manomohaḥ, pramūḍhatā indriyamohaḥ||2|| prāgrūmāha– hṛdityādi| tasminnapasmāre bhaviṣyati sati hṛtkampādīni pūrvarūpāṇi bhavanti| śūnyatā hṛdayasyaiva| dhyānaṃ jihmāyanam| atra mūrchā manomohaḥ, pramūḍhatā indriyamohaḥ||2|| kampate pradaśeddantān phenodvāmī śvasityapi | paruṣāruṇakṛṣṇāni paśyedrūpāṇi cānilāt ||3|| (ca. ci. a. 10) | vātikalakṣaṇamāha– kampata ityādi| śvasiti kharaśvāso bhavati| rūpāṇīti prāṇinaḥ, ‘nīlo māmanudhāvati’ iti suśrutavacanāt, evaṃ paittike “pīto māmanudhāvati” iti, evaṃ ślaiṣmike “śveto māmanudhāvati” (su. u. taṃ. a. 61) iti||3|| vātāpasmāralakṣaṇamāha– kampate ityādi| anilāt tathā dantān daśati, tathā phenamudvamati, tathā śvasiti kharaśvāso bhavati, paruṣāruṇakṛṣṇāni rūpāṇi paśyet; rūpāṇīti puruṣāḥ prāṇinaḥ, ‘nīlo māmanudhāvati’ iti suśrutavacanāt; evaṃ paittike'pi ‘pīto māmanudhāvati’ iti ślaiṣmike”– śuklo māmanudhāvati” iti||3|| pītaphenāṅgavaktrākṣaḥ pītāsṛgrūpadarśakaḥ | satṛṣṇoṣṇānalavyāptalokadarśī ca paittikaḥ ||4|| (ca. ci. a. 10) | paittikalakṣaṇamāha– pītetyādi| pītāsṛgrūpadarśaka iti pītalohitavarṇasamastavastudarśī| satṛṣṇetyādi satṛṣṇaścāsāvuṣṇaśceti satṛṣṇoṣṇaḥ, satṛṣṇoṣṇaścāsāvanalavyāptalokadarśī ceti samāsaḥ||4|| paittikamāha– pītetyādi| paittikaḥ pittāpasmārayuktaḥ puruṣaḥ pītaphenāṅgavaktrākṣo bhavati| pītāsṛgrūpadarśana iti pītalohitavarṇasamastavastudarśanaḥ| satṛṣṇetyādi satṛṣṇaścāsāvuṣṇaśceti satṛṣṇoṣṇaḥ, satṛṣṇoṣṇaścāsāvanalavyāptalokadarśī ceti samāsaḥ||4|| śuklaphenāṅgavaktrākṣaḥ śītahṛṣṭāṅgajo guruḥ | paśyechuklāni rūpāṇi ślaiṣmiko mucyate cirāt ||5|| (ca. ci. a. 10) | ślaiṣmikalakṣaṇamāha– śukletyādi| hṛṣṭāṅgajo hṛṣṭaromā| cirādityanenaiva vātapittayoracireṇa vegamokṣa iti sūcayati||5|| ślaiṣmikalakṣaṇamāha– śukla ityādi| ślaiṣmiko naraḥ śuklaphenāṅgavaktrākṣo bhavati| śītahṛṣṭāṅgaja iti śītaḥ śītagātraḥ| tathā hṛṣṭāṅgajo hṛṣṭaromā| cirādityanena vātapittayoracireṇa vegamokṣa iti sūcayati| kṛṣṇapītaśukladarśanaṃ vātādīnāṃ prabhāvo na tu paiśācādikaṃ rūpamabhipretam||5|| sarvairetaiḥ samastaiśca liṅgairjñeyastridoṣajaḥ | apasmāraḥ sa cāsādhyo yaḥ kṣīṇasyānavaśca yaḥ ||6|| (ca. ci. a. 10) | pratisphurantaṃ bahuśaḥ kṣīṇaṃ pracalitabhruvam | netrābhyāṃ ca vikurvāṇamapasmāro vināśayet ||7|| sānnipātikalakṣaṇamāha– sarvairityādi| sa ceti sa sānnipātikaḥ kṣīṇasyaikadoṣajo'pyasādhyaḥ| evamanavaśca bodhyaḥ| prasphurantaṃ prakampantam| netrābhyāṃ ca vikurvāṇamiti netrābhyāṃ vikṛtimāsādayantam||6-7|| sannipātajamāha– sarvairityādi| etaiḥ sarvaistribhiḥ samastaiśca liṅgaistridoṣajaḥ sānnipātiko jñeyaḥ| sa ceti sānnipātikaḥ| kṣīṇasyaikadoṣajo'pyasādhyaḥ| evamanavaśca bodhyaḥ| asādhyamāha– visphurantamiti| visphurantaṃ prakampantam| ‘bahuśo'pyapasmarantaṃ tu’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ; bahuśo bahūn vārānapasmarantamapasmāravegavantam| kṣīṇaṃ ‘puruṣam’ iti śeṣaḥ| netrābhyāṃ ca vikurvāṇamiti netrābhyāṃ vikṛtimāsādayantam| itthambhūtaṃ puruṣamapasmāravegādyupadravasahitamapasmāro vināśayediti sambandhaḥ||6-7|| pakṣādvā dvādaśāhādvā māsādvā kupitā malāḥ | apasmārāya kurvanti vegaṃ kiñcidathāntaram ||8|| (ca. ci. a. 10) | deve varṣatyapi yathā bhūmau bījāni kānicit | śaradi pratirohanti tathā vyādhisamucchrayāḥ ||9|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 61) | apasmāraprakopakālamāha– pakṣādityādi| pakṣāt paittikaḥ, dvādaśāhādvātikaḥ, māsāt ślaiṣmikaḥ| dvādaśāhānantaraṃ pakṣe vaktavye tatpūrvaṃ pakṣābhidhānaṃ, tenāto'dhikakālenāpi vegaṃ karotītyāhuḥ| kiñcidathāntaramiti uktakālebhyo'rvāgapi doṣatāratamyāditi| nanu, vegaṃ kṛtvā apasmārārambhako doṣo'styeva tat kutaḥ sarvadā vegaṃ na kurute? dvādaśāhādiṣveva kuruta ityāha– deve varṣatītyādi| ayamabhisandhiḥ– tejo'vanīpavanapayaḥsanāthaṃ vidyamānamapi bījaṃ kālaviśeṣa evāṅkuraṃ janayati, kālaviśeṣasya api sahakāritvāt; tathā gatasyāpyapasmārasya punarudbhavaḥ sambhavati| śaradīti tatkālocitabījābhiprāyeṇa, tena kānicidbījāni varṣāsvapi bhavantīti| ayaṃ ca nyāyaḥ cāturthikajvarādiṣvapi bodhyaḥ||8-9|| vātādijanitāpasmāravegadinaniyamalakṣaṇamāha– pakṣādityādi| malā vātādayaḥ kupitāḥ santaḥ apasmārāya pakṣādatha vā dvādaśāhānmāsādvā vegaṃ kurvanti| pakṣātpaittikaḥ, dvādaśāhādvātikaḥ, māsāt ślaiṣmikaḥ; dvādaśāhādanantaraṃ pakṣe vaktavyo yatpakṣābhidhānaṃ prathamaṃ tenāto'dhikakāle'pi vegaṃ karotītyāhuḥ| kiñcidathāntaramiti uktakālebhyo'rvāgapi doṣatāratamyāditi| nanu, vegaṃ kṛtvā apasmārārambhako doṣo'styeva tatkutaḥ sarvadā vegaṃ na kurute dvādaśāhādiṣveva kuruta ityata āha– deva ityādi| ayamabhisandhiḥ– tejo'vanīpavanatoyasanāthaṃ vidyamānamapi bījaṃ kālaviśeṣa evāṅkuraṃ janayati, kālaviśeṣasyāpi sahakāritvāt; tathā''gatasyāpyapasmārasya punarudbhavaḥ sambhavati| śaradīti tatkālaniyatabījābhiprāyeṇa, tena kānicidvarṣādiṣvapi janayantīti| ayaṃ nyāyaścāturthikajvarādiṣvapi bodhya iti| atha ḍallaṇābhiprāyaḥ– yathā varṣatyapi deve bhūmāvuptāni kānicidbījāni śaradyeva pravirohanti, tathā sarvarogabījānāṃ vātādīnāṃ kadācit kasyacidapasmārādivyādhiviśeṣasya nidānādisaṅgame'pi sandūṣyādisamudāyenaiva samudbhavo bhavatītyarthaḥ| anye tvanyathā vyākhyānayanti– nanu, sañcayādikrameṇopayogo doṣāṇāṃ tadā punaḥ kathamalpenaiva kālena tadvikārodgamaḥ syādityatrāha– deve'varṣatītyādi| avarṣatyapi deve yathā śaratkāle bhūmau stimitatvāt kānicidbījāni prarohantyeva, tathā alpenāpi kālena śarīrasthā doṣāḥ kiñcidupacitā vikāraṃ janayantīti||8-9|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne'pasmāranidānaṃ samāptam ||21|| iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāmapasmāranidānaṃ samāptam||21|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāmapasmāranidānam||21|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘hastapādādikṣepaṇaṃ ca’ iti pā.| ↩ 2 . ‘ ... mapasmāramāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘ ... mapastatparivarjane’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘mithyāyogendriyārthānāṃ karmaṇāmati’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘cetasobhibhavaiḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘mithyātīndriyārthānām’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘ ... matisevanāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 9 . ‘tathāpūtyādyānām’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 11 . ‘tatra’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘vyāyāmādiniṣiddhakālādiṣu’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . vyāyāmāderniṣiddhakālādiṣu ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 14 . ‘sevanamatiyogaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 15 . ‘malinapūtidviṣṭā ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 16 . ‘dṛṣṭo'dṛṣṭārthaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 17 . ‘tasya sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha ... netravikṛtirhastapādādivikṣepaṇaṃ ca||’ ime dve paṅktī kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 18 . ‘sati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 19 . ‘rūpāṇi’ iti pā.| ↩ 20 . ‘prasphurantaṃ subahuśaḥ’ iti pā., ‘visphurantaṃ subahuśaḥ’ iti ca pā. | ↩ 21 . ayaṃ ‘visphurantam’ ityeva pāṭhamaṅgīkaroti’ iti pā.| ↩ 22 . ‘prathamam’ iti pā.| ↩ 23 . ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 24 . agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 25 . atra ‘kānicidbījāni varṣāsvapi bhavantīti’ etatsthāne ‘kānidvarṣāsvapi janayantīti’ iti pā.| ↩ 26 . ‘kiñciddeśāntaramiti’ iti pā.| ↩ 27 . ‘tatkālaniyatā'niyateti’ iti pā.| ↩ 28 . ‘śaradi’ iti pā.| ↩ 29 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāmapasmāranidānam||21||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 22. vātavyādhinidānam
text: atha vātavyādhinidānam| rūkṣaśītālpalaghvannavyavāyātiprajāgaraiḥ | viṣamādupacārācca doṣāsṛksravaṇādapi ||1|| laṅghanaplavanātyadhvavyāyāmādiviceṣṭitaiḥ | dhātūnāṃ saṅkṣayāccintāśokarogātikarṣaṇāt ||2|| vegasandhāraṇādāmādabhighātādabhojanat | marmābādhādgajoṣṭrāśvaśīghrayānāpataṃsanāt ||3|| dehe srotāṃsi riktāni pūrayitvā'nilo balī | karoti vividhān vyādhīn sarvāṅgaikāṅgasaṃśrayān ||4|| (ca. ci. a. 28) | apasmāravadvātavikārāṇāmapyākṣepakādīnāṃ vegakartṛtvādapasmārānantaraṃ vātavyādhyārambhaḥ| nanu, vātavyādhiriti ko'rthaḥ? kiṃ vāta eva vyādhirvātavyādhiḥ, uta vātena janito vyādhirvātavyādhiḥ? ādye svastheṣvapi prasaṅgaḥ, dvitīye jvarādiṣu| ucyate– vyādhipadasāmānādhikaraṇyādvikṛto duḥkhakārī vāto vātavyādhiḥ| uktaṃ hi suśrute– ‘‘pakvāśayastho'ntrakūjaṃ śūlāṭopau karoti ca|’’ (su. ni. a. 1) iti| vātajanito'sādhāraṇavyādhirvātavyādhiriti viśeṣaṇīyaṃ, tenobhayatrāprasaṅgaḥ| yaccoktam– ‘‘kaphapittānvito vāyurvāyureva ca kevalaḥ| kuryādākṣepakam’’ ityādi; tatrārambhako vāyureva, pittakaphau tvanubandhāviti na virodhaḥ syāt| carake hi dvividhā vyādhaya uktāḥ sāmānyajā, nānātmajāśceti; tatra sāmānyajā ye vātādibhiḥ samastairvyastairvā janyante, yathā– jvarādayaḥ; nānātmajā ye niyataikadoṣajanyāḥ, yathā– ākṣepakādayo ye vātenaiva janyante, na svatantreṇa pittena kaphena vā; tathā oṣacoṣādayaḥ pittenaiva, na vātena kaphena ca tathā tṛptyādayaḥ kaphenaiva, na vātena, na pittena,; evaṃ vyavasthite vātavyādhivat pittakaphavyādhī kasmānnoktau? ucyate– vāyoratibalatvena āśukāritvena ca garīyastvāttadvikārāṇāṃ duḥsādhyatvādāśvevātyayakaratvādviśiṣṭacikitsyatvādvātavyādhyabhidhānaṃ, natu kaphapittavyādhyabhidhānam| ata eva carakasuśrutādiṣvapi vātarogādhyāya eva nirdiṣṭo, natu pittakapharogādhyāyaḥ| candrikākārastvāha– pittakaphayo rūparasādiyogāddūṣyaviśeṣayogādvā haridrācūrṇasaṃyogavadatyantavisadṛśā rasādimanto vikārāḥ pṛthaṅnāmāno jāyante, vāyostu rūparasādyabhāvāt dūṣyanirapekṣā ākṣepakādayo vātādanatibhinnarūpā nānātmajāḥ; tena vātavikārāḥ pṛthagucyante, natu pittakaphavikārā iti| etattu bakulakaraprabhṛtayā nānumanyante, carakavirodhāt| carake hi pittakaphayorapi nānātmajā uktāḥ, yathā– ‘aśītirvātavikārāḥ, catvāriṃśat pittavikārāḥ, viṃśatiḥ śleṣmavikārāḥ|’ (ca. sū. a. 20) iti| suśrutena tu śalyādhyāyinā pittakaphanānātmajā na darśitāḥ, parādhikāreṣu na vistāroktirityabhiprāyeṇeti| laṅghanamutpatanam, upavāsasyānaśanaśabdena vamanādeśca doṣasravaṇaśabdena vakṣyamāṇatvāt| plavanaṃ bāhubhyāṃ jalaprataraṇam| āmāditi āmarasāt, tasya kāraṇatvaṃ mārgāvaraṇadvāreṇa natu svarūpeṇa; āyāsāditi pāṭhāntaramayuktaṃ, tasya vyāyāmaśabdenoktatvāt| marmābādhāt marmābhighātāt| apataṃsanaṃ gajādibhyaḥ śīghrayānena patanam, ucchvāsāvarodho vā; dhātukarṣaṇamiti kharanādaḥ||1-4|| apasmāravadvātavikārāṇāmākṣepakādīnāṃ vegakartṛtvādapasmārānantaraṃ vātavyādhyārambhaḥ| nanu ko'yaṃ vātavyādhiḥ, kiṃ vāta eva vyādhiḥ, uta vātajanito vyādhiḥ? ādye svasthe'pi prasaṅgaḥ, dvitīye jvarādiṣu| ucyate– carake dvividhā vyādhaya uktāḥ– sāmānyajā nānātmajāśceti; tatra sāmānyajā vātādibhiḥ samastairvyastairvā janyante, yathā– jvarādayaḥ, nānātmajā ye niyataikadoṣajanyāḥ, yathā– ākṣepakādayo vātenaiva janyante, na svatantreṇa pittena kaphena vā; tathā oṣacoṣādayaḥ pittenaiva na vātena na vā kaphena; tathā tṛptyādayo kaphena, naiva ca vātena pittena vā| evaṃ vyavasthite vātavyādhivatpittakaphavyādhī kasmānnoktau? ucyate– vāyoratibalatvenāśukāritvena ca garīyastvāttadvikārāṇāṃ duḥsādhyatvādāśukāritvādviśiṣṭacikitsyatvādvātavyādhyabhidhānaṃ, na tu pittakaphavyādhyabhidhānam| ata eva carakasuśrutadiṣvapi vātarogādhyāya eva nirdiṣṭo, na tu pittakapharogādhyāyaḥ| tathā ya suśrute doṣāṇāṃ vāta eva pradhānaḥ| uktaṃ ca– “pittaṃ paṅgu kaphaḥ paṅguḥ paṅgavo maladhātavaḥ| vāyunā yatra nīyante tatra varṣanti meghavat||” iti| ato vātavyādhyabhidhānam| tasya samprāptipūrvakaṃ nidānamāha– rūkṣetyādi| alpaṃ stokaṃ, laghvannaṃ purātanaṃ ṣaṣṭikādi, vyavāyo maithunaṃ, prajāgaraṇaṃ rātrijāgaraṇam| viṣamādupacārāditi aprāpte kriyākāle kriyākramaḥ| doṣāsṛksrāvaṇādapi vamanavirekābhyāṃ doṣasyātirekāt rudhirasravaṇāt| laṅghanamutpatanaṃ, plavanaṃ bāhubhyāṃ taraṇam| , rogādikarṣaṇam, atrādinā adhvajvarādiṣvatilaṅghanam| āmāt āmarasāt, tasya kāraṇatvaṃ mārgāvaraṇadvāreṇa, na tu svarūpeṇa| abhighāto laguḍādibhiḥ| abhojanādupavāsāt| marmābādhāt marmābhighātāt| apataṃsanaṃ patanaṃ gajādibhyaḥ, tathā śīghrayānādibhiḥ| etaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ kupito balī vāyū riktāni srotāṃsi pūrayitvā sarvāṅgaikāṅgajān vyādhīn karoti||1-4|| avyaktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ pūrvarūpamiti smṛtam | ātmarūpaṃ tu yadvyaktamapāyo laghutā punaḥ ||5|| (ca. ci. a. 28) | pūrvarūpādikamāha– avyaktamityādi| avyaktamiti vakṣyamāṇānāṃ vātavikārāṇāṃ rūpamevāvyaktaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ, natu jvarādivadviśiṣṭamanyat| ātmarūpamityādi tadeva vyaktamātmarūpaṃ doṣādibhedena samyak prakāśitaṃ svalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| apāya iti vāyoścalatvena stambhasaṅkocakampādīnāṃ kadācidabhāvāt; yaduktam– “gate bhramo mūrchā rujā dāhaḥ pittena prāṇa āvṛte|| vidagdhe'nne ca vamanamudāne'pi bhramādayaḥ| dāho'ntararujā bhraṃśo dāho vyānena sarvagaḥ|| klamo'ṅgaceṣṭāsaṅgaśca santāpaḥ sahavedanaḥ| samāna ūṣmopahatiratisvedo'ratiḥ satṛṭ|| dāhaśca syādapāne tu male hāridravarṇatā| rujo'tivṛddhistāpaśca yonimehanapāyuṣu|| śleṣmaṇā tvāvṛte prāṇe sādastandrā'rucirvamiḥ| ṣṭhīvanaṃ kṣavathūdgāraniḥśvāsocchvāsasaṅgrahaḥ|| udāne gurugātratvamarucirvā svaragrahaḥ| balavarṇapraṇāśaśca, vyāne parvāsthivāggrahaḥ|| gurutā'ṅgeṣu sarveṣu skhalitaṃ ca gatau bhṛśam| samāne'tihimāṅgatvamasvedo mandavahnitā|| apāne sakaphaṃ mūtraśakṛtaḥ syātpravartanam| iti dvāviṃśatividhaṃ vāyorāvaraṇaṃ viduḥ|| prāṇādayastathā'nyonyamāvṛṇvanti yathākramam| sarve'pi dvāviṃśatividhaṃ vidyādāvaraṇaṃ ca tat|| niḥśvāsocchvāsasaṃrodhaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ śirograhaḥ| hṛdrogo mukhaśoṣaśca prāṇenodāna āvṛte|| udānenāvṛte prāṇe varṇaujobalasaṅkṣayaḥ| diśā'nayā ca vibhajetsarvamāvaraṇaṃ bhiṣak||” iti| dehe ca eka eva vāyuḥ pṛthakkāyasthānanāmakarmabhedātpañcadhā ityāhuḥ| saṃsargidravyatvenaikāśraye jalavat pṛthagavasthānānupapatteḥ| īśāno'pyāha-”yathaivaiko devadattaḥ sthānabhedādgṛhastho vānaprasthaḥ, karmabhedānmālā kāraḥ kumbhakāra ityucyate, tathā vāyurapi’’ iti||22-26|| yadā tu dhamanīḥ sarvāḥ kupito'bhyeti mārutaḥ | tadā''kṣipatyāśu muhurmuhurdehaṃ muhuścaraḥ ||27|| muhurmuhuścākṣepaṇādākṣepaka iti smṛtaḥ | (su. ni. a. 1) | ākṣepakasya sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha– yadā tvityādi| sarvā iti ūrdhvādhastiryaggāḥ| ākṣipati dehaṃ hastyārūḍhapuruṣasyeva gātraṃ cālayati| muhuścara iti hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇam| ‘bahiścara’ iti pāṭhāntare koṣṭhādbahiḥ śākhāgataścarannākṣepakaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| candrikākārastu etannānumanyate, sthānagāmbhīryādākṣepakasya tadārambhakavāyorbahiścaratvāyuktatvāt||27|| ākṣepakasya sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha– yadetyādi| sarvā iti| ūrdhvādhastiryagdhamanīḥ| muhurmuhurdehamākṣipati, hastyārūḍhasyeva gātraṃ cālayati| muhuścara iti hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇaṃ, vāraṃvāraṃ sañcaraṇaśīlaḥ, ‘bahiścaraḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ tatra koṣṭhādbahiḥ śākhāgataścaran ākṣepaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| ākṣepaṇāt cālanāt||27|| kruddhaḥ svaiḥ kopanairvāyuḥ sthānādūrdhvaṃ pravartate ||28|| pīḍayan hṛdayaṃ gatvā śiraḥśaṅkhau ca pīḍayan | dhanurvannamayedgātrāṇyākṣipenmohayettadā ||29|| sa kṛcchrāducchvaseccāpi stabdhākṣo'tha nimīlakaḥ | kapota iva kūjecca niḥsañjñaḥ so'patantrakaḥ ||30|| dṛṣṭiṃ saṃstabhya sañjñāṃ ca hatvā kaṇṭhena kūjati | hṛdi mukte naraḥ svāsthyaṃ yāti mohaṃ vṛte punaḥ ||31|| vāyunā dāruṇaṃ prāhureke tadapatānakam | (ca. si. a. 1) | asyaivāvasthāviśeṣāvapatantrakāpatānakāvāha– kruddha ityārabhya eke tadapatānakamityantena| svaiḥ kopanairityanena rūkṣādikupitaḥ svatantro na tvāvaraṇakupita itīśānaḥ| nimīlitākṣaḥ stabdhākṣo vā bhavatītyarthaḥ| ākṣepakaścaturvidho bhavati– daṇḍāpatānako'bhyantarāyāmo bahirāyāmo'bhighātajaśceti| dṛḍhabalena yadyapi ākṣepakāt pūrvamantarāyāmabahirāyāmau paṭhitau, tathā'pyākṣepakaviśeṣāvetau mantavyau, suśrutadarśanāt||28-31|| asyaivāvasthāviśeṣāvapatantrakāpatānakāvāha– kruddhaḥ ityārabhya eke tamapatānakamityantena| svaiḥ kopanairityanena rūkṣādikupitaḥ svatantraḥ, na tvāvaraṇakupita itīśānajaḥ| sthānāt pakvāśayāt| ūrdhvaṃ śirasi uddiśya| pīḍayan rujā| hṛdayaṃ tataḥ tasmāt śiraḥ śaṅkhau ca pīḍayet| ākṣipet cālayet| mohayedindriyāṇi| kaṣṭenocchvāsaṃ muñcati| nimīlako nimīlitākṣaḥ, stabdhākṣo vā bhavatītyarthaḥ| kapota iva kūjet, niḥsañjñaḥ sañjñārahitaḥ, so'patantrakaḥ, dṛṣṭiṃ rūpagrahaṇayogyāṃ, saṃstabhyācchādya, sañjñāṃ jñānaviṣayiṇīṃ buddhiṃ, vināśya| vāyunā mukte hṛdi sukhaṃ labhate| vṛte mūrchite tamevāpatantrameke tvapatānakamāhuḥ| tantrāntare apatantrakalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhitam| tadyathā– “kruddhaḥ svaiḥ kopanairvāyurapāno nābhisaṃśrayaḥ| sandūṣya hṛdayasthaṃ ca mano vyākulayettataḥ|| pīḍayan hṛdayaṃ prāpya śiraḥśaṅkhau ca pīḍayet| ākṣipya cākhilaṃ dehaṃ mohayecca punaḥ punaḥ|| sa kṛcchrāducchvaseccāpi svedaśaityayuto bahiḥ| sa nidrāṃ labhate nītaḥ prāpya cāśu prabudhyate|| trasate kampate bhūyo niḥsañjñaḥ so'patantrakaḥ| pralāpo vaktrakaṭutā bhramo mūrchā'rucistṛṣā|| tasminpittānvite svedaḥ pītābhaḥ śītakāmitā| śiro'ṅgagauravaṃ glāniḥ śītadviṭ mandavedanaḥ| kaphānvite ca sadanaṃ śaityaṃ ca hṛdayagrahaḥ|| vātolbaṇe'ṅgasphuraṇaṃ śiromanyākaṭivyathā| dhairyādiviplavo dainyaṃ viṣayeṣvanavasthitaḥ||”||28-31|| kaphānvito bhṛśaṃ vāyustāsveva yadi tiṣṭhati ||32|| daṇḍavat stambhayeddehaṃ sa tu daṇḍāpatānakaḥ | (su. ni. a. 1) | eṣāṃ lakṣaṇamāha– kaphānvita ityādi| bhṛśaṃ kaphānvita ityanena pittamapi na vāryata ityāhuḥ| carake tvasyāsādhyatvaṃ kevalavātajatvena drṣṭavyam| yadāha– “pāṇipādaśiraḥpṛṣṭhaśroṇīḥ stabhnāti mārutaḥ| daṇḍavat stabdhagātrasya daṇḍakaḥ so'nupakramaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 28) iti| tāsviti sarvadhamanīṣu||32|| teṣāṃ lakṣaṇamāha– kaphānvita ityādi| tāsviti sarvadhamanīṣu| bhṛśaṃ kaphānvita ityanena pittamapi na vāryata ityāhuḥ| carake tvasyāsādhyatvaṃ kevalavātajatvena draṣṭavyam| yadāha– “pāṇipādaśiraḥpṛṣṭhaśroṇīḥ stabhnāti mārutaḥ| daṇḍavat stabdhagātrasya daṇḍakaḥ so'nupakramaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 28) iti| tāsviti sarvadhamanīṣu||32|| dhanustulyaṃ namedyastu sa dhanuḥstambhasañjñakaḥ ||33|| (su. ni. a. 1) | antarāyāmabahirāyāmayoḥ sādhāraṇaṃ rūpamāha– ‘dhanustulyaṃ namedyastu sa dhanustambhasañjñakaḥ’ iti||33|| antarāyāmabahirāyāmayoḥ sādhāraṇarūpamāha– stambhaḥ sāmānyaḥ, dhanuḥstambhaḥ asyaiva bhedaḥ| dhanustulyamiti dhanustulyaṃ kroḍena namrastiṣṭhati, daṇḍāpatānakastu śuṣkakāṣṭhadaṇḍavat||33|| aṅgulīgulphajaṭharahṛdvakṣogalasaṃśritaḥ | snāyupratānamanilo yadā''kṣipati vegavān ||34|| viṣṭabdhākṣaḥ stabdhahanurbhagnapārśvaḥ kaphaṃ vaman | abhyantaraṃ dhanuriva yadā namati mānavam ||35|| tadā'syābhyantarāyāmaṃ kurute māruto balī | bāhyasnāyupratānastho bāhyāyāmaṃ karoti ca ||36|| tamasādhyaṃ budhāḥ prāhurvakṣaḥkaṭyūrubhañjanam | (su. ni. a. 1) | viśeṣalakṣaṇamāha– aṅgulītyādi| vakṣo bāhudvayāntaram| hṛdayaṃ tadabhyantaraṃ dvyaṅgulam| snāyupratānaṃ latāvadanekaprarohaṃ snāyujālam; snāyurityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena sirākaṇḍarayorapi grahaṇam| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare– “mahāheturbalī vāyuḥ sirāḥ sasnāyukaṇḍarāḥ| manyāpṛṣṭhāśritā bāhyāḥ saṃśoṣyāyāmayedbahiḥ||” ityādi| abhyantarāyāmaṃ kroḍe nataṃ, bāhyāyāmaṃ pṛṣṭhe natam| antarāyāmabahirāyāmābhyāṃ tantrāntaroktakubjasyāvarodhaḥ| yaduktam– “hṛdayaṃ yadi vā pṛṣṭhamunnataṃ kramaśaḥ saruk| kruddho vāyuryadā kuryāttadā taṃ kubjamādiśet||” iti||34-36|| viśeṣalakṣaṇamāha– aṅgulītyādi| balī vāyuḥ kupitaḥ gulphau caraṇaghuṭike, vakṣo bāhudvayāntaraṃ, hṛdayaṃ tadabhyantaraṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ, snāyupratānaṃ latāvadanekaprarohaṃ snāyujālaṃ, snāyvityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena sirākaṇḍarayorapi grahaṇam| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare– “mahāheturbalī vāyuḥ sirāḥ sasnāyukaṇḍarāḥ| manyāpṛṣṭhāśritā bāhyāḥ saṃśoṣyāyāmayedbahiḥ” ityādi| tataḥ snāyupratānaṃ dhanuriva nāmayet| abhyantarāyāmaṃ kroḍe natam| hanuḥ kaṇṭhakapolasandhiḥ| bahirāyāmalakṣaṇamāha– bāhyetyādi| pūrvavadbāhyasnāyupratānaṃ dhanurvadānamet| bāhyāyāmaṃ pṛṣṭhe nataṃ vakṣaḥkaṭhyūrubhaṅgtvāt| tamasādhyamāhuḥ||34-36|| ( hṛdayaṃ yadi vā pṛṣṭhamunnataṃ kramaśaḥ saruk | kruddho vāyuryadā kuryāt tadā taṃ kubjamādiśet) | kaphapittānvito vāyurvāyureva ca kevalaḥ ||37|| kuryādākṣepakaṃ tvanyaṃ caturthamabhighātajam | (su. ni. a. 1) | uktānāmākṣepakaprakārāṇāṃ kaphapittānubandhamāha– kaphapittānvita ityādi| etacca daṇḍāpatānakalakṣaṇameva jejjaṭena vyākhyātam| pittakaphānubandhaścātra śaityaśothagurutvānītyādinoktalakṣaṇa eva bodhyaḥ| caturthamabhighātajamiti daṇḍāpatānakāditritayāpekṣya caturthatvam, abhighātajaṃ daṇḍādyabhighātakupitavātajam; asya ca lakṣaṇam– ‘‘yadā tu dhamanīḥ sarvāḥ’’ ityādinoktasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam||37|| uktānāmākṣepaprakārāṇāṃ kaphapittānubandhamāha– kaphetyādi| kaphapittānubandhaścātra śaityaśoṣagurutvānītyādinoktalakṣaṇe boddhavyaḥ, kevalaḥ svatantra ākṣepaṃ karoti| anyaṃ caturthamabhighātajam| daṇḍābhighātakupitavātajātasya tu lakṣaṇam| ‘yadā tu dhamanīḥ sarvāḥ’ ityādinā jñeyam||37|| garbhapātanimittaśca śoṇitātisravācca yaḥ ||38|| abhighātanimittaśca na sidhyatyapatānakaḥ | (su. ni. a. 1) | asādhyatvamāha– garbhapātetyādi| gadādharastvāha– kaphapittānvita ityādinā nimittabhedenākṣepakaścaturdhā iti; tadyathā– ekaḥ kaphānvitena vātena, dvitīyaḥ pittānvitena, tṛtīyaḥ kevalena, caturtho'bhighāteneti| atra pakṣe garbhapātaśoṇitātisrāvajau kevalavātena grāhyau| eteṣāṃ ca muhurmuhurākṣepaṇaṃ bodhyam ākṣepakaviśeṣatvāt||38|| asādhyamāha– garbhetyādi| atrāpatānakamupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena catuṣṭayamapi gṛhyate ‘kaphapittānvitaḥ’ ityādi nimittabhedena caturtha ākṣepaka iti gadādharaḥ| tadyathā– ekaḥ kaphānvitena vātena, dvitīyaḥ pittānvitena, tṛtīyaḥ kevalena, caturtho'bhighātajeneti| atra garbhapātaśoṇitātisrāvajau kevalavātena grāhyāviti| eṣāṃ ca muharmuhurākṣepaṇaṃ jñeyam, ākṣepakaviśeṣāt||38|| gṛhītvā'rdhaṃ tanorvāyuḥ sirāḥ snāyūrviśoṣya ca ||39|| pakṣamanyataraṃ hanti sandhibandhān vimokṣayan | kṛtsno'rdhakāyastasya syādakarmaṇyo vicetanaḥ ||40|| ekāṅgarogaṃ taṃ kecidanye pakṣavadhaṃ viduḥ | sarvāṅgarogastadvacca sarvakāyāśrite'nile ||41|| (vā. ni. a. 15) | pakṣavadhamāha– gṛhītvetyādi| ardhamiti ardhamaryādayā ardhanārīśvaravat| pakṣaṃ bāhukakṣapārśvādibhāgam, anyataramiti vāmaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vā| sandhibandhān kaphasahitasnāyubhirvṛtān mokṣayanniti gadādharaḥ; ata eva “sirāḥ snāyūrviśoṣya” ityuktam| ardhakāya ityukte'pi kṛtsnagrahaṇaṃ yugapat sarvārdhāṅgavyāptyartham| akarmaṇya īṣacceṣṭākṣamaḥ| vicetano'lpacetanaḥ, īṣatsparśādijñānavānityarthaḥ| tadvaccetyanena sirāḥ snāyūrviśoṣya cetyādisamprāptiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cātidiśati||39-41|| pakṣavadhamāha– gṛhītvetyādi| vāyustanoḥ śarīrasyārdhaṃ gṛhītvā sirāḥ snāyūrviśoṣya śoṣayitvā anyataraṃ pakṣaṃ hanti nirīhaṃ karoti| ardhamiti ardhamaryādayā ardhanārīśvaravat| pakṣamiti śarīrārdhaṃ bāhukakṣapārśvādibhāgam, anyataramiti vāmaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ veti| kiṃ kurvan? sandhīnāṃ bandhān sandhibandhān kaphasahitasnāyubhirvṛtān vimokṣayanniti gadādharaḥ| ataḥ sirāḥ snāyūrviśoṣyetyuktam| tasya tathāvidhasya puṃsaḥ kṛtsno niḥśeṣa ardhakāyo'karmaṇyo vicetanaḥ syāt| ardhakāya ityukte'pi kṛtsnagrahaṇaṃ yugapatsarvāṅgavyāptyartham| akarmaṇya īṣacceṣṭākṣayaḥ| vicetano'lpacetanaḥ īṣatsparśādijñānavānityarthaḥ| kecidācāryāstaṃ vyādhimekāṅgarogaṃ viduḥ, anye pakṣavadhaṃ viduḥ| sarvakāyāśrite samastadehagate vāte tadvatsarvāṅgarogamityāhuḥ| tadvaccetyanena ‘sirāḥ snāyūrviśoṣya ca’ ityādisamprāptiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cātidiśati||39-41|| dāhasantāpamūrchāḥ syurvāyau pittasamanvite | śaityaśothagurutvāni tasminneva kaphānvite ||42|| śuddhavātahataṃ pakṣaṃ kṛcchrasādhyatamaṃ viduḥ | sādhyamanyena saṃyuktamasādhyaṃ kṣayahetukam ||43|| (su. ni. a. 1) | (garbhiṇīsūtikābālavṛddhakṣīṇeṣvasṛksrute | pakṣāghātaṃ pariharet vedanārahito yadi) | tasyaiva sādhyāsādhyajñānārthamāha– dāhetyādi| etacca lakṣaṇamanyatrāpi vātaroge draṣṭavyam, ata eva sāmānyena vāyāviti kṛtavān| śuddhaḥ kevalaḥ| anyeneti kaphena, pittena vā| kṣayahetukamiti kevalaḥ, kṛcchrasādhyaṃ kaṣṭasādhyaṃ, anyena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ kaphena pittena vā yuktaṃ, kṣayahetukaṃ dhātukṣayajamityarthaḥ||42-43|| uccairvyāharato'tyarthaṃ khādataḥ kaṭhināni vā | hasato jṛmbhato vā'pi vedanāsphuraṇavakratvādikam| grīvetyādi yasmin pārśve'rditaṃ tasmin grīvādīnāṃ vedaneti yojyam| tantrāntare tu mukhārdhavaccharīrārdhavyāpako'pyarditaḥ paṭhitaḥ| yadāha dṛḍhabalaḥ– ‘ardhe tasmin ‘pṛṣṭhaśūlam’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 118 . agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 119 . ‘hanustambhā’ iti pā.| ↩ 120 . ‘svasthāna ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 121 . ‘śatamiti’ ityasya sthāne ‘śatam’ iti pā.| ↩ 122 . atra ‘avyāhata ityādi’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 123 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ vātavyadhinidānam||22||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 23. vātaraktanidānam
text: atha vātaraktanidānam | lavaṇāmlakaṭukṣārasnigdhoṣṇājīrṇabhojanaḥ | klinnaśuṣkāmbujānūpamāṃsapiṇyākamūlakaiḥ ||1|| kulatthamāṣaniṣpāvaśākādipalalekṣubhiḥ | dadhyāranālasauvīraśuktatakrasurāsavaiḥ ||2|| viruddhādhyaśanakrodhadivāsvapnaprajāgaraiḥ | prāyaśaḥ sukumārāṇāṃ mithyāhāravihāriṇām | (ca. ci. a. 29) | sthūlānāṃ sukhināṃ cāpi kupyate vātaśoṇitam ||3|| (su. ci. a. 1) | vātavyādhiviśeṣatvāttadanantaraṃ vātaraktamāha| nanu, suśrute vātarogādhyāye eva vātaraktaṃ paṭhitaṃ, tat kuto'tra saṅgrahe pṛthak pāṭhaḥ? ucyate– satyapi vātarogatve nidānavaiśiṣṭyāt viśiṣṭadoṣadūṣyakhyāpanārthaṃ hastādideśa eva samprāptikathanārthaṃ kriyāviśeṣakhyāpanārthaṃ ca pṛthakkaraṇam| ata eva carake'pi vātavyādhyanantaraṃ pṛthagvātaraktādhikāraḥ| nanu, ‘rujastīvrāḥ sasantāpā’ ityādinā raktagatasya vātasya lakṣaṇaṃ vātavyādhāvevoktaṃ, tataśca vātaraktābhidhānaṃ punaruktaṃ syāt; naivaṃ, vātaraktaṃ hi duṣṭena vātena duṣṭena raktena ca viśiṣṭasamprāptikaṃ vikārāntarameva| uktaṃ hi carake– “vāyuḥ pravṛddho vṛddhena raktenāvāritaḥ pathi| kruddhaḥ sandūṣayedraktaṃ tajjñeyaṃ vātaśoṇitam||” (ca. ci. a. 29) iti| raktagatavāte tu vāta eva duṣṭo raktamaduṣṭameva gacchatīti bhedaḥ| lavaṇāmletyādi, klinnaśuṣkaśabdau māṃsena sambadhyete| piṇyākastilakalkaḥ| niṣpāvaḥ śimbiḥ, palalaṃ māṃsam| prāyaśa ityādi, sukumārā mṛdudehāvayavāḥ, “teṣāmalpaceṣṭatvāllavaṇādibhiḥ raktaṃ kaṭutiktaprajāgarādibhiśca vātaḥ kupyati|” iti īśānaḥ||1-3|| vātavyādhiviśeṣatvāttadanantaraṃ vātaraktamāha| nanu, suśrute vātarogādhyāye eva vātaraktaṃ paṭhitaṃ, tat kuto'tra saṅgrahe pṛthak paṭhitam? ucyate– satyapi vātarogatve nidānavaiśiṣṭyādviśiṣṭasamprāptikathanārthaṃ kriyāviśeṣajñāpanārthaṃ ca pṛthakkaraṇam| ata eva carake'pi vātavyādhyanantaraṃ pṛthagvātaraktādhyāya uktaḥ| tasya nidānamāha– lavaṇetyādi| lavaṇādibhirbhojanaiḥ, tathā klinnaśuṣkāmbujādibhiḥ, tathā kulatthādibhiḥ, tathā dadhyādibhiḥ, tathā viruddhādibhiḥ, tathā prāyaśaḥ sukumārāṇāṃ puṃsāṃ, tathā mithyāhāravihāriṇāṃ sthūlānāṃ ca sukhināṃ ca vātaraktaṃ prakupyati| klinnaśuṣkaśabdau māṃsena sambadhyete| piṇyākaḥ tilakalkaḥ, niṣpāvaḥ śimbiḥ, palalaṃ māṃsaṃ, klinnaṃ śaṭitam, ambujā matsyādayaḥ, āranālādayaḥ kāñjikabhedāḥ, surā piṣṭakṛtā, āsavo madyaṃ, viruddhaṃ kṣīramatsyādi, adhyaśanaṃ bhuktoparibhojanaṃ, sukumārā mṛdudehāvayavāḥ, sthūlā medasvinaḥ, sukhinaśca samyakpravṛttyādivarjitāḥ; teṣāmalpaceṣṭatvāt lavaṇādibhiḥ raktaṃ, tiktakaṭukaṣāyādibhirvātaśca kupyatīti īśānaḥ||1-3|| hastyaśvoṣṭrairgacchataścāśnataśca vidāhyannaṃ savidāho'śanasya | kṛtsnaṃ raktaṃ vidahatyāśu tacca srastaṃ duṣṭaṃ pādayoścīyate tu | tat sampṛktaṃ vāyunā dūṣitena tatprābalyāducyate vātaraktam ||4|| (su. ni. a. 1) | samprāptimāha– hastyaśvetyādi| hastyādigamanaṃ vātavṛddhau viśeṣeṇa raktasya dravasyādhogamane'pi hetuḥ, vidāhyannaṃ ca śoṇitavṛddhau| hastyādigamanaṃ viśeṣeṇa, pādenāpi gamanaṃ hetureva| tat raktam| sampṛktaṃ vāyunā dūṣitena svahetuvṛddhena| tatprābalyāditi dvayorduṣṭatve'pivātasya prābalyāt doṣatvena prādhānyādvātaraktavyapadeśaḥ, natu raktavāta iti||4|| tasya samprāptimāha– hastītyādi| vidāhi virūḍhakādikam| aśnataḥ bhuktavataḥ, vidāhāt kṛṣṇaśarīragataraktamāśu vidahati, vidāhyannaṃ śoṇitavṛddhau hastyādigamanaṃ ca viṣamapādenāpi gamanaṃ hetuḥ| tatsampṛktamiti tadraktapittaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ vāyunā dūṣitena svahetuvṛddhena saha, tatprābalyādvātaraktamucyate– tatprābalyāditi dvayorduṣṭatve'pi vātasya prābalyāddoṣatvena prādhānyādvātaraktavyapadeśaḥ, natu raktavāta iti| tadvatpittamiti duṣṭaṃ pittamityarthaḥ| dūṣitenāsṛjāktamiti dūṣitena raktena miśraṃ tathā duṣṭaḥ śleṣmā dūṣitena raktenākto miśraḥ||4|| svedo'tyarthaṃ na vā kārṣṇyaṃ sparśājñatvaṃ kṣate'tiruk | sandhiśaithilyamālasyaṃ sadanaṃ piḍakodgamaḥ ||5|| jānujaṅghorukaṭyaṃsahastapādāṅgasandhiṣu | nistodaḥ sphuraṇaṃ bhedo gurutvaṃ suptireva ca ||6|| kaṇḍūḥ sandhiṣu rugbhūtvā bhūtvā naśyati cāsakṛt | vaivarṇyaṃ maṇḍalotpattirvātāsṛkpūrvalakṣaṇam ||7|| (ca. ci. a. 29) | pūrvarūpamāha– svedetyādi| svedo'tyarthaṃ na veti gharmāgamanamatyarthaṃ bhavati sarvathā vā na bhavati, etacca vyādhimahimnā kuṣṭhavat| kṣate'tirugiti yadi kāraṇāntarāt kṣataṃ syāttadā'tiśayaṃ rujā syāt, taddeśasya duṣṭatvāt||5-7|| tasya pūrvarūpamāha– sveda ityādi| gharmāgamanamatyarthaṃ bhavati sarvathā vā na bhavati, etacca vyādhimahimnā kuṣṭhavat boddhavyam| kārṣṇyamaṅgānām| kṣate'tirugiti yadi kāraṇāntarāt kṣataṃ bhedaḥ syāt, tadā hyatiśayena rujā bhavati, taddeśasya duṣṭatvāt| sadanamaṅgānām| piḍikāprādurbhāvo jānvādiṣu, nistodaḥ pīḍāviśeṣaḥ, suptistvacaḥ, vaivarṇyaṃ vicchāyatā, etatpūrvarūpaṃ vātaraktasya||5-7|| vāte'dhike'dhikaṃ tatra śūlasphuraṇabhañjanam | śothasya raukṣyaṃ kṛṣṇatvaṃ śyāvatā vṛddhihānayaḥ ||8|| dhamanyaṅgulisandhīnāṃ saṅkoco'ṅgagraho'tiruk | śītadveṣānupaśayau stambhavepathusuptayaḥ ||9|| rakte śotho'tiruktodastāmraścimicimāyate | snigdharūkṣaiḥ śamaṃ naiti kaṇḍūkledasamanvitaḥ ||10|| pitte vidāhaḥ sammohaḥ svedo mūrchā madastṛṣā | sparśāsahatvaṃ rugrāgaḥ śothaḥ pāko bhṛśoṣmatā ||11|| kaphe staimityagurutāsuptisnigdhatvaśītatāḥ | kaṇḍūrmandā ca rugdvandvaṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ ca saṅkarāt ||12|| (vā. ni. a. 16) | vātaraktasya doṣāntarasaṃsargeṇa lakṣaṇānyāha– vāte'dhika ityādi| vṛddhihānaya iti vātaraktalakṣaṇānām| rakta ityādi| rakta ityatra ‘adhika’ ityanuvartanīyam, evaṃ vakṣyamāṇapittādiṣu| etaccārambhakaraktādanyadraktāntaraṃ bodhyaṃ, raktamapi raktāntaradūṣakaṃ bhavati| yaduktaṃ duṣṭaraktalakṣaṇe– “ pittavadraktenātikṛṣṇaṃ ca|” (su. sū. a. 14) iti| śamaṃ naiti śāntiṃ na yāti| kapha ityādi| dvandvasarvaliṅgaṃ ca saṅkarāditi saṅkarāt dvidoṣatridoṣamelakāt dvandvaliṅgaṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ ca kramādvātaraktaṃ bhavati||8-12|| doṣāntarasaṃsarge lakṣaṇamāha– vāte'dhika ityādi| tatra jānujaṅghādisthāneṣu śūlādikaṃ jñeyaṃ, tathā śothasya raukṣyādikaṃ vṛddhihānayaśca vijñeyāḥ, dhamanyādīnāṃ saṅkocaḥ| aṅgagrahaḥ śītadveṣaḥ, anupaśayaḥ asātmyam; śītena rogavṛddhiḥ| raktādhikalakṣaṇamāha– rakta iti| rakta ityatrādhika ityanuvartanīyam, evaṃ vakṣyamāṇapittādiṣu| kaṇḍūkledau śamaṃ na yātaḥ, kledo dravatvam| etaccārambhakaraktādraktāntaraṃ boddhavyam| raktamapi raktāntaradūṣakaṃ bhavati, yaduktaṃ duṣṭaraktalakṣaṇe– “pittavat raktenātikṛṣṇaṃ ca” iti| pittādhikamāha– pitta iti| bhṛśoṣmatā santāpādhikyam| kaphādhikamāha– kapha iti| kaphādhike staimityamārdratā, mandā adāruṇā, ruk pīḍā| dvandvajasānnipātikāvāha– dvandvamityādi| saṅkarāt dvidoṣamelakāt tridoṣamelakācca dvandvaliṅgaṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ ca bhavet||8-12|| pādayormūlamāsthāya kadāciddhastayorapi | ākhorviṣamiva kruddhaṃ taddehamupasarpati ||13|| (su. ni. a. 1) | pādayorjātamapratikriyamāṇaṃ deśāntaraṃ vyāpnoti, pādavaddhastayorapi bhavatīti darśayannāha– pādayorityādi| ākhorviṣamityanena mandavisarpaṇatāṃ darśitavān; etadvātaraktaṃ carakeṇa dvividhamuktam| yadāha– “uttānamatha gambhīraṃ dvividhaṃ vātaśoṇitam| tvaṅmāṃsāśrayamuttānaṃ gambhīraṃ tvantarāśrayam||” (ca. ci. a. 29) iti| suśrutena tu kuṣṭhavadutpattau uttānasyottarakālaṃ gambhīratvamuktamiti matabheda eva||13|| pādayorjātamapratikriyamāṇaṃ pradeśāntaraṃ prāpnoti; pādabaddhastayorapi bhavatīti darśayannāha– pādayorityādi| kadāciditi apratikriyamāṇam| hastayorapīti mūlamāsthāya| ākhorviṣamivetyanena mandavisarpitāṃ darśitavān| etacca vātaraktaṃ carakeṇa dvividhamuktaṃ tadyathā– “uttānamatha gambhīraṃ dvividhaṃ vātaśoṇitam| tvaṅmāṃsāśrayamuttānaṃ gambhīraṃ tvantarāśrayam||” iti||13|| ājānu sphuṭitaṃ yacca prabhinnaṃ prasrutaṃ ca yat | upadravaiśca yajjuṣṭaṃ prāṇamāṃsakṣayādibhiḥ ||14|| vātaraktamasādhyaṃ syādyāpyaṃ saṃvatsarotthitam | (su. ni. a. 1) | asvapnārocakaśvāsamāṃsakothaśirograhāḥ ||15|| sammūrchāmadaruktṛṣṇājvaramohapravepakāḥ | hikkāpāṅgulyavīsarpapākatodabhramaklamāḥ ||16|| aṅgulīvakratāsphoṭadāhamarmagrahārbudāḥ | etairupadravairvarjyaṃ mohenaikena vā'pi yat ||17|| akṛtsnopadravaṃ yāpyaṃ, sādhyaṃ syānnirupadravam | ekadoṣānugaṃ sādhyaṃ navaṃ, yāpyaṃ dvidoṣajam | tridoṣajamasādhyaṃ syādyasya ca syurupadravāḥ ||18|| (ca. ci. a. 29) | asādhyatvādikamāha– ājānvityādi| ājānu jānuparyantaṃ gatamasādhyam| tathā sphuṭitādikaṃ sphuṭitaṃ dalitatvak, prabhinnaṃ vidīrṇatvak| upadravairityādau ādiśabdena vakṣyamāṇānāmasvapnādīnāṃ grahaṇam| yāpyaṃ saṃvatsarotthitamityanena saṃvatsarādarvāk sādhyaṃ, yadi sphuṭitatvagādayo na bhaveyurityāhuḥ| asvapnetyādi| pāṅgulyaṃ paṅgutā| mohenaikeneti vacanāt pūrvoktaiḥ samastairdvitryādibhiśceti jñāpayatīti||14-18|| etasyaivāsādhyayāpyatve āha– ājānvityādi| ājānu jānuparyantaṃ gatamasādhyam| sphuṭitaṃ dalitatvak| prabhinnaṃ vidīrṇam| prasrutaṃ srāvayuktam| upadravairiti prāṇamāṃsakṣayādibhiḥ, ādigrahaṇena ca vakṣyamāṇānāmasvapnādīnāṃ grahaṇam| yāpyaṃ saṃvatsarotthitamityanena saṃvatsarādarvāk sādhyaṃ, yadi sphuṭitatvādayo na bhaveyuḥ| upadravānāha– asvapnetyādi| māṃsakotho māṃsagalanam| mūrchāyo mūrchā| amandaruk pīḍābāhulyam| moha indriyārthānām| pāṅgulyaṃ paṅgutā| mohenaikeneti vacanāt pūrvoktaiḥ samastaiśceti jñāpayati| punaśca sādhyāsādhyatvamāha– akṛtsnetyādi| yasya ca sarve upadravā bhaveyuḥ so'pyasādhyaḥ| ‘akṛtsnopadravam’ ityādikaṃ mādhavena na gṛhītaṃ, pustakāntareṣu dṛṣṭatvāllikhitamiti||14-18|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne vātaraktanidānaṃ samāptam ||23|| iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ vātaraktanidānaṃ samāptam||23|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ vātaraktanidānam||23|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘vātaraktaṃ prakupyati’ iti pā. | ↩ 2 . ‘carake’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘duṣṭena’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 4 . ‘kaṭuprajāgarādibhiśca’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘vātavyādhyadhyāye’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘nidānavaiśiṣṭyādviśiṣṭasamprāptikathanam’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘duṣṭaṃ srutam’ iti pā. | ↩ 8 . ‘vidāhāt’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 9 . ‘madaḥ satṛṭ’ iti pā. | ↩ 10 . ‘rakta ityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 11 . ‘bhavati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 12 . ‘pittavadraktenātiduṣṭam’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘kapha ityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 14 . ‘saṅkarāditi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 15 . ‘kāraṇamāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 16 . ‘jānujaṅghādisthāneṣu vātaraktalakṣaṇānām’ iti pā.| ↩ 17 . ‘dhamanyāḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 18 . ‘aṅgagrahaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 19 . ‘asātmyam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 20 . ‘śītena rogavṛddhiḥ|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 21 . ‘cimicimeti kaṇḍūbhedaḥ śamaṃ na yāti, kledaśca dravatvam|’ iti pā.| ↩ 22 . ‘yato raktāntaraṃ dūṣakaṃ, yat duṣṭaraktalakṣaṇaṃ pittavat raktenātikṛṣṇaṃ bhavati|’ iti pā.| ↩ 23 . ‘alpapīḍā mandā ruk ceti lakṣaṇabhedaḥ|’ iti pā.| ↩ 24 . ‘mūrchātimadaruk ... ’ iti pā. | ↩ 25 . ‘asvapnetyādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 26 . ‘bodhayatīti’ iti pā.| ↩ 27 . ‘asādhyam’ iti pā.| ↩ 28 . etacca ‘mūrchāyo'mandaruktṛṣṇā’ iti pā.| ↩ 29 . ‘na’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 30 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ vātaraktanidānam||23||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 24. ūrustambhanidānam
text: athorustambhanidānam | śītoṣṇadravasaṃśuṣkagurusnigdhairniṣevitaiḥ | jīrṇājīrṇe tathā''yāsasaṅkṣobhasvapnajāgaraiḥ ||1|| saśleṣmamedaḥpavanaḥ sāmamatyarthasañcitam | abhibhūyetaraṃ doṣamūrū cet pratipadyate ||2|| sakthyasthinī prapūryāntaḥ śleṣmaṇā stimitena ca | tadā stabhnāti tenorū stabdhau śītāvacetanau ||3|| parakīyāviva gurū syātāmatibhṛśavyathau | dhyānāṅgamardastaimityatandrācchardyarucijvaraiḥ ||4|| saṃyuktau pādasadanakṛcchroddharaṇasuptibhiḥ | tamūrustambhamityāhurāḍhyavātamathāpare ||5|| (vā. ni. a. 15) | vātavyādhiviśeṣatvādūrustambhamāha– śītoṣṇetyādi| śītoṣṇagrahaṇamanuktaparasparavirodhidvandvopalakṣaṇārthaṃ, tena gurusnigdhābhyāṃ laghurūkṣayorgrahaṇaṃ bodhyamiti jejjaṭaḥ| saṃśuṣkaṃ kaṭhinaṃ, dravavirodhitvāt| jīrṇājīrṇe iti prabhūtaṃ jīrṇaṃ, stokamajīrṇamityāhuḥ, tasmin; ‘bhojane’ iti śeṣaḥ| ata eva dṛḍhabalena– ‘jīrṇājīrṇe samaśnataḥ|’ (ca. ci. a. 27) iti paṭhitam| ete ca yathāsambhavaṃ śleṣmādīnāṃ hetavaḥ| saśleṣmamedaḥpavanaḥ iti saśleṣmamedaścāsau pavanaśceti saśleṣmamedaḥpavanaḥ iti vigrahaḥ| itaraṃ doṣaṃ pittam| asyāṃ samprāptau vātasya prādhānyamuktam, ata eva suśrutena mahāvātavyādhāvayaṃ rogaḥ paṭhitaḥ| carake tu kaphasya prādhānyamuktam| yadāha– “ūrū śleṣmā samedasko vātapitte'bhibhūya tu|” (ca. ci. a. 27) ityādi| tatra carake āvarakasya śleṣmaṇaḥ prākcikitsyatvena prādhānyam, ārambhakatvena tu suśrute pavanasyeti na virodhaḥ| parakīyāvivetyanena utkṣepaṇagamanādiṣvaprabhutvaṃ darśayati| dhyānādibhirjvarāntairupalakṣitaḥ ‘puruṣa’ iti śeṣaḥ||1-5|| vātavyādhiviśeṣatvādūrustambhanidānārambhaḥ| tasya nidānapūrvāṃ samprāptimāha– śītetyādi| śītoṣṇādigrahaṇamanuktaparasparavirodhidvandvadoṣopalakṣaṇārthaṃ, tena gurusnigdhābhyāṃ laghurūkṣayorgrahaṇaṃ boddhavyamiti jejjaṭaḥ| saṃśuṣkaṃ kaṭhinaṃ, dravavirodhitvāt| jīrṇājīrṇe iti prabhūtaṃ jīrṇaṃ, stokamajīrṇamityāhuḥ, tasmin; ‘bhojane’ iti śeṣaḥ| ata eva dṛḍhabalena ‘jīrṇājīrṇe samaśnataḥ’ iti paṭhitam| āyāso vyāyāmaḥ| svapnaṃ divā, jāgaraṇaṃ niśi| saśleṣmamedaḥpavana iti saśleṣmamedaścāsau pavanaśca saśleṣmamedaḥ pavanaḥ| atyarthasañcitamitaraṃ doṣaṃ pittam| asyāṃ samprāptau vātasya prādhānyamuktam, ata eva suśrute mahāvātavyādhāvayaṃ paṭhitaḥ; carake tu kaphaprādhānyam| tatra carake āvarakasya kaphasya prākcikitsyatvena prādhānyam| ārambhakatvena tu suśrute pavanasyeti na virodhaḥ| stimitena mandena, stabhnāti stambhayati, acetanau sparśajñānarahitau| parakīyāvivetyanena utkṣepaṇagamanādiṣvaprabhutvaṃ darśayati| dhyānādibhiḥ jvarāntairupalakṣitaḥ, ‘puruṣa’ iti śeṣaḥ| ūrustambhamapare āḍhyavātamāhuḥ||1-5|| prāgrūpaṃ tasya nidrā'tidhyānaṃ stimitatā jvaraḥ | romaharṣo'ruciśchardirjaṅghorvoḥ sadanaṃ tathā ||6|| prāgrūpamāha– prāgityādi||6|| vātaśaṅkibhirajñānāttasya syāt snehanāt punaḥ | pādayoḥ sadanaṃ suptiḥ kṛcchrāduddharaṇaṃ tathā ||7|| jaṅghoruglāniratyarthaṃ śaśvaccādāhavedane | pādaṃ ca vyathate nyastaṃ śītasparśaṃ na vetti ca ||8|| saṃsthāne pīḍane gatyāṃ cālane cāpyanīśvaraḥ | anyasyeva hi sambhagnāvūrū pādau ca manyate ||9|| yadā dāhārtitodārto vepanaḥ puruṣo bhavet | ūrustambhastadā hanyāt, sādhayedanyathā navam ||10|| (ca. ci. a. 27) | anupaśayamāha– vātetyādi| vātaśaṅkibhiriti suptisaṅkocakampādivātarogasadṛśaliṅgadarśanāttacchaṅkibhiḥ| ajñānādaniścayāt, mohāditi īśānaḥ| tatropaśayānupaśayajñānārthaṃ snehanaṃ, yaduktaṃ carake– “gūḍhaliṅgaṃ vyādhimupaśayānupaśayābhyāṃ parīkṣeta|” (ca. ci. a. 4) iti| tataḥ snehanādanupaśayo bhavatītyāha– pādayorityādi| uddharaṇam ūrdhvacālanam| ādāhavedane iti āṅ īṣadarthe; anye tvīṣadartha eva nañamāhuḥ, udbhūtadāhasyāsādhyatvena vakṣyamāṇatvāt| ‘ānāhavepa(da)ne’ iti pāṭhāntaramayuktaṃ, carakaṭīkākāraiḥ sarvairavyākhyātatvāt| vyādhisvabhāvādayaṃ corustambha eka eva tridoṣārabdhaḥ, natu vātādibhedādanekavidhaḥ| uktaṃ hi carake vyādhisaṅkhyāyām– “eka evorustambhaḥ” (ca. sū. a. 19) iti| sambhagnāviti sambhagnāviva sambhagnau||7-10|| tasyānupaśayamāha– vātetyādi| suptisaṅkocakampādivātarogasadṛśaliṅgadarśanāt tacchaṅkibhirvātarogo'yamiti, ajñānāt bhramāt, snehanāt abhyaṅgādeḥ tatropaśayānupaśayajñānārthaṃ snehanam– “gūḍhaliṅgaṃ vyādhimupaśayānupaśayābhyāṃ parīkṣeta|” iti| tataḥ snehanādanupaśayo bhavatītyāha– pādayorityādi| uddharaṇamūrdhvacālanam| śaśvaccādāhavedaneti āṅ īṣadarthe, anye tvīṣadarthe nañamāhuḥ; udbhūtadāhasyāsādhyatvena vakṣyamāṇatvāt| ‘ānāhaveda(pa)ne’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ na yuktaṃ, carakaṭīkākāraiḥ sarvairavyākhyātatvāt| vyādhisvabhāvādayaṃ corustambha eka eva tridoṣārabdhaḥ, na tu vātādibhedādanekavidhaḥ| asādhyatvamāha– yadeti| anyatheti pūrvoktairupadravai rahitaṃ cotpannamātrameva||7-10|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne ūrustambhanidānaṃ samāptam ||24|| iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāmūrustambhanidānaṃ samāptam||24|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāmūrustambhanidānam||24|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘iti vigrahaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 2 . ‘suśrute’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘kaphaprādhānyamuktam’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘vātavyādhiviśeṣatvādūrustambhamāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘niśi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 6 . agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 7 . ‘apare’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘anyaneyau’ iti pā. | ↩ 9 . ‘anupaśayamāha– vātetyādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 10 . ‘sambhagnāviti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 11 . ‘bhramaḥ ajñānādaniyamāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘snehanam| yaduktam-’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāmūrustambhanidānam||24||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 25. āmavātanidānam
text: athāmavātanidānam | viruddhāhāraceṣṭasya mandāgnerniścalasya ca | snigdhaṃ bhuktavato hyannaṃ vyāyāmaṃ kurvatastathā ||1|| vāyunā prerito hyāmaḥ śleṣmasthānaṃ pradhāvati | tenātyarthaṃ vidagdho'sau dhamanīḥ pratipadyate ||2|| vātapittakaphairbhūyo dūṣitaḥ so'nnajo rasaḥ | srotāṃsyabhiṣyandayati nānāvarṇo'tipicchilaḥ ||3|| janayatyāśu daurbalyaṃ gauravaṃ hṛdayasya ca | vyādhīnāmāśrayo hyeṣa āmasañjño'tidāruṇaḥ ||4|| yugapatkupitāvantastrikasandhipraveśakau | stabdhaṃ ca kuruto gātramāmavātaḥ sa ucyate ||5|| ūrustambhe vāyuḥ sāma ityuktam, atastadanantaramāmavātanidānamāha– viruddhetyādi| viruddhāhāraḥ saṃyogādiviruddhaḥ, viruddhā ca ceṣṭā yathā– ajīrṇe vyāyāmavyavāyajalaprataraṇādi| snigdhaṃ bhuktavato vyāyāmaṃ kurvata iti milito hetuḥ, na pṛthaktvena| śleṣmasthānamāmāśayasandhyādi| tena vātena vidagdho dūṣito'sāvāmo dhamanīḥ pratipadyate, ‘dhamanībhiḥ pratipadyata’ iti pāṭhāntare śleṣmasthānamiti yojyam| so'nnajo rasa iti āmaḥ, annarasasyaivāpakvasya tantrāntare āmavyapadeśāt| yaduktam– “ūṣmaṇo'lpabalatvena dhātumādyamapācitam| duṣṭamāmāśayagataṃ rasamāmaṃ pracakṣate||” (vā. sū. a. 13) ityādi| anyairapyuktam–
