kapikacchuśūkaiḥ kapikacchuḥ śūkaśimbī, eteṣāṃ sparśāt; prasaraṇaśīlaḥ, bhṛśoṣmā atiśayasantāpakṛt, pittaśvayathulakṣaṇaḥ||11-12|| viṣajaḥ saviṣaprāṇiparisarpaṇamūtraṇāt | daṃṣṭrādantanakhāghātādaviṣaprāṇināmapi ||13|| viṇmūtraśukropahatamalavadvastrasaṅkarāt | viṣavṛkṣānilasparśādgarayogāvacūrṇanāt ||14|| mṛduścalo'valambī ca śīghro dāharujākaraḥ |15| (vā. ni. a. 13) | viṣajamāha– viṣaja ityādi| saviṣaprāṇinaḥ sarpādayasteṣāṃ parisarpaṇaṃ bhramaṇaṃ tasmāt, saviṣaprāṇināṃ mūtraṇācca| daṃṣṭrādanteti daṃṣṭrā kuṭilā ‘dāḍha’ iti khyātā, tadviparītaśca danto gobalīvardanyāyāt| viṇmūtraśukropahatamalavadvastrasaṅkarāditi saviṣaprāṇināṃ viṇmūtrādyupahataṃ malavacca vastraṃ yattasya saṃsparśāt| avalambī adhogamanaśīlaḥ| śīghraḥ śīghrotpattiḥ| ayaṃ cāganturapi viśiṣṭaliṅgacikitsopayogāt pṛthak paṭhitaḥ||13-14||– viṣajaśothalakṣaṇamāha– viṣajetyādi| saviṣaprāṇinaḥ saviṣā ye jantavaḥ śatapadīlūtādayaḥ, teṣāṃ śarīropari sarpaṇaṃ mūtraṇaṃ ca dvayamapi śvayathorhetuḥ| daṃṣṭrādanteti daṃṣṭrā kuṭilākārā ‘dāḍha’ iti loke, dantā agrebhavāḥ, anye daṃṣṭridantanakheti paṭhanti, tatra daṃṣṭriṇo vyāghrādayaḥ, nakhāḥ prasiddhāḥ| aviṣaprāṇināṃ manuṣyādīnāmapyabhighātaḥ śothahetuḥ| viṇmūtretyādi saviṣaprāṇināṃ viṇmūtrādyupahatamalavadvastrasya saṃsparśāt; anye ‘malavadvastu’ iti paṭhanti, tatra saviṣaprāṇināṃ viṇmūtraśukropahatatvenaitadyanmalavadvastu tasya samparkādityarthaḥ| saviṣā ye vṛkṣāsteṣāṃ yo'nilaḥ, tasya sparśādapi| garaḥ kṛtrimaviṣaṃ tasyāvacūrṇanāt, tasya śarīrasparśādityarthaḥ| mṛduḥ mṛdusparśaḥ, calaḥ sthānāntaragatiḥ, avalambī adhogamanaśīlaḥ, śīghraḥ śīghrotpattiḥ||13-14|| doṣāḥ śvayathumūrdhvaṃ hi kurvantyāmāśayasthitāḥ ||15|| pakvāśayasthā madhye tu varcaḥsthānagatāstvadhaḥ | kṛtsnadehamanuprāptāḥ kuryuḥ sarvasaraṃ tathā ||16|| (su. ci. a. 23) | yatrasthā doṣā yatra deśe śothaṃ kurvanti tamāha– doṣā ityādi| ūrdhvamiti uraḥprabhṛtyūrdhvadehe| madhya iti uraḥpakvāśayamadhye| adha iti pakvāśayādadhaḥ| sarvasaraṃ sarvaśarīrasaraṇaśīlam||15-16|| yasmin deśe doṣāḥ śophaṃ kurvanti tamāha– doṣā ityādi| ūrdhvamiti uraḥprabhṛtyūrdhvadehe| madhya iti uraḥpakvāśayamadhye, adha iti pakvāśayādadho varcaḥsthānaṃ purīṣāśayaḥ, sarvaśarīrasaraṇaśīlam||15-16|| yo madhyadeśe śvayathuḥ sa kaṣṭaḥ sarvagaśca yaḥ | ardhāṅge riṣṭabhūtaḥ syādyaścordhvaṃ parisarpati ||17|| śvāsaḥ pipāsā chardiśca daurbalyaṃ jvara eva ca | yasya cānne rucirnāsti śvayathuṃ taṃ vivarjayet ||18|| (su. ci. a. 23) | ananyopadravakṛtaḥ śothaḥ pādasamutthitaḥ | puruṣaṃ hanti nārīṃ ca mukhajo guhyajo dvayam | navo'nupadravaḥ śothaḥ sādhyo'sādhyaḥ pureritaḥ ||19|| (vā. ni. a. 13) | vivarjayet kukṣyudarāśritaṃ ca tathā gale marmaṇi saṃśritaṃ ca | sthūlaḥ kharaścāpi bhavedvivarjyo yaścāpi bālasthavirābalānām ||20|| ataḥ paraṃ kṛcchrādibhedamāha– yo madhyadeśa ityādi| madhyadehagasya kaṣṭatvaṃ taddeśagaśothaprabhāvāt| sarvaga iti sarvadehagāmī| sarvaja iti pāṭhāntare sarvajaḥ sānnipātikaḥ| riṣṭabhūta iti riṣṭatulyaḥ, bhūtaśabda upamāne; yathā– mātṛbhūtaḥ, pitṛbhūta iti| vyādherevātra riṣṭabhūtatvaṃ, tasya ca nimittakṛtatvāt bhūtaśabda upātta iti kārtikaḥ| anye tu bhūtaśabdaṃ svarūpavacanamāhuḥ| yaścordhvaṃ parisarpatīti puruṣaviṣayakametat; cakārāt striyāśca uparijo yo'dho yāti sa gṛhyate, tathā guhyajo yaḥ sarvagaḥ| vacanaṃ hi– “yastu pādābhinirvṛttaḥ śothaḥ sarvāṅgago bhavet| puruṣaṃ hanti, nārīṃ ca mukhajo, guhyajo dvayam||” (ca. sū. a. 18) iti| ananyopadravakṛta iti anyasya upadravā anyopadravāstadviparītā ananyopadravāḥ; etenāyamarthaḥ– śothasyaiva ye upadravāstaiḥ kṛtaḥ| te ca– “śvāsaḥ pipāsā daurbalyaṃ jvaraśchardirarocakaḥ| hikkātīsārakāsāśca śothinaṃ kṣapayanti hi||” (su. ci. a. 23) iti suśrutoktāḥ| carake'pyuktam– “chardistṛṣṇā'ruciḥ śvāso jvaro'tīsāra eva ca| saptako'yaṃ sadaurbalyaḥ śothopadravasaṅgrahaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 18) iti| athavā anyamupadravaṃ karotīti anyopadravakṛnnidānam| nānyopadravakṛdananyopadravakṛt, tataḥ svanidānāt ‘jātaḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ; tena śothajanakanidānādeva utpanna ityarthaḥ| pāṇḍurogādau tu yaḥ śothaḥ pādasamutthitaḥ so'nyopadravakṛto nidānāntarājjātaḥ sādhya eva| ‘ānanopadravagata’ iti pāṭhāntare ayamarthaḥ– pādayorutthitaḥ pūrvaṃ paścādānanamupadraveṇa prasāreṇa upadravatvena vā gataḥ| tathāca tantrāntaram– “ pādapravṛttaḥ śvayathurnṛṇāṃ yaḥ prāpnuyānmukham| strīṇāṃ vaktrādadho yāti, bastijaśca na sidhyati||” iti| kṣārapāṇinā'pyuktam– “ūrdhvagāmī naraṃ padbhyāmadhogāmī mukhāt striyam| ubhayaṃ bastisañjātaḥ śotho hanti na saṃśayaḥ||” iti| guhyaja iti bastijātaḥ| dvayamiti naraṃ nārīṃ ca| asādhyaḥ purerita iti “ardhāṅge riṣṭabhūta” ityādinā||17-20|| ataḥ sthānāśrayatve kṛcchrādibhedamāha– ya ityādi| madhyagaśvayathoḥ kaṣṭasādhyatvaṃ taddeśaprabhāvāt| sarvaga iti sarvadehagāmī, ‘sarvaja’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatra sānnipātikaḥ| riṣṭabhūta iti riṣṭatulyaḥ; bhūtaśabdo hyupamāne, yathā mātṛbhūtaḥ pitṛbhūta iti| yaścordhvaṃ parisarpatīti puruṣaviṣayametat, cakārāt striyāścoparijo yo'dho yāti sa gṛhyate, tathā guhyajo yaḥ sa sarvagaḥ| upadravaviśeṣasyāsādhyatvamāha– śvāsa iti| yasyaitāni santi śvayathau sati, taṃ parivarjayet| sthānabhedenāsādhyatvamāha– ananyetyādi| na anyopadravāḥ ananyopadravāḥ śophasyopadravāstaiḥ kṛtaḥ, te ca suśrutoktāḥ– “śvāsaḥ pipāsā daurbalyaṃ jvaraśchardirarocakaḥ| hikkātīsārakāsāśca śothinaṃ kṣapayanti hi|” iti| carake'pyuktam– “chardiḥ śvāso'rucistṛṣṇā jvaro'tīsāra eva ca| saptako'yaṃ sadaurbalyaḥ śothopadravasaṅgraha||” iti| athavā anyamupadravaṃ karotīti anyopadravakṛt nidānaṃ, na anyopadravakṛt ananyopadravakṛt, tato nidānājjāta ityanena śophajanakanidānādevotpanna ityarthaḥ| pāṇḍurogādau tu yaḥ śophaḥ so'nyopadravakṛto nidānājjātaḥ sādhya eva| pādasamutthitaḥ puruṣaṃ hanti nārīṃ tu mukhajo hanti, guhyajo bastisañjātaḥ, dvayamiti naraṃ nārīṃ ca| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare– “pādapravṛttaḥ śvayathurnṛṇāṃ yaḥ prāpnuyānmukham| vakrādadhastādyo yāti bastijaśca na siddhyati|” kṣīrapāṇinā'pyuktam– “ūrdhvagāmī naraṃ padbhyāmadhogāmī mukhātstriyam| ubhayorbastisañjātaḥ śotho hanti na saṃśayaḥ||” iti| sādhyāsādhyalakṣaṇamāha– nava iti| navo navotthānaḥ, upadravarahitaḥ, upadravāḥ pūrvoktāḥ śvāsādayaḥ, tairmuktaḥ sa sādhyaḥ, asādhyaḥ pūrvairita ūrdhvāṅge riṣṭabhūtaḥ||17-20|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne śothanidānaṃ samāptam ||36|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śothanidānaṃ samāptam||36|| ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ śothanidānam||36|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘śothasya upadravatvena’ iti pā.| ↩ 2 . ‘pāṭhato’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘ ... prabhūtakāraṇabhedairyo’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘militairekadvayaistrayaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘kṣīrāmla...’ iti pā. | ↩ 6 . ‘maṇḍakanavodakādi’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . etacca– kṣīrāmleti pāṭha.| ↩ 8 . ‘dadhyādiṣu’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘setyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 10 . ‘abahulatvak’ iti pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘abalatvak’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . atra ‘atiratiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake upalabhyate | ↩ 13 . ‘gaṇyante’ iti pā.| ↩ 14 . ‘paṭhati’ iti pā.| ↩ 15 . ‘himānilairudadhyanilaiḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 16 . ‘śvayathuḥ saśastrādibhiḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 17 . ‘viṣajaḥ saviṣaprāṇītyādi’ iti pā.| ↩ 18 . ‘viṣe śothalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 19 . ‘mūtraṇam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 20 . ‘garakṛtrimaviṣam’ iti pā.| ↩ 21 . ‘mṛduḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 22 . ‘doṣāḥ śvayathumūrdhvamityādi’ iti pā.| ↩ 23 . ‘adhāṅga’ iti aśuddhaḥ pā. | ↩ 24 . ‘pādapravṛttaśvayathurnṛṇām’ iti pā.| ↩ 25 . ‘kṣīrapāṇinā ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 26 . ‘pāṭhāntare’ iti pā.| ↩ 27 . ‘saptakopam’ iti pā.| ↩ 28 . atra ‘sarpan’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 29 . ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 30 . ‘pūrverita ūrdhvāṅge iti bhūtaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 31 . ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyām’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 37. vṛddhinidānam
text: atha vṛddhinidānam | kruddho'nūrdhvagatirvāyuḥ śothaśūlakaraścaran | muṣkau vaṅkṣaṇataḥ prāpya phalakoṣābhivāhinīḥ ||1|| prapīḍya dhamanīrvṛddhiṃ karoti phalakoṣayoḥ | doṣāsramedomūtrāntraiḥ sa vṛddhiḥ saptadhā gadaḥ ||2|| mūtrāntrajāvapyanilāddhetubhedastu kevalam |3| (vā. ni. a. 11) | śothatvasāmānyāt śothānantaraṃ vṛddhirabhidhīyate| vṛddheḥ samprāptimāha– kruddho'nūrdhvagatirvāyurityādi| anūrdhvagatiradhogatirvāyuḥ muṣkau prāpya caran gacchan vaṅkṣaṇato meḍhrajaṅghāsandheḥ sakāśāt; phalakoṣābhivāhinīriti phalaṃ ca koṣaśca phalakoṣau, athavā phalayoḥ koṣau, tadvahā dhamanīśca prapīḍya sandūṣya, vṛddhiṃ karoti| phalakoṣayoriti dvivacanamupalakṣaṇaṃ, tenaikakoṣe'pi dṛśyamānā vṛddhiḥ saṅgatā| sa vṛddhiriti “kticktau ca sañjñāyām” ityanena ktijanto vṛddhiśabdaḥ puṃliṅgaḥ, ktinnantastu strīliṅgaḥ| vṛddhiḥ kuraṇḍo'bhidhīyate| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ saptadheti vacanaṃ nyūnādhikasaṅkhyānirāsārthaṃ, tena dvandvajādivṛddheradhikāyā nirāsaḥ, asambhavastu tasyā vyādhisvabhāvāt; mūtrāntravṛddhyorvātavṛddhyantarbhāvāt nyūnasaṅkhyānirāsārtham anayorvātajatve'pi nimittacikitsābhedāt pṛthagabhidhānaṃ, nimittabhedanibandhana eva vyādhibhedaḥ| yaduktam– “doṣadūṣyasaṃsargādāyatanaviśeṣānnimittataścaiṣāṃ vyādhīnāṃ bhedaḥ|” (su. sū. a. 24) iti| ata āha– mūtrāntrajāvapyanilāddhetubhedastu kevalamiti||1-2|| śothādhikārāt vṛddhirabhidhīyate| vṛddheḥ samprāptimāha– kruddha ityādi| anūrdhvagatirvāyuḥ adhogatirvāto muṣkau prāpya caran gacchan, vaṅkṣaṇato meḍhrajaṅghāsandheḥ sakāśāt, phalakoṣābhivāhinīriti phalaṃ ca kośaśca phalakośau, athavā phalayoḥ kośau phalakośau, tadvahā dhamanīḥ prapīḍya sandūṣya vṛddhiṃ karoti, phalakoṣayoriti dvivacanamupalakṣaṇaṃ, tenaikaphalakoṣe'pi dṛśyamānā vṛddhiḥ sammatā| vṛddhiḥ ‘kuraṇḍa’ iti loke| vṛddheḥ saṅkhyāmāha– doṣetyādi| doṣatrayaistrayaḥ, raktenaikaḥ, medasā caikaḥ, mūtreṇaikaḥ, evaṃ sapta| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ punaḥ saptadheti vacanaṃ nyūnādhikasaṅkhyānirāsārthaṃ, dvandvajāyā api vṛddhernirāsaḥ, dvandvajāyāstvasambhavo vyādhisvabhāvāt; mūtrāntravṛddhyorvātavṛddhyantarbhāvāt nyūnasaṅkhyānirāsaḥ, anayorvātajatve'pi nidānacikitsābhedāt pṛthagabhidhānaṃ, nidānabhedanibandhana eva vyādhibhedaḥ| uktaṃ ca– “doṣadūṣyasaṃsargādāyatanaviśeṣānnimittataścaiṣāṃ vyādhīnāṃ bhedaḥ” iti| ata eva mūtrāntrajāvapi vātāt, tatra hetubhedata eva bhedaḥ kevala iti| vṛddhiśabdaḥ pulliṅgo vā||1-2|| vātapūrṇadṛtisparśo rūkṣo vātādaheturuk ||3|| pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ pittāddāhoṣmapākavān kaphācchīto guruḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhino'lparuk ||4|| kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ pittavṛddhiliṅgaśca raktajaḥ | kaphavanmedasā vṛddhirmṛdustālaphalopamaḥ ||5|| mūtradhāraṇaśīlasya mūtrajaḥ sa tu gacchataḥ | ambhobhiḥ pūrṇadṛtivat kṣobhaṃ yāti saruṅmṛduḥ ||6|| mūtrakṛcchramadhaḥ syācca cālayan phalakoṣayoḥ |7| (vā. ni. a. 11) | vātajādīnāṃ mūtrajāntānāṃ vṛddhīnāṃ krameṇa lakṣaṇānyāha– vātetyādi| aheturugiti animittato dāhādiruk| raktaje ‘kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛta’ iti pittajavṛddhiliṅgādadhikaṃ; tena hetuliṅgacikitsābhedādraktajavṛddhiḥ pṛthaggaṇyate| medoje tālaphalopama iti pakvatālaphalamiva nīlavartulaḥ| mūtraje mūtrakṛcchramiti mūtrakṛcchravat vedanā| cālayan phalakoṣayoriti phalakoṣayoścālayan calo bhavannitastato gacchan so'dhaḥ syāt| cālayanniti svārthiko ṇic||3-6||– vātajamāha– vātetyādi| dṛtiścarmakhalliḥ| animittato bhedatodādiruk| pittajamāha– pakvetyādi| pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ pakvodumbaraphalābhaḥ, tathā dāhādiyuktaḥ| kaphavṛddhimāha– kaphādityādi| kaphād vṛddhiḥ śītaḥ śītasparśaḥ, tathā guruḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhino'śmavat, alparuk mandavedanaḥ| raktajamāha– raktetyādi| raktajo vṛddhiḥ, atra tu kṛṣṇasphoṭaiścitaḥ pittavṛddhiliṅgaiśca pakvodumbarasaṅkāśādibhiryuto bhavet| atra tu kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛta iti pittavṛddhiliṅgādadhikaṃ, tena hetubhedacikitsābhedādraktajo vṛddhiḥ pṛthaggaṇyate| medojamāha– kaphavatkaphavṛddhilakṣaṇaṃ tālaphalopama iti pakvatālavannīlavartulaḥ| mūtrajamāha– mūtretyādi| mūtradhāraṇaśīlasya mūtrajo bhavati, gacchataḥ puṃsaḥ jalapūrṇadṛtivat kṣobhaṃ yāti pūrito bhavati, saruk savyathaḥ, mṛduḥ mṛdusparśaḥ| mūtrakṛcchramiti mūtrakṛcchravedanaḥ| phalakośayoriti phalakośayoścālayan calo bhavannitastato gacchan so'dhaḥ syāt| cālayanniti svārthiko ṇic| ‘valayaṃ phalakośayoḥ’ iti pāṭhe phalakośayoradhastādvalayaṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ syāt||3-6||– vātakopibhirāhāraiḥ śītatoyāvagāhanaiḥ ||7|| dhāraṇeraṇabhārādhvaviṣamāṅgapravartanaiḥ | kṣobhaṇaiḥ kṣobhito'nyaiśca kṣudrāntrāvayavaṃ yadā ||8|| pavano viguṇīkṛtya svaniveśādadho nayet | kuryādvaṅkṣaṇasandhistho granthyābhaṃ śvayathuṃ tadā ||9|| upekṣyamāṇasya ca muṣkavṛddhimādhmānarukstambhavatīṃ sa vāyuḥ | prapīḍito'ntaḥsvanavān prayāti pradhmāpayanneti punaśca muktaḥ ||10|| yasyāntrāvayavāśleṣānmuṣkayorvātasambhavāt | antravṛddhirasādhyo'yaṃ vātavṛddhisamākṛtiḥ ||11|| (vā. ni. a. 11) | antravṛddhimāha– vātakopibhirityādi| dhāraṇaṃ vegasyopasthitasya, īraṇamaprāptasya| kṣobhaṇaiḥ kṣubhito'nyairiti balavadvigrahadhanurākarṣaṇādibhiḥ| kṣudrāntrāvayavamiti bṛhadantravyudāsārtham| viguṇīkṛtyeti saṅkucīkṛtya| dviguṇīkṛtyeti pāṭhāntare saṅkocena dviguṇīkṛtya| svaniveśāt svasthānāt| tadā vaṅkṣaṇasandhisthaḥ san vaṅkṣaṇasandhau granthirūpaṃ sādhyaṃ śvayathuṃ karoti, tatra granthirūpeṇa sthitvā kālāntareṇa phalakoṣaṃ gacchatīti| tāṃ muṣkavṛddhimādhmānarukstambhavatīmupekṣyamāṇasya acikitsitapuruṣasya| atra bhojaḥ– “antraṃ dviguṇamādāya jantornayati vaṅkṣaṇam| vaṅkṣaṇāttadrujāyuktaṃ phalakoṣaṃ prapadyate||” iti| pradhmāpayanniti ucchūnayan| asādhyo'yamiti kathaṃ? yato'sya cikitsā'bhihitā; naivam, aprāptaphalakoṣāyāmayaṃ cikitsāvidhiḥ; prāptaphalakoṣā tvasādhyā; yāpyāyāṃ vā tasyāṃ cikitsāvidhiḥ| yaduktaṃ bhoje– “yāpyāṃ tāmantrajāṃ viduḥ|” iti| bradhnanidānaṃ tu tantrāntare paṭhyate| tadyathā– “atyabhiṣyandigurvannasevanānnicayaṃ gataḥ| karoti granthivacchothaṃ doṣo vaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu|| jvaraśūlāṅgasādāḍhyaṃ taṃ bradhnamiti nirdiśet||” iti||7-10|| antravṛddhimāha– vātetyādi| vātakopibhirāhārai rūkṣatiktakaṣāyādibhirāsevitaistathā śītatoyāvagāhanaistathā dhāraṇeraṇabhārādibhiranyaiśca kṣobhaṇaiḥ kṣobhitaḥ kupitaḥ pavano vāyuryadā yasmin kāle kṣudrāntrāvayavaṃ (mūtraśakṛdgātraikadeśaṃ?) svaniveśāt svasthānāt, dviguṇīkṛtyā'dho nayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| anye viguṇīkṛtyeti paṭhanti| dhāraṇamupasthitavegasya , īraṇamaprāptavegasya, kṣobhaṇaiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ, anyairiti balavadvigrahaiḥ dhanurākarṣaṇādibhiḥ, viṣamāṅgapravartanaiḥ viṣamatvena śarīramoṭanaiḥ| pavano vaṅkṣaṇasandhisthaḥ san, vaṅkṣaṇasandhau granthirūpamasādhyaṃ śvayathuṃ karoti| tatra granthirūpeṇa sthitvā kālāntareṇa phalakośaṃ gacchati| tāṃ muṣkavṛddhimādhmānarukstambhavatīṃ tadopekṣamāṇasyācikitsataḥ puruṣasya| yadāha bhojaḥ– “antraṃ dviguṇamādāya jantornayati vaṅkṣaṇam| vaṅkṣaṇāttadrujāyuktaṃ phalakośaṃ prapadyate||” iti| sa ca śvayathuḥ kareṇa pīḍitaḥ saśabdaṃ prayāti, muktaḥ sannādhmāpayan pūrayan punarāyāti| asādhyamāha– yasyetyādi| āśleṣāt saṃyogāt, vātasañcayāt muṣkayorantravṛddhirbhavati| ayamasādhyaḥ, kathaṃ tarhi cikitsā? aprāptaphalakośayościkitsāvidhiḥ, prāptaphalakoṣā tvasādhyā| yāpyāyāṃ vā cikitsāvidhiḥ| yaduktaṃ bhoje– ‘yāpyāṃ tāmantrajāṃ viduḥ’ iti| bradhnanidānaṃ tu tantrāntare paṭhyate, tadyathā– “atyabhiṣyandigurvannasevanānnicayaṃ gataḥ| karoti granthivacchothaṃ doṣo vaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu| jvaraśūlāgnisādāḍhyaṃ taṃ bradhnamiti nirdiśet||” iti||7-10|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne vṛddhinidānaṃ samāptam ||37|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ vṛddhinidānaṃ samāptam||37|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyakṛtāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ vṛddhinidānam||37|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . meḍhrorusandherityarthaḥ| ↩ 2 . ‘sapta saṅkhyeyaiva nirdeśādeva’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘ ... lakṣaṇaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘pīḍito ... ’ iti pā. | ↩ 5 . agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate ↩ 6 . ‘acikitsitaḥ puruṣasya’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . kvacitpustake agrimapaṅktiḥ ekapaṅktipaścāt upalabhyate | ↩ 8 . atra ‘iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 9 . kvacitpustake ‘anye viguṇīkṛtyeti paṭhanti|’ iti paṅktiḥ atra upalabhyate | ↩ 10 . ‘vā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 11 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ vṛddhinidānam||37||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 38. galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāpacīgranthyarbudanidānam
text: atha galagaṇḍa-gaṇḍamālāpacī-granthyarbudanidānam | nibaddhaḥ śvayathuryasya muṣkavallambate gale | mahān vā yadi vā hrasvo galagaṇḍaṃ tamādiśet ||1|| (su. ni. a. 11) | vṛddhiyuktamuṣkasamānaliṅgatvāttadanantaraṃ galagaṇḍanidānam| tasya sāmānyaliṅgamāha– nibaddhaḥ śvayathurityādi| nibaddho'nubandhavān| muṣkavadaṇḍavat| bhoje'pyuktam– “mahāntaṃ śothamalpaṃ vā hanumanyāgalāśrayam| lambantaṃ muṣkavaddṛṣṭvā galagaṇḍaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||1|| vṛddhiyuktamuṣkasādharmyāttadanantaraṃ galagaṇḍanidānam| tasya sāmānyaliṅgamāha– nibaddha ityādi| nibaddho'nubandhavān, muṣkavat aṇḍavat| yaduktaṃ bhojena– “mahāntaṃ śothamalpaṃ vā hanumanyāgalāśrayam| lambantaṃ muṣkavaddṛṣṭvā galagaṇḍaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||1|| vātaḥ kaphaścāpi gale praduṣṭo manye ca saṃśritya tathaiva medaḥ | kurvanti gaṇḍaṃ kramaśaḥ svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitaṃ taṃ galagaṇḍamāhuḥ ||2|| (su. ni. a. 11) | tasya samprāptimāha– vāta ityādi| vātakaphamedāṃsi pṛthak galagaṇḍakāraṇāni, tena traya eva galagaṇḍāḥ; paittikastu na bhavatyeva, vyādhisvabhāvāt; cāturthakajvaravat| cāturthake hi vacanam– “cāturthako darśayati prabhāvaṃ dvividhaṃ jvaraḥ| jaṅghābhyāṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ pūrvaṃ śirasto'nilasambhavaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| kramaśa ityanena śanaireva vardhanaṃ darśayati| svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitamiti “nibaddhaḥ śvayathuḥ” ityādinā uktagalagaṇḍaliṅgairanvitam||2|| tasya samprāptimāha– vāta ityādi| vātakaphamedāṃsi pṛthaggalagaṇḍakāraṇāni, tena traya eva galagaṇḍāḥ paittikastu na bhavatyeva, vyādhisvabhāvāt| manye ubhe kaṇṭhasandhau| kramaśa iti śanairvṛddhirdarśitā| svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitamiti vātakaphamedolakṣaṇaiḥ samanvitamiti||2|| todānvitaḥ kṛṣṇasirāvanaddhaḥ śyāvo'ruṇo vā pavanātmakastu | pāruṣyayuktaściravṛddhyapāko yadṛcchayā pākamiyātkadācit ||3|| vairasyamāsyasya ca tasya jantorbhavettathā tālugalapraśoṣaḥ |4| (su. ni. a. 11) | vātajamāha– todānvite ityādi| ciravṛddhiriti vikāraprabhāvāt vātajo'pi cireṇa vardhate| yadṛcchayā pākamiyāditi kāraṇāpratiniyamena kadācit pākaṃ yāti, kāraṇāpratiniyamaśca bāhyo'bhipretaḥ, ābhyantarastu pākakāraṇaṃ pittaṃ raktaṃ ca niyatameva| kadāciditi na sarvakālam| “yadṛcchayā caiva bhavet kadācit” iti pāṭhāntare ‘pāka’ iti śeṣaḥ||3||– vātikamāha– todānvita ityādi| todaḥ pīḍāviśeṣaḥ, kṛṣṇasirāvṛtaḥ, pāruṣyayuktaḥ sparśanakarkaśaḥ| ciravṛddhiriti vyādhiprabhāvāt vātajo'pi cireṇa vardhate| kāraṇāpratiniyamena kadācit pākaṃ gacchati| kāraṇāpratiniyamaśca bāhyo'bhimataḥ, ābhyantaraṃ tu pākakāraṇaṃ pittaṃ raktaṃ ca niyatameva| kadāciditi na sarvakālam| ‘yadṛcchayā caiva bhavet’ iti pāṭhāntaram| tatra ‘pāka’ iti śeṣaḥ||3||– sthiraḥ savarṇo gururugrakaṇḍūḥ śīto mahāṃścāpi kaphātmakastu ||4|| cirābhivṛddhiṃ bhajate cirādvā prapacyate mandarujaḥ kadācit | mādhuryamāsyasya ca tasya jantorbhavettathā tālugalapralepaḥ ||5|| (su. ni. a. 11) | śleṣmajamāha– sthira ityādi| savarṇa iti prakṛtisamavarṇaḥ||4-5|| ślaiṣmikamāha– sthira ityādi| sthiro niścalaḥ, savarṇaḥ prakṛtivarṇaḥ, mahān sthūlaḥ| mandaruja ityādi kadācidyadā prapacyate tadā mandaruja eva prapacyate, pākakāle pīḍā na bhavatītyarthaḥ| pralepa iti śleṣmaṇā lipta iva||4-5|| snigdho guruḥ pāṇḍuraniṣṭagandho medobhavaḥ kaṇḍuyuto'lparuk ca | pralambate'lābuvadalpamūlo dehānurūpakṣayavṛddhiyuktaḥ ||6|| snigdhāsyatā tasya bhavecca jantorgale'nuśabdaṃ kurute ca nityam |7| (su. ni. a. 11) | medojamāha– snigdha ityādi| dehānurūpakṣayavṛddhiyukta iti dehakṣaye kṣayaṃ, dehavṛddhau ca vṛddhiṃ yātītyarthaḥ| gale'nuśabdamiti anunādaṃ karoti| ‘gale tu śabdam’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ sugamam||6||– medojamāha– snigdha ityādi| aniṣṭagandho, alābuvat tumbīphalavat, alpamūlastanumūlaḥ| dehānurūpakṣayavṛddhiḥ– dehakṣaye kṣayaṃ kārśyaṃ, dehavṛddhau vṛddhiṃ, yātītyarthaḥ| gale'nuśabdamiti anunādaṃ pratiśabdaṃ karoti; “galena śabdam” iti pāṭhāntaraṃ sugamam||6||– kṛcchrācchvasantaṃ mṛdusarvagātraṃ saṃvatsarātītamarocakārtam ||7|| kṣīṇaṃ ca vaidyo galagaṇḍayuktaṃ bhinnasvaraṃ cāpi vivarjayecca |8| (su. ni. a. 11) | asādhyatāmāha– kṛcchrācchvasantamityādi| kṛcchrācchvasantaṃ duḥkhena śvāsavimokṣakāriṇam| bhinnasvaraṃ svarabhedavantam||7||– asādhyamāha– kṛcchrādityādi| duḥkhena śvāsavimokṣakārakaṃ, mṛdusarvagātraṃ śithilasarvagātram, atikrāntavatsaraṃ, bhinnasvaraṃ svarabhedavantam||7||– karkandhukolāmalakapramāṇaiḥ kakṣāṃsamanyāgalavaṅkṣaṇeṣu ||8|| medaḥkaphābhyāṃ ciramandapākaiḥ syādgaṇḍamālā bahubhiśca gaṇḍaiḥ |9| (su. ni. a. 11) | sthānatulyatayā gaṇḍamālāmihaivāha– karkandhukolāmalakapramāṇairityādi| karkandhuḥ śṛgālakoliḥ, kolaṃ bṛhadbadaram| medaḥkaphābhyāmiti medo dūṣyaṃ, kapho doṣo'trārambhakaḥ, medaḥkaphau prādhānyenoktau; tena vātapittasambandho'pyatra draṣṭavyaḥ| yadāha bhojaḥ– “vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaścāpi samācitam| jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāḥ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśān bahūn|| kurvanti granthitāṃstebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito'nilaḥ| tān doṣānūrdhvago vakṣaḥkakṣamanyāgalāśritaḥ|| nānāprakārān kurute granthīn sā tvapacī matā| tāṃ tu mālākṛtiṃ vidyāt kaṇṭhahṛddhanusandhiṣu|| gaṇḍamālāṃ vijānīyādapacītulyalakṣaṇām|” iti| syādgaṇḍamāleti mālātulyagaṇḍayogāt gaṇḍamālā| galamātra eva gaṇḍamālā carake paṭhitā| yathā– “medaḥkaphācchoṇitasañcayottho galasya madhye galagaṇḍa ekaḥ syādgaṇḍamālā bahubhiśca gaṇḍaiḥ” (ca. ci. a. 12) iti||8||– sthānatulyatayā gaṇḍamālāmihaivāha– karkandhvityādi| karkandhurlaghubadaraṃ, kolaṃ bṛhadbadaram| aṃsau bāhumūle, manyā śirodhaḥ, vaṅkṣaṇaṃ jānūrusandhiḥ| medaḥkaphābhyāmityādi| medo dūṣyaṃ, kapho doṣo'trārambhakaḥ, medaḥkaphau ca prādhānyenoktau, tena vātapittasañcayo'pyatra draṣṭavyaḥ| yadāha bhojaḥ– “vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaścāpi samācitam| jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāḥ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśānbahūn|| kurvanti granthitāṃstebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito'nilaḥ| tāndoṣānūrdhvago vakṣaḥkakṣamanyāgalāśritaḥ| nānāprakārānkurute granthīn sā tvapacī matā| vyāmiśradoṣasañjātā kṛcchrasādhyā prakīrtitā|| tāsāṃ vātottarā rūkṣā vātavedanayā'nvitā| kṣiprapākasamutthānā dāhayuktā ca paittikī|| gūḍhapākā ca kaṭhinā kaphāt snigdhā'lparukkarā| medovikārā ślaiṣmikī ca viśeṣādatimārdavā|| apacī kaṇṭhamanyāsu kakṣavaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu| tāṃ tu mālākṛtisamāṃ kaṇṭhahṛddantasandhiṣu| kaṇṭhamālāṃ vijānīyādapacītulyalakṣaṇam||” iti| syādgaṇḍamāleti mālātulyagaṇḍāśrayā gaṇḍamālā| galamātra eva carake gaṇḍamālā paṭhitā, yathā– “medaḥkaphācchoṇitasañcayottho galasya pārśve galagaṇḍa ekaḥ| syādgaṇḍamālā bahubhiśca gaṇḍaiḥ” iti||8||– te granthayaḥ kecidavāptapākāḥ sravanti naśyanti bhavanti cānye ||9|| kālānubandhaṃ ciramādadhāti saivāpacīti pravadanti tajjñāḥ | sādhyāḥ smṛtāḥ pīnasapārśvaśūlakāsajvaracchardiyutāstvasādhyāḥ ||10|| gaṇḍamālātulyatayā apacīmāha– te granthaya ityādi| te iti gaṇḍamālārambhakadoṣadūṣyakṛtā ye granthayasta evetyarthaḥ| kālānubandhaṃ ciramiti carakalānubandham| saivāpacīti tādṛśī amālārūpā apacī bhaṇyate| saivāpacīti itiśabdenābhihitatvāt pravadantīti kriyāyoge'pi na dvitīyā| apacīniruktiścāparāparopacīyamānatayā| ata eva “cayaprakarṣādapacīṃ vadanti|” (su. ni. a. 11) iti suśrutaḥ| cayaprakarṣaścāparāparabhavanenaiva, sādhutvaṃ ca nairuktyena vidhinā| yaduktam– “varṇāgamo varṇaviparyayaśca dvau cāparau varṇavikāranāśau| dhātostadarthātiśayena yogastaducyate pañcavidhaṃ niruktam||” iti| ata evoktam– naśyanti bhavanti cānya iti| sādhyāḥ smṛtā iti chedaḥ| pīnasādibhirupadravairasādhyāḥ| ayaṃ tu granthiḥ carake gaṇḍamālāyāmasti; saṅgrahakāreṇa tu gaṇḍamālayā saha tulyatvādapacyā apacyāmeva granthiḥ paṭhitaḥ||9-10|| gaṇḍamālātulyatayā'pacīmāha– ta ityādi| gaṇḍamālārambhakadoṣadūṣyakṛtā ye granthayasta evetyarthaḥ| avāptapākāḥ labdhapākāḥ, kālānubandhamiti carakalasambandham| saivāpacīti tādṛśī āmalakarūpā apacī bhaṇyate| saivāpacīti– itiśabdenābhihitatvātpravadantītyādikriyāyoge'pi na dvitīyā| tasya sādhyatvamāha– sādhyetyādi| sādhyāḥ smṛtā iti pūrvagranthena sambandhaḥ, ‘sravanti naśyanti bhavanti cānye’ ityādipīnasādibhirupadravairyutā asādhyāḥ||9-10|| vātādayo māṃsamasṛk praduṣṭāḥ sandūṣya medaśca tathā sirāśca | vṛttonnataṃ vigrathitaṃ ca śothaṃ kurvantyato granthiriti pradiṣṭaḥ ||11|| (su. ni. a. 11) | anantaramapacīguḍakatulyatayā granthimāha– vātādaya ityādi| vātapittakaphāḥ pratyekaṃ duṣṭāḥ; duṣṭiścātra vṛddhireva na kṣayaḥ, kṣīṇānāṃ vikārakaraṇākṣamatvāt| yadyevaṃ tarhi kathaṃ vātādikṣaye mandaceṣṭādayaḥ? ucyate– tatkṣaye virodhidoṣakopāt; yathā– madhurasnigdhādibhirvāte kṣīṇe tatsamānatvāt śleṣmā prakupyati| vacanaṃ hi– “vṛddhiścāpi virodhinām|” iti| sandūṣya medaśca māṃsamasṛk sirāścetyanena medojaḥ kaphasambandhādyo bhavati tathā sirājo'pi vāyunā sirāduṣṭyā yo janyate sa ucyate| evaṃ pañca granthayaḥ| tatheti sandūṣya| māṃsamasṛgiti atrāsṛjaḥ kramollaṅghanena pāṭho'prādhānyapratipādanārthaḥ, visarpe tu śoṇitameva pradhānam| ata eva kvacit cakāramaprādhānyasūcakaṃ niveśya ‘asṛk ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ| carake tu granthiḥ vātakaphaja eva granthivisarpaśabdenoktaḥ| vṛttonnatamiti vṛttaṃ vartulam, unnatam ucchūnam| vigrathitaṃ kaṭhinaṃ, kakakhaṭaṃ vā; vigrathitatvādeva granthiriti sañjñā||11|| apacīgaṇḍakarūpatayā granthikāmāha– vātādayetyādi| vātādayo vātapittakaphāḥ, pratyekaṃ duṣṭāḥ māṃsamasṛk sandūṣya śophaṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| etena trayo granthaya uktāḥ, duṣṭiścātra vṛddhireva, na kṣayaḥ, kṣīṇānāṃ vikārakaraṇākṣamatvāt, sandūṣya medaśca tathā sirāścetyanena medojaḥ sirājaścaivaṃ dvau, sandūṣya māṃsamasṛgityatrāsṛjaḥ kramollaṅghanena pāṭho'prādhānyapratipādanārthaṃ, vṛttaṃ vartulam, unnataṃ ucchūnaṃ, vigrathitaṃ vicchidya grathitam, ato vigrathitatvādeva granthisañjñā||11|| āyamyate vṛścyati tudyate ca pratyasyate mathyati bhidyate ca | kṛṣṇo mṛdurbastirivātataśca bhinnaḥ sraveccānilajo'sramaccham ||12|| (su. ni. a. 11) | anilagranthimāha– āyamyata ityādi| āyamyate ākṛṣya dīrghīkriyate| vṛścyatīti chinattīva, atra divāderākṛtigaṇatvāt ‘śyan’ pratyayaḥ| pratyasyate kṣipyate| mathyati āloḍayatīva, atrāpi pūrvavat samādhānam| bhidyate vidīryata iva| asraṃ srāvam||12|| vātikamāha– āyamyata ityādi| ākṛṣya dīrghīkriyata iva, vṛścyati chinattīva, tudyate śūleneva, pratyasyate kṣipyate, mathyati āloḍayatīva, bhidyate vidāryata iva||12|| dandahyate dhūpyati vṛścyate ca pāpacyate prajvalatīva cāpi | raktaḥ sapīto'pyathavā'pi pittādbhinnaḥ sraveduṣṇamatīva cāsram ||13|| (su. ni. a. 11) | pittagranthimāha– dandahyata ityādi| dandahyate atyarthaṃ dahyate agnineva| pāpacyate bhṛśaṃ pacyata iva kṣāreṇa, kiṃvā utkvathyata iva| prajvalatīva jvalan bhasmībhavatīva||13|| paittikamāha– dandahyata ityādi| agninā dahyata eva, dhūpyati dhūmāyata iva, cūṣyate śṛṅgeṇeva, pāpacyate bhṛśaṃ pacyata iva kṣāreṇa, kiṃvā utkvathyata iva| jvalatīva jvalaneneva bhasmībhavati, varṇena raktaḥ athavā pītaḥ, bhinnaḥ san atīvātiśayena duṣṭaṃ raktaṃ sravati||13|| śīto'vivarṇo'lparujo'tikaṇḍuḥ pāṣāṇavat saṃhananopapannaḥ | cirābhivṛddhaśca kaphaprakopādbhinnaḥ sravecchuklaghanaṃ ca pūyam ||14|| (su. ni. a. 11) | kaphagranthimāha– śīta ityādi| avivarṇaḥ prakṛtivarṇaḥ, īṣadvivarṇa iti kaścit| pāṣāṇavat saṃhananopapanna iti pāṣāṇavat kaṭhina ityarthaḥ; kiṃvā pāṣāṇavat bhavati, saṃhananopapanna iti saṃhatānvito mahānityarthaḥ||14|| ślaiṣmikamāha– śīta ityādi| avivarṇaḥ prakṛtivarṇaḥ, pāṣāṇavat saṅghātānvito mahānityarthaḥ| bhinnaḥ san śuklaṃ ghanaṃ pūyaṃ sravet ca||14|| śarīravṛddhikṣayavṛddhihāniḥ snigdho mahān kaṇḍuyuto'rujaśca | medaḥkṛto gacchati cātra bhinne piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tu medaḥ ||15|| (su. ni. a. 11) | medojagranthimāha– śarīretyādi| śarīravṛddhikṣayavṛddhihāniriti śarīravṛddhikṣayābhyāṃ yathākramaṃ vṛddhihānī yasya sa tathā| medojeṣvevaṃ yuktiḥ dhātusvabhāvāt cirasthāyitvādvā| gacchati cātra bhinne piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tu meda iti bhinne sati piṇyākastilakalkaḥ, sarpiratra styānaṃ, tatsadṛśaṃ medaḥ sravati| bhojena tu medograntheḥ samprāptiḥ paṭhyate| yathā– “medo vāyuryadā māṃse nikṣipedathavā tvaci| tatra medobhavagranthiḥ śyāvo bhavati pāṇḍuraḥ|| kṛśaḥ kṛśe, mahān sthūle, granthirbhinnaśca pīḍitaḥ| tilakalkanibhaḥ srāvo ghṛtavaccāsya jāyate||” iti||15|| medojamāha– śarīravṛddhikṣayābhyāṃ yathākramaṃ vṛddhihānī yasya sa tathā| bhinne sati piṇyākasarpiḥsadṛśaṃ medo gacchati sravatītyarthaḥ| piṇyākastilakalkaḥ, sarpiratra styānam, tatsadṛśaṃ medo gacchati| uktañca bhoje– “medo vāyuryadā māṃse nikṣipedatha vā tvaci| tatra medobhavo granthiḥ śyāvo bhavati pāṇḍuraḥ|| kṛśaḥ kṛśe mahān sthūle granthiśchinnaśca pīḍitaḥ| tilakalkanibhaḥ srāvo ghṛtavaccāsya jāyate||” iti||15|| vyāyāmajātairabalasya taistairākṣipya vāyustu sirāpratānam | saṅkucya sampiṇḍya viśoṣya cāpi granthiṃ karotyunnatamāśu vṛttam ||16|| granthiḥ sirājaḥ sa tu kṛcchrasādhyo bhavedyadi syāt sarujaścalaśca | sa cāruja ścāpyacalo mahāṃśca marmotthitaścāpi vivarjanīyaḥ ||17|| (su. ni. a. 11) | sirājagrantheḥ samprāptimāha– vyāyāmajātairityādi| saṅkucyeti antarbhāvito'tra ṇyarthaḥ, tena saṅkocyetyarthaḥ| sampiṇḍyeti saṃhatīkṛtya| unnatamāśu vṛttamiti asya sāmānyalakṣaṇenaiva siddhe punastaduktiratiśayārtham| sa ca sirājo granthiryadi sarujaścalaśca syāttadā kṛcchrasādhyaḥ| sa cārujaścāpītyādinā na sādhyaḥ| sa ceti cakāreṇārujatvādidharmayogādapare'pi granthayo'sādhyā iti sūcayati| yaduktaṃ bhoje– “pañcaitānarujo granthīn marmajānacalāṃstyajet| kapolagalamanyāsu duścikitsyāśca sandhiṣu||” iti| anye tu māṃsāsṛgbhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ granthiṃ vadanta evaṃ paṭhanti– “ māṃsāsṛjaṃ cārbudalakṣaṇena tulyaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ tvatha lakṣaṇajñaiḥ|” iti kintvanārṣo'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ, bhojādisamānatantreṣvadṛṣṭatvāt||16-17|| sirājagrantheḥ samprāptimāha– vyāyāmetyādi| taistairiti balavadvigrahādibhiḥ sirāpratānaṃ sirābhyo nirgataṃ sūkṣmasirājālam| saṅkucyeti antarbhāvito'tra ṇyarthaḥ, tena saṅkocyetyarthaḥ| sampīḍya saṃhatīkṛtya, unnatamuccaṃ, vṛttaṃ vartulam| sa tu sirājo granthiḥ yadi sarujaścalaḥ syāttadā kṛcchrasādhyaḥ| tasyāsādhyatvamāha– sa iti| cakāreṇārujādidharmayogād apare'pi granthayaḥ asādhyā iti sūcayanti| yaduktaṃ bhojena– “pañcaitānarujo granthīnmarmajāṃśca calāṃstyajet| kapolagalamanyāsu duścikitsyāśca sandhiṣu||” iti||16-17|| gātrapradeśe kvacideva doṣāḥ sammūrchitā māṃsamasṛk pradūṣya | vṛttaṃ sthiraṃ mandarujaṃ mahāntamanalpamūlaṃ ciravṛddhyapākam ||18|| kurvanti māṃsocchrayamatyagādhaṃ tadarbudaṃ śāstravido vadanti | vātena pittena kaphena cāpi raktena māṃsena ca medasā vā ||19|| tajjāyate tasya ca lakṣaṇāni grantheḥ samānāni tadā bhavanti |20| (su. ni. a. 11) | māṃsaśoṇitadūṣyasāmyādarbudābhidhānam| tasya samprāptimāha– gātrapradeśe kvacidityādi| kvacidevetyanenāniyatadeśe, na punarapacīvanniyatadeśe| “sammūrchitā” iti pāṭhāntare sammūrchitā vṛddhāḥ, dūṣyasaṃsṛṣṭā iti kārtikaḥ| māṃsamasṛk pradūṣyeti sarvārbudasādhāraṇaṃ dūṣyaṃ, māṃsārbudamedo'rbudayostu viśeṣeṇa māṃsaduṣṭiḥ; māṃsārbudamedo'rbudayorapi taddūṣako doṣo'sti, tena tatrāpi doṣakartṛtayā samprāptiriyaṃ bhavati| māṃsocchrayamiti māṃsocchrayatayā pratīyamānam| medoje'pi māṃsamudgataṃ bhavati| atyagādhamiti dūrānupraviṣṭam; ata evānalpamūlamityuktam| vātādibhistadarbudaṃ jāyate bhavati, tena ṣaḍarbudāni bhavanti| grantheḥ samānānīti vātapittakaphamedogranthibhirvātapittakaphamedo'rbudānāṃ lakṣaṇāni samānāni, śoṇitajamāṃsajayostu lakṣaṇaṃ pṛthak vakṣyati||18-19||– athārbudānyāha| tasya samprāptimāha– gātretyādi| kvacideveti aniyatadeśe na punarapacīvat niyatapradeśe| sammūrchitā iti pāṭhāntare vṛddhāḥ| māṃsamasṛk pradūṣyeti sarvārbudeṣu sādhāraṇaṃ dūṣyaṃ, māṃsārbudamedo'rbudayośca viśeṣeṇa māṃsamedoduṣṭiḥ, vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, mṛduṃ mṛdusparśaṃ, māṃsamedaāśrayatvāt| atyagādhaṃ dūrānupraviṣṭam, ata evānalpamūlamityuktam| tasya saṅkhyāmāha– vātenetyādi| vātādibhistadarbudaṃ jāyate bhavati; tena ṣaḍarbudāni bhavanti| grantheḥ samānānīti vātapittakaphamedojagranthibhirvātapittakaphamedojārbudānāṃ lakṣaṇāni samānāni| śoṇitajamāṃsajayostu lakṣaṇaṃ pṛthakpaṭhyate||18-19||– doṣaḥ praduṣṭo rudhiraṃ sirāśca saṅkucya sampiṇḍya tatastvapākam ||20|| sāsrāvamunnahyati māṃsapiṇḍaṃ māṃsāṅkurairācitamāśuvṛddham | karotyajasraṃ rudhirapravṛttimasādhyametadrudhirātmakaṃ tu ||21|| raktakṣayopadravapīḍitatvāt pāṇḍurbhavedarbudapīḍitastu | (su. ni. a. 11) | raktārbudamāha– doṣaḥ praduṣṭa ityādi| saṅkucyeti antarbhāvito'tra ṇyarthaḥ| apākamīṣatpākaṃ, tena sāsrāvamityupapannaṃ bhavati| doṣa unnahyati ucchrito bhavati| sāsrāvamīṣatsrāvam| māṃsapiṇḍamāśuvṛddhaṃ śīghravardhanaṃ, māṃsāṅkurairācitaṃ karoti, tathā ajasraṃ rudhirapravṛttimapi karoti; rudhiraṃ cātrādhiṣṭhānabhūtaṃ sirāgataṃ pravartate na tu pākāt, īṣadeva srāvasya kledarūpasyoktatvāt| kiṃvā unnahyatītyantarbhāvitaṇyarthaḥ, tena māṃsapiṇḍamunnāhayati udgataṃ karoti| “doṣāḥ praduṣṭā” iti pāṭhapakṣe “ sāsrāvamunnahya hi” iti pāṭhaḥ| unnahya unnāhya, antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvāt| hi pādapūraṇe||20-21||– raktārbudamāha– doṣa ityādi| saṅkucyeti antarbhāvito'tra ṇyarthaḥ| apākamiti īṣatpākaṃ, tena sāsrāvamityupapannaṃ bhavati| doṣaḥ praduṣṭaḥ unnahyati ucchrito bhavati| ajasraṃ rudhirapravṛttimatirudhiraṃ cādhiṣṭhānabhūtaṃ pravartate, na tu pākāt, īṣadeva srāvasya kledarūpasyoktatvāt| suśrutoktaiḥ raktakṣayopadravaiḥ pāṇḍuḥ syāt||20-21||– muṣṭiprahārādibhirardite'ṅge māṃsaṃ praduṣṭaṃ janayeddhi śotham ||22|| avedanaṃ snigdhamananyavarṇamapākamaśmopamamapracālyam | praduṣṭamāṃsasya narasya gāḍhametadbhavenmāṃsaparāyaṇasya ||23|| māṃsārbudaṃ tvetadasādhyamuktaṃ... | (su. ni. a. 11) | māṃsajanyasamprāptimāha– muṣṭiprahārādibhirityādi| aśmopamaṃ pāṣāṇavat kaṭhinam| apracālyaṃ sthiram| yadyapi raktamāṃsārbudayo raktamāṃsayorhetutvenoktistathā'pi raktaje pittaṃ, māṃsaje vāyurārambhakaḥ, evamapi tābhyāṃ ghṛtadugdhanyānena vyapadeśaḥ| māṃsaparāyaṇasya māṃsāśanaśīlasya| tasya cātimātraṃ māṃsavṛddhiḥ, “māṃsaṃ māṃsena vardhate” ityabhidhānāt||22-23||– māṃsajasya samprāptimāha– muṣṭītyādi| muṣṭiprahārādibhirardite'ṅgapradeśe, ananyavarṇam, apākaṃ pākarahitam, aśmopamaṃ pāṣāṇavatkaṭhinam, apracālyaṃ sthiram| yadyapi raktamāṃsārbudayoḥ raktamāṃsayorhetutvenoktiḥ, tathā'pi raktaje pittaṃ, māṃsaje vāyurārambhakaḥ, evamapi tābhyāṃ ghṛtadugdhanyāyena vyapadeśaḥ| māṃsaparāyaṇasya māṃsabhakṣaṇaśīlasya, tasya cātimātraṃ māṃsavṛddhiḥ “māṃsaṃ māṃsena vardhate” iti vacanāt| etanmāṃsārbudamasādhyam||22-23||– ...sādhyeṣvapīmāni tu varjayecca | samprasrutaṃ marmaṇi yacca jātaṃ srotaḥsu vā yacca bhavedacālyam ||24|| (su. ni. a. 11) | sādhyeṣvapyasādhyaprakārānāha– sādhyeṣvapītyādi| samprasrutaṃ srāvayuktaṃ, srāvaścātrāpākitve'pi tvagavadaraṇāt manāgavagantavyaḥ| srotaḥsu nāsādiṣu| acālyaṃ sthiram||24|| sādhyeṣvapyasādhyaprakārānāha– sādhyeṣvityādi| sādhyeṣvapi imāni arbudāni varjayet| samprasrutaṃ srāvayuktam| srāvaścātrāpākitve'pi tvagdāraṇāt manāgavagantavyaḥ| srotassu sirādiṣu, acālyaṃ sthiram||24|| yajjāyate'nyat khalu pūrvajāte jñeyaṃ tadaddhyarbudamarbudajñaiḥ | yaddvandvajātaṃ yugapat kramādvā dvirarbudaṃ tacca bhavedasādhyam ||25|| (su. ni. a. 11) | adhyarbudamāha– yajjāyata ityādinā| adhikamarbudam adhyarbudam, etaddvirarbudameva| yaddvandvajātaṃ yugapat kramādveti dvandvajātaṃ yugmena jātaṃ, yugapadekadā krameṇa vā, taddvirarbudaṃ na sādhyam| tathāca bhojaḥ– “arbude tvarbudaṃ jātaṃ dvandvajaṃ cānujaṃ ca yat| dvirarbudamiti jñeyaṃ taccāsādhyaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||25|| adhyarbudamāha– yadityādi| adhikamarbudamadhyarbudaṃ, etaddvirarbudameva| yad dvandvajātaṃ yugapadekadā krameṇa vā tat dvirarbudaṃ na sādhyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “arbudaṃ tvarbude jātaṃ dvandvajaṃ cānujaṃ ca yat| dvirarbudamiti jñeyaṃ taccāsādhyaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||25|| na pākamāyānti kaphādhikatvānmedobahutvācca viśeṣatastu | doṣasthiratvādgrathanācca teṣāṃ sarvārbudānyeva nisargatastu ||26|| (su. ni. a. 11) | arbudānāṃ pākābhāve hetumāha– na pākamāyāntītyādi| sarvārbudāni pittaraktajānyapi na pākamāyānti, kutaḥ ityata āha– kaphādhikatvānmedobahutvācca| nanu, apacyāmapi viśeṣataḥ kaphamedasī adhike, atha ca tasyāḥ pāko'styeva, ityata āha– doṣasthiratvāditi| apacyāṃ kālāntareṇa hi raktapittamadhikaṃ pākamārabhate, tacceha doṣasthiratvāt sadā sadṛśadoṣatvāt grathitatvācca na pākārambhakam| anye tu doṣasthiratvāditi doṣocchrāyarūpaśothakāṭhinyādityāhuḥ; tadaprayojanakam, anyatra doṣocchrāyaśothakāṭhinye'pi pākadarśanāt| atha kuto yathoktahetusampadityāha– nisargatastviti| nisargato vyādhisvabhāvāt| bhoje'pyuktam– “na pacyate sthiratvācca grathitatvāt svabhāvataḥ|” iti||26|| arbudānāṃ pākābhāve hetumāha– netyādi| sarvārbudāni pittaraktajānyapi na pākamāyānti, kuta ityāha– kaphādhikatvānmedobahutvācca| nanu, apacyāmapi kaphamedasī adhike, atha ca tasyāḥ pākaḥ kālato'styevetyāha– doṣasthiratvāditi kālāntareṇa hi raktapittamadhikaṃ pākamārabhate| nanu, iha doṣasthiratvāt sadṛśadoṣatvāt granthitatvācca na pākārambhakatvam, atha kuto yathoktahetusampadityāha– nisargatastviti| nisargato vyādhisvabhāvāt| bhoje'pyuktam– “na pacyate sthiratvācca grathitatvātsvabhāvataḥ” iti| teṣāmarbudānāmiti||26|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāpacīgranthyarbudanidānaṃ samāptam ||38|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāpacīgranthyarbudanidānaṃ samāptam||38|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālā'pacīgranthyarbudanidānam||38|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘kaṇṭhasandhī’ iti pā.| ↩ 2 . ‘samanvitamiti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 3 . kvacitpustake agrimapaṅktiḥ ekaślokapūrvaṃ upalabhyate ↩ 4 . ‘ābhyantaraśca’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘caiṣa’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘savarṇaṃ prakṛtiḥ samavarṇaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘aniṣṭagandhī’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘granthayastebhyaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘apacīkaṇṭhamanyāsu kakṣavaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu||’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . ‘galagaṇḍamālāmihaivāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘śirodhiḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘vātapittasañcayo'pyevam’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘manye’ iti pā.| ↩ 14 . ‘analparūpā’ iti pā.| ↩ 15 . atra ‘bhavanti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 16 . ‘ ... gaṇḍakatulyatayā’ iti pā.| ↩ 17 . ‘karkaśam’ iti pā.| ↩ 18 . ‘atyarthaṃ dahyata iva’ iti pā.| ↩ 19 . ‘vṛścyate’ ityatra ‘cūṣyate’ iti pā.| ↩ 20 . ‘kiñca’ iti pā.| ↩ 21 . etacca– ‘bhinnaḥ sravedduṣṭamatīva cāsram’ iti pā.| ↩ 22 . ‘saṅghātānvito’ iti pā.| ↩ 23 . ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 24 . ‘sampīḍya’ iti pā. | ↩ 25 . ‘aruk sa evāpyacalo’ iti pā. | ↩ 26 . ‘śirāja ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 27 . ‘ ... 'tra’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 28 . ‘māṃsāsrajam’ iti pā.| ↩ 29 . ‘śirāja ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 30 . ‘śirāpratānaṃ ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 31 . ‘śirābhyo’ iti pā.| ↩ 32 . ‘ ... śirājālam’ iti pā.| ↩ 33 . ‘śirājo’ iti pā.| ↩ 34 . etacca– ‘vṛttaṃ mṛduṃ mandarujam’ iti pā. | ↩ 35 . ‘sadā’ iti pā. | ↩ 36 . ‘bhavati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 37 . etacca– ‘vṛttaṃ mṛduṃ mandarujam’ iti pā.| ↩ 38 . ‘cātrādhiṣṭhānapūrvabhūtaśirāgatam’ iti pā.| ↩ 39 . atra ‘vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 40 . ‘sāsrāvamunnahyati’ iti pā.| ↩ 41 . ‘raktamāṃsārbude'pyatiraktamāṃsayorhetu ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 42 . ‘saprasrutam’ iti pā. | ↩ 43 . ‘samprastutam’ iti pā.| ↩ 44 . ‘tadadhyarbuda ... ’ iti pā. | ↩ 45 . ‘taddvirarbudamiti’ iti pā.| ↩ 46 . ‘etaddvirbudameva|’ iti pā.| ↩ 47 . ‘kaphādhikatvāt medobahutvācca’ iti pā.| ↩ 48 . ‘arbudānāmapākabhāve’ iti pā.| ↩ 49 . ‘ ... kṛtāyām’ iti pā.| ↩ 50 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālā'pacīgranthyarbudanidānam||38||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 39. ślīpadanidānam
text: atha ślīpadanidānam | yaḥ sajvaro vaṅkṣaṇajo bhṛśārtiḥ śotho nṛṇāṃ pādagataḥ krameṇa | tacchlīpadaṃ syāt karakarṇanetraśiśnauṣṭhanāsāsvapi kecidāhuḥ ||1|| vātajaṃ kṛṣṇarūkṣaṃ ca sphuṭitaṃ tīvravedanam | animittarujaṃ tasya bahuśo jvara eva ca ||2|| pittajaṃ pītasaṅkāśaṃ dāhajvarayutaṃ mṛdu | ślaiṣmikaṃ snigdhavarṇaṃ ca śvetaṃ pāṇḍu guru sthiram ||3|| utsedhasādharmyādarbudena saha kaphasambandhāvyabhicārasāmyāccātha ślīpadanidānam| tasya samprāptimāha– ya ityādi| vaṅkṣaṇāvasthānamevāsya pūrvarūpam| krameṇeti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ| tat ślīpadaṃ syādityanena nirupādhireveyaṃ sañjñeti darśayati; anye śilāvat padaṃ ślīpadamiti vadanti, nairuktyena ca vidhinā sādhutvam| karakarṇādigataślīpadānāṃ yathoktasamprāptyabhāvāt kecidāhuriti paramatenoktiḥ||1-3|| utsedhasādharmyādarbudena saha kaphasambandhāvyabhicārasādharmyācca ślīpadanidānam| tasya samprāptimāha– ya ityādi| vaṅkṣaṇādyavasthānamevāsya pūrvarūpam| krameṇeti śanaiḥ| vaṅkṣaṇamūrumeḍhrasandhiḥ, vaṅkṣaṇasthaḥ śvayathuḥ bhṛśārtisahitaḥ caraṇaṃ gacchatītyarthaḥ, tat ślīpadaṃ syādityanena pāribhāṣikī nirupādhireveyaṃ sañjñeti| anye śilāvat padaṃ ślīpadamiti vadanti| kecidāhuriti paramatenoktiḥ| vātajamāha– animittamityādi| akāraṇenaivaṃ pīḍā| bahuśo vāraṃvāraṃ jvaraḥ, śeṣaṃ sugamam| pittajamāha– pītasaṅkāśaṃ pītāvabhāsaṃ, mṛdu mṛdusparśam| śleṣmajamāha– snigdhavarṇamiti| snigdhavadvarṇo yasya, cikkaṇamityarthaḥ| pāṇḍu pītaśvetam||1-3|| valmīkamiva sañjātaṃ kaṇṭakairupacīyate | abdātmakaṃ mahattacca varjanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||4|| eṣāmasādhyatāmāha– valmīkamivetyādi| sañjātaṃ pravṛddhaṃ sat valmīkavadbahuśikharākāraṃ granthibhirupacitaṃ yadbhavati tadasādhyam| anye tu punaramuṃ granthiṃ kaphajalakṣaṇatvena varṇayanti; tanna mano dhinoti, suśrute valmīkavajjātasyāsādhyatvenābhidhānāt| tadyathā– “tatra saṃvatsarātītamatimahadvalmīkamiva sañjātaṃ samprasrutamiti varjanīyāni bhavanti|” (su. ni. a. 12) iti| abdātmakamityādi| abdātmakaṃ saṃvatsarātītam, abdamekamiti pāṭhe tu ‘atikrāntam’ iti śeṣaḥ| mahaditi atyantamucchūnam| varjanīyaṃ viśeṣata iti pratyākhyeyam||4|| eṣāmasādhyatāmāha– valmīkamityādi| valmīkavadbahuśikharākāragranthibhirupacitaṃ yad bhavati tadasādhyam| anye punaramuṃ granthiṃ kaphajalakṣaṇatvena varṇayanti; tanna mano dhinoti, suśrute valmīkavajjātasyāsādhyatvenābhidhānāt| tadyathā– “tatra saṃvatsarātītamatimahadvalmīkavajjātaṃ samprasrutamiti varjanīyāni bhavanti” iti| sarvātmakaṃ tridoṣajam| anye abdātmakamiti paṭhanti, tatrātikrāntavatsaramityarthaḥ| mahat atyantamucchūnam| varjanīyaṃ viśeṣata iti pratyākhyeyam||4|| trīṇyapyetāni jānīyācchlīpadāni kaphocchrayāt | gurutvaṃ ca mahattvaṃ ca yasmānnāsti kaphaṃ vinā ||5|| (su. ni. a. 12) | ślīpadeṣu kaphasyāvyabhicāreṇa prādhānyamāha– trīṇyapyetānītyādi| nanu, yadyavyabhicārī sarvatra kaphaḥ kathaṃ tarhi ekadoṣajatvavyapadeśaḥ, sarvasya dvidoṣajatvaprasaṅgāt? ucyate– anubandho'tra kaphaḥ, na tvanubandhyaḥ; etenātra na dvidoṣajaprasaṅga ityabhiprāyaḥ||5|| ślīpadeṣu kaphasyāvyabhicāreṇa prādhānyamāha– trīṇītyādi| trīṇi vātajādīni, yato gurutvaṃ ca śleṣmaṇā vinā na syāt| nanu, yadyevaṃ tarhi kathamekadoṣajavyapadeśaḥ, sarvasya dvidoṣatvaprasaṅgāt; ucyate– kapho'trānubandharūpaḥ, na tvanubandhyaḥ| tena, na dvidoṣajatvaprasaṅga ityabhiprāyaḥ||5|| purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhāḥ sarvartuṣu ca śītalāḥ | ye deśāsteṣu jāyante ślīpadāni viśeṣataḥ ||6|| (su. ni. a. 12) | ślīpadasambhavahetuṃ deśamāha– purāṇodaketyādi| anūpadeśe hi salilaṃ patitaṃ bahūdakaṃ nimnatayā na śoṣamupayāti; jāṅgale tu āgneyonnatabhūbhāgatvāt na purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā| stimitasyānūpasya mandātapatvenoṣṇartāvapi śītateti ata uktam– “sarvartuṣu ca śītalāḥ” iti| karakarṇādigataślīpadasandehe kopadvāreṇa jvareṇa ślīpadāvadhāraṇaṃ karaṇīyam||6|| ślīpadasambhave hetunirdeśamāha– purāṇodaketyādi| purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhā iti anūpadeśe salilaṃ patitaṃ bahūdakaṃ nimnabhūbhāgatayā na śoṣamupayāti, ato'nūpadeśasya purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā; jāṅgale tvāgneyonnatabhūbhāgatayā salilaṃ patitaṃ na tiṣṭhati, sthitamapi rūkṣoṣṇaśuṣkadeśasya śoṣamupayāti, iti jāṅgaladeśasya na purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā| sarveṣvapi ṛtuṣu śītalā ye deśāḥ himavatpradeśāḥ||6|| yacchleṣmalāhāravihārajātaṃ puṃsaḥ prakṛtyā'pi kaphātmakasya | sāsrāvamatyunnatasarvaliṅgaṃ sakaṇḍuraṃ śleṣmayutaṃ vivarjyam ||7|| aparamasādhyalakṣaṇamāha– yadityādi| atyunnatasarvaliṅgamiti yena doṣeṇārabdhaṃ ślīpadaṃ tasyātyunnatāni ativṛddhāni sarvāṇi liṅgāni yatra tattathā| sakaṇḍuramiti atyantakaṇḍumat| śleṣmayutamiti śleṣmānugam||7|| punarasādhyatāmāha– yadityādi| śleṣmalāhāro madhurādiḥ, vihāro divāsvapnādiḥ, kaphaprakṛtikasya sāsrāvam āsrāvayutam| atyunnatasarvaliṅgaṃ yena doṣeṇārabdhaṃ ślīpadaṃ, tasyātyunnatāni imānyatipravṛddhāni sarvāṇi tridoṣaliṅgāni yatra tat, sakaṇḍuraṃ kaṇḍūyutaṃ, śleṣmayutaṃ śleṣmaṇopagatam||7|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne ślīpadanidānaṃ samāptam ||39|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ ślīpadanidānaṃ samāptam||39|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ ślīpadanidānam||39|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘yaḥ sajvara’ iti pā.| ↩ 2 . ‘kaphasambandhasaṃvādatvādavyabhicārasāmyāccātha’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘padaṃ ślīpadamiti vadanti|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 4 . ‘snigdhavad varṇam’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘valmīkamiva sañjātaṃ kaṇṭakairupacīyate iti|’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘ ... valmīkajātam’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘prasṛtamiti’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘trīṇi trīṇi vātajādīni vātajādīni’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘dvidoṣajatvaprasaṅgāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . ‘ānūpadeśe’ iti pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘sāsrāvamityādi|’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ ślīpadanidānam||39||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 40. vidradhinidānam
text: atha vidradhinidānam | tvagraktamāṃsamedāṃsi sandūṣyāsthisamāśritāḥ | doṣāḥ śothaṃ śanairghoraṃ janayantyucchritā bhṛśam ||1|| mahāmūlaṃ rujāvantaṃ vṛttaṃ vā'pyathavā''yatam | sa vidradhiriti khyāto vijñeyaḥ ṣaḍvidhaśca saḥ ||2|| pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastaiśca kṣatenāpyasṛjā tathā | ṣaṇṇāmapi hi teṣāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ sampravakṣyate ||3|| (su. ni. a. 9) | śothatvasāmānyāt vidradhinidānam| tasya samprāptimāha– tvagraktamāṃsamedāṃsītyādi| ghoramityanyebhyo'pi śothasamutthānebhyo granthyādibhya āśukāritvāddāruṇam| ucchritā bhṛśamiti atyarthaṃ vṛddhāḥ| asthisamāśritā ityanena sthānasaṃśrayo'bhihitaḥ| ucchritā bhṛśamityanena prakopa āviṣkṛtaḥ, etenaivāntarīyakatayā cayaprasarāvapyākṣiptau mantavyau| mahāmūlamasthyādisamāśrayaṇādgambhīramūlam| rujāvantamiti utpattāveva rujāprakarṣavantam, atiśāyane matup| vṛttamityādi vṛttaṃ vartulam| āyataṃ dīrgham| vṛttāyatābhyāṃ granthyādivilakṣaṇatā| vidradhiriti khyāta iti, itiśabdena nirupādhisaṅketamātrā vidradhisañjñeti darśayati| carake tu vidāhaprakarṣādvidradhisañjñā| yaduktam– “sa vai śīghravidāhitvādvidradhītyabhidhīyate|” (ca. sū. a. 17) iti||1-3|| śothasāmānyādvidradhinidānam| tasya samprāptimāha– tvagityādi| ghoramanyebhyaḥ śothasamutthānebhyo granthyādibhyaḥ āśukāritvāddāruṇam| ucchritā bhṛśamiti atyarthaṃ vṛddhāḥ, asthisamāśritā iti sthānasaṃśrayo'rtho'bhihitaḥ| ucchritā bhṛśamityanena prakopa āviṣkṛtaḥ| mahāmūlam asthyādisamāśrayaṇād gambhīramūlam| rujāvantamutpattāveva rujāprakarṣavantam| vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, āyataṃ dīrghaṃ vṛttatvāyatatvābhyāṃ granthyādivilakṣaṇatā kathitā, vidradhiriti khyāta iti| itiśabdena nirupādhisaṅketamātrā vidradhiriti sañjñeti darśayati, carake tu vidāhaprakarṣādvidradhisañjñā| yaduktam– “sarvaiḥ śīghravidāhitvādvidradhīti nirūpyate|” iti| sa ṣaṭprakāraḥ; tribhirdoṣaistrayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, kṣatenaikaḥ, asṛjā'pyeka iti ṣaṭ| ṣaṇṇāmapi lakṣaṇaṃ kathyate||1-3|| kṛṣṇo'ruṇo vā viṣamo bhṛśamatyarthavedanaḥ | citrotthānaprapākaśca vidradhirvātasambhavaḥ ||4|| (su. ni. a. 9) | vātikamāha– kṛṣṇa ityādi| viṣamo bhṛśamiti kadācidalpaḥ, kadācinmahān| citrotthānaprapāka iti| citrau nānāvidhau vāyorviṣamakriyatvāt udgamaprapākau yasya sa tathā||4|| vātikavidradhilakṣaṇamāha– kṛṣṇa ityādi| viṣamo bhṛśamiti kadācidalpaḥ, kadācinmahān, bhṛśamatiśayena| citrotthānaprapāka iti citrau nānāvidhau vāyorviṣamakriyatvādudgamaprapākau yasya sa tathā||4|| pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ śyāvo vā jvaradāhavān | kṣiprotthānaprapākaśca vidradhiḥ pittasambhavaḥ ||5|| paittikamāha– pakvetyādi| jvaradāhāvutthānakāla eva, pākakāle tu prakarṣavantau tāviti viśeṣaḥ||5|| paittikamāha– pakvetyādi| pakvodumbarasadṛśaḥ, śyāvaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ, jvaradāhau utthānakāla eva syātāṃ, pākakāle tu tāveva prakarṣavantau, kṣipramutthānaprapākau yasya sa tathā||5|| śarāvasadṛśaḥ pāṇḍuḥ śītaḥ snigdho'lpavedanaḥ | cirotthānaprapākaśca vidradhiḥ kaphasambhavaḥ ||6|| (su. ni. a. 9) | kaphajamāha– śarāvetyādi| śarāvasadṛśa iti mahattvasūcanaparam||6|| śleṣmajamāha– śarāvetyādi| śarāvasadṛśa iti mahattvasūcanaparam| ciramutthānaprapākau yasya sa tathā||6|| tanupītasitāścaiṣāmāsrāvāḥ kramaśaḥ smṛtāḥ |7| pākānantaraṃ sambhūtāsrāvaliṅgamāha– tanupītasitāścaiṣāmityādi| kramaśa iti yathākramaṃ; tena vātena tanuḥ, pittena pītaḥ, kaphena sitaḥ; tanusrāve vātānurūpo varṇo jñeyaḥ|7|– teṣāṃ doṣabhedena srāvānāha– tanvityādi| kramaśa iti krameṇa; vātena tanuḥ, pittena pītaḥ, śleṣmaṇā sitaḥ, tanusrāve vātānurūpo varṇo jñeyaḥ|7|– nānāvarṇarujāsrāvo ghāṭālo viṣamo mahān ||7|| viṣamaṃ pacyate cāpi vidradhiḥ sānnipātikaḥ | (su. ni. a. 9) | sannipātajamāha– nānetyādi| nānāvarṇarujāsrāva iti nānāśabdo varṇādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate; nānā bahuvidhā varṇāḥ kṛṣṇapītaśuklavarṇāḥ, rujāḥ todadāhakaṇḍvādikāḥ, tanupītasitā āsrāvāśca yasya sa tathā| anyatra śothe pākakāle nānārujā, atra tu sarvadā| ghāṭāla iti ghāṭā asyāsti sa ghāṭāla iti matvarthīyo lac, atyucchritāgratvena ghāṭāla iva| viṣamo'sādhyatvāt| viṣamaṃ pacyate iti cirāciragambhīrottānordhvānūrdhvabhedena viṣamaṃ yathā bhavati tathā pacyata iti; viṣamam asamam| nanu, viṣamapākitvaṃ vātike vidradhāvuktaṃ, tathā'nupakrānte ca śothe; yathā– “yo'bhyutthito'lpo yadi vā mahān syāt kriyāṃ vinā pākamupaiti śothaḥ| viśālamūlo viṣamo vidagdhaḥ sa kṛcchratāṃ yātyavagāḍhadoṣaḥ||” (su. sū. a. 17) iti| ataḥ saṃśaye kathaṃ mitho bhedapratītiḥ? ucyate– vātike apratīkāreṇaiva viṣamapākitvam, pratīkāreṇaiva bheditam| iha punaḥ pratīkāre'pi vaiṣamyaṃ; vātike tu pākamātravaiṣamyaṃ, na tu gāmbhīryādinā; ato vātikaḥ sādhyaḥ||7||– sānnipātikamāha– nānetyādi| nānā bahuvidhāḥ kṛṣṇapītaśuklā varṇāḥ, todadāhakaṇḍvādirujāḥ, tanupītasitāḥ srāvā yasya sa tathā| anyatra śothe pākakāle nānārujāḥ, atra tu sarvadā| ghāṭāla iti ghāṭā asyāstīti ghāṭālaḥ, matvarthīyo lac, atyucchritākṛtitvena ghāṭāla iva| viṣamo'sādhyatvāt| viṣamaṃ pacyata iti cirāciragambhīrottānordhvānūrdhvabhedena viṣamaṃ yathā bhavati tathā pacyate||7|| taistairbhāvairabhihate kṣate vā'pathyakāriṇaḥ ||8|| kṣatoṣmā vāyuvisṛtaḥ saraktaṃ pittamīrayet | jvarastṛṣṇā ca dāhaśca jāyate tasya dehinaḥ ||9|| āganturvidradhirhyeṣa pittavidradhilakṣaṇaḥ |10| (su. ni. a. 9) | abhighātajasyāgantoḥ samprāptimāha– taistairityādi| taistairiti kāṣṭhaloṣṭapāṣāṇādibhiḥ| abhihata iti asrutaraktasya mathitapiccitāderupalakṣaṇaṃ, kṣata iti srutaraktasya chinnabhinnādeḥ; dvayorabhihatayorapathyakāriṇa iti viśeṣaṇam| kṣatoṣmeti kṣataśabdasya hiṃsāmātraparigrahāt kṣatābhihatayorapyūṣmā kṣatoṣmaśabdenocyate| vāyuvisṛta iti kṣate raktakṣayāt abhihate abhighātādeva vātakopaḥ, kupitena vātena hetubhūtena visṛtaḥ prasṛto vāyuvisṛtaḥ| yadyapyayaṃ vātapittaraktajastathā'pi prāgabhighātasambhavatvenāgantuḥ, vātapittaraktajānāṃ janakatvenaiva vilakṣaṇā'sya samprāptiḥ| pittavidradhilakṣaṇa iti atroktajvarādivyatiriktasaṃsthānavarṇavedanādipittavidradhiliṅgayukta ityarthaḥ||8-9||– abhighātajasyāgantorvidradheḥ samprāptimāha– taistairityādi| kāṣṭhalaguḍapāṣāṇādibhiḥ, abhihita iti asrutaraktasya mathitapiccitāderupalakṣaṇam| dvayorabhihatakṣatayorapathyakāriṇa iti yojyam| kṣatoṣmetyādi kṣatasya hiṃsātvamātraparigrahāt kṣatābhihatayorapyūṣmā kṣatoṣmaśabdenocyate| vāyuvisṛta ityādi| vātena vistāritaḥ kṣatena raktakṣayāt, abhihate abhighātādeva vātakopaḥ, kupitena ca vātena hetubhūtena visṛtaḥ prasṛtaḥ raktaṃ pittaṃ īrayet kopayet| yadyapyayaṃ vātapittaraktajastathā'pi prāgabhighātasambhavatvenāgantuḥ| pittavidradhilakṣaṇa iti atra jvaradāhavyatiriktasaṃsthānavarṇavedanādipittalakṣaṇa ityarthaḥ||8-9|| kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ śyāvastīvradāharujākaraḥ ||10|| pittavidradhiliṅgastu raktavidradhirucyate |11| (su. ni. a. 9) | raktajamāha– kṛṣṇetyādi| pittavidradhiliṅgātideśena labdhāvapi dāhajvarau tīvratāviśeṣārthamuktau| śyāva iti pittavidradhiliṅgātideśena prasaktasya pakvodumbarasaṅkāśasyāpavādaḥ| bhojaprabhṛtayastu dhāturaktajaṃ vidradhiṃ parityajya makkallasañjñayā''rtavalakṣaṇaraktajaṃ paṭhanti| teṣāṃ mate ārtavajena saha ṣaḍvidradhayaḥ, suśrute tu dhāturaktajo'pi tathā makkallasañjñako'pi vidradhiḥ sāmānyena raktaja eveti ṣaḍvidradhaya iti boddhavyam||10||– raktajavidradhimāha– kṛṣṇetyādi| kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ, sphoṭāvṛtaḥ piḍakāyuktaḥ, śyāvaḥ śyāvavarṇaḥ; anye ‘kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ’ iti paṭhanti, tatra kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭairāvṛtaḥ pittavidradhilakṣaṇanirdeśena yadyapi dāhajvarau labdhau, tathā'pyatrātidāhajvarakhyāpanārthamuktam| bhojaprabhṛtayastu dhāturaktajaṃ vidradhiṃ parityajya makkallasañjñamārtavalakṣaṇaraktajaṃ paṭhanti| teṣāṃ mate ārtavajena saha ṣaḍ vidradhayaḥ, suśrute tu dhāturaktajo'pi tathā makkallajo'pi vidradhiḥ sāmānyena raktaja eveti ṣaḍ vidradhaya iti boddhavyam||10||– pṛthak sambhūya vā doṣāḥ kupitā gulmarūpiṇam ||11|| valmīkavat samunnaddhamantaḥ kurvanti vidradhim | gude bastimukhe nābhyāṃ kukṣau vaṅkṣaṇayostathā ||12|| vṛkkayoḥ plīhni yakṛti hṛdi vā klomni vā'pyatha | teṣāmuktāni liṅgāni bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaiḥ ||13|| adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaṃ śṛṇu viśeṣataḥ | gude vātanirodhaśca bastau kṛcchrālpamūtratā ||14|| nābhyāṃ hikkā tathā''ṭopaḥ kukṣau mārutakopanam | kaṭīpṛṣṭhagrahastīvro vaṅkṣaṇotthe tu vidradhau ||15|| vṛkkayoḥ pārśvasaṅkocaḥ plīhnyucchvāsāvarodhanam | sarvāṅgapragrahastīvro hṛdi kāsaśca jāyate | śvāso yakṛti hikkā ca klomni pepīyate payaḥ ||16|| (su. ni. a. 9) | adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaviśeṣaṃ sādhyatāmasādhyatāṃ ca pratipādayitumābhyantaravidradhimāha– pṛthagityādi| iyamadhikavidhānārthamuktā'pi samprāptirvidradheḥ punarucyate| ābhyantarasya raktajasya tathā''gantośca vidradherdoṣeṇa vyapadeśādiyameva tatrāpi samprāptirjñeyeti kaścit| bāhyāgantuvadābhyantarāgantusamprāptirityarthaḥ| kṣatajasyābhyantarābhāvānna nirdiṣṭaḥ kṣataja iti tu jejjaṭaḥ| gulmarūpiṇamiti gulmavat saṃhatam| etadābhyantaravidradhīnāṃ sāmānyarūpaṃ; viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ tu bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaireva jñeyam| valmīkavat samunnaddhaṃ samantādunnatam; etadapi pacyamānāvasthāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ samānam| bastimukha iti bastimukha eva, vidradhyādhārabhūtamāṃsādisambhavāt; na bastau, tasya tanutvāt| āṭopo rujāpūrvakakṣobhaḥ| mārutakopanamiti mārgāvarodhādvāyoḥ kopaḥ| vṛkkayoriti vṛkkamagramāṃsam| sarvāṅgapragrahaḥ pratyaṅgavyathā, sarvasirādhiṣṭhānatvāt hṛdayasya| klomnīti kloma vṛkkādūrdhvaṃ pipāsāsthānam| pepīyate payaḥ iti punaḥ punarjalaṃ pātumicchatītyarthaḥ||11-16|| adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaviśeṣaṃ sādhyāsādhyatāṃ ca jñāpayitumantaravidradhīnāha– pṛthagityādi| doṣā vātādayaḥ, pṛthag bhinnāḥ, sambhūya militvā vā, antarmadhye, gulmarūpiṇaṃ gulmavatsaṃhataṃ, valmīkavatsamunnataṃ, valmīkaṃ bhūmau kṛmiviśeṣaiḥ kṛtaṃ, tadvatsamantāt unnatam| sthānasaṃśrayamāha– guda ityādi| bastimukha iti bastimukhāśritamāṃsādau; na ca bastau, tanutvāt| kukṣau pārśvayoradhobhāge, vaṅkṣaṇayoḥ ūrumeḍhrasandhyoḥ| vṛkkau māṃsapiṇḍadvayam, eko vāmapārśve sthitaḥ, dvitīyo dakṣiṇapārśve sthitaḥ, plīhā udarasya vāmapārśve sthitaḥ, yakṛt kālakhaṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇapārśvasthaṃ, hṛdayaṃ kamalamukulākāramadhomukhaṃ, kloma kālakhaṇḍādhastāt sthitaṃ dakṣiṇapārśvasthaṃ tilakaṃ prasiddham| teṣāmābhyantarāṇāṃ vidradhīnāṃ liṅgāni bāhyavidradhīnāṃ liṅgāni bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇairuktāni| pratyekaṃ sthānasaṃśrayatvena rūpamāha– guda ityādi| gudenārte vidradhau vātanirodho bhavati, tathā bastau kṛcchramūtratā alpamūtratā ca| tābhyāṃ hikkā tathā āṭopo rujāpūrvakaḥ kṣobhaḥ, kukṣau mārutakopanamiti mārgarodhāt vāyoḥ prakopaḥ, vaṅkṣaṇotthe vidradhau tīvraḥ kaṭīpṛṣṭhagraho bhavati vṛkkayorityādi| vṛkkamagramāṃsaṃ, pārśvasaṅkocaḥ pārśvotpāṭanamiva, plīhni ucchvāsāvarodhanaṃ bhavati| tathā hṛdīti hṛdayotthe vidradhau sarvāṅgapragrahādaya upadravā bhavantītyarthaḥ| tīvro duḥsahaḥ, sarveṣāmaṅgānāṃ prakarṣeṇa grahaṇamiva sarvāṅgapragrahaḥ pratyaṅgavyathā, sarvādhiṣṭhānatvāt hṛdayasya, yakṛti jāte vidradhau śvāsastathā hikkā ca bhavati| klomnītyādi| vṛkkādūrdhvaṃ pipāsāsthānaṃ kloma, pepīyate paya iti punaḥpunarjalaṃ pātumicchati||11-16|| nābheruparijāḥ pakvā yāntyūrdhvamitare tvadhaḥ |17| (su. ni. a. 9) | srāvanirgamamārgamāha– nābherityādi| uparijā vṛkkaplīhādijāḥ| yānti sravanti| nābhijastūbhayamārgasrāvī, ūrdhvādhaḥsrāvaśca tathāgatitvāt vātasya| yadāha hārītaḥ– “ūrdhvaṃ prabhinneṣu mukhānnarāṇāṃ pravartate'sṛksahito'pi pūyaḥ| adhaḥprabhinneṣu ca pāyumārgāt, dvābhyāṃ pravṛttistviha nābhijeṣu||” iti| itara iti nābhibastivaṅkṣaṇajāḥ|17|– srāvanirgamamāha– nābherityādi| uparijātāḥ vṛkkaplīhādijāḥ pakvāḥ santa ūrdhvaṃ yānti sravanti, nābhijastūbhayamārgasrāvī, ūrdhvādhaḥsrāvaśca tathā gatitvādvātasya| tathā ca hārītaḥ– “ūrdhvaṃ prabhinneṣu mukhānnarāṇāṃ pravartate'sṛksahitaśca pūyaḥ| adhaḥprabhinneṣu tu pāyumārgād dvābhyāṃ pravṛttistviha nābhijeṣu||” iti| itare nābhibastivaṅkṣaṇajāḥ sravanti|17|– adhaḥsruteṣu jīvettu sruteṣūrdhvaṃ na jīvati ||17|| hṛnnābhibastivarjyā ye teṣu bhinneṣu bāhyataḥ | jīvet kadācit puruṣo netareṣu kadācana ||18|| (su. ni. a. 9) | sādhyā vidradhayaḥ pañca vivarjyaḥ sānnipātikaḥ | āmapakvavidagdhatvaṃ teṣāṃ śothavadādiśet ||19|| (vā. ni. a. 11) | ādhmātaṃ baddhaniṣyandaṃ chardihikkātṛṣānvitam | rujāśvāsasamāyuktaṃ vidradhirnāśayennaram ||20|| (su. sū. a. 33) | sādhyatvādikamāha– adha ityādi| adhaḥsruteṣviti svayameva yadā nābhyādijā bhinnā adhaḥ sravanti tadā jīvati| sruteṣūrdhvaṃ na jīvatīti ūrdhvaṃ pūyasyāsamyaṅnirgamānna jīvanam| hṛnnābhibastivarjyā iti plīhaklomādijāḥ| bhinneṣu bāhyata iti vaidyavyāpāreṇa bhinneṣu; anye marmādyāśayajeṣu svayameva bhinneṣviti vyācakṣate, antarbhinneṣvapyadhaḥsrāviṣu jīvanokteḥ| netareṣviti hṛnnābhibastijeṣu bhinneṣu teṣāṃ marmatvād bāhyā ābhyantarā vā varjyāḥ| kadācaneti pāke apāke vā| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “asādhyo marmajo jñeyaḥ pakvo'pakvaśca vidradhiḥ| sannipātotthito'pyevaṃ pakva eva tu bastijaḥ|| tvagjo nābheradho yaśca sādhyo marmasamīpajaḥ| apakvaścaiva pakvaśca sādhyo nopari nābhijaḥ||” iti| atra marmajaśabdena hṛdayanābhijāvucyete| baddhaniṣyandamiti baddhamūtram| etadbastije prāyaḥ||17-20|| srāvaviṣayasādhyāsādhyatvamāha– svayameva yadā nābhyādijā bhinnā adhaḥ sravantīti tadā jīvati, sruteṣūrdhvamityādi, ūrdhvasruteṣu na jīvati| ūrdhvapūyasyāsamyaṅnirgamānna jīvanam|| hṛdityādi| bhinneṣu bāhyata iti vaidyavyāpāreṇa bhinneṣu kadāciddaivavaśāt puruṣo jīvet| anye marmādyāśayajeṣu svayameva bhinneṣviti vyācakṣate| antarbhinneṣvapyadhaḥsrāviṣu jīvanokteḥ| netareṣviti hṛnnābhibastijeṣu bhinneṣu, teṣāṃ marmatvāt bāhyā ābhyantarā vā varjyāḥ| kadācaneti pāke apāke ca| tathāca bhojaḥ– “asādhyo marmajo jñeyaḥ pakvo'pakvaśca vidradhiḥ| sannipātotthito'pyevaṃ pakva eva tu bastijaḥ|| tvagjo nābheradho yaśca sādhyo marmasamīpajaḥ| apakvaścaiva pakvaśca sādhyo noparinābhijaḥ||” iti| atra marmaśabdena hṛdayanābhijāvucyete| sādhyāsādhyatvamāha– pañca iti| vātikapaittikaślaiṣmikāganturaktajā iti| ayaṃ bāhyeṣu viṣayaḥ tridoṣajastvasādhyaḥ| teṣāṃ viṣayamāha– āmeti| teṣāṃ vidradhīnāmābhyantareṣvasādhyatvamāha– ādhmātamityādi| baddhaniṣpandaṃ baddhamūtram, etadbastije prāyaḥ| śeṣaṃ sugamam| atra kecit tantrāntaroktaṃ stanavidradhilakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti, tadyathā– “evameva stanasirā vikṛtāḥ prāpya yoṣitām| sūtānāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca sambhavecchvayathurghanaḥ|| stane sadugdhe cāptāsṛgbāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaḥ| nāḍīnāṃ sūkṣmarandhratvātsa kanyānāṃ na jāyate||17-20|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne vidradhinidānaṃ samāptam ||40|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ vidradhinidānaṃ samāptam||40|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ vidradhinidānam||40|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘āyatanadīrghavṛttatvāyatatvābhyām’ iti pā.| ↩ 2 . ‘ ... vidradhiriti’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . atra ‘ca’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘mahattvasūcanam’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘varṇādibhiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 6 . ‘pratīkāreṇaiva bheditam|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 7 . ‘ata evāyaṃ sādhyaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘kṛṣṇapītaśuklavarṇāḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . mūlaśloke ‘abhihata’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 11 . etacca– ‘kṛṣṇaḥ sphoṭāvṛtaḥ’ iti pā. | ↩ 12 . ‘makkallasañjñārtavalakṣaṇaṃ raktajam’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘pṛthak sambhūya vā ityādi’ iti pā.| ↩ 14 . ‘kṣatasyāntarabhāvānna’ iti pā.| ↩ 15 . atra ‘iti valmīka “uyeraḍipi” tadvat’ iti adhikaḥ pā., ‘unchūnattvaṃ,’ iti vā kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 16 . ‘sarvaśirādhiṣṭhānatvāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 17 . ‘sādhyatām’ iti pā.| ↩ 18 . ‘bāhyavidradhīnāṃ liṅgāni’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 19 . ‘nābheruparijā ityādi|’ iti pā.| ↩ 20 . ‘itare nābhibastivaṅkṣaṇajāḥ sravanti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 21 . ‘svayameva yadā nābhyādijā bhinnā adhaḥ sravantīti tadā jīvati, sruteṣūrdhvamityādi, ūrdhvasruteṣu na jīvati| ūrdhvapūyasyāsamyaṅnirgamānna jīvanam||’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 22 . ‘teṣāṃ viṣayamāha– āmeti|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 23 . mūlaśloke ‘baddhaniṣyandam’ iti pā.| ↩ 24 . ‘stanaśirā’ iti pā.| ↩ 25 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ vidradhinidānam||40||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 41. vraṇaśothanidānam
text: atha vraṇaśothanidānam | ekadeśotthitaḥ śotho vraṇānāṃ pūrvalakṣaṇam | ṣaḍvidhaḥ syāt pṛthaksarvaraktāgantunimittajaḥ ||1|| śothāḥ ṣaḍete vijñeyāḥ prāguktaiḥ śothalakṣaṇaiḥ | viśeṣaḥ kathyate caiṣāṃ pakvāpakvādiniścaye ||2|| prāyeṇa cikitsāsādharmyād bhāvivraṇatvasambandhatulyatvācca vraṇaśothanidānamāha– ekadeśotthita ityādi| ṣaḍvidha iti saṅkhyākathanaṃ dvandvajaniṣedhārtham| prāguktairiti āmapakvaiṣaṇīyoktaiḥ; tatra hi “vātaśvayathuraruṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vā paruṣo mṛduranavasthitaḥ” (su. sū. a. 17) ityādinā ṣaṭśothalakṣaṇānyuktāni| viśeṣaḥ kathyate caiṣāmiti tatrānukto viśeṣaḥ kathyata ityarthaḥ| pakvāpakvādiniścaya iti atrādiśabdena pacyamānasya parigrahaḥ||1-2|| vraṇacikitsāsāmānyādbhāvivraṇatvasambandhatulyatvācca vraṇaśothanidānārambhaḥ| teṣāṃ prāgrūpeṇa saṅkhyāmāha– eketyādi| ekadeśe śothaḥ etadvraṇapūrvarūpaṃ; sa ca ṣaḍvidhaḥ– tribhirdoṣaistrayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, raktenaikaḥ, anya āgantukaḥ abhighātajaḥ, evaṃ ṣaṭ, ṣaḍvidha iti saṅkhyākathanaṃ dvandvajaniṣedhārtham| teṣāṃ lakṣaṇanirdeśaṃ darśayannāha– śothā iti| prāguktairiti| śothanidānoktaiśca, ‘rasastanutvakparuṣāruṇādikaiḥ’ ityādi| sāmprataṃ pakvāpakvādiniścaya ityatrādiśabdena pacyamānāvasthāyāḥ grahaṇam||1-2|| viṣamaṃ pacyate vātāt pittotthaścācirācciram | kaphajaḥ pittavacchotho raktāgantusamudbhavaḥ ||3|| vātādibhedena viśeṣalakṣaṇamāha– viṣamamityādi| pittavaditi pittaśothavadaciraṃ pacyate||3|| tameva viśeṣamāha– viṣamamityādi| śvayathorekadeśe ardhe vā, pittottho'ciraṃ śīghraṃ, kaphajaściraṃ carakalaṃ, raktāgantujayoḥ pittavat pittaśophavadaciraṃ pacyate||3|| mandoṣmatā'lpaśothatvaṃ kāṭhinyaṃ tvaksavarṇatā | mandavedanatā caitacchothānāmāmalakṣaṇam ||4|| āmaśothalakṣaṇamāha– mandeti| mandoṣmatā īṣaduṣṇatā, tvaksavarṇatā tvaksadṛśa eva varṇaḥ||4|| dahyate dahaneneva kṣāreṇeva ca pacyate | pipīlikāgaṇeneva daśyate chidyate tathā ||5|| bhidyate caiva śastreṇa daṇḍeneva ca tāḍyate | pīḍyate pāṇinevāntaḥ sūcībhiriva tudyate ||6|| soṣācoṣo vivarṇaḥ syādaṅgulyevāvaghaṭyate | āsane śayane sthāne śāntiṃ vṛścikaviddhavat ||7|| na gacchedātataḥ śotho bhavedādhmātabastivat | jvarastṛṣṇā'ruciścaiva pacyamānasya lakṣaṇam ||8|| pacyamānalakṣaṇamāha– dahyata ityādi| pacyamānaśothe pittaliṅgānyeva bhūyasā bhavanti, vidāhasya pittaprakopajatvāt; vidāhaścātra doṣādīnāmeva| tena jvaratṛṣṇārucyādayo'tra pittaliṅgāni| chidyata iti dvidhā kriyata iva| bhidyata iti vidāryate| soṣācoṣa iti uṣā dāhaḥ, coṣaḥ pārśvasthāgnisantāpavadvyathā, tābhyāṃ saha vartate yaḥ sa tathā||5-8|| vraṇaśophasya pacyamānāvasthāmāha– dahyata ityādi| pacyamānaśophe pittaliṅgānyeva bhūyasā bhavanti, vidāhaḥ pittaprakopāt, jvaratṛṣṇārucyādayo'pi pittaliṅgāni, agninā dahyata iva, kṣāreṇa pacyata iva, pipīlikābhirdaśyata iva, chidyate dvidhākriyata iva śastreṇa, bhidyata iva, daṇḍena tāḍyata iva, antarmadhye, hastena pīḍyata iva, sūcībhirvidhyata iva| uṣā ekadeśiko dāhaḥ, coṣaḥ pārśvasthitāgnisantāpavadvyathā, tābhyāṃ saha vartate yaḥ sa tathā, vivarṇaḥ mlānaḥ, aṅgulyā ivāvaghaṭyate cālyate| āsane tathā śayane tathā sthāne ūrdhvabhavane vṛścikaviddhavat śāntiṃ na gacchet| ādhmātabastivat vāyupūrṇabastyākhyamūtrakośavat, śvayathuḥ satato bhavati, tvaksaṅkocarahita ityarthaḥ| jvaratṛṣṇādayaścopadravā bhavanti pacyamānavraṇaśophe||5-8|| vedanopaśamaḥ śotho'lohito'lpo na connataḥ | prādurbhāvo valīnāṃ ca todaḥ kaṇḍūrmuhurmuhuḥ ||9|| upadravāṇāṃ praśamo nimnatā sphuṭanaṃ tvacām | bastāvivāmbusañcāraḥ syācchothe'ṅgulipīḍite ||10|| pūyasya pīḍayatyekamantamante ca pīḍīte | bhaktākāṅkṣā bhaveccaitacchothānāṃ pakvalakṣaṇam ||11|| pakvalakṣaṇamāha– vedanopaśama ityādi| dāhādivedanopaśāntiḥ, vidāhopaśamena pittasyābalavattvāt| todaḥ kaṇḍūścātra vātakaphaliṅgam| prādurbhāvo valīnāmiti māṃsaśaithilyādvalīsambhavaḥ| upadravāṇāṃ praśama iti pittakopajanitā uṣācoṣatṛṣṇārucyādayo rogā eva upadravāsteṣāṃ praśamaḥ| nimnatā svarūpataḥ, aṅgulipīḍanādvā| sphuṭanaṃ tvacāmiti kiñcittvagavadaraṇam| bastāvivetyādi| bastiścarmapuṭakam, pūyasyetyatra ‘sañcāra’ iti śeṣaḥ| ayamarthaḥ– bastau yathā'mbusañcārastathā śothe'ṅgulipīḍite sati pūyasya sañcāraḥ| pīḍayatyekamantamante ca pīḍita iti ekamantaṃ deśam, ante avayave pīḍite pīḍayati avagāhate, ‘pūya’ iti śeṣaḥ||9-11|| pakvāvasthasya śophasya lakṣaṇamāha– vedanopaśama ityādi| vidāhopaśamena pittasyābalatvāt| alohitaḥ pāṇḍuḥ dhūsaro vā, yaduktaṃ suśrute– “ pāṇḍutā'lpaśothatā” iti alpavedanayā iti īṣat pīḍā vedanopaśamaḥ, iti| yaduktam– uktaḥ vedanāpekṣayā prādurbhāvo valīnāmiti māṃsaśaithilyādvalīsambhava iti| todaḥ kaṇḍuścātra vātakaphaliṅgam| upadravāṇāmityādi| pittakopajanitā uṣācoṣatṛṣṇā'rucyādaya upadravāsteṣāmupaśamaḥ| nimnatā svarūpato'ṅgulinipīḍanādvā| sphuṭanaṃ tvacāmiti kiñcittvagavadaraṇam| bastāvivetyādi– bastiścarmapuṭakam| pūyasyetyatra ‘sañcāra’ iti śeṣaḥ| ayamarthaḥ– bastau yathā'mbusañcāraḥ, tathā'ṅgulipīḍite śothe'pi pūyasya sañcāraḥ| ekamantaṃ deśam, ante avayave pīḍite pīḍayati avagāhate ‘pūya’ iti śeṣaḥ| bhaktākāṅkṣeti vedanāpagamādeva||9-11|| narte'nilādruṅna vinā ca pittaṃ pākaḥ kaphaṃ cāpi vinā na pūyaḥ | tasmāddhi sarve paripākakāle pacanti śothāṃstraya eva doṣāḥ ||12|| (su. sū. a. 17) | ekadoṣārabdhe'pi śothe pākakāle sarvadoṣasambandhamāha– narte'nilādrugityādi| rugrujā todādirūpā| suśrute– “tribhiretaiḥ śoṇitacaturthaiśca śarīramidaṃ dhāryate” (su. sū. a. 21) iti dvitīyaṃ darśanaṃ śoṇitaprādhānyākhyāpakamāśrityoktam– “kālāntareṇābhyuditaṃ tu pittaṃ kṛtvā vaśe vātakaphau prasahya| pacatyataḥ śoṇitameṣa pāko mataḥ pareṣāṃ viduṣāṃ dvitīyaḥ||” (su. sū. a. 17) iti| atra darśane pittaṃ vidāhakupitaṃ śoṇitaṃ dūṣyaṃ karmabhūtaṃ pacati, vātakaphau vaśe kṛtvā kroḍīkṛtya; hīnārtho vā vaśeśabdaḥ, vātakaphau hīnau kṛtvetyarthaḥ; śoṇitaṃ kartṛbhūtaṃ vā, tena paktyanukūlatvādvivakṣitaṃ; pūrvadarśane kaphāt pūyaḥ, atra darśane śoṇitāt pūya iti viśeṣaḥ| gambhīrapāke śothe sakalāmapacyamānalakṣaṇānudayādajñāyamāne lakṣaṇāntaramuktaṃ suśrutena| tadyathā– “kaphajeṣu khalu śotheṣu gambhīragatitvādabhighātajeṣu vā keṣucidasamastaṃ pakvalakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā pakvamapakvamiti bhiṣaṅmohamupaiti, yatra hi tvaksavarṇatā śītaśothatā alparujatā aśmavadghanatā ca, na tatra mohamupeyāt|” (su. sū. a. 17) iti| asyārthaḥ– yadā rāgadāhādivedanāsamudāyānantaraṃ tvaksavarṇatādīni bhavanti tadā na mohamajñānatāmupeyāt pakvameveti niścinuyāt| gadādhareṇa tu tvaksavarṇatādīni saṃśayahetūnyuktāni; yatastena “gambhīrapākitvādantaḥ pāko bahiḥ punastvaksāvarṇyaṃ, gambhīrapākitvādeva bahiḥ śītatā, kaphārabdhatvānmandarujatā'śmavacca ghanatā” ityabhidhāya “śeṣaṃ pakvalakṣaṇairjānīyāt” ityuktam||12|| ekadoṣārabdhe'pi śothe pākakāle sarvadoṣasambandhamāha– netyādi| anilādvātādṛte ruṅ na bhavati, pittaṃ vinā pāko na bhavati, kaphaṃ vinā pūyo na bhavati, tasmāddhetoḥ sarve śophāḥ paripākakāle tribhireva doṣaiḥ pākaṃ gacchanti, ruk rujā todādirūpā, śeṣaṃ sugamam| suśrute– ‘tribhiretaiḥ śoṇitacaturthaiḥ śarīramidaṃ dhāryate|’ iti dvitīyaṃ nidarśanaṃ śoṇitaprādhānyākhyāpakamāśrityoktaṃ matāntaramāha– kālāntareṇetyādi| pittaprakopaprasarasthānasaṅgrahakālāvadhinā abhi samantato bhāvenābhyuditaṃ kupitaṃ pittaṃ, pittamatra doṣo jñeyaḥ, śoṇitaṃ dūṣyaṃ, tuśabdo'tra punararthe, vātakaphau vaśe kṛtvā ātmasāt kṛtvā, pākakriyāyāṃ pittasya prādhānyāt| pūrvamate kaphāt pūyaḥ, atra tu śoṇitādibhiriti tātparyārthaḥ||12|| kālāntareṇābhyuditaṃ tu pittaṃ kṛtvā vaśe vātakaphau prasahya | pacatyataḥ śoṇitameṣa pāko mataḥ pareṣāṃ viduṣāṃ dvitīyaḥ ||13|| kakṣaṃ samāsādya yathaiva vahnirvāyvīritaḥ sandahati prasahya | tathaiva pūyo hyaviniḥsṛto hi māṃsaṃ sirāḥ snāyu ca khādatīha ||14|| (su. sū. a. 17) | aviniḥsṛtasya pūyasya doṣamāha– kakṣamityādi| kakṣaṃ samāsādyeti kakṣaṃ tṛṇādigahanam||13-14|| anirhṛtasya pūyasya doṣaṃ darśayannāha– kakṣamityādi| kakṣaṃ tṛṇādīnāṃ samūhaṃ, snāyumūlāḥ sirāḥ, vāyvīritaḥ vāyupreritaḥ||13-14|| āmaṃ vidahyamānaṃ ca samyak pakvaṃ ca yo bhiṣak | jānīyāt sa bhavedvaidyaḥ śeṣāstaskaravṛttayaḥ ||15|| yaśchinattyāmamajñānādyo vā pakvamupekṣate | śvapacāviva mantavyau tāvaniścitakāriṇau ||16|| (su. sū. a. 17) | śvapacāviva caṇḍālāviva, mantavyau jñātavyau| śeṣāstaskaravṛttaya iti lobhamātraprayuktatvāttaskarā iva śeṣāḥ||15-16|| āmādilakṣaṇajñāne guṇamajñāne ca doṣaṃ darśayannāha– āmamityādi| āmamapakvaṃ, vidahyamānaṃ pacyamānaṃ, samyak pakvaṃ ca, yo bhiṣak jānīyāt, sa vaidyo bhavet āyurvedavit syāt, śeṣā anye āmādijñānavarjitāḥ lobhamātraprayuktatvāttaskarā eva| pakvāpakvayośchedanāchedanena vaidyadoṣamāha– ya ityādi| śvapacaścāṇḍālaḥ, sa hi sarvabhakṣitvāt śvānamapi pacati| śeṣaṃ sugamam||15-16|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne vraṇaśothanidānaṃ samāptam ||41|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ vraṇaśothanidānaṃ samāptam||41|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ vraṇaśothanidānam||41|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘raktenaikaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 2 . ‘śothā iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 3 . ‘iti atrādiśabdena pacyamānasya parigrahaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘grahaṇam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 5 . ‘vāyupūrṇabastyādisūtrakośavat’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘śotho lohito'lpo’ iti pā. | ↩ 7 . ‘kiñcittvagavadāraṇam’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘śothe'ṅgulīpīḍite’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘pāṇḍutā'lpaśothā’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . ‘alpavedanayā iti īṣat pīḍā vedanopaśamaḥ, iti| yaduktam– uktaḥ vedanāpekṣayā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 11 . ‘śothāstribhireva doṣaiḥ’ iti pā. | ↩ 12 . ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 13 . ‘śoṇitādibhistātparyārthaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 14 . ayaṃ ślokaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate ↩ 15 . ‘śirāḥ’ iti pā. | ↩ 16 . ‘anirhṛtya pūyasya doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā darśayannāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 17 . ‘śirāḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 18 . ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyām’ iti pā.| ↩ 19 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ vraṇaśothanidānam||41||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 42. śārīravraṇanidānam
text: atha śārīravraṇanidānam | dvidhā vraṇaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ śārīrāgantubhedataḥ | doṣairādyastayoranyaḥ śastrādikṣatasambhavaḥ ||1|| stabdhaḥ kaṭhinasaṃsparśo mandasrāvo mahārujaḥ | tudyate sphurati śyāvo vraṇo mārutasambhavaḥ ||2|| tṛṣṇāmohajvarakledadāhaduṣṭyavadāraṇaiḥ | vraṇaṃ pittakṛtaṃ vidyādgandhaiḥ srāvaiśca pūtikaiḥ ||3|| bahupiccho guruḥ snigdhaḥ stimito mandavedanaḥ | pāṇḍuvarṇo'lpasaṅkledaścirapākī kaphavraṇaḥ ||4|| (ca. ci. a. 25) | rakto raktasrutī raktāddvitrijaḥ syāttadanvayaiḥ |5| śothānāmanupakrāntānāṃ vraṇabhāvāpattervraṇanidānamāha– dvidhetyādi| ‘vraṇa gātravicūrṇane’ ityasmāddhātorvraṇasya sādhutvamuktam| vraṇaniruktiśca suśrutena kṛtā| yathā– “vṛṇoti yasmādrūḍhe'pi vraṇavāstu na naśyati| ādehadhāraṇājjantorvraṇastasmānnirucyate||” (su. sū. a. 21) iti| anya ityāgantuḥ| āgantuvraṇe yadyapi doṣastatkālaṃ tadātvena sañcayakopaprasaraṇaśālī vikārakaraṇasamarthaḥ kalpayituṃ śakyate, tathā'pi saptarātraṃ kṣatoṣmanirvāpaṇāya madhusarpirupayogāt śītakriyāvidhānācca nijavraṇavilakṣaṇacikitsārthaṃ vyapadiśyate| raktasyaikaikasmin doṣe dvandve ca prasaramāha– dvitrijaḥ syāttadanvayairityādi| raktānvayaiḥ ekaikadoṣairdvandvaiśca; raktānvitairekaikadoṣairdvijo vraṇaḥ, raktānvitairdvandvatrayaistrijaḥ; evaṃ doṣatraye'pi raktasambandha ūhanīyaḥ; evaṃ pañcadaśadhā prasaro doṣāṇāmupagṛhīto bhavati| athavā'yamarthaḥ– tadanvayairdoṣadvandvatrayānvayaiḥ, tena doṣadvayānvayena dvijo dvandvajo vraṇaḥ, doṣatrayānvayena trijaḥ sannipātajaḥ||1-4||– vraṇaśophānāmanupakrāntānāṃ vraṇabhāvāpattervraṇanidānam| teṣāṃ bhedamāha– dvidhetyādi| ‘vraṇa gātravicūrṇane’ ityasmāddhātoḥ vraṇasya niruktiḥ| vraṇaniruktiśca suśrute kṛtā| yathā– “vṛṇoti yasmādrūḍhe'pi vraṇavāstu na naśyati| ādehadhāraṇājjantorvraṇastasmānnirucyate||” iti| śārīrāgantubhedato vraṇo dvidhā jñeyaḥ, tayordvayormadhye ādyaḥ śārīraḥ, sa ca doṣaiḥ pavanakaphapittaśoṇitasannipātaiḥ syāt, anya ityāgantuḥ śastrādikṣatasambhavo bhavati| vātikamāha– stabdha ityādi| stabdhaḥ acalaḥ, tudyate śūleneva, śyāvaḥ śāvavarṇaḥ| paittikamāha– tṛṣṇetyādi| etairliṅgaiḥ pittakṛtaṃ jānīyāt| kleda ārdratā, dāhaduṣṭiḥ dāhavān, avadāraṇaṃ tvaksphoṭanaṃ, pūtikairdurgandhaiḥ| kaphajamāha– bahvityādi| bahupicchaḥ bhūyaḥ picchilaḥ, stimito niścalaḥ, alpasaṅkledaḥ īṣadārdraḥ| raktasyaikasmin doṣe dvandve ca prasaramāha– rakta ityādi| raktavarṇo bhavati, raktasrāvo vā| dvitrijaḥ syāttadanvayairiti raktānugaiḥ pṛthagdoṣaiḥ dvandvaiśca, tena pṛthagdoṣaiḥ saraktaiḥ dvijaḥ, dvandvajaiḥ saraktaistrijaḥ, evaṃ tridoṣaje'pi raktaḥ sambandhanīyaḥ| tadyathā– vātajaḥ, pittajaḥ, śleṣmajaḥ, saṅghātajaḥ, raktajaḥ, vātapittajaḥ, vātaśleṣmajaḥ, pittaśleṣmajaḥ, evamaṣṭau; śoṇitasambandhāt sapta, vātaśoṇitasambandhāttajjaḥ, śleṣmaḥ pittaśoṇitajaḥ, śleṣmaśoṇitajaḥ, vātapittaśoṇitajaḥ, vātaśleṣmaśoṇitajaḥ, pittaśleṣmaśoṇitajaḥ, sannipātakṣatajaḥ iti; evaṃ doṣāṇāṃ bhedena pañcadaśadhā prasara uktaḥ| athavā tadanvayaiḥ doṣatrayānvayaiḥ, tena doṣadvayānvayena dvijaḥ dvandvajo vraṇaḥ, doṣatrayānvayena trijaḥ sānnipātiko vraṇa ityarthaḥ||1-4||– tvaṅmāṃsajaḥ sukhe deśe taruṇasyānupadravaḥ ||5|| dhīmato'bhinavaḥ kāle sukhe sādhyaḥ sukhaṃ vraṇaḥ | guṇairanyatamairhīnastataḥ kṛcchro vraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||6|| sarvairvihīno vijñeyastvasādhyo bhūryupadravaḥ | (ca. ci. a. 25) | sādhyatvādikamāha– tvagityādi| sukhe deśa iti marmarahite dehāvayave| anupadrava iti jvaratṛṣṇādyupadravarahitaḥ| dhīmata iti hitāhitajñasya| kāle sukhe iti hemante śiśire ca| anyatamairiti uktānāṃ guṇānāṃ madhye ekatamairguṇaiḥ||5-6||– vraṇasya sukhasādhyatvamāha– tvagityādi| tvaṅmāṃsajaḥ, sukhe deśe marmarahite dehāvayave, anupadravaḥ jvaratṛṣṇādyupadravarahitaḥ, dhīmataḥ ataralabuddheḥ, sukhe kāle hemante śiśire ca| vraṇasya kaṣṭasādhyamāha– guṇairityādi| prāguktānāṃ guṇānāṃ madhye anyatamairguṇairhīnaḥ rahitaḥ, tvaṅmāṃsajādīnāmityarthaḥ| sa vraṇaḥ kaṣṭasādhyaḥ| asādhyamāha– sarvairityādi| sarvaistvagmāṃsajādikairguṇaiḥ rahitaḥ, nirupakramaḥ anupakrāntaḥ||5-6||– pūtiḥ pūyātiduṣṭāsṛksrāvyutsaṅgī cirasthitiḥ ||7|| duṣṭo vraṇo'tigandhādiḥ śuddhaliṅgaviparyayaḥ |8| duṣṭavraṇaliṅgamāha– pūtirityādi| pūyātiduṣṭāsṛksrāvīti pūyayuktamatiduṣṭaṃ raktaṃ satataṃ sravatītyarthaḥ| utsaṅgī koṭaravān| cirasthitirityanena bahuladoṣasambandhaṃ darśayati| tathā coktam– “anātmavatāmajñaiścopakrāntā vraṇāḥ pradūṣyanti, vṛddhatvāddoṣāṇām||” (su. sū. a. 22) iti| duṣṭavraṇa ityatra ‘paribhāṣita’ iti śeṣaḥ| atigandhādiriti ādiśabdena varṇasrāvavedanākṛtayo gṛhītāḥ, atiśabdena ca viśiṣyante| śuddhaliṅgaviparyaya iti vakṣyamāṇaśuddhaliṅgaviparītaḥ pūtitvādiyogādeva| ‘pūtipūyātiduṣṭāsṛksrāvi’ iti kvacit pāṭhe pūtiśabdaḥ pūyaduṣṭāsṛgviśeṣaṇam||7||– duṣṭavraṇalakṣaṇamāha– pūtirityādi| pūtiḥ śaṭitaḥ, “pūtipūyātiduṣṭāsṛksrāvī” iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ, tatra pūtiśabdaḥ pūyaduṣṭāsṛgviśeṣaṇaṃ, pūyayuktamatiduṣṭaraktaṃ satataṃ sravatītyarthaḥ| cirasthitirityanena bahudoṣasambandhaṃ darśayati| tathā coktam– “anātmavatāmajñaiścopakrāntā vraṇā vṛddhatvāddoṣāṇāṃ praduṣyanti” iti| duṣṭo vraṇa iti kathitaḥ atigandhādiḥ, ādiśabdena varṇāsrāvavedanākṛtayo gṛhyante| śuddhaliṅgaviparyaya iti vakṣyamāṇaśuddhalakṣaṇaviparītaḥ||7||– jihvātalābho'timṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ snigdho'lpavedanaḥ ||8|| suvyavastho nirāsrāvaḥ śuddho vraṇa iti smṛtaḥ |9| śuddhavraṇalakṣaṇamāha– jihvetyādi| jihvātalābha iti jihvātalavadābhā prabhā yasya sa tathā; talaśabdaḥ svarūpavacanaḥ| jihvātalābhaśabdaścātra mṛduślakṣṇasnigdhaśabdaiḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate; tena jihvātalābho mṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ snigdhaścetyāhuḥ| suvyavastha iti utsannotsaṅgitvarahitaḥ| nirāsrāva iti doṣakṛtasrāvarahitaḥ| carake tu paṭhyate– “nātirakto nātipāṇḍurnātisrāvo na cātiruk| na cotsanno na cotsaṅgī śuddho ropyaḥ paraṃ vraṇaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 25) iti, taddarśanādatra nirāsrāvatvaṃ doṣakṛtasrāvahīnatvaṃ, vigatavedanatvaṃ ca vātādyuktavedanārahitatvam| vraṇasrāvakṛtavedanāyuktatvaṃ punarastyeva, ata eva rūḍhaliṅge arujamityuktam||8||– śuddhavraṇalakṣaṇamāha– jihvetyādi| jihvātalavadābhā prabhā yasya sa tathā| talaśabdaḥ svarūpavacanaḥ, jihvātalābhaśabdaścātra mṛduślakṣṇasnigdhaśabdaiḥ saha pratyekamabhisambadhyate; tena jihvātalābho mṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ snigdhaśceti prāhuḥ| suvyavastha iti śobhanākṛtiḥ, tena utsannotsaṅgitvarahitaḥ, kintu sama ityarthaḥ| nirāsrāva iti doṣakṛtāsrāvahīnaḥ| yaduktaṃ carake– “nātirakto nātipāṇḍurnātisrāvo na cātiruk| na cotsanno na cotsaṅgī śuddho ropyaḥ paraṃ vraṇaḥ||” iti||8||– kapotavarṇapratimā yasyāntāḥ kledavarjitāḥ ||9|| sthirāśca piḍakāvanto rohatīti tamādiśet | (su. sū. a. 23) | ruhyamāṇalakṣaṇamāha– kapotetyādi| kapotavarṇapratimā iti pāṇḍudhūsarāḥ, sthirāḥ adaraṇāḥ| ‘cipiṭikāvarṇa’ iti pāṭhāntare cipiṭikā māṃsacelī, tadvarṇaḥ||9||– rohaṇonmukhavraṇalakṣaṇamāha– kapotetyādi| yasya vraṇasyāntāḥ prāntāḥ kapotavarṇapratimāḥ, pāṇḍudhūsarā ityarthaḥ| kledena varjitāḥ| sthirā acalāḥ kaṭhinā ityarthaḥ| “cipiṭikāvantaḥ” iti pāṭhe cipiṭikā māṃsacelī carmavalīti yāvat, ‘karocaḍī’ iti loke, tā vidyante yeṣāṃ te cipiṭikāvantaḥ||9||– rūḍhavartmānamagranthimaśūnamarujaṃ vraṇam ||10|| tvaksavarṇaṃ samatalaṃ samyagrūḍhaṃ vinirdiśet | (su. sū. a. 23) | samyagrūḍhalakṣaṇamāha– rūḍhavartmānamityādi| rūḍhavartmānamiti vartma vraṇamārgo vraṇavāstu rūḍho yasya tam| antaḥpūyābhāvādaśūnamarujaṃ ca| tvaksavarṇaṃ tvacāsamānavarṇam| samatalamiti samaṃ talena jihvātalena karatalena vā| agranthimityanena upari ucchūnatāyā niṣedhaḥ, samatalena tvadhonimnatāyā niṣedhaḥ||10||– rūḍhavraṇalakṣaṇamāha– rūḍhavartmānamityādi| vartma vraṇamārgo vraṇavāstu sa rūḍho yasya tam, agranthiṃ granthirahitam, etena upari utsannatāyā niṣedhaḥ| aśūnaṃ śvayathurahitam, arujaṃ pīḍārahitaṃ, tvaksavarṇaṃ tvacāsamānavarṇam| samatalamiti samaṃ talena jihvātalena karatalena vā, samatalaśabdena tvadho nimnatāyā niṣedhaḥ||10||– kuṣṭhināṃ viṣajuṣṭānāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ madhumehinām ||11|| vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyanti yeṣāṃ cāpi vraṇe vraṇāḥ | vasāṃ medo'tha majjānaṃ mastuluṅgaṃ ca yaḥ sravet ||12|| āgantujo vraṇaḥ siddhyenna siddhyeddoṣasambhavaḥ | (su. sū. a. 23) | vyādhiviśeṣeṇa vraṇasya kṛcchrasādhyatvamāha– kuṣṭhināmityādi| kuṣṭhaviśeṣeṇātyantadoṣadūṣitaraktādidūṣyatvena sarvadā duṣṭiradhiketi kṛcchrasādhyatvam| viṣajuṣṭānāmiti dūṣīviṣārtānām| śoṣe madhumehe ca dhātukṣayāt, vraṇe ca raktasrāvādāhārasaṃyamanādadhikā duṣṭiḥ| vasāṃ medo'tha majjānaṃ mastuluṅgaṃ ca yaḥ sravediti majjā asthisnehaḥ, mastuluṅgaṃ ghṛtikā| na sidhyeddoṣasambhava iti doṣairatidūṣitānāṃ vasādīnāṃ srāvasya bahuvyāpattikaratvāt||11-12|| vyādhiviśeṣeṇa vraṇasya kṛcchrasādhyatvamāha– kuṣṭhināmityādi| kuṣṭhaviśeṣeṇātyantadoṣadūṣitaraktādidūṣyatvena sarvadā duṣṭiradhiketi kṛcchratvam| viṣajuṣṭānāṃ dūṣīviṣārtānāṃ, śoṣe madhumehe ca dhātukṣayād vraṇe raktasrāvāccāhārasaṃyamāccādhikaduṣṭiḥ| punaḥ kṛcchrasādhyatvamāha– vasetyādi| vasā māṃsasnehaḥ, majjā'sthisnehaḥ, mastuluṅgo mastakābhyantarasnehaḥ, vasādīnāṃ srāvādāgantuje vraṇe kṛcchratvaṃ vā, kintu doṣaje vraṇe'sādhyatvaṃ, doṣairatiśayadūṣitānāṃ vasādīnāṃ srāvasya bahuvyāpattikaratvāt||11-12||– madyāgurvājyasumanaḥpadmacandanacampakaiḥ ||13|| sagandhā divyagandhāśca mumūrṣūṇāṃ vraṇāḥ smṛtāḥ | (su. sū. a. 28) | riṣṭarūpāṃ gandhavikṛtimāha– madyāgurvājyetyādi| sumanā jātī, sagandhāḥ samānagandhāḥ, divyagandhā aparikalpitādbhutapārijātādigandhāḥ||13||– riṣṭarūpāṃ gandhavikṛtimāha– madyetyādi| madyaṃ prasiddham, aguru gandhadravyam, ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ, sumanā jātī, padmaṃ kamalaṃ, madyādibhiḥ samānagandhāḥ||13||– ye ca marmasvasambhūtā bhavantyatyarthavedanāḥ ||14|| dahyante cāntaratyarthaṃ bahiḥśītāśca ye vraṇāḥ | dahyante bahiratyarthaṃ bhavantyantaśca śītalāḥ ||15|| prāṇamāṃsakṣayaśvāsakāsārocakapīḍitāḥ | pravṛddhapūyarudhirā vraṇā yeṣāṃ ca marmasu ||16|| kriyābhiḥ samyagārabdhā na sidhyanti ca ye vraṇāḥ | varjayedapi tān vaidyaḥ saṃrakṣannātmano yaśaḥ ||17|| (su. sū. a. 28) | ye ca marmasvasambhūtā iti| marmasu na jātā api bhṛśavedanāḥ, marmajātatvena hi bhṛśavedanāvattvaṃ yuktam| prāṇamāṃsakṣaya iti prāṇakṣayeṇa śaktikṣayaḥ, māṃsakṣayeṇa copacayakṣayaḥ| anuktamapyaśeṣaṃ riṣṭaṃ saṅgṛhṇannāha– kriyābhirityādi||14-17|| punaścāsādhyatvamāha– ya ityādi| marmasu na jātā api bhṛśavedanāḥ syuḥ, marmajātatvena hi bhṛśavedanatvaṃ yuktam| ye bahiḥ śītalāḥ, antarmadhye atyarthaṃ dahyante| punaścāsādhyaliṅgatvamāha– prāṇetyādi| prāṇakṣayaḥ śaktikṣayaḥ, māṃsakṣayaḥ upacayakṣayaḥ, marmasu pāyunābhihṛdayādiṣu| punaścāsādhyatvamāha– kriyābhirityādi| pādacatuṣṭayānvitābhiḥ||14-17|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne śārīravraṇanidānaṃ samāptam ||42|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śārīravraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||42|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ śārīravraṇanidānam||42|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘bhūyaḥ picchaḥ picchilaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 2 . ‘śleṣmaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 3 . ‘vātapittaśleṣmaśoṇitajaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘kaṣṭasādhyatvamāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘bhūryupadravaḥ’ ityatra ‘nirupakramaḥ’ iti pā.| ‘sarvairvihīno'sādhyastu tathaivopadravānvitaḥ’ iti ca pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 7 . ‘duṣṭe’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘suvyavasthita’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘jihvātalaśabdaścātra’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . ‘iti darśanāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘ruhyamāna ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘raktasrāvāccāhāra ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘vraṇe'kṛcchratvam’ iti
