pā.| ↩ 14 . ubhayoḥ vyākhyayoḥ ‘ ... sumanā ... ’ iti pā. | ↩ 15 . asyāgre “vraṇe śvayathurāyāsāt sa ca rāgaśca jāgarāt tau ca rukca divāsvāpāt, tāśca mṛtyuśca maithunāt” iti kvacitpustake'dhikaṃ paṭhyate ↩ 16 . ‘marmajā tattvena hi bhṛśavedanatvayuktam|’ iti pā.| ↩ 17 . ‘antarmadhyam’ iti pā.| ↩ 18 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ śārīravraṇanidānam||42||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 43. sadyovraṇanidānam
text: nānādhāramukhaiḥ śastrairnānāsthānanipātitaiḥ | bhavanti nānākṛtayo vraṇāstāṃstānnibodha me ||1|| chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ tathā viddhaṃ kṣataṃ piccitameva ca | ghṛṣṭamāhustathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||2|| (su. ci. a. 2) | śārīravraṇamabhidhāyāgantuvraṇamāha– nānādhāramukhairityādi| nānā dhārā mukhāni ca yeṣāṃ tāni tathā| sthānaviśeṣo'pi śastranipātatulyatvenākṛtiviśeṣe heturityata uktaṃ– nānāsthānanipātitairiti||1-2|| atha śārīravraṇamabhidhāyāgantumāha– nānetyādi| nānādhārāmukhaiḥ śastraiḥ, nānāsthānanipātitaiḥ, ebhirnānākṛtayo vraṇā bhavanti, me matsakāśāttān vraṇān nibodha jānīhi| tatṣāḍvidhyamāha– chinnamityādi| evaṃ chinnādibhedena āgantavaḥ ṣaḍvidhā bhavanti||1-2|| tiryak chinna ṛjurvā'pi yo vraṇastvāyato bhavet | gātrasya pātanaṃ taddhi chinnamityabhidhīyate ||3|| (su. ci. a. 2) | chinnalakṣaṇamāha– tiryagityādi| tiryagiti tiryagvyavasthitaḥ| chinnaḥ chedasampannaḥ| ṛjuravakraḥ| gātrasya pātanamiti gātrāvayavasya tadekadeśarūpasya vā gātrasya pātanam||3|| tatra chinnalakṣaṇamāha– tiryagityādi| yo vraṇastiryak chinno'thavā ṛjuśchinnaḥ sannāyato bhavet, tiryagiti tiryagvyavasthitaḥ, chinnaḥ chedasampannaḥ| ‘tiraścīnaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare sa evārthaḥ, ṛjuravakraḥ, anayordvayorapyāyata iti viśeṣaṇam| atra pātanaṃ nirdiśannāha– gātrasya pātanamiti gātrasyāvayavasya tadekadeśarūpasya vā gātrasya pātanam| ḍallanastu vyācaṣṭe– śastrādiprahāreṇa gātrasya hastādeḥ pātanaṃ, cakārādapātanaṃ ca||3|| śaktidanteṣu khaḍgāgraviṣāṇairāśayo hataḥ | yatkiñcit prasravettaddhi bhinnalakṣaṇamucyate ||4|| (su. ci. a. 2) | bhinnalakṣaṇamāha– śaktītyādi| viṣāṇaṃ dantaḥ śṛṅgaṃ ca| etadbhinnalakṣaṇaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ; tena vyadha evāśayadeśe bheda ucyate, āśayadeśarahite tu vyadhaḥ| yatkiñcidityādi| yasya mūtrarudhirāderya āśayo bhinnaḥ sa tat prasravet; tena bastirbhinno mūtraṃ, rudhirāśayo rudhiramityādi||4|| bhinnalakṣaṇamāha– śaktītyādi| śaktyādibhirāśayo hataḥ san yatkiñcit prasravet, tadbhinnalakṣaṇamucyate| kunto bhallaḥ, viṣāṇaṃ dantaḥ śṛṅgaṃ ca, etadbhinnalakṣaṇaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ, tena vyadha evāśayadeśe bheda ucyate, āśayarahite tu deśe vyadhaḥ| yatkiñcit prasravediti kimapi nirdeṣṭavyamityarthaḥ| yasya mūtrarudhirāderyaścāśayo bhinnaḥ sa tat prasravet; tena bastirbhinno mūtraṃ, udaraṃ medaḥ, purīṣāśayaḥ purīṣaṃ, rudhirāśayo rudhiramiti||4|| sthānānyāmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca | hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaśca koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate ||5|| tasmin bhinne raktapūrṇe jvaro dāhaśca jāyate | mūtramārgagudāsyebhyo raktaṃ ghrāṇācca gacchati ||6|| mūrchā śvāsastṛṣā''dhmānamabhaktacchanda eva ca | viṇmūtravātasaṅgaśca svedāsrāvo'kṣiraktatā ||7|| lohagandhitvamāsyasya gātradaurgandhyameva ca | hṛcchūlaṃ pārśvayoścāpi viśeṣaṃ cātra me śṛṇu ||8|| āmāśayasthe rudhire rudhiraṃ chardayatyapi | ādhmānamatimātraṃ ca śūlaṃ ca bhṛśadāruṇam ||9|| pakvāśayagate cāpi rujā gauravameva ca | adhaḥkāye viśeṣeṇa śītatā ca bhavediha ||10|| (su. ci. a. 2) | yatra bhūyasā''māśayānāṃ sthāne bhedavyapadeśastamāha– sthānānītyādi| āmasya sthānamāmāśayaḥ agneḥ pacyamānāśayaḥ, malasya pakvāśayaḥ, mūtrasya bastiḥ, rudhirasya yakṛtplīhānau, hṛt hṛdayaṃ, uṇḍuka ikṣurasapākamalavadyaḥ śoṇitamalastajja uṇḍukaḥ, sa cāntradeśe vyavasthitaḥ purīṣādhānamiti, phupphusa iti hṛdayasya vāmapārśve raktādhāraḥ ‘phupphusa’ iti khyātaḥ| mūtramārgagudāsyebhyo raktaṃ ghrāṇācca gacchatīti bastyādau bhinne mehanagudābhyāṃ raktaṃ niḥsarati, āmāśayādibhede tu mukhaghrāṇābhyāṃ raktanirgamaḥ| svedāsrāva iti svedasyātyantasrutiḥ| pārśvayoścāpīti śūlamiti sambandhaḥ| me ityavyayaṃ matta ityarthaḥ| āmāśayastha ityādi ādhmānaṃ raktāvatatatvādvāyoḥ| rujā śūlam| gauravaṃ raktabahutvāt| adhaḥkāye viśeṣeṇa śītateti vyādhiprabhāvāt||5-10|| yatra bhūyasāmāśayānāṃ sthāne bhedavyapadeśastamāha– sthānānītyādi| sthānaśabdaḥ āmādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate, āmasya sthānamāmāśayaḥ, agneḥ pacyamānāśayaḥ, pakvasya pakvāśayaḥ, mūtrasya bastiḥ, rudhirasya yakṛtplīhānau, hṛt hṛdayaṃ, uṇḍuka ikṣurasapākamalavacchoṇitamalaḥ, tajja uṇḍukaḥ, sa cāntradeśe vyavasthitaḥ purīṣādhānaṃ, phupphusa iti hṛdayasya vāmapārśve phupphusa iti khyātaḥ| āmādīnāṃ sthānāni koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate| bhinnakoṣṭhasya sāmānyaliṅgamāha– tasminnityādi| tatra bastyādau bhinne mehanagudābhyāṃ raktaṃ niḥsarati, āmāśayādibhede tu mukhaghrāṇābhyāṃ raktanirgamaḥ, jvaramūrchādaya upadravā bhavanti, viṇmūtravātānāṃ saṅgo'pravṛtiḥ, svedāsrāvaḥ svedasyāsrutiḥ| mukhasya lohagandhatā, hṛtpārśvayoḥ śūlamiti sambandhaḥ| atrāpi me matto viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu| raktapūrṇabhedalakṣaṇamāha– āmāśayastha ityādi| atimātramādhmānaṃ ādhmātabastirivodarapūrṇatā, dāruṇaṃ māraṇātmakam| pakvāśayasthitasya raktasya lakṣaṇamāha– pakvetyādi| rujā śūlam| gauravamiti nābheradho boddhavyam| adhaḥkāye viśeṣeṇa śītateti vyādhiprabhāvāt||5-10|| sūkṣmāsyaśalyābhihataṃ yadaṅgaṃ tvāśayaṃ vinā | uttuṇḍitaṃ nirgataṃ vā tadviddhamiti nirdiśet ||11|| (su. ci. a. 2) | viddhalakṣaṇamāha– sūkṣmāsyaśalyetyādi| āśayaṃ vineti uktāmādyāśayaṃ vinā| uttuṇḍitamanirgataśalyopalakṣaṇaṃ, tenānuttuṇḍitamuttuṇḍitaṃ ca viddhaṃ gṛhyate| nirgatena ca nirgatamukhaṃ viddhaṃ sarvathā nirgataṃ ca gṛhyate; tena tantrāntare “viddhamuttuṇḍitamanuttuṇḍitaṃ bhinnaṃ nirbhinnam” iti yaccatuṣprakāramabhihitaṃ tat sarvaṃ saṅgṛhītam||11|| viddhalakṣaṇamāha– sūkṣmetyādi| āśayaṃ vinā sūkṣmāsyena śalyena yadaṅgamabhihatam uttuṇḍitaṃ unnamitatvaṅmāṃsam īṣaddṛṣṭamukhaṃ vā, nirgataṃ nirgataśalyam, uttuṇḍitamanirgataśalyopalakṣaṇam| tenānuttuṇḍitaṃ ca viddhaṃ gṛhyate, nirgatena ca vinirgatamukhaṃ viddhaṃ sarvadā nirgataṃ ca gṛhyate, tena tantrāntare viddhamuttuṇḍitamanuttuṇḍitaṃ bhinnaṃ nirbhinnamiti catuḥprakāramabhihitaṃ tatsaṅgṛhītam||11|| nāticchinnaṃ nātibhinnamubhayorlakṣaṇānvitam | viṣamaṃ vraṇamaṅge yattat kṣataṃ tvabhidhīyate ||12|| (su. ci. a. 2) | kṣatamāha– nāticchinnamityādi| nāticchinnaṃ nāvagāḍhacchedam| nātibhinnamiti nātividīrṇāśayam| ubhayorlakṣaṇānvitamiti stokacchedastokāvadaraṇayogādubhayalakṣaṇayuktam| viṣamaṃ vraṇamaṅge yaditi aṅgavaiṣamyakaraṃ vraṇaṃ yattat kṣatam||12|| kṣatalakṣaṇamāha– netyādi| nāticchinnamiti nāvagāḍhacchinnaṃ, nātibhinnamiti nātividīrṇāśayam| ubhayoriti chinnabhinnayorityarthaḥ| tena stokacchedastokāvadaraṇayogādubhayalakṣaṇayuktam| viṣamaṃ vraṇamaṅge iti aṅge vaiṣamyakaraṃ vraṇaṃ yattatkṣatamiti||12|| prahārapīḍanābhyāṃ tu yadaṅgaṃ pṛthutāṃ gatam | sāsthi tat piccitaṃ vidyānmajjaraktapariplutam ||13|| (su. ci. a. 2) | piccitalakṣaṇamāha– prahāretyādinā| prahāro mudgarādinā, pīḍanaṃ kapāṭādinā| pṛthutāmiti cippiṭatām| majjaraktapariplutamityanena vraṇabhāvāt majjaraktāgamaṃ darśayati| tena yat vraṇaṃ piccitaṃ, tadbhagnasya tathā sadyovraṇasya ca cikitsāviṣayam||13|| piccitalakṣaṇamāha– prahāretyādi| prahāro mudgarādinā, pīḍanaṃ karādinā, pṛthutāṃ vipulatāṃ, sāsthi asthikhaṇḍānvitaṃ, majjaraktapariplutamityanena vraṇabhāvānmajjaraktāgamaṃ darśayati, tena yadvraṇaṃ piccitaṃ tadbhagnasya tathā sadyovraṇasya cikitsāviṣayam||13|| gharṣaṇādabhighātādvā yadaṅgaṃ vigatatvacam | uṣāsrāvānvitaṃ tacca ghṛṣṭamityabhidhīyate ||14|| (su. ci. a. 2) | ghṛṣṭalakṣaṇamāha– gharṣaṇādityādi| gharṣaṇāt karkaśavastrādinā| vigatatvacamiti pāṭhaṃ tyaktvā ‘vigatatvacā’ iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ, vigatatvacopalakṣitamaṅgam| uṣā ūṣmanirgamavadvyathā||14|| ghṛṣṭalakṣaṇamāha– gharṣaṇādityādi| yadaṅgaṃ gharṣaṇāt karṣaṇāt karkaśavastrādinā abhighātādvā vigatatvacaṃ bhavati, anye ‘vigatatvacā’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, vigatatvacā lakṣitamaṅgam| uṣā ūṣmānirgamavadvyathā||14|| śyāvaṃ saśothaṃ piḍakācitaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ śoṇitavāhinaṃ ca | mṛdūdgataṃ budbudatulyamāṃsaṃ vraṇaṃ saśalyaṃ sarujaṃ vadanti ||15|| tvaco'tītya sirādīni bhittvā vā parihṛtya vā | koṣṭhe pratiṣṭhitaṃ śalyaṃ kuryāduktānupadravān ||16|| (su. ci. a. 2) | koṣṭhabhedamāha– tvaca ityādi| tvaca iti sapta tvacaḥ| sirādīnīti māṃsasnāyvasthisandhīni| parihṛtya veti parihārapakṣe'pi koṣṭhabhedasya saṅgatatvāt; sirāvyadhaliṅgaṃ cātraiva ‘surendragopapratimaṃ’ ityādinā vyaktībhaviṣyati| uktāniti pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānīye| tatra hyuktaṃ– “koṣṭhagate tvāṭopānāhau mūtrapurīṣāhāradarśanaṃ ca vraṇamukhādbhavati|” (su. sū. a. 26) iti||15-16|| saśalyavraṇalakṣaṇamāha– śyāvamityādi| śyāvaṃ śāvavarṇam| muhurvāraṃvāraṃ, śoṇitasrāvayuktaṃ, mṛdu komalaṃ, udgataṃ tumbyākārāvasthitabudbudena sadṛśaṃ māṃsaṃ yasya taṃ, sarujaṃ pīḍāyuktam| koṣṭhabhedamāha– tvaca ityādi| sapta tvacaḥ, sirādīni sirāmāṃsasnāyvasthisandhīni bhittvā, parihṛtya veti santyajya vā| uktāniti pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānīye| tatra hyuktaṃ, “koṣṭhagate tvāṭopānāhau mūtrapurīṣāhāradarśanaṃ ca vraṇamukhādbhavati” iti||15-16|| tatrāntarlohitaṃ pāṇḍuśītapādakarānanam | śītocchvāsaṃ raktanetramānaddhaṃ ca vivarjayet ||17|| asādhyakoṣṭhabhedaliṅgamāha– tatretyādi| tatra koṣṭhe| antarlohitamiti abhyantarasthitaraktam, aniḥsṛtaraktamiti yāvat| ānaddhamityānāhavantam||17|| asādhyakoṣṭhāntarbhedaliṅgamāha– tatretyādi| koṣṭhe antarlohitam abhyantarasthitaraktam, aniḥsṛtaraktamiti| pāṇḍūni śītāni pādakarānanāni yasya taṃ, tathā| ānaddhaṃ ānāhayuktam||17|| bhramaḥ pralāpaḥ patanaṃ pramoho viceṣṭanaṃ glānirathoṣṇatā ca | srastāṅgatā mūrchanamūrdhvavātastīvrā rujā vātakṛtāśca tāstāḥ ||18|| māṃsodakābhaṃ rudhiraṃ ca gacchet sarvendriyārthoparamastathaiva | daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣvatha vikṣateṣu sāmānyato marmasu liṅgamuktam ||19|| (su. sū. a. 25) | māṃsasirāsnāyvasthisandhimarmasu pañcasu kṣateṣu sāmānyaliṅgamāha– bhrama ityādi| viceṣṭanaṃ viruddhaceṣṭanaṃ karacaraṇādikṣepādikam| glānirbalakṣayaḥ| srastāṅgatā aṅgasandhivisraṃsavadvyathā| mūrchanamindriyamohaḥ| indriyārthoparama indriyāṇāṃ svaviṣayeṣu rūpādiṣu uparamo grahaṇāśaktiḥ| daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣu pañcasu||18-19|| māṃsasandhisirāsnāyvasthimarmasu pañcasu kṣateṣu sāmānyaliṅgamāha– bhrama ityādi| bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva, patanaṃ bhūmau, pramohaḥ manomohaḥ, viceṣṭanaṃ viruddhaceṣṭanaṃ caraṇakṣepaṇādikaṃ, glāniḥ balakṣayaḥ, srastāṅgatā aṅgasandhivisraṃsavadvyathā, śarīraśaithilyaṃ vā, mūrchanamindriyasammohaḥ, pramohastu manomohaḥ, ūrdhvavāta iti udgārabāhulyaṃ, vātakṛtā rujastāstā daṇḍāpatānakākṣepakādyāḥ| sarvendriyārthoparamaḥ svaviṣayeṣu rūpādiṣu uparamo grahaṇe'śaktiḥ, daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣu pañcasu||18-19|| surendragopapratimaṃ prabhūtaṃ raktaṃ sravettatkṣayajaśca vāyuḥ | karoti rogān vividhān yathoktān sirāsu viddhāsvatha vā kṣatāsu ||20|| kaubjyaṃ śarīrāvayavāvasādaḥ kriyāsvaśaktistumulā rujaśca | cirādvraṇo rohati yasya cāpi taṃ snāyuviddhaṃ puruṣaṃ vyavasyet ||21|| śophābhivṛddhistumulā rujaśca balakṣayaḥ sarvata eva śothaḥ | kṣateṣu sandhiṣvacalācaleṣu syāt sarvakarmoparamaśca liṅgam ||22|| ghorā rujo yasya niśādineṣu sarvāsvavasthāsu ca naiti śāntim | bhiṣagvipaścidviditārthasūtrastamasthividdhaṃ puruṣaṃ vyavasyet ||23|| (su. sū. a. 25) | sirādayo marmarūpā amarmarūpāśca santi, tatra pūrvaṃ marmarahitānāṃ sirādīnāṃ viddhaliṅgamāha– surendragopetyādi| yathoktāniti śoṇitavarṇanīyoktān| tatra coktaṃ– “tadatipravṛttaṃ śirobhitāpamāndhyamākṣepādīṃśca karoti|” iti| viddhāsu bāṇādinā| kṣatāsu khaḍgādinā| kaubjyaṃ kubjatā| tumulā gahanāḥ| sandhiṣvacalācaleṣviti acaleṣu niśceṣṭeṣu, caleṣu ceṣṭāvatsu; sandhayaścalācalabhedena dvividhāḥ| tathāca suśrutaḥ– “śākhāsu hanvoḥ kaṭyāṃ ca ceṣṭāvantaśca sandhayaḥ| śeṣāstu sandhayaḥ sarve vijñātavyāḥ sthirā budhaiḥ||” (su. śā. a. 5) iti||20-23|| sirādayo marmarūpā amarmarūpāśca santi, tatra marmarahitasirādividdhaliṅgamāha– surendretyādi| indragopo vārṣikaḥ kīṭaḥ, tatkṣayajaḥ tasya rudhirasya kṣayājjāto vāyuḥ, yathoktāniti śoṇitavarṇanīyoktān, tathā coktam– “tadatipravṛttaṃ śirobhitāpamāndhyamākṣepakādīṃśca karoti” iti| viddhāsu bāṇādinā, kṣatāsu khaḍgādinā| snāyuviddhamāha– kaubjyamityādi| yasya kaubjyādicihnaṃ bhavati, taṃ puruṣaṃ snāyuviddhaṃ vyavasyet jānīyāt| kaubjyaṃ kubjatā, tacca antarbahirāyāmajaṃ dvidhā, avayavāvasādaḥ avayavānāṃ svakarmaṇyasāmarthyaṃ, kriyāsvaśaktiḥ sarvaśarīrasyotkṣepaṇāpakṣepaṇaprasāraṇākuñcanakriyāṇāmaśaktiḥ| tumulā gahanāḥ, anye tu vātapittakaphajanitā ekatra vyākulībhūtavedanāstumulā ucyante iti vadanti| sandhividdhamāha– śophetyādi| acalācaleṣu sandhiṣu kṣateṣu satsu śophātivṛddhyādiliṅgaṃ syāt| sandhayastu calācalabhedāt dvividhāḥ| tathā coktaṃ suśrute– “śākhāsu hanvoḥ kaṭyāṃ ca ceṣṭāvantaśca sandhayaḥ| śeṣāstu sandhayaḥ sarve vijñātavyāḥ sthirā budhaiḥ” iti| karmoparamaḥ karmoparatiḥ| asthividdhamāha– ghorā ityādi| tamasthividdhaṃ jānīyāt, sarvāsvavasthāsu śayanāsanādikāsu, viditārthasūtraḥ adhigataśalyatantraḥ||20-23|| yathāsvametāni vibhāvayecca liṅgāni marmasvabhitāḍiteṣu |24| (su. sū. a. 25) | marmarahitānāṃ sirādīnāṃ viddhalakṣaṇamabhidhāya sirādimarmaviddhaliṅgamatideśayannāha– yathāsvametānītyādi| vibhāvayecceti cakāro bhinnakrame; tena etāni liṅgāni tathā sāmānyaliṅgāni ca jānīyādityarthaḥ|24|– marmarahitānāṃ sirādīnāṃ viddhaliṅgamabhidhāya sirādimarmaviddhaliṅgamatideśenāha– yathāsvamityādi| vibhāvayecceti cakāro'tra bhinnakrame, tenaitāni marmaviddhasirāliṅgāni tathā sāmānyaliṅgāni bhramapralāpādīni pūrvoktāni ca yathāsvaṃ jānīyādityarthaḥ|24|– pāṇḍurvivarṇaḥ spṛśitaṃ na vetti yo māṃsamarmaṇyabhipīḍitaḥ syāt ||24|| (su. sū. a. 25) | anuktamāṃsamarmaṇo viddhasya liṅgamāha– pāṇḍurvivarṇa ityādi| nanu, sirādividdhaliṅgavat māṃsaviddhaliṅgamapi pūrvaṃ kuto nopadiṣṭam? ucyate– kevalamāṃsaviddhasyābahuvyāpatkaratvāt pūrvamanupādānam||24|| māṃsamarmaviddhaliṅgamāha– pāṇḍurityādi| vivarṇo vicchāyaḥ| nanu, sirādividdhaliṅgavanmāṃsaviddhaliṅgamapi pūrvaṃ kuto nopadiṣṭaṃ? ucyate– kevalamāṃsaviddhasyābahuvyāpatkaratvāt pūrvamanupādānam||24|| visarpaḥ pakṣaghātaśca sirāstambho'patānakaḥ | mohonmādavraṇarujo jvarastṛṣṇā hanugrahaḥ ||25|| kāsaśchardiratīsāro hikkā śvāsaḥ savepathuḥ | ṣoḍaśopadravāḥ proktā vraṇānāṃ vraṇacintakaiḥ ||26|| (ca. ci. a. 25) | sarvavraṇānāmupadravānāha– visarpa ityādi||25-26|| sarvavraṇānāmupadravānāha– visarpa ityādi| vraṇarujo vraṇapīḍāḥ, vepathuḥ kampaḥ||25-26|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne sadyovraṇanidānaṃ samāptam ||43|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ sadyovraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||43|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ sadyovraṇanidānam||43|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘atra pātanaṃ nirdiśannāha-’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate| ↩ 2 . ‘śaktikunteṣu’ iti pā. ↩ 3 . ‘pakvasya’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘sthānabhedavyapadeśastamāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘phusphusa’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘yaccatuḥprakāramabhihitaṃ’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘nāticchinnamiti’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘prahāretyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate| ↩ 9 . ‘ūṣmānirgamavadvyathā’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . ‘śirādīni’ iti pā. ↩ 11 . ‘śirādīnīti’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘śirāvyadhaliṅgaṃ’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘śalyavraṇalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 14 . ‘śirāmāṃsasnāyvasthisandhīni’ iti pā.| ↩ 15 . ‘māṃsasandhiśirāsnāyvasthimarmasu’ iti pā.| ↩ 16 . ‘sravettatkṣatajaśca’ iti pā. ↩ 17 . ‘yathoktāñchirāsu’ iti pā. ↩ 18 . ‘śoṣābhivṛddhistumulā’ iti pā. ↩ 19 . ‘śirādayo’ iti pā.| ↩ 20 . ‘śirādīnāṃ’ iti pā.| ↩ 21 . ‘ācaleṣu’ iti pā.| ↩ 22 . ‘śirādayo’ iti pā.| ↩ 23 . ‘marmarahitaśirādividdhaliṅgamāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 24 . ‘tatkṣatajaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 25 . ‘upaśayanāsanādikāsu’ iti pā.| ↩ 26 . ‘śirādīnāṃ’ iti pā.| ↩ 27 . ‘śirādimarmaviddhaliṅgamatideśayannāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 28 . ‘śirādīnāṃ’ iti pā.| ↩ 29 . ‘śirādimarmaliṅgamatideśenāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 30 . ‘marmaviddhaśirāliṅgāni’ iti pā.| ↩ 31 . ‘śirādividdhaliṅgavat’ iti pā.| ↩ 32 . ‘śirādividdhaliṅgavanmāṃsaviddhaliṅgamapi’ iti pā.| ↩ 33 . ‘śirāstambho'patānakaḥ’ iti pā. ↩ 34 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ sadyovraṇanidānam||43||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 44. bhagnanidānam
text: atha bhagnanidānam | bhagnaṃ samāsāddvividhaṃ hutāśa kāṇḍe ca sandhau ca hi tatra sandhau | utpiṣṭaviśliṣṭavivartitaṃ ca tiryaggataṃ kṣiptamadhaśca ṣaṭ ca ||1|| āgantusāmānyāt bhagnanidānam| dvividhaṃ hi bhagnaṃ savraṇamavraṇaṃ ca, tatra savraṇamabhidhāyāvraṇamāha– bhagnaṃ samāsādityādi| hutāśa iti agniveśasambodhanaṃ, carake hutāśaśabdenāgniveśo'bhidhīyate, ekadeśenāpi samudāyapratīteḥ| kāṇḍe ca sandhau ceti sandhivicchinnamekaṃ, dvitīyaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ; kāṇḍamasthikāṇḍaḥ, kāṇḍena ca nalakakapālavalayataruṇarucakānāṃ grahaḥ, tatra bhagnaṃ kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ; dvayorasthnoḥ, sandhānaṃ sandhiḥ, tadviśleṣaḥ sandhimuktam| tatra sandhāviti sandhau mukte ‘liṅgamabhidhīyate’ iti śeṣaḥ| nanu kathaṃ sandhimuktaṃ bhagnamucyate? asthnāṃ hi bhaṅgo yuktaḥ| ucyate– asthiviśleṣo'tra bhagno'bhipretaḥ, sa ca kāṇḍabhagne sandhimukte cāstīti na doṣaḥ||1|| āgantutvasāmānyādbhagnamāha– bhagnamityādi| taṃ cāgantuvraṇaṃ samāsāt dvividhamāhuḥ, kathamityāha– kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ tathā sandhau ceti; sandhivicchinnamekaṃ, kāṇḍamasthikāṇḍaḥ, kāṇḍena ca nalakakapālavalayataruṇarucakānāṃ grahaṇaṃ, tatra bhagnaṃ kāṇḍe bhagnam| dvayorasthnoḥ sandhānaṃ sandhiḥ, tadviśleṣaḥ sandhimuktam| sandhimuktasya ṣāḍvidhyamāha– utpiṣṭetyādi| tatra sandhāviti tatra tayoḥ kāṇḍabhagnasandhibhagnayormadhye, sandhau mukte'pi ‘liṅgamabhidhīyata’ iti śeṣaḥ| utpiṣṭādibhedena ṣoḍhā bhavati| nanu, kathaṃ sandhimuktaṃ bhagnamucyate? asthnāṃ bhaṅgo yuktaḥ; ucyate asthiviśleṣo'tra bhagno'bhipretaḥ, sa ca kāṇḍabhagne sandhimukte cāstīti na doṣaḥ||1|| prasāraṇākuñcanavartanogrā ruk sparśavidveṣaṇametaduktam | sāmānyataḥ sandhigatasya liṅgam... |2| sandhibhagnasya sāmānyaliṅgamāha– prasāraṇetyādi| prasāraṇākuñcanavartanogrā rugiti prasāraṇādiṣu ugrā ruk| vartanaṃ niṣkriyatayā'vasthānam|1|– tatra sandhimuktasya sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha– prasāraṇetyādi| prasāraṇādiṣu ugrā ruk vyathā, vartanamiti niṣkriyatayā'vasthānam| etatsāmānyaliṅgam|1|– ...utpiṣṭasandheḥ śvayathuḥ samantāt ||2|| viśeṣato rātribhavā rujā ca, viśliṣṭaje tau ca rujā ca nityam | vivartite pārśvarujaśca tīvrāstiryaggate tīvrarujo bhavanti ||3|| kṣipte'tiśūlaṃ viṣamatvamasthnoḥ kṣipte tvadho rugvighaṭaśca sandheḥ | utpiṣṭādiliṅgamāha– utpiṣṭasandherityādi| utpiṣṭaṃ dvābhyāmasthibhyāṃ sandhau gharṣaṇam| śvayathuḥ samantāditi ubhayabhāge śothaḥ, ubhayataḥ sandhyasthnorgharṣitatvāt| viśeṣato rātribhavā rujā ceti abhighātakupita eva rātrau śaityenātyantaṃ vṛddho vāyuḥ rujāṃ karoti| atra cūrṇitatvena mārgāvaraṇāt vātakopa ityarthaḥ| viśliṣṭaje iti viśliṣṭajāte sandhimukte, viśliṣṭaṃ manāk sandhiviśleṣaḥ śithilatāmātraṃ, viśliṣṭamiti bhāve ktaḥ| tau ceti viśliṣṭe rātrirujāsamantācchothau; samantācchotho'pyatrālpo bodhyaḥ, sandheranabhighātāt| sandhivikriyayā asthnorapasṛtatvāt madhyanimnatvaṃ, “utpiṣṭamatha viśliṣṭaṃ sandhiṃ vaidyo na ghaṭṭayet|” (su. ci. a. 2) iti vacanāt; manāgvikriyayā vā| rujā ca nityamiti sarvadā rujā balavatī bhavatītyutpiṣṭādviśeṣaḥ| vivartite iti ‘sandhau’ iti śeṣaḥ, vivartite viparītaṃ vartite; vivartanaṃ sandhau dvayorasthnorvivṛtirvibhramaṇamanārjavatā| pārśvarujaśca tīvrā iti ābhyantarasandhisthānayoḥ pārśvasandhyasthnoḥ pārśvagamanāttīvrāḥ pārśvarujaḥ| tiryaggata iti tiryakkṣipte| atra hyekaṃ sandhyasthi sandhisthānaṃ tyaktvā tiryagyāti| kṣipte'tīti atikṣipte; ‘ūrdhvam’ iti śeṣaḥ| atra hyekāsthivikriyayā ubhayāsthivikriyayā vā dvayorapyasthnoḥ parasparātikramaṇaṃ dūragamanaṃ vā; viśliṣṭe tu manāk śithilatāmātram; adhaḥkṣipte tu kiñcidadhogamanamiti viśeṣaḥ| “viṣamāśca sakthnoḥ” iti pāṭhe tu ‘ruja’ iti śeṣaḥ| kṣipte tvadhorugvighaṭaśca sandheriti adhaḥkṣipte ruk rujā, sandhervighaṭaśca vighaṭanam| ‘viruddhaceṣṭā vighaṭasya’ iti pāṭhāntare vighaṭitasya sandherityarthaḥ| atra adho'sthigamanam| adhaḥ kṣiptavadūrdhvaṃ kṣiptasyāpyabhidhāne prāpte anuktiratikṣipte'varodhāt||2-3||– viśiṣṭaliṅgamāha– utpiṣṭasandherityādi| utpiṣṭaṃ dvābhyāmasthibhyāṃ sandhau gharṣaṇaṃ, śvayathuḥ samantāditi ubhayabhāge śophaḥ, ubhayataḥ sandhyasthnorgharṣaṇāt| viśeṣata ityādyabhighātakupita eva rātrau śaityenātyantaṃ vṛddho vāyuḥ rujaṃ karoti, atra cūrṇitatvena mārgāvaraṇādvātaprakopa ityarthaḥ| viśliṣṭamāha– viśliṣṭaja ityādi| viśliṣṭe sandhimukte tau ca nityaṃ ca rujā ca bhavati| viśliṣṭaṃ manāksandhiviśleṣaḥ, śithilatāmātraṃ; viśliṣṭamiti bhāve ktaḥ| tenālpaḥ śopho boddhavyaḥ| tau ceti rātrirujāsamantācchothau, samantācchotho'pyatrālpo bodhyaḥ, sandheranabhighātāt| sandhivikriyayā asthnorapasṛtatvānmadhyanimnatvam| “utpiṣṭamatha viśliṣṭaṃ sandhimuktaṃ tathā cyutam| jaghanaṃ pratipiṣṭaṃ ca bhagnaṃ yattadvivarjayet||” iti| manāk vikriyayā vā| rujā ca nityamiti sarvadā rujā balavatī bhavatītyutpiṣṭādviśeṣaḥ| vivartitamiti, sandhāviti śeṣaḥ| vivartite viparītaṃ vartite, vivartanaṃ sandhau dvayorasthnorvivṛtirvibhramaṇamanārjavatā| pārśve rujāśca tīvrāḥ santi, atyantasandhisthānayoḥ pārśvasandhyasthnoḥ pārśvagatatvāttīvrāḥ pārśvarujaḥ, cakārāt sandhisaṃśrayayorapyasthnorvyāvartanena pārśvopagamanādviṣamāṅgateti ḍallaṇaḥ| tiryagityādi– tiryak kṣipte, sandhāviti śeṣaḥ| atra hyekasandhyasthi sandhisthānaṃ tyaktvā tiryagyāti| atikṣiptamāha– kṣipta ityādi| kṣipte ūrdhvamiti śeṣaḥ| atra tu dvayorapi asthnoḥ parasparātikramaṇaṃ, dūragamanaṃ vā, viśliṣṭe tu manāk śithilatāmātramiti bhedaḥ| adhaḥkṣipte tu kiñcidadhogamanamiti viśeṣaḥ| sakthnorūrukaṭisandhyorviṣamamiti| śūlaṃ viṣamamiti kadāciddhīnaṃ kadācidvivṛddham| ‘viṣamāśca sakthnoḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram| tatra rujā iti śeṣaḥ| adhaḥkṣiptamāha– kṣipte tvityādi| adhaḥkṣipte'dhogate sandhau ruk rujā, sandhervighaṭaśca, vighaṭo vighaṭanam| ‘viruddhaceṣṭā vighaṭasya’ iti pāṭhāntare vighaṭitasya sandherityarthaḥ| atrādho'sthigamanam| adhaḥkṣiptavadūrdhvakṣiptasyāpyabhidhāne prāpte'nuktiratikṣipte'varodhāt||2-3||– kāṇḍe tvataḥ karkaṭakāśvakarṇavicūrṇitaṃ piccitamasthichallikā ||4|| kāṇḍeṣu bhagnaṃ hyatipātitaṃ ca majjāgataṃ ca sphuṭitaṃ ca vakram | chinnaṃ dvidhā dvādaśadhā'pi kāṇḍe srastāṅgatā śotharujātivṛddhiḥ ||5|| sampīḍyamāne bhavatīha śabdaḥ sparśāsahaṃ spandanatodaśūlāḥ | sarvāsvavasthāsu na śarmalābho bhagnasya kāṇḍe khalu cihnametat ||6|| ataḥ paraṃ kāṇḍe bhagnamabhidhīyate– kāṇḍe tvata ityādi| kāṇḍe ityatra bhagnamiti śeṣaḥ| ata iti ataḥ param| karkaṭaketi ubhayoḥ pārśvayornipīḍanenāvanatam, ata eva madhye granthirivonnataṃ karkaṭatulyatvāt karkaṭakam| aśvakarṇeti aśvakarṇavat vipulāsthinirgamādaśvakarṇam| vicūrṇitamiti kṣuṇṇamasthi, tacca śabdasparśābhyāmavagantavyam| piccitamiti yantritaṃ bahuśotham| asthichalliketi challaṃ valkalaṃ tadatrāstīti asthichallikā, atra matvarthīyaṣṭhikan| atra tu ā na bhavati, vṛddheranityatvāt| eṣā pārśvagatastokāsthiviśleṣādbhavati| ‘asthichallitam’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ, challamasya sañjātamiti challitam| kāṇḍeṣu bhagnamityanena kāṇḍabhagnamabhidhīyate, prasāraṇe kampamānaṃ kāṇḍabhagnam| yadyapi kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ sarvameva karkaṭādi, tathā'pi viśiṣṭe kāṇḍabhagne kāṇḍabhagnasañjñeyaṃ boddhavyā| yathā– jāṅgalaśabdo jaṅghālādyaṣṭavidhamāṃsavarge sāmānye, viśeṣe punareṇādāveva ca vartate| atipātitamiti asthiniḥśeṣataśchinnamatipātitam| majjāgatamiti asthyavayavo'sthimadhyamanupraviśya majjānaṃ niḥsārayatīti majjāgatam| sphuṭitaṃ stokaṃ bahudhā vidīrṇaṃ śūkapūrṇamiva vedanāvat| vakramiti avimuktāsthi kubjībhūtaṃ vakram| vakratā'pi bhagnatvaṃ jñeyam| chinnaṃ dvidheti ekamaṇuvidīrṇaṃ, bahuvidīrṇamanyat; ekaṃ vidīrṇaṃ, saṃlagnamaparaṃ vidīrṇaṃ dvidhābhūtam; anyastu vipulaikavidaraṇamityāha; suśrute etat pāṭitasañjñam| kāṇḍe bhagnasya dvādaśavidhatvaṃ niyamayati– kāṇḍa iti| atra bhagnamiti śeṣaḥ| apiśabdo'tra bhinnakramaḥ, sa cāvadhāraṇārthaṃ, tena chinnamityatra sambadhyate| chinnameva dvidhā, na karkaṭādi||4-6|| ataḥ paraṃ kāṇḍe bhagnamāha– kāṇḍe tvityādi| chinnaṃ dvidhā kāṇḍe ityatra bhagnam iti śeṣaḥ| ata iti ataḥ param| karkaṭaketi ubhayoḥ pārśvayoḥ nipīḍanenāvanatam, ata eva madhye granthirivonnataṃ karkaṭatulyatvātkarkaṭakam| aśvakarṇeti aśvakarṇavadvipulāsthinirgamādaśvakarṇam| vicūrṇitamiti kṣuṇṇamasthi, tacca śabdasparśābhyāmavagantavyam| piccitamiti yantritaṃ bahuśotham| asthicchalliketi– challaṃ valkalaṃ, tadatrāstīti asthicchallikā, eṣā pārśvagatastokāsthyavayavaviśleṣādbhavati| “asthicchallitam” iti vā pāṭhaḥ| challamasya jātaṃ challitam| kāṇḍeṣu bhagnamityādi| anena kāṇḍabhagnamityabhidhīyate| prasāraṇe kampamānaṃ kāṇḍabhagnam| yadyapi kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ sarvameva karkaṭakādi, tathā'pi viśiṣṭe kāṇḍe bhagne sañjñeyaṃ boddhavyā| atipātitamiti asthi niḥśeṣataśchinnamatipātitam| majjāgatamiti asthyavayavo'sthimadhyamanupraviśya majjānaṃ niḥsārayatīti majjāgatam| sphuṭitaṃ stokaṃ bahudhā vidīrṇaṃ śūkapūrṇamiva vedanāvat| vakramiti avimuktāsthi kubjībhūtaṃ vakraṃ, vakratā'pi bhagnatvaṃ jñeyam| chinnaṃ dvidheti ekamaṇuvidīrṇaṃ, bahuvidīrṇamanyat| kaścidekatarapārśvalagnamaparatra vidīrṇamityāha, anyaśca vipulaikavidaraṇam, etacca suśrute pāṭitasañjñam| kāṇḍe bhagnasya dvādaśavidhatvaṃ niyamayati– dvādaśadhā'pi kāṇḍa iti kāṇḍe; ityatra bhagnamiti śeṣaḥ| apiśabdo'tra bhinnakramaḥ, sa cāvadhāraṇārthaḥ, tena chinnamityatra sambadhyate, chinnameva dvidhā na karkaṭakādi| sāmānyena kāṇḍabhagnalakṣaṇamāha– srastāṅgatetyādi| kāṇḍe bhagnasyaitaccihnaṃ srastāṅgatā śopharujayorativṛddhiḥ| sampīḍyamāne hastādinā mṛdite sati śabdaḥ, sparśāsahaśca, tathā spandanatodaśūlā bhavanti| sarvāsu śayanāsanādikāsvavasthāsu śarmalābho na bhavati||4-6||– bhagnaṃ tu kāṇḍe bahudhā prayāti samāsato nāmabhireva tulyam ||7|| kāṇḍe bhagnasya dvādaśaprakārādapyadhikatvamāha– bhagnamityādi| samāsato nāmabhireva tulyamiti saṅkṣepato nāmānurūpametadavagantavyamityarthaḥ||7|| kāṇḍe bhagnasya dvādaśaprakārādapyadhikatvamāha– bhagnamityādi| saṅkṣepato nāmānurūpametadevāvagantavyaṃ, yasyedṛśāsthi bhagnaṃ tasyaiva nāmetyarthaḥ||7|| alpāśino'nātmavato jantorvātātmakasya ca | upadravairvā juṣṭasya bhagnaṃ kṛcchreṇa sidhyati ||8|| (su. ci. a. 3) | kaṣṭasādhyatāmāha– alpetyādi| vātātmakasyeti vātaprakṛteḥ| upadravairiti upadravā jvarādhmānamūtrapurīṣasaṅgādayaḥ||8|| bhagnasya kṛcchrasādhyatvamāha– alpāśina iti| āhārarahitasya, anātmavato'pathyāśinaḥ, vātātmakasya vātaprakṛteḥ| upadravairityādi upadravā jvaramohamūtrapurīṣasaṅgādayaḥ||8|| bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyāṃ tu sandhimuktaṃ tathā cyutam | jaghanaṃ pratipiṣṭaṃ ca varjayeddhi vicakṣaṇaḥ ||9|| asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ca lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yat | bhagnaṃ stanāntare pṛṣṭhe śaṅkhe mūrdhni ca varjayet ||10|| (su. ni. a. 15) | asādhyatāmāha– bhinnaṃ kapālamityādi| bhagnamiti vācye bhinnamiti yat kṛtaṃ, tat kapālānāṃ prāyaśo bhedāt| ata evoktam– “kapālāni vibhajyante” (su. śā. a. 5) iti| nanu, kaṭyasthnaḥ kapālasañjñāyā abhāvāt kathamucyate bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyāmiti? taduktaṃ suśrute– “jānunitambāṃsagaṇḍatāluśaṅkhavaṅkṣaṇaśiraḥsu kapālāni|” (su. śā. a. 5) iti; ucyate– nitambagrahaṇena tatra kaṭīgrahaṇādadoṣaḥ; athavā sarvaṃ kapālasañjñitam asthibhinnaṃ, tathā kaṭyāṃ cāsthibhinnaṃ varjayet| asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ceti tu niyamārthaṃ; tena lalāṭe kapālasyāsaṃśliṣṭasyāsādhyatvaṃ, nānyathā bhinnasyeti| bhinnaṃ kapālamiti kāṇḍabhagnametat| sandhimuktamiti nānāvidhamapi sandhimuktaṃ kaṭyāṃ na sidhyatīti| cyutamiti adhaḥkṣiptam, anyastu viśliṣṭamāha; athavā kaṭyāṃ sandhimuktaṃ cyutalakṣaṇaṃ na sarvam| jaghanaṃ pratipiṣṭaṃ ceti jaghanasthāne piṣṭamutpiṣṭametattathā cyutamiti ca| sandhimuktaṃ punarviśeṣārthamuktaṃ, viśeṣābhidhānādanyasya kaṭīsandhimuktasya kadācit sādhyatā sūcyate, ata eva cikitsite “tataḥ sthānasthite sandhau” (su. ci. a. 3) iti vakṣyati| asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ca lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yaditi yathā avidyamānasaṃśleṣaṃ yat kapālaṃ, tathā lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yat vighaṭitasandhi tadasādhyam| bhagnamiti sāmānyena sandhimuktaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ ca gṛhyate| anye tu bhagnamityanena kāṇḍabhagnaviśeṣaṃ ‘prasāraṇe kampamānam’ ityanenoktaṃ vadanti| uktaṃ ca bhālukinā– “śaṅkhe mūrdhni stanāntare vā kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ maraṇāya|” iti| stanāntare urasi, mūrdhni cūḍāsthāne||9-10|| asādhyatāmāha– bhinnamityādi| bhagnamiti vācye bhinnamiti yatkṛtaṃ, tatkapālānāṃ prāyaśo bhedāt| yaduktamihaiva– ‘kapālāni vibhidyante’ ityādi| nanu, kaṭyasthnaḥ kapālasañjñāyā abhāvāt kathamucyate bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyāmiti? yaduktaṃ suśrute– “jānunitambāṃsagaṇḍatāluśaṅkhavaṅkṣaṇaśirassu kapālāni” iti| ucyate– nitambagrahaṇena tatra kaṭīgrahaṇādadoṣaḥ, athavā sarvaṃ kapālasañjñitamasthibhinnaṃ, chedāttathā kaṭyāṃ cāsthibhinnaṃ ca varjayet| sandhimuktamityādi nānāvidhamapi sandhimuktaṃ kaṭyāṃ na siddhyati| tathā kaṭyāṃ cyutamiti adhaḥkṣiptaṃ, sañjñeyam| piṣṭamutpiṣṭamasañjñaṃ ca, jaghanaṃ prati lakṣīkṛtaṃ na siddhyati| punarvarjyaṃ bhagnamāha– asaṃśliṣṭamityādi| yathā tathā avidyamānasaṃśleṣaṃ yat kapālaṃ tathā lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ yat vighaṭitasandhi tadasādhyam| bhagnamiti sāmānyena sandhimuktaṃ kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ ca gṛhyate, anye tu bhagnamiti kāṇḍe bhagnamāhuḥ| yaduktaṃ bhālukinā– “śaṅkhe mūrdhni stanāntare vā kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ maraṇāya|” iti| stanāntare urasi, stanagrahaṇena stanāntaraṃ boddhavyam||9-10|| samyak sandhitamapyasthi durnikṣepanibandhanāt | saṅkṣobhādvā'pi yadgacchedvikriyāṃ tacca varjayet ||11|| (su. ni. a. 15) | sarveṣāmanavadhānato'sādhyatvamāha– samyagityādi| sandhitaṃ saṃyamitam| durnikṣepanibandhanāditi duḥsthāpanāttathā duṣṭabandhanāt| saṅkṣobhādveti abhighātabhayādisaṅkṣobhāt| ayamarthaḥ– samyaksaṃyamitamapi duḥsthāpanāt, sunyastamapi duṣṭabandhanāt, sunyastaṃ subaddhamapi saṅkṣobhādvikṛtamasādhyam||11|| sarveṣāmanavadhānato'sādhyatvamāha– samyagityādi| durnikṣepanibandhanāt duḥsthāpanāt tathā duṣṭabandhanāt| saṅkṣobhādveti abhighātabhayādisaṅkṣobhāt| ayamarthaḥ– samyaksaṃyamitamapi duṣṭabandhanāttathā sunyastaṃ subaddhamapi saṅkṣobhāt vikṛtamasādhyam||11|| taruṇāsthīni namyante bhidyante nalakāni ca | kapālāni vibhajyante sphuṭanti rucakāni ca ||12|| (su. ni. a. 15) | asthiviśeṣeṇa bhagnaviśeṣamāha– taruṇāsthīnītyādi| namyante vakrībhavanti, tenātra vakralakṣaṇaṃ bhagnam| ghrāṇakarṇākṣipuṭeṣu taruṇaṃ komalamasthi| bhidyante nalakāni ceti asthyantarānupraveśādbhidyante, atipātitalakṣaṇena ca bhagnena nalakāni yujyante; anye tu dvādaśavidhamapi bhagnamatrecchanti| kapālāni vibhajyanta iti kapāleṣu vidaraṇalakṣaṇo bhagnaḥ| ‘vibhidyante’ iti pāṭhāntaram, arthastu sa eva| rucakāni dantāḥ, teṣu sphuṭitalakṣaṇo bhagnaḥ| asthīni pañcavidhāni taruṇanalakakapālavalayarucakabhedāt| rucakāni ceti cakārāt valayānyapi sphuṭitāni bhavantīti| etat suśrute sphuṭitaṃ bhagnam||12|| asthiviśeṣeṇa bhagnaviśeṣamāha– taruṇetyādi| ghrāṇakarṇākṣikūṭeṣu taruṇāsthīni komalāsthīni, namyante vakrībhavanti| atra vakralakṣaṇaṃ bhagnam| bhidyante nalakānītyādi| asthyantarānupraveśādbhidyante, atipātitalakṣaṇena ca bhagnena nalakāni yujyante| anye tu dvādaśavidhamapi bhagnamātramicchanti| kapāleṣu vidaraṇalakṣaṇo bhagnaḥ| rucakāni dantāḥ, teṣu sphuṭitalakṣaṇo bhaṅgaḥ| asthīni pañcavidhāni, taruṇanalakakapālavalayarucakabhedāt| cakārād valayānyapi sphuṭantīti jñeyam| etacca suśrute sphuṭitaṃ bhagnam||12|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne bhagnanidānaṃ samāptam ||44|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ bhagnanidānaṃ samāptam||44|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ bhagnanidānam||44|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘ṣoḍhā’ iti pā. | ↩ 2 . sampratyupalabhyamāne carakatantre bhagnanidānaṃ na paṭhyate| ↩ 3 . ‘dvitīyaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ;’ iti pā. kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 4 . ‘grahaṇam’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘viṣamā rugasthnoḥ’ iti pā. | ↩ 6 . ‘rātrighūrṇitatvena’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘vighaṭṭayet’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘ ... rvibhramaṇamārjavatā’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘atyaktasandhisthānayoḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . ‘pārśvagatatvāttīvrāḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘sandhyasthnorgharṣaṇatvāt|’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 13 . ‘viśliṣṭarātrirujāsamantācchothau’ iti pā.| ↩ 14 . ‘saghanam’ iti pā.| ↩ 15 . ‘śakthnoḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 16 . ayaṃ paṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 17 . ‘śūlaviṣamamiti’ iti pā.| ↩ 18 . atra ‘tatra’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 19 . ‘prāpte'nuktamapi ūrdhvakṣiptābhidhānam’ iti pā.| ↩ 20 . ‘matvarthīyaṣṭikaṇ’ iti pā.| ↩ 21 . ‘pārśvagatastokāsthyavayavaviśleṣādbhavati’ iti pā.| ↩ 22 . ‘jātam’ iti pā.| ↩ 23 . ‘kāṇḍabhagnam’ iti pā.| ↩ 24 . ‘bileśayādau’ iti pā. ‘jāṅgalādyaṣṭavidhamāṃsavarge’ iti vā pā.| ↩ 25 . ‘sāmānye'pi ṣaḍvidhamāṃsavarge bileśayādau, punareṇādāveva viśeṣe ca vartate|’ iti pā.| ↩ 26 . ‘asthiniḥśeṣitacchinna ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 27 . ‘bahudhā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 28 . ‘ekatarapārśvalagnamekam’ iti pā.| ↩ 29 . ‘pārśvagatastokāsthyavayavaviśeṣādbhavati’ iti pā.| ↩ 30 . ‘asthiniḥśeṣitacchinnamatipātitam’ iti pā.| ↩ 31 . ‘sphuṭitastokam’ iti pā.| ↩ 32 . ‘kubjībhūtavakram’ iti pā.| ↩ 33 . ‘anyacca’ iti pā.| ↩ 34 . ‘kāṇḍabhagnasya etaccihnam’ iti pā.| ↩ 35 . ‘bhagnakṛcchramāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 36 . ‘yaduktam’ iti pā.| ↩ 37 . ‘kaṭyasthikapālasañjñāyā’ iti pā.| ↩ 38 . ‘prati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 39 . ‘adhastanāntare’ iti pā.| ↩ 40 . ‘subandhamapi’ iti pā.| ↩ 41 . ‘tathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 42 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ bhagnanidānam||44||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 45. nāḍīvraṇanidānam
text: atha nāḍīvraṇanidānam | yaḥ śothamāmamatipakvamupekṣate'jño yo vā vraṇaṃ pracurapūyamasādhuvṛttaḥ | abhyantaraṃ praviśati pravidārya tasya sthānāni pūrvavihitāni tataḥ sapūyaḥ ||1|| (su. ni. a. 10) | bhagnasyāpi vraṇasyopekṣayā nāḍī bhavati, ato'nantaraṃ nāḍīmāha– yaḥ śothamityādi| upekṣata iti pīḍanaśodhanādikaṃ na karoti| pracurapūya ityanena gambhīrapākitvamuktam| asādhuvṛttaḥ ahitāhārācāraḥ| sthānāni pūrvavihitānīti vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyoktāni tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyusandhyasthikoṣṭhamarmāṇi||1|| bhagnasyāpi vraṇasyopekṣayā nāḍīsambhavāttadanantaraṃ nāḍīmāha– ya ityādi| yo'pakvaṃ śophamāmamityupekṣate pīḍanaśodhanādīni na karoti, athavā yaḥ yuruṣaḥ pracurapūyaṃ vraṇamupekṣate iti sambandhaḥ| pracurapūyamityanena gambhīrapākitvaṃ darśayati| asādhuvṛttaḥ ahitāhārācāraḥ| sapūyaḥ tasya pūrvoktāni vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyoktāni tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyusandhyasthikoṣṭhamarmāṇi sthānāni vidāryāntaḥ praviśati||1|| tasyātimātragamanādgatiriṣyate tu nāḍīva yadvahati tena matā tu nāḍī |2| (su. ni. a. 10) | tasyeti pūyasya| nāḍīveti antaḥśuṣiralatādināḍīvat|2|– tasyetyādi| pūyasyātimātragamanādgatiriṣyate, iṣyate ceti caśabdo nāḍīniruktipakṣāntarasamuccaye, tāmeva nāḍīniruktimāha– nāḍītyādi| yena hetunā nāḍīva praṇālīva yadvahati, tena hetunā nāḍī matetyarthaḥ| antaḥśuṣiranālā nāḍī|2|– doṣaistribhirbhavati sā pṛthagekaśaśca sammūrchitairapi ca śalyanimittato'nyā ||2|| (su. ni. a. 10) | tāsāṃ kālāntarasambhavena doṣānubandhena saṅkhyāmāha– doṣaistribhirityādi| doṣaiḥ pṛthak tisraḥ| ekaśaśca sammūrchitairiti pratyekaṃ vṛddhyā miśrībhūtaistribhiścaturthī; kārtikastu sannipatitairityadhyāhārya ekaśaśca sannipatitairanyā| sammūrchitaiḥ saṃśliṣṭairaparāstisraḥ| ata evoktaṃ suśrute– “doṣadvayābhihitalakṣaṇadarśanena tisro gatīrvyatikaraprabhavāstu vidyāt|” (su. ni. a. 10) iti| vyatikaraprabhavā dvandvaprabhavāḥ; api cakārau sārthakāvityāhuḥ| na coktapañcasaṅkhyāhāniḥ, asmin pakṣe'tideśenoktayordvandvasannipātayoḥ sarvatrāgaṇanāt| śalyanimittato'nyeti āganturaparetyarthaḥ| iti pañca nāḍyaḥ||2|| tāsāṃ kālāntarasambhavena doṣānubandhena saṅkhyāmāha– doṣairityādi| tribhirdoṣaistisraḥ, śalyanimittato'nyeti āganturityarthaḥ| evaṃ pañca nāḍyaḥ||2|| tatrānilāt paruṣasūkṣmamukhī saśūlā phenānuviddhamadhikaṃ sravati kṣapāsu |3| (su. ni. a. 10) | vātajāmāha– tatretyādi| adhikaṃ sravati kṣapāsviti śaityena vātavṛddhe rātrāvadhikaṃ sravaṇam|3|– tatra vātajāmāha– tatretyādi| paruṣaṃ karkaśaṃ sūkṣmaṃ mukhaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathā, śaityena vātavṛddhirato rātrāvadhikaṃ sravati|3|– pittāttṛṣājvarakarī paridāhayuktā pītaṃ sravatyadhikamuṣṇamahaḥsu cāpi ||3|| (su. ni. a. 10) | pittajāmāha– pittādityādi| adhikamuṣṇamahaḥsu ceti divā auṣṇyena pittakopāt||3|| pittajāmāha– pittādityādi| paridāhaḥ samantāddāhaḥ, adhikamuṣṇam, ahaḥsviti divaseṣu, auṣṇyena pittaprakopāt||3|| jñeyā kaphādbahughanārjunapicchilāsrā stabdhā sakaṇḍurarujā rajanīpravṛddhā |4| (su. ni. a. 10) | kaphajāmāha– jñeyetyādi| bahughanārjunapicchilāsrā iti atrārjunaḥ śvetaḥ, ghanaḥ sāndraḥ, āsraśabda āsrāvaśabdaikadeśapāṭhaḥ, pade'pi padaikadeśaprayogāt| yathā “je proṣṭhapadānām” ityatra je ityanenaiva jāta ityucyate| picchilāsruriti pāṭhe'pyayamevārthaḥ| āsruśabdaḥ sampadādiṣu pāṭhāt kvibantaḥ, tugabhāvastvāgamānityatvāt|4|– śleṣmajāmāha– jñeyā ityādi| bahuradhikaḥ, ghanaḥ sāndraḥ, arjunaḥ śvetaḥ, picchilaḥ āsraḥ āsrāvo yasyāṃ sā tathā| āsraśabdena āsrāva ucyate| anye ‘picchilāsruḥ’ iti paṭhanti| atrāpyayamevārthaḥ| āsruśabdaḥ sampadāditvātkvibantaḥ, tugabhāvastvāgamānityatvāt| rajanīpravṛddheti śaityena śleṣmaṇaḥ prakopāt|4|– dāhajvaraśvasanamūrchanavaktraśoṣā yasyāṃ bhavantyabhihitāni ca lakṣaṇāni ||4|| tāmādiśet pavanapittakaphaprakopādghorāmasukṣayakarīmiva kālārātrim | (su. ni. a. 10) | tridoṣajāmāha– dāhetyādi| abhihitānīti pratyekaṃ vātādijanāḍīkathitāni| asukṣayakarīmiti māraṇātmikāṃ, kālarātriṃ maraṇakāriṇīṃ yamabhaginīmiva| ‘gatiṃ tvasuharām’ iti pāṭhāntaram||4||– tridoṣajāmāha– dāhetyādi| abhihitānīti pūrvoktadoṣatrayalakṣaṇāni asukṣayakarīmiti māraṇātmikām| kālarātrimiveti mṛtyurūpāmiva||4||– naṣṭaṃ kathañcidanumārgamudīriteṣu sthāneṣu śalyamacireṇa gatiṃ karoti ||5|| sā phenilaṃ mathitamuṣṇamasṛgvimiśraṃ srāvaṃ karoti sahasā sarujā ca nityam | (su. ni. a. 10) | śalyanimittāmāha– naṣṭamityādi| naṣṭamadṛśyamānam| kathañciditi vegakṣayādikāraṇānāmaniyamārthamuktam| anumārgaṃ mārgaṃ lakṣīkṛtya| kecit ‘aṇumārgam’ iti paṭhitvā śalyaviśeṣaṇatayā yojayanti| kintvasmin pakṣe'ṇumārgatvenaiva śalyasyādarśane prayukte kathañciditi nirarthakaṃ syāt| udīriteṣviti tvagādiṣu| phenilaṃ phenavantam| mathitamunmathitam| uṣṇamuṣṇasparśam| ete ca dharmāḥ prasāraṇākuñcanādau calatā śalyena māṃsādikṣobheṇa bhavanti||5|| śalyanimittāmāha– naṣṭamityādi| naṣṭadṛśyamānaṃ, kathañcit pramādāt, anumārgaṃ mārgaṃ lakṣīkṛtya| kecid ‘aṇumārgam’ iti paṭhanti| tatra śalyaviśeṣaṇatayā yojayanti| udīriteṣviti tvaṅmāṃsādiṣu pūrvokteṣu| sā nāḍī, phenilaṃ phenavarṇam, unmathitam, uṣṇamuṣṇasparśam, ete ca dharmāḥ prasāraṇādau calatā śalyena māṃsādikṣobheṇa bhavanti||5||– nāḍī tridoṣaprabhavā na sidhyeccheṣāścatasraḥ khalu yatnasādhyāḥ ||6|| (su. ci. a. 17) | asādhyatvādikamāha– nāḍītyādi| nanu, nāḍī tridoṣaprabhavā na sidhyediti punaruktam, asukṣayakarīmityanenaivāsādhyatvasyoktatvāt| naivam, ayaṃ granthaḥ suśrutena nidānasthānoktameva tridoṣanāḍyā asādhyatvamanūdya tadanyāsāṃ śeṣatvaniścayena yatnasādhyatvapratipādanāya cikitsite paṭhitaḥ, sa evātra mādhavakareṇa likhita ityadoṣaḥ||6|| asādhyāmāha– nāḍītyādi| śeṣā vātapittakaphaśalyajā iti||6|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne nāḍīvraṇanidānaṃ samāptam ||45|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ nāḍīvraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||45|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ nāḍīvraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||45|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘tvaṅmāṃsaśirā ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 2 . ‘nāḍībhavā ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘yo'jñaḥ pakvam’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘vraṇasrāva ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘tvaṅmāṃsaśirā ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘ca’ iti pā. | ↩ 7 . ‘praṇālī vodvahati’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘ataḥ śuṣiranālā’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘sa’ iti pā. | ↩ 10 . ‘cikitsite’ iti pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘śaityādvātavṛddhau’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘naṣṭam adṛśyamānam’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘mārgam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 14 . ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyām’ iti pā.| ↩ 15 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ nāḍīvraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||45||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 46. bhagandaranidānam
text: atha bhagandaranidānam | gudasya dvyaṅgule kṣetre pārśvataḥ piḍakā''rtikṛt | bhinnā bhagandaro jñeyaḥ sa ca pañcavidho mataḥ ||1|| nāḍīviśeṣatvāt saṅkhyāsāmyācca bhagandaranidānam| bhagandarapūrvarūpapiḍakāmāha– gudasyetyādi| kṣetre deśe| “saiva bhinnā bhagandaraḥ|” niruktirasya suśrutena kṛtā| tadyathā– “gudabhagabastipradeśadāraṇāt bhagandarāḥ|” (su. ni. a. 4) iti| bhagaśabdo gudādyupalakṣaṇam| bhoje'pyuktam– “bhagaṃ parisamantācca gudaṃ bastiṃ tathaiva ca| bhagavaddārayedyasmāttasmājjñeyo bhagandaraḥ||” iti| pūrvarūpaṃ tvasya suśrute paṭhyate; yathā– “kaṭīkapālavedanā gudakaṇḍurdāhaḥ śothaśca gudasya bhavati|” (su. ni. a. 4) iti| etat sāmānyaṃ pūrvarūpam| kaṭīkapālamatra kaṭīphalakam| pañcavidha iti saṅkhyākathanaṃ raktajadvandvajabhagandarasambhāvanānirāsārtham||1|| nāḍīviśeṣasaṅkhyāsāmānyād vraṇavadupakramādvā'to'nantaraṃ bhagandaranidānam| tasyāvasthānasaṃśrayatvena lakṣaṇamāha– gudasyetyādi| kṣetre deśe, pārśvataḥ samīpataḥ, piḍakā, saiva bhinnā bhagandarārtikṛt, tasya ca niruktiḥ suśrutena kṛtā– “gudabhagabastipradeśadāraṇādbhagandaraḥ” iti| bhagandaraśabde bhagaśabdo gudādyupalakṣaṇaḥ, bhoje'pyuktam– “bhagaṃ parisamantācca gudaṃ basti tathaiva ca| bhagavaddārayedyasmāttasmājjñeyo bhagandaraḥ||” iti| pūrvarūpaṃ tvasya suśrute paṭhitam, yathā– “kaṭīkapālavedanā gudakaṇḍurdāhaḥ śothaśca gudasya bhavati” iti| etatsāmānyaṃ pūrvarūpamiti| kaṭīkapālamatra kaṭīphalakam| sa ca pañcavidhaḥ– doṣaistrayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, śalyena cāparaḥ, evaṃ pañcavidhasaṅkhyākathanaṃ raktajadvandvajabhagandarasambhāvanānirāsārtham||1|| kaṣāyarūkṣaistvatikopito'nilastvapānadeśe piḍakāṃ karoti yām | upekṣaṇātpākamupaiti dāruṇaṃ rujā ca bhinnā'ruṇaphenavāhinī ||2|| tatrāgamo mūtrapurīṣaretasāṃ vraṇairanekaiḥ śataponakaṃ vadet |3| śataponakamāha– kaṣāyetyādi| apānadeśa iti gudadeśe| upekṣaṇāditi vimlāpanādyakaraṇāt| rujā ca bhinneti rujā rujānvitā, arśaāderākṛtigaṇatvādac, bhinnā vidīrṇā| vraṇairanekaiḥ śataponakaṃ vadediti śataponakatulyatvāt śataponakaḥ; śataponakaścālanikā, sahasradhārā ityanye; kiṃvā śataponakaḥ śūkadoṣe paṭhito vikāraḥ ‘chidrairaṇumukhaiḥ’ ityādinā, kintu yadi śūkadoṣapaṭhitaśataponakatulyatvamasya tadā chidrairaṇumukhairityādinimittasyobhayatra paṭhitatvāt kiṃ tatsādṛśyapravṛtteyaṃ sañjñā, sā vā etatsādṛśyapravṛtteti durvijñānāttatrāpi cālanikātulyatvameva pravṛttinimittamiti manyamānena jejjaṭena cālanikātulyatvamatra varṇitam| śataponakavadanekamukhatve vātikabhagandarasvabhāva eva hetuḥ||2|| vātikaśataponakamāha– kaṣāyetyādi| upekṣaṇāditi vimlāpanādyakaraṇāt| rujā ca bhinneti rujā rujānvitā, bhinnā vidīrṇā| śataponakatulyatvācchataponakaḥ śūkadoṣapaṭhito vikāraḥ, cālanikātulyatvamasya śataponakavadanekamukhatvena| tatra ca vātikabhagandarasvabhāva eva hetuḥ, śataponako'sya nāma||2||– prakopaṇaiḥ pittamatiprakopitaṃ karoti raktāṃ piḍakāṃ gudāśritām ||3|| tadā''śupākā'himapūtivāhinīṃ bhagandaraṃ tūṣṭraśirodharaṃ vadet ||4|| uṣṭragrīvalakṣaṇamāha– prakopaṇairityādi| tadāśupākāhimapūtivāhinīmiti tadeti tatkāle, pittajatvenāśupākā ca sā ahimapūtivāhinī uṣṇapūtivāhinī ca sā āśupākāhimapūtivāhinī tām| atra piḍakāvasthāgatagalavakratvena uṣṭragrīvākāratvaṃ, tenoṣṭragrīvasañjñā||3-4|| pittajamuṣṭragrīvamāha– prakopaṇairityādi| uṣṇapūtidurgandhavāhinīm| atrāpi piḍakāvasthāgatagalavakratve uṣṭragrīvākāratvaṃ, tenoṣṭragrīvasañjñā||3-4|| kaṇḍūyano ghanasrāvī kaṭhino mandavedanaḥ | śvetāvabhāsaḥ kaphajaḥ parisrāvī bhagandaraḥ ||5|| parisrāviṇamāha– kaṇḍūyana ityādi| parisrāvī kaphajaḥ, sa ca ghanasrāvayogāt parisrāvī||5|| parisrāvisañjñaṃ kaphajaṃ bhagandaramāha– kaṇḍūyana ityādi| parisrāvī bhagandaraḥ kaphajaḥ, sa ca ghanaparisrāvayogātparisrāvī| kaṇḍūyanaḥ kaṇḍubahulaḥ||5|| bahuvarṇarujāsrāvā piḍakā gostanopamā | śambūkāvartavannāḍī śambūkāvartako mataḥ ||6|| sannipātajaṃ śambūkāvartamāha– bahuvarṇarujāsrāvetyādi| pratyekadoṣajabhagandarapaṭhitavarṇavedanāḥ srāvaśca| śambūkāvartavat pūrṇanadyāḥ śambūkāvartavadāvartanaṃ vedanā doṣagativiśeṣādbhavatīti śambūkāvartaḥ| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “nadīnāṃ paripūrṇānāṃ śambūkāvartakā yathā| samuttiṣṭhanti vegena toyavegasamīritāḥ||” iti||6|| sannipātajaṃ śambūkāvartamāha– bahvityādi| bahuvarṇeti pratyekadoṣajabhagandarapaṭhitavarṇavedanāsrāvī, śambūkāvartavat laghuśaṅkhavat, pūrṇanadyāḥ śambūkāvarto yathā āvartena ca vedanā doṣagativiśeṣādbhavatīti śambūkāvartaḥ| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “nadīnāṃ paripūrṇānāṃ śambūkāvartakā yathā| abhyuttiṣṭhanti vegena toyavegasamīritāḥ||” iti||6|| kṣatādgatiḥ pāyugatā vivardhate hyupekṣaṇāt syuḥ krimayo vidārya te | prakurvate mārgamanekadhā mukhairvraṇaistadunmārgibhagandaraṃ vadet ||7|| unmārgibhagandaramāgantumāha– kṣatādgatirityādi| kṣatāditi kaṇṭakādighātāt| vidārya ta iti te krimayo vidārya mārgaṃ kurvata iti yojanā| anekadhā mukhairanekamukhaiḥ| atronmārgeṇa krimikṛtavimārgeṇa purīṣādigamanādunmārgisañjñā jñeyā| tantrāntare tvarśobhagandaraḥ paṭhitaḥ| tadyathā– “kaphapitte tu pūrvotthe durnāmāśritya kupyataḥ| arśomūle tataḥ śothaḥ kaṇḍūdāhārtimān bhavet|| sa śīghraṃ pakvabhinno'sya kledayan mūlamarśasaḥ| sravatyajasraṃ gatibhirayamarśobhagandaraḥ||” iti| ayamanyatamasmin śataponakādīnāṃ doṣalakṣaṇadarśanādantarbhāvyaḥ||7|| unmārgibhagandaramāgantumāha– kṣatādityādi| kṣatāt kaṇṭakādighātāt, ye kṛmayo vidārya mārgaṃ prakurvata iti yojanā| anekadhā mukhairanekamukhairvraṇaiḥ| atronmārgeṇa kṛmikṛtavimārgeṇa purīṣādinirgamādunmārgisañjñā pratītā| tantrāntare tvarśobhagandaraḥ paṭhitaḥ, yathā– “kaphapitte tu pūrvotthe durnāmāśritya kupyataḥ| arśomūle tataḥ śophaḥ kaṇḍudāhārtimānbhavet|| sa śīghraṃ pakvabhinno'sya kledayanmūlamarśasaḥ| sravatyajasraṃ gatibhirayamarśobhagandaraḥ||” iti| ayaṃ śataponakādīnāṃ doṣalakṣaṇadarśanādantarbhāvyaḥ||7|| ghorāḥ sādhayituṃ duḥkhāḥ sarva eva bhagandarāḥ | teṣvasādhyastridoṣotthaḥ kṣatajaśca viśeṣataḥ ||8|| (su. ni. a. 4) | pratīkāraprayatnāyāha– ghorā ityādi| duḥkhā iti duḥkhapradāḥ| kṣatajaśca viśeṣata iti kṣatajo'pi viśeṣamanekavraṇayogaṃ krimisambhavādikaṃ ca vīkṣyāsādhyaḥ, ata eva cikitsite asādhyatāṃ pratijñāya kriyāṃ vakṣyati| viśeṣata iti lyablope pañcamī; viśeṣato'tiśayādasādhya ityarthaḥ, yāpanārthaṃ kriyāvidhiriti| kvacit “kṣatajaśca bhagandaraḥ” iti pāṭhaḥ| kṣatajo viśeṣataḥ sādhayituṃ ghoraḥ asādhya eva, srāvarūpaviśeṣasya yuktatvāditi gadādharaḥ||8|| asādhyalakṣaṇamāha– ghorā ityādi| kṣatajo'pi viśeṣamanekavraṇayogyaṃ krimisambhavādikaṃ vīkṣyāsādhyaḥ||8|| vātamūtrapurīṣāṇi krimayaḥ śukrameva ca | bhagandarāt sravantastu nāśayanti tamāturam ||9|| (su. sū. a. 33) | avasthāyāmasādhyatāmāha– vātamūtrapurīṣāṇītyādi| bhagandarāt sravanta ityatra ‘amī viśeṣā’ iti śeṣaḥ||9|| avasthāyāmasādhyatāmāha– vātetyādi| bhagandarātsravanta ityatra ‘amī viśeṣā’ iti śeṣaḥ| amī vātādyā viśeṣā bhagandarātsravantastamāturaṃ vināśayanti||9|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne bhagandaranidānaṃ samāptam ||46|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ bhagandaranidānaṃ samāptam||46|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ bhagandaranidānam||46|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . etacchlokānantaraṃ “kaṭīkapālanistodadāhakaṇḍūrujādayaḥ bhavanti pūrvarūpāṇi bhaviṣyati bhagandare” iti kvacitpustake'dhikaṃ paṭhyate| ↩ 2 . ‘bhagandaraḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘chidrairaṇḍamukhai ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘parisrāvīmāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘srāvāśca’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘śambūkāvartavadāvartena’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘doṣalakṣaṇadarśanādabhāvaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘pratīkāraprayatnopāyamāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘...vraṇayogāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 11 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ bhagandaranidānam||46||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 47. upadaṃśanidānam
text: athopadaṃśanidānam | hastābhighātānnakhadantapātādadhāvanādratyatisevanādvā | yonipradoṣācca bhavanti śiśne pañcopadaṃśā vividhāpacāraiḥ ||1|| sthānapratyāsatterupadaṃśanidānamāha– hastetyādi| nakhadantapātāditi balavadanurāgodayāt nakhadantacchedasthānatvenānukte'pi mehane nakhadantapātaḥ; yaduktaṃ kāmaśāstre– “śāstrasya viṣayastāvadyāvanmandarasā narāḥ| pravṛtte raticakre tu na śāstraṃ nāpi ca kramaḥ||” (kā. sū. sāṃ. a. 2) iti| kalahādivaśādvā mehane nakhadantapātaḥ| adhāvanādaprakṣālanāt| ratyatisevanāditi vyavāyasyātyantasevanāt| yonipradoṣāditi dīrghakarkaśaromādiyogādyoniduṣṭeḥ| śiśne mehane| vividhāpacārairiti aśuddhasalilaprakṣālanabrahmacāriṇīgamanādibhiḥ| upadaṃśasañjñā ca daṃśanopādhimantareṇāpi rūḍhā boddhavyā| yadyapyabhighātakṣate mehane upadaṃśa āgantuḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ sambhāvyate, tathā'pi tasya doṣaliṅgayuktatayā doṣaja evāntarbhāvaḥ||1|| vraṇatvasāmānyātsthānapratyāsannatvādupadaṃśanidānam| tasya hetumāha– hastetyādi| nakhadantapātāditi balavadanurāgodayātprabalakāmarāgavaśāt kāmināṃ mehane dantanakhapāto bhavati| yaduktaṃ kāmaśāstre– “śāstrasya viṣayastāvadyāvanmandarasā narāḥ| raticakre pravṛtte ca na śāstraṃ nāpi ca kramaḥ||” iti| kalahādivaśādvā mehane nakhadantapātaḥ| adhāvanādaprakṣālanāt, atyupasevanāditi vyavāyasyātyantasevanāt, yonipradoṣāt alpamahādvāradīrghakarkaśaromasaṅkīrṇadeśatvādiyonidoṣāt, rogaprabhṛtervā yoniduṣṭeḥ| vividhopacārairiti kṣāroṣṇamalināmbhaḥprakṣālanabrahmacāriṇīgamanādibhiḥ| pañcopadaṃśā iti vātena, pittena, śoṇitena, kaphena, sannipātena; evaṃ pañca| yadyapyabhighātakṣate mehane upadaṃśa āgantuḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ sambhavati, tathā'pi tasya doṣaliṅgayuktatayā doṣaja evāntarbhāvaḥ||1|| satodabhedaiḥ sphuraṇaiḥ sakṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭairvyavasyet pavanopadaṃśam | pītairbahukledayutaiḥ sadāhaiḥ pittena... |2| paittikamāha– pītairityādi| sphoṭairityanusañjanīyam| evamuttaratrāpi|2|– vātajopadaṃśalakṣaṇamāha– satodetyādi| bhedo dvidhā kriyata iva| vyavasyet jānīyāt| pittajamāha– pītairityādi| pittai raktairveti vikalpaḥ, pittena bahukledayutaiḥ ārdratābahulaiḥ, sphoṭairiti śeṣaḥ|2| ...raktāt piśitāvabhāsaiḥ ||2|| sphoṭaiḥ sakṛṣṇai rudhiraṃ sravantaṃ raktātmakaṃ pittasamānaliṅgam | sakaṇḍuraiḥ śothayutairmahadbhiḥ śuklairghanaiḥ srāvayutaiḥ kaphena ||3|| raktajamāha– raktādityādi| raktāt piśitāvabhāsairiti māṃsavattāmraiḥ sphoṭaiḥ raktācchoṇitāt upadaṃśaṃ vyavasyet| ‘raktaiḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare raktaiḥ śoṇitaiḥ||2-3|| raktajamāha– piśitāvabhāsairityādi| māṃsavattāmraiḥ sphoṭaiḥ raktāt śoṇitāt upadaṃśaṃ vyavasyet| ‘raktaiḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram, tatra raktaiḥ śoṇitaiḥ| kaphajamāha– sakaṇḍuraiḥ kaṇḍūyutaiḥ, mahadbhiḥ mahatparigrahaiḥ, ghanairnibiḍaiḥ, sphoṭairiti śeṣaḥ||2-3|| nānāvidhasrāvarujopapannamasādhyamāhustrimalopadaṃśam |4| sannipātajamāha– nānāvidhetyādi| nānāvidhasrāvarujopapannamiti pratyekadoṣoktasrāvavedanāyuktam| trimalopadaṃśamiti tridoṣopadaṃśam|4|– sannipātajamāha– nānetyādi| pratyekadoṣoktasrāvavedanāyuktam| trimalopadaṃśamiti tridoṣopadaṃśamasādhyamāhuḥ|4|– viśīrṇamāṃsaṃ krimibhiḥ prajagdhaṃ muṣkāvaśeṣaṃ parivarjayecca ||4|| asādhyatāmāha– viśīrṇetyādi| muṣkāvaśeṣamiti viśīrṇasamastamehanamāṃsatvenāvaśiṣṭaphalakoṣamātram||4|| varjyamāha– viśīrṇetyādi| viśīrṇamāṃsaṃ śaṭitamāṃsaṃ, kṛmibhiḥ prajagdhaṃ bhakṣitaṃ, muṣkāvaśeṣamiti śīrṇasamastamehanamāṃsatvenāvaśiṣṭaphalakośamātraṃ, evamuktalakṣaṇopadaṃśaṃ parivarjayet||4|| sañjātamātre na karoti mūḍhaḥ kriyāṃ naro yo viṣaye prasaktaḥ | kālena śothakrimidāhapākairviśīrṇaśiśno mriyate sa tena ||5|| upakrame cikitsākaraṇārthamāha– sañjātetyādi| viṣaye prasakta iti ativyavāyarataḥ| kālena cirakālena||5|| upakrame cikitsākaraṇārthamāha– sañjātetyādi| yo mūḍho viṣaye prasaktaḥ vyavāyāditatparaḥ, sa tenopadaṃśena kālena kālāntareṇa mriyate śothādibhirupadravaiḥ praśīrṇaśiśnaḥ galitamehanaḥ||5|| aṅkurairiva saṅghātairuparyuparisaṃsthitaiḥ | krameṇa jāyate vartistāmracūḍaśikhopamā ||6|| koṣasyābhyantare sandhau sarvasandhigatā'pi vā | (savedanā picchilā ca duścikitsyā tridoṣajā) | liṅgavartirabhikhyātā liṅgārśa iti cāpare ||7|| ekasthānatvenātra liṅgārśa āha– aṅkurairityādi| aṅkurairaṅkurasadṛśairīṣaddīrghaiḥ, saṅghātairmāṃsapratānaiḥ, ‘sañjātaiḥ’ iti pāṭhe ‘māṃsaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| tāmracūḍaśikhopamā iti tāmracūḍaḥ, kukkuṭaḥ, taccūḍātulyā| sandhāviti meḍhrarandhrasandhau, sarvasandhigatetyanena sarvasandheruktatvāt| eṣā tridoṣajā, vartiriti yojyam; ata eva ‘savedanā picchilā ca duścikitsyā tridoṣajā|’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ| suśrute kvacit strīṇāmapyupadaṃśaḥ paṭhyate| yathā– “meḍhrasandhau vraṇāḥ kecit kecit sarvāśrayāstathā| kulatthākṛtayaḥ kecit kecit padmadalopamāḥ|| rujādāhārtibahulāḥ kṛṣṇāstodasamanvitāḥ| śīghraṃ kecidvisarpanti śanaiḥ kecittathā'pare| strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca jāyante upadaṃśāḥ sudāruṇāḥ||” iti| kintu samānatantreṣvadarśanādetadanārṣamāhuḥ||6-7|| ekasthānatvenātra liṅgārśa āha– aṅkurairityādi| aṅkurasadṛśairīṣaddīrghasaṅghātaiḥ māṃsapratānaiḥ| anye sandhāviti meḍhrarandhrasandhau, sarvasandhigatetyanena sarvasandheruktatvāt, eṣā tridoṣajā, ata eva “savedanā picchilā ca duścikitsyā tridoṣajā” iti kvacitpaṭhyate| suśrute tu kvacit strīṇāmapyupadaṃśāḥ paṭhyante| tadyathā– “meḍhrasandhau vraṇāḥ kecitkecitsarvāśrayāstathā| kulatthākṛtayaḥ kecitkecitpadmadalopamāḥ|| rujādāhārtibahulāḥ kṛṣṇāstodasamanvitāḥ| strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca jāyante upadaṃśāḥ sudāruṇāḥ||” iti| kintu samānatantreṣvadarśanādetadanārṣamāhuḥ||6-7|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne upadaṃśanidānaṃ samāptam ||47|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāmupadaṃśanidānaṃ samāptam||47|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyakṛtāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāmupadaṃśanidānam||47|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘ ... dhāvanādatyupasevanādvā’ iti pā. | ↩ 2 . ‘ ... ṣañjanīyam’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘bhedo’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 4 . ‘ ... lakṣaṇamupadaṃśam’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘ativyavāyādirataḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘saṅghātairmāṃsasampratānaiḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘vartiriti yojyam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 8 . ‘randhrasandhau’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāmupadaṃśanidānam||47||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 48. śūkadoṣanidānam
text: atha śūkadoṣanidānam | akramācchephaso vṛddhiṃ yo'bhivāñchati mūḍhadhīḥ | vyādhayastasya jāyante daśa cāṣṭau ca śūkajāḥ ||1|| samānasthānatvācchūkadoṣanidānamāha– akramādityādi| śūko jalaśūkaḥ, sa tu viṣajanturjalamalodbhavaḥ saśūkaḥ, tathā śūkapradhāno liṅgavṛddhikaro vātsyāyanādyukto yogaḥ śūka ucyate; tasya doṣo vaikṛtamasamyakkaraṇāt, tato vā doṣo vātādiḥ, tatkṛto vā vikāraḥ, “doṣā api vyādhyākhyāṃ labhante” ityāgamāt; ata eva śūkadoṣavivaraṇe śūkadoṣanimittā vyādhaya eva boddhavyāḥ| evaṃ ca yadatra ‘kumbhikā raktapittotthā’ ityādikāraṇāntaropavarṇanaṃ tat śūkakṛtaraktapittādirūpaṃ jñeyam| anye tvādiśabdalopāt śūkādidoṣanidānamāhuḥ| ādiśabdena duṣṭayonigūḍhāntarlomadurbhagāgamanādi gṛhyate; tanna manoharaṃ, “vṛddhiṃ yo'bhivāñchati” ityanena viśeṣaṇena duṣṭayonyāderayogyasya grahītumanarhatvāt| anye tu duṣṭayonyādīnyupadaṃśahetutvenoktatvāt nānumanyante; tadanaikāntikam, ekajātīyahetūnāmanekarogakaraṇadarśanāt| akramādityanucitavṛddhikramāt; anucitā ca vṛddhirbhūrivikārakarajalaśūkayogānāmācāraṇāt, jalaśūkayogānāṃ vātsyāyanādau vistaraḥ| yathā– “bhallātakāsthijalaśūkamathābjapatramantarvidahya matimān saha saindhavena| etadvirūḍhabṛhatīphalatoyapiṣṭamālepanaṃ mahiṣaviḍvimalīkṛte'ṅge|| sthūlaṃ mahattaraturaṅgamatulyamāśu śephaṃ karotyabhimataṃ na hi saṃśayo'sti||” ityādi| yacca jalaśūkarahitamaśvagandhāditailaṃ taducitameva liṅgavardhanam| yaduktam– “aśvagandhāvarīkuṣṭhamāṃsīsiṃhīphalānvitam| caturguṇena dugdhena tilatailaṃ vipācayet|| stanaliṅgakarṇapālivardhanaṃ mrakṣaṇādidam||” iti| gadādharastvāha– liṅgavṛddhireva kāmaparāyaṇaninditapuruṣaiḥ kriyamāṇā akramaḥ| daśa cāṣṭau ceti aṣṭādaśa; saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva labdhāyāṃ saṅkhyāyāṃ punastaduktiḥ sammūḍhapiḍakādau dvitvaśaṅkānirāsārtham||1|| samānasthānatvācchūkadoṣanidānārambhaḥ| tasya samprāptimāha– akramādityādi| śūko jalaśūkaḥ, sa tu viṣajanturjalamalodbhavo jīvaviśeṣaḥ saśūkaḥ, tatpradhāno liṅgavṛddhau vātsyāyanādiśāstrokto yogaḥ śūkadoṣa ucyate, tanmukhyatvāt liṅgavṛddhau anye'pi yogāḥ śūkāḥ kathyante, tasya doṣo vikāraḥ, śūkasya kāraṇatvāt “kvaciddoṣā api vyādhyākhyāṃ labhante” ityāgamāt, ata eva śūkadoṣavivaraṇe śūkadoṣanimittatvāt vyādhaya eva vaktavyāḥ| atra śūkajā iti śūkadoṣajā vyādhayaḥ| akramāditi anucitavṛddhikramāt, anucitā vṛddhiḥ bhūrivikārakarajalaśūkayogānāmācaraṇāt, jalaśūkayogānāṃ vātsyāyanādau vistaraḥ| yathā– “bhallātakāsthijalaśūkamathābjapatramantarvidahya matimānsaha saindhavena| etadvirūḍhabṛhatīphalajopapiṣṭamālepanaṃ mahiṣaviḍvimalīkṛte'ṅge|| sthūlaṃ mahattaraturaṅgamatulyamāśu śephaṃ karotyabhimataṃ na hi saṃśayo'sti|” ityādi| yacca jalaśūkarahitamaśvagandhāditailaṃ, taducitameva liṅgavardhanam| yaduktam– “ aśvagandhāvacākuṣṭhamāṃsīsiṃhīphalānvitam| caturguṇena dugdhena tilatailaṃ vipācayet| stanaliṅgakarṇapālivardhanaṃ mrakṣaṇādidam||” iti| śephaso liṅgasya| gadādharastvāha– liṅgavṛddhireva kāmaparāyaṇaninditapuruṣaiḥ kriyamāṇā akramaḥ| daśa ca aṣṭau ceti aṣṭādaśa, saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva labdhāyāṃ saṅkhyāyāṃ punastaduktiḥ sammūḍhapiḍakādau dvitvasaṅkhyānirāsārtham||1|| gaurasarṣapasaṃsthānā śūkadurbhugnahetukā | piḍakā śleṣmavātābhyāṃ jñeyā sarṣapikā tu sā ||2|| (su. ni. a. 14) | sarṣapikāmāha– gauretyādi| śūkadurbhugnahetuketi durbhugnaśūkahetuketyarthaḥ| piḍakādiṣu ubhayavacanamiti(?) paranipātaḥ durbhugno duravacāritaḥ| ‘śūkadurbhagahetukā’ iti pāṭhāntare śūkanimittā, duṣṭayoninimittā cetyarthaḥ||2|| vātaśleṣmajanitāṃ sarṣapikāmāha– gauretyādi| gaurasarṣapatulyā| śūkadurbhugnahetuketi durbhugnaśūkahetuketyarthaḥ| ‘piḍakādiṣu ubhayavacanam’ iti paranipātaḥ| durbhugno duravacāritaḥ| “śūkadurbhagahetukī” iti pāṭhāntaram| tatra śūkanimittā duṣṭayoninimittā cetyarthaḥ||2|| kaṭhinā viṣamairbhugnairvāyunā'ṣṭhīlikā bhavet |3| (su. ni. a. 14) | aṣṭhīlikāmāha– kaṭhinetyādi| viṣamairbhugnairiti vakṣyamāṇaśūkairityanena sambadhyate| viṣamairiti apraśastaiḥ| aṣṭhīlikā lauhakārasya bhāṇḍīviśeṣa, tattulyatvādaṣṭhīlikā|3|– aṣṭīlikāmāha– kaṭhinetyādi| viṣamairbhugnairiti vakṣyamāṇaśūkairityanena sambadhyate| viṣamaiḥ apraśastaiḥ, bhugnairvakraiḥ| aṣṭhīlikā lohakārabhāṇḍaviśeṣaḥ, tattulyatvādaṣṭhīlikā; sā ca vātena|3|– śūkairyat pūritaṃ śaśvadgrathitaṃ nāma tat kaphāt ||3|| grathitamāha– śūkairityādi| śūkairyat pūritaṃ śaśvadgrathitamiti śūkaiḥ sarvadā pūritaṃ liṅgaṃ yat granthilaṃ tat grathitamityarthaḥ; granthitulyatvāt grathitasañjñā||3|| kaphādgrathitamāha– śūkairityādi| śūkaiḥ sarvadā pūritaṃ liṅgaṃ yattadgrathitamityarthaḥ| grathitatvād grathitasañjñā| śaśvaditi aharahaḥ| śūkapūraṇaṃ śephasi, etenaikadināntarapūraṇaṃ praśastamicchanti kāmatantrācāryāḥ| nityapūraṇād grathitanāmno rogasyotpattiḥ||3|| kumbhikā raktapittotthā jāmbavāsthinibhā'śubhā |4| (su. ni. a. 14) | kumbhikāmāha– kumbhiketyādi| kumbhī kumbhīlatā, tasyāḥ phalaṃ kumbhī; taddhitasya luk; ‘ive pratikṛtau’ iti kan kumbhīphalavat kumbhikā| aśubheti śubhaṃ śuklaṃ tadvirodhe nañ, kṛṣṇetyarthaḥ| ‘āśujā’ iti pāṭhāntaram|4|– raktapittābhyāṃ kumbhikāmāha– kumbhiketyādi| kumbhikā kumbhakārī, tasyāḥ phalaṃ kumbhī, taddhitasya luk “ive pratikṛtau” iti kan, kumbhīphalavat kumbhikā, tathā jāmbavāsthirūpā jambūphalāsthisadṛśī, aśubhā śubhaṃ śuklaṃ na śubhā aśubhā kṛṣṇetyarthaḥ| sā ca raktapittajanitā| ‘āśujā’ iti pāṭhāntaram|4|– tulyajāṃ tvalajīṃ vidyādyathāproktāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||4|| (su. ni. a. 14) | alajīmāha– tulyajāmityādi| tulyajāmiti pramehapiḍakā alajī tattulyasambhavā, sā ca raktā'sitā sphoṭacitā| tulyatvameva vivṛṇoti– yathāproktāmiti| alajī yathāproktā yādṛśalakṣaṇā tatheyamapītyarthaḥ| eṣā ca kāraṇacikitsābhedāt pramehaṃ vinā liṅga eva sambhavācca tataḥ pṛthagbhūtā jñeyā||4|| alajīmāha– tulyajāmityādi| vicakṣaṇaḥ alajīpiḍakāṃ vidyāt| kimbhūtāṃ? tulyajāmiti| pramehapiḍakā alajī, tattulyasambhavā| sā ca raktāsitasphoṭacitā| tulyatvameva vivṛṇoti– yathāproktāmityādi| sā alajī yathāproktā yādṛśalakṣaṇā tatheyamapītyarthaḥ| eṣā ca kāraṇacikitsābhedāt pramehaṃ vinā liṅga eva sambhavācca tataḥ pṛthagbhūtā jñeyā| iyamapi duṣṭaśūkāvacāraṇājjñeyā||4|| mṛditaṃ pīḍitaṃ yacca saṃrabdhaṃ vātakopataḥ |5| (su. ni. a. 14) | mṛditamāha– mṛditamityādi| pīḍitamiti adhikṛtatvāt śūkapātānantaraṃ pīḍitamiti jñeyaṃ, pīḍitaṃ ‘liṅgam’ iti śeṣaḥ| saṃrabdhaṃ saśotham|5|– mṛditamāha– mṛditamityādi| saṃrabdhaṃ saśophaṃ tanmṛditaṃ mṛditākhyaṃ rogākrāntaṃ jñeyaṃ, pīḍitamityadhikṛtatvāt śūkapātānantaraṃ pīḍitamiti jñeyam|5|– pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe sammūḍhapiḍakā bhavet ||5|| (su. ni. a. 14) | sammūḍhapiḍakāmāha– pāṇibhyāmityādi| pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe ityadhikārāt pātitaśūke liṅge pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe piccitāvanate, atrāpi ‘vātakopāt’ ityanuvartate||5|| sammūḍhapiḍakāmāha– pāṇibhyāmityādi| pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe ityatrādhikārāt pātitaśūke liṅge pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe atyarthaṃ piccitāvanate sammūḍhapiḍakā syāt, atrāpi vātaprakopa ityanuvartate||5|| dīrghā bahvyaśca piḍakā dīryante madhyatastu yāḥ | so'dhimanthaḥ kaphāsṛgbhyāṃ vedanāromaharṣakṛt ||6|| (su. ni. a. 14) | adhimanthamāha– dīrghā ityādi| kaphāsṛgbhyāmiti śūkapātakṛtābhyām| evamanyatrāpi sāmānyena śūkadoṣābhihite śūkapāto'nukto'pi jñeyaḥ| vedanāromaharṣakṛditi vedanayā romaharṣaṃ karoti||6|| avamanthamāha– dīrghā ityādi| dīrghā vistīrṇāḥ, bahvyaḥ bahulāḥ| kaphāsṛgbhyāmiti śūkapātakṛtābhyām| evamanyatra sarveṣvapi sāmānyena śūkadoṣeṣu śūkapāto'nukto'pi jñeyaḥ| vedanayā romaharṣaṃ karoti iti vedanāromaharṣakṛt| adhimantha iti sañjñā||6|| piḍakā piḍakāvyāptā pittaśoṇitasambhavā | padmakarṇikasaṃsthānā jñeyā puṣkarikā tu sā ||7|| (su. ni. a. 14) | puṣkarikāmāha– piḍeketyādi||7|| puṣkarikāmāha– piḍakābhiścitetyādi| yā piḍakaiva piḍakābhiścitā vyāptā| padmakarṇikasaṃsthāneti kamalakośatulyā, puṣkariketi sañjñā pittaśoṇitādvijñeyā||7|| sparśahāniṃ tu janayecchoṇitaṃ śūkadūṣitam |8| (su. ni. a. 14) | sparśahānimāha– sparśahāniṃ tvityādi|8|– sparśahānimāha– sparśahānimityādi| sparśahānināmānaṃ vyādhiviśeṣaṃ, śūkadūṣitaṃ śūkena duṣṭiṃ nītaṃ raktaṃ janayet|8|– mudgamāṣopamā raktā raktapittodbhavā tu yā ||8|| vyādhireṣottamā nāma śūkājīrṇanimittajā | (su. ni. a. 14) | uttamāmāha– mudgamāṣetyādinā| eṣottamā vyādhiḥ śūkājīrṇanimittajā bhavati, śūkājīrṇaṃ punaḥ punarduravacāritaśūkavikṛtirūpameva| “vyādhireṣottamo nāma” iti pāṭhāntare eṣottama iti nirdeśaḥ pūrvatrāsiddhavidheranityatvāt sādhuḥ||8||– uttamamāha– vyādhirityādi| eṣa uttamo nāma vyādhiḥ śūkājīrṇanimittajo bhavati, śūkājīrṇaṃ punaḥ punarduravacāritaśūkavikṛtirūpameva, tadeva nimittaṃ tato jāyata iti| ‘ vyādhireṣottama’ iti nirdeśaḥ| pūrvatrāsiddhavidheranityatvātsādhuḥ||8|| chidrairaṇumukhairliṅgaṃ citaṃ yasya samantataḥ ||9|| vātaśoṇitajo vyādhiḥ sa jñeyaḥ śataponakaḥ | (su. ni. 14) ||11|| śataponakamāha– chidrairaṇumukhairityādinā| chidrairiti duravacāritaśūkadoṣajanitavātaśoṇitajaiḥ, citamupacitam, ata eva cikitsāyāṃ lekhanopadeśaḥ| śataponakaścālanikā, tattulyatvāt śataponakaḥ||9||– śataponakamāha– chidrairityādi| yasya liṅgaṃ chidraiḥ sūkṣmamukhaiḥ samantataḥ sarvataścitaṃ vyāptaṃ, sa vyādhiḥ śataponako jñeyaḥ| chidrairiti duravacāritaśūkajanitavātaśoṇitajaiḥ| śataponakaścālanikā, tattulyaḥ śataponakaḥ||9||– vātapittakṛto jñeyastvakpāko jvaradāhakṛt ||10|| (su. ni. a. 14) | tvakpākamāha– vātapittakṛta ityādi| śūkadoṣeṣu kvacit kasyacit doṣasyābhidhānaṃ śūkaviśeṣādāhārācārabhedācca samarthanīyam||10|| tvakpākamāha– vātetyādi| vātapittakṛtaḥ tvakpākanāmā vyādhirjñeyaḥ| sa ca jvaradāhau karoti| ayaṃ ca duravacāritaśūkadūṣitavātapittaja ityarthaḥ| śūkadoṣeṣu kvacitkasyaciddoṣasyābhidhānaṃ śūkaviśeṣādāhārādibhedācca samarthanīyam||10|| kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ saraktābhiḥ piḍakābhirnipīḍitam | yasya vāsturujaścogrā jñeyaṃ tacchoṇitārbudam ||11|| (su. ni. a. 14) | śoṇitārbudamāha– kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭairityādinā| piḍakābhiriti svalpābhirnipīḍitaṃ liṅgamiti boddhavyam| yasya vāsturuja iti vāstu vraṇādhiṣṭhānaṃ, tatra rujaḥ, agādhocchritamāṃsaśothatvāt| ‘bastirujaścogrā’ iti pāṭhāntaram| arbudaṃ duravacāritaśūkajaśoṇitakṛtam||11|| śoṇitārbudamāha– kṛṣṇairityādi| piḍakābhiriti svalpābhiḥ nipīḍitaṃ liṅgamiti boddhavyam| yasya vāsturuja iti vāstu vraṇādhiṣṭhānam| tatra ugrā rujaḥ, agādhocchritamāṃsaśothatvāt| ‘bastirujaścogrāḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram| sarvadā duravacāritaśūkajaśoṇitakṛtam||11|| māṃsadoṣeṇa jānīyādarbudaṃ māṃsasambhavam |12| (su. ni. a. 14) | māṃsārbudamāha– māṃsadoṣeṇetyādi| māṃsadoṣeṇeti śūkapātānantaraṃ prahārādinā kṛtena māṃsadoṣeṇa|12|– māṃsārbudamāha– māṃsadoṣeṇetyādi| śūkapātānantaraṃ prahārādinā kṛtena māṃsadoṣeṇa, atrāpi śoṇitaṃ hetuḥ, māṃsārbudasañjñā|12|– śīryante yasya māṃsāni yasya sarvāśca vedanāḥ ||12|| vidyāttaṃ māṃsapākaṃ tu sarvadoṣakṛtaṃ bhiṣak | (su. ni. a. 14) | māṃsapākamāha– śīryante yasyetyādi| śīryante galanti, sarvāśca vedanā iti vātapittakaphajāḥ||12||– māṃsapākamāha– śīryanta ityādi| śīryante galanti| sarvāśca vedanāḥ iti vātapittakaphajāḥ, ayaṃ tridoṣajaḥ||12||– vidradhiṃ sannipātena yathoktamiti nirdiśet ||13|| (su. ni. a. 14) | vidradhimāha– vidradhimityādi| sannipātena yathoktamiti ‘nānāvarṇarujāsrāvaḥ’ ityādinā sannipātajavidradhilakṣaṇaṃ vidradhimiha jānīyādityarthaḥ||13|| vidradhimāha– yathoktamityādi| sannipātavidradhilakṣaṇena jānīyāt| vidradhinidānoktaṃ ‘nānāvarṇarujāsrāvaḥ’ ityādinā||13|| kṛṣṇāni citrāṇyathavā śūkāni saviṣāṇi vā | pātitāni pacantyāśu meḍhraṃ niravaśeṣataḥ ||14|| kālāni bhūtvā māṃsāni śīryante yasya dehinaḥ | sannipātasamutthāṃstu tān vidyāttilakālakān ||15|| (su. ni. a. 14) | tilakālakamāha– kṛṣṇānītyādi| citrāṇīti nānāvarṇāni| saviṣāṇīti śūkānāṃ saviṣatve'pi viśeṣārthamuktam| kālānīti kṛṣṇāni, kṛṣṇatilatulyatvāt tilakālakasañjñā| śīryante galanti||14-15|| tilakālakamāha– kṛṣṇānītyādi| yasya puṃsaḥ śūkāni kṛṣṇāni, athavā citrāṇi, athavā saviṣāṇi, tāni saṃhatyāśu śīghraṃ niravaśeṣataḥ samagraṃ meḍhraṃ pacanti, kṛṣṇāni kṛṣṇavarṇāni, citrāṇīti śuklapītanīlādinānāvarṇāni, saviṣāṇīti śūkānāṃ saviṣatve'pi viśeṣārthamuktaṃ, tathā kālānīti kṛṣṇāni pariṇatatilaphalavarṇāni bhūtvā śīryanti galanti, tān sannipātajān tilakālakān vidyāt, kṛṣṇatilatulyavarṇatvāttilakālakasañjñā||14-15|| tatra māṃsārbudaṃ yacca māṃsapākaśca yaḥ smṛtaḥ | vidradhiśca na siddhyanti ye ca syustilakālakāḥ ||16|| (su. ni. a. 14) | śūkadoṣeṣvasādhyānāha– tatra māṃsārbudamityādi| yacceti cakāro'yaṃ bhinnakramaḥ, sa ca na siddhyatītyanantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ; tena sādhyatā'pyeṣāmaciratvādinā bhavati, ata eva pratyākhyāya cikitsāvidhānamupapannamiti gadādharaḥ| durjñānāt sādhye eva asādhyatāropādasampūrṇāvasthāyāmasādhye'pi kriyāsiddheśca mā nivartatāṃ bhiṣagiti pratyākhyāya cikitsāṃ kāruṇikatayā ācārya upadiśatīti mantavyam||16|| śūkadoṣeṣvasādhyatāmāha– tatretyādi| tatra teṣu śūkadoṣeṣu madhye yanmāṃsārbudaṃ, tathā yo māṃsapākaḥ, tathā vidradhiḥ, tathā ye ca tilakālakāḥ syuḥ, ete na sidhyanti| ye ceti cakāro bhinnakramaḥ, sa ca na siddhyatītyanantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| tena sādhyatā'pyeṣāmaciratvādinā bhavati, ata eva pratyākhyāya cikitsāvidhānamupapannamiti gadādharaḥ||16|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne śūkadoṣanidānaṃ samāptam ||48|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śūkadoṣanidānaṃ samāptam||48|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyakṛtāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ śūkadoṣanidānaṃ samāptam||48|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘yatra kumbhikādau raktapittotthetyādi ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 2 . ‘tvādiśabdalābhāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘duṣṭayonyāderayogasya’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘ ... śūkayogānāmavacāraṇāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘mahiṣaviḍimalīkṛte'ṅge’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘śephaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘samānasthānatvāt śūkadoṣanidānam|’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘viṣajanturjalamalodbhavaḥ saśūkaḥ,’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘śūka’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . ‘bhūrivikārajalaśūkayogānāmācaraṇāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘etadvirūḍhabṛhatīphalatoyapiṣṭamālepanam’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘ ... siṃhīda(pha)lānvitam’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘kumbhīḍulatā’ iti pā., ‘kumbhāḍulatā’ iti ca pā.| ↩ 14 . ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 15 . ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 16 . ‘śubham aśubham’ iti pā.| ↩ 17 . ‘duṣṭaśūkāvadhāraṇājjñeyā’ iti pā.| ↩ 18 . ‘pīḍitaśūkaliṅge’ iti pā.| ↩ 19 . etacca– ‘piḍakāmiśritā yā ca’ iti pā.| ↩ 20 . ‘śūkājīrṇanimittataḥ’ iti pā. | ↩ 21 . ‘eṣā uttamā’ iti pā.| ↩ 22 . ‘vyādhireṣottamā’ iti pā.| ↩ 23 . ‘pūrvatrāsandhividhe ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 24 . ‘cittam’ iti pā. | ↩ 25 . ‘pūrvaṃ sambandhanīyam’ iti pā.| ↩ 26 . ‘śūkaṃ doṣeṣu’ iti pā.| ↩ 27 . ‘tatra rujaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 28 . ‘ ... māṃsaśoṣatvāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 29 . ‘pramehādinā’ iti pā.| ↩ 30 . ‘śūkadoṣeṣvasādhyatāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 31 . ‘tathā yo māṃsapākaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 32 . ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyām’ iti pā.| ↩ 33 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ śūkadoṣanidānam||48||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 49. kuṣṭhanidānam
text: atha kuṣṭhanidānam | virodhīnyannapānāni dravasnigdhagurūṇi ca | bhajatāmāgatāṃ chardiṃ vegāṃścānyān pratighnatām ||1|| vyāyāmamatisantāpamatibhuktvā niṣeviṇām | gharmaśramabhayārtānāṃ drutaṃ śītāmbusevinām ||2|| ajīrṇādhyaśināṃ caiva pañcakarmāpacāriṇām | navānnadadhimatsyātilavaṇāmlaniṣeviṇām ||3|| māṣamūlakapiṣṭānnatilakṣīraguḍāśinām | vyavāyaṃ cāpyajīrṇe'nne nidrāṃ ca bhajatāṃ divā ||4|| viprān gurūn dharṣayatāṃ pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatām | vātādayastrayo duṣṭāstvagraktaṃ māṃsamambu ca ||5|| dūṣayanti sa kuṣṭhānāṃ saptako dravyasaṅgrahaḥ | ataḥ kuṣṭhāni jāyante sapta caikādaśaiva ca ||6|| (ca. ci. a. 7) | aṣṭādaśasaṅkhyārūpeṇa tulyatvāt kuṣṭhanidānamucyate| viśeṣeṇa kuṣṭhajanakaṃ nidānamāha– virodhīnītyādi| virodhīni “na matsyān payasā'bhyavaharet” (ca. sū. a. 26) ityādinoktāni| bhajatāmiti pūrveṇa sambadhyate| āgatāmiti upasthitavegām| vegāṃścānyāniti mūtrapurīṣādivegān| vyāyāmamatisantāpamatibhuktveti bhuktvā vyāyāmamatiyujya santāpamatiyujya ca niṣeviṇāmiti etayoreva sevanaśīlānāṃ; niṣeviṇāmityanena saha prathamataḥ sambandhe kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt, tataśca vyāyāmasyātisantāpasyātiniṣeviṇāmiti prayogaḥ prasajyeta| “śītoṣṇalaṅghanāhārān kramaṃ muktvā niṣeviṇām” iti pāṭhāntare śītoṣṇādīnāṃ yadā yena krameṇa sevyatvamuktaṃ, tadvaiparītyena tān sevyamānān| śītoṣṇalaṅghanāhārānityanantaraṃ pratīti draṣṭavyaṃ, tena śītoṣṇādīn prati yaḥ kramastaṃ muktvā eteṣāmeva niṣeviṇām| gharmaśramabhayārtānāmiti gharmādibhirārtatve sati drutamaviśramya śītāmbusevinām| gharma ātapaḥ| ajīrṇādhyaśināmiti ajīrṇamāmamannam, apakvamiti yāvat, tadbhuñjānānām; adhyaśināmāhāre evāpariṇate bhuñjānānām| aśināmiti ajīrṇādhiśabdābhyāṃ saha sambandhyate| pañcakarmāpacāriṇāmiti pañcakarmaṇi kriyamāṇe apacāriṇām| navānnadadhimatsyānīti atiśabdo navānnādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ sambadhyate| vyavāyaṃ cāpyajīrṇa iti vidagdhādirūpe ajīrṇe| dharṣayatāmiti abhibhavatām| pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatāmityanenaiva viprādidharṣaṇe labdhe punastadvacanaṃ viśeṣārtham| doṣadūṣyasaṅgrahamāha– vātādaya ityādinā| vātādīnāṃ tritve pratīte'pi traya iti vacanaṃ sarvakuṣṭheṣu militānāmeva trayāṇāṃ duṣṭipradarśanārtham| dravyasaṅgraha iti dravyamārambhakaṃ kāraṇamucyate; yathā– “rasanārtho rasastasya dravyamāpaḥ kṣitistathā|” (ca. sū. a. 1) iti| arthalabdhamapi saptakamiti padaṃ sarvatra saptakaniyamārthaṃ punaruktam| nanu, visarpāṇāṃ samutpāde etāvatyeva sāmagrī, yaduktam– “raktaṃ lasīkā tvaṅmāṃsaṃ dūṣyaṃ doṣāstrayo malāḥ| visarpāṇāṃ samutpattau vijñeyāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti| lasīkayā ca tatrodakamucyate, tat kinnibandhanaḥ kuṣṭhavisarpayorbhedaḥ? ucyate– kuṣṭhaṃ cirakriyaiḥ sthirairaprabalaraktapittairdoṣairjanyate, visarpastvaciravisarpaṇaśīlaiḥ prabalaraktapittaiḥ; kuṣṭhe gurupradharṣaṇaparadravyāpahārādayo nimittaṃ, na visarpe| anye tvāhuḥ– visarpā vātādibhirekaikaśo'pi bhavanti, yaduktam– “pṛthak trayastribhiścaiko visarpā dvandvajāstrayaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti, kuṣṭhaṃ tu tridoṣajameveti| kiṃ tvetatsamādhānaṃ tridoṣajatve'pi visarpāṇāmekadoṣajakuṣṭhavadekadoṣajatvakīrtanaṃ saṅgatamiti na manoharam| ataḥ kuṣṭhānīti ata ityasmāt doṣadūṣyasamudāyāt| sapta caikādaśaiva ceti vicchedapāṭhena saptānāṃ mahākuṣṭhatvamekādaśānāṃ kṣudratvamiti bodhayati||1-6|| aṣṭādaśarūpasaṅkhyātulyatvātkuṣṭhanidānamucyate| viśeṣeṇa kuṣṭhajanakaṃ nidānamāha– virodhīnītyādi| etadācaratāṃ nṛṇāṃ kuṣṭhāni jāyante iti sambandhaḥ| virodhīni kṣīramatsyādīni bhajatāmiti sambadhyate| āgatāmiti upasthitavegāṃ chardiṃ, tathā vegāṃścānyāniti mūtrapurīṣādivegān, pratighnatāṃ pratighātaṃ kurvatām| vyāyāmamatisantāpamatibhuktveti bhuktvā vyāyāmamatiyujya santāpamatiyujya niṣeviṇāmiti| etayoreva sevanaśīlānāṃ, niṣeviṇāmityanena prathamataḥ sambandhe kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt; tatra vyāyāmasyātisantāpasyātiniṣeviṇāmiti prayogaḥ prayujyate| śītetyādi śītoṣṇādīnāṃ tu yadā yena krameṇa sevyatvamuktaṃ, tadvaiparītyena tān sevamānānām| gharma ātapaḥ| ajīrṇādhyaśināmityādi| ajīrṇamanagnipakvamannaṃ, carvaṇamiti yāvat, tadbhojinām| adhyaśinām, āhāra evāpariṇate bhuñjānānām| aśināmiti ajīrṇādhibhyāṃ saha sambadhyate| pañcakarmāpacāriṇāmiti pañca karmāṇi vamanavirekādīni, teṣāmapacāriṇāṃ vyāpattvayoginām| navānnadadhimatsyātīti, atiśabdo navānnādiguḍāntaiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| vyavāyaṃ cāpyajīrṇe'nne ityādi| vyavāyaṃ maithunaṃ, vidagdharūpe ajīrṇe; divā ca nidrāṃ bhajatām| dharṣayatāmiti abhibhavatām| pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatāmityanenaiva viprādidharṣaṇe labdhe punastadvacanaṃ viśeṣārthapratipādakam| doṣadūṣyasaṅgrahamāha– vātādaya ityādi| vātādīnāṃ tritve pratīte'pi traya iti vacanaṃ sarvakuṣṭheṣu militānāmeva trayāṇāṃ duṣṭipradarśanārtham| dravyasaṅgraha iti dravyamārambhakaṃ kāraṇamucyate| yathā– “rasanārtho rasastasya dravyamāpaḥ kṣitistathā|” iti| arthalabdhamapi saptakamiti padaṃ sarvatra saptakaniyamārthaṃ punaruktam| nanu, visarpāṇāmapyutpattyādau etāvatyeva sāmagrī| yaduktam– “raktaṃ lasīkā tvaṅmāṃsaṃ dūṣyaṃ doṣāstrayo malāḥ| visarpāṇāṃ samutpattau vijñeyāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ||” iti| tatkuṣṭhavisarpayoḥ ko bhedaḥ? ucyate– kuṣṭhaṃ cirakriyaiḥ sthirairaprabalaraktapittairdoṣairjanyate, visarpastvaciravisaraṇaśīlaiḥ prabalaraktapittaiḥ, kuṣṭhe gurupradharṣaṇaparadravyāpahārādayo nimittaṃ, na visarpe| anye tvāhuḥ– visarpā vātādibhirekaikaśo'pi bhavanti, yaduktam– “pṛthaktrayastribhiścaiko visarpā dvandvajāstrayaḥ|” iti; kuṣṭhaṃ tridoṣajameveti| kintvayaṃ samādhiḥ tridoṣajatve'pi visarpāṇāmekadoṣakuṣṭhavadekadoṣajatvakīrtanaṃ saṅgatamiti na manoharam| kuṣṭhasaṅkhyāmāha– ata ityādi| ata ityasmāddoṣadūṣyasamudāyātsapta tathā ekādaśa kuṣṭhāni jāyante| sapta caikādaśaiveti vicchedapāṭhena saptānāṃ mahākuṣṭhatvamekadaśānāṃ kṣudratvamiti bodhayati||1-6|| kuṣṭhāni saptadhā doṣaiḥ pṛthagdvandvaiḥ samāgataiḥ | sarveṣvapi tridoṣeṣu vyapadeśo'dhikastvataḥ ||7|| (vā. ni. a. 14) | kuṣṭhānāṃ tridoṣajatve'pi ulbaṇadoṣeṇa saptaprakāratāmāha– kuṣṭhānītyādi| doṣaiḥ pṛthak trayaḥ, dvandvaistrayaḥ, samāgataiḥ sannipātaireka iti saptatvam| vyapadeśo'dhikaṃ tvataḥ iti yathā– vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālamityādi||7|| kuṣṭhānāṃ tridoṣajatve'pyudrekadoṣeṇa saptaprakāratvamāha– kuṣṭhānītyādi| kuṣṭhāni saptadhā saptaprakārāṇi, kathamityāha pṛthagdoṣaiḥ vātena, pittena, śleṣmaṇā, trīṇi; tathā taireva doṣairdvandvairvātapittābhyāṃ, vātakaphābhyāṃ, kaphapittābhyāṃ trīṇi, tathā taireva doṣaiḥ samāgataiḥ sannipatitairekam, iti saptatvam| nanvevaṃ satyekadoṣajaṃ dvidoṣajaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ tatsarvaṃ tridoṣajaṃ syādityāha– sarveṣvityādi| sarveṣvapi kuṣṭheṣu tridoṣajeṣu satsvadhikatvataḥ adhikatvādvyapadeśo nirdeśaḥ kāryaḥ, sannipātasya samaviṣamatvāt; yathā– vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālamityādi||7|| atiślakṣṇakharasparśasvedāsvedavivarṇatāḥ | dāhaḥ kaṇḍūstvaci svāpastodaḥ koṭhonnatirbhramaḥ ||8|| vraṇānāmadhikaṃ śūlaṃ śīghrotpattiścirasthitiḥ | rūḍhānāmapi rūkṣatvaṃ nimitta'lpe'tikopanam ||9|| romaharṣo'sṛjaḥ kārṣṇyaṃ kuṣṭhalakṣaṇamagrajam | (vā. ni. a. 14) | pūrvarūpamāha– atiślakṣṇetyādinā| atiślakṣṇaḥ atimasṛṇaḥ| kharo rūkṣaḥ (kharaḥ karkaśaḥ), atiślakṣṇo vā kharo vā sparśaḥ| svedāsvedau svedavahasroto'varodhānavarodhakṛtau| svāpaḥ sparśājñānam| koṭhonnatiḥ varaṭīdaṣṭasaṅkāśaḥ śothaḥ koṭhaḥ, tasyonnatiḥ| śīghrotpattiścirasthitiśca vraṇānāmeva| nimitte'lpe'tikopanamiti anyathā'pi duṣṭaśoṇitatvādvraṇānāṃ dehagatānāmalpe'pi hetau kopaḥ| kuṣṭhalakṣaṇamagrajamiti kuṣṭhānāṃ pūrvarūpamityarthaḥ||8-9||– pūrvarūpamāha– atītyādi| atiślakṣṇādikaṃ kuṣṭhalakṣaṇamaprajamiti kuṣṭhānāṃ pūrvarūpamityarthaḥ| atiślakṣṇa iti atimasṛṇaḥ, kharo rūkṣaḥ, atiślakṣṇo vā kharaḥ sparśaḥ| svedā'svedāviti svedavahasrotovarodhānavarodhakṛtau| vivarṇatā vaivarṇyaṃ, dāhaḥ sarvāṅgīṇaḥ, kaṇḍūḥ tvaci, svāpaḥ sparśājñatvaṃ, koṭhonnatiḥ varaṭīdaṃśasaṅkāśaḥ śophaḥ koṭhaḥ tasyonnatiḥ, śramo'nāyāsajaḥ| śīghrotpattiścirasthitiḥ vraṇānāmeva| alpe'pi nimitte kopo vraṇānām||8-9||– kṛṣṇāruṇakapālābhaṃ yadrūkṣaṃ paruṣaṃ tanu ||10|| kāpālaṃ todabahulaṃ tatkuṣṭhaṃ viṣamaṃ smṛtam | rugdāharāgakaṇḍūbhiḥ parītaṃ romapiñjaram ||11|| udumbaraphalābhāsaṃ kuṣṭhamaudumbaraṃ vadet | śvetaṃ raktaṃ sthiraṃ styānaṃ snigdhamutsannamaṇḍalam ||12|| kṛcchramanyonyasaṃyuktaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ maṇḍalamucyate | karkaśaṃ raktaparyantamantaḥśyāvaṃ savedanam ||13|| yadṛṣyajihvasaṃsthānamṛṣyajihvaṃ taducyate | saśvetaṃ raktaparyantaṃ puṇḍarīkadalopamam ||14|| sotsedhaṃ ca sarāgaṃ ca puṇḍarīkaṃ taducyate | śvetaṃ tāmraṃ tanu ca yadrajo ghṛṣṭaṃ vimuñcati ||15|| prāyaścorasi tat sidhmamalābukusumopamam | yat kākaṇantikāvarṇaṃ sapākaṃ tīvravedanam ||16|| tridoṣaliṅgaṃ tat kuṣṭhaṃ kākaṇaṃ naiva sidhyati | (ca. ci. a. 7) | saptamahākuṣṭhānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha– kṛṣṇāruṇakapālābhamityādi| kṛṣṇāruṇakapālābhaṃ kṛṣṇāruṇakapālavarṇaṃ, kapālaṃ kharparaśakalam| paruṣaṃ kharasparśam| tanu tanutvak, viṣamaṃ duścikitsyam| audumbaramāha– rugityādi| romapiñjaramiti romabhiḥ piñjaraṃ kapilaromamityarthaḥ| maṇḍalakuṣṭhamāha– śvetetyādi| sthiraṃ kaṭhinaṃ, styānamārdraṃ sajalaṃ vā| utsannamaṇḍalamudgatamaṇḍalam| kṛcchraṃ kṛcchrasādhyam| anyonyasaṃyuktamiti aparāparairmilitam| ṛṣyajihvamāha– karkaśamityādi| ṛṣyajihvasaṃsthānamiti ṛṣyo nīlāṇḍo hariṇaḥ, ‘robhu’ iti prasiddhaḥ, tasya jihvākāram| puṇḍarīkamāha– saśvetamityādi| puṇḍarīkadalopamamiti puṇḍarīkaṃ raktapadmaṃ tatpatropamaṃ, tena saśvetaṃ raktaparyantam| sarāgamiti salohitaṃ, madhye śvetalohitamityarthaḥ| sidhmalakṣaṇamāha– śvetamityādi| śvetaṃ tāmramiti śvetalohitātmakam| prāyaścorasītyurasi tadbāhulyena bhavati, kaphapradhānatvāt| prāyograhaṇādanyatrāpi bhavati| kākaṇamāha– yadityādi| yat kākaṇantikāvarṇamiti kākaṇantikā guñjā| guñjāsavarṇatvena ca madhye kṛṣṇamante raktam, athavā madhye raktamante kṛṣṇam| kuṣṭhatvenaiva tridoṣalakṣaṇatve siddhe tridoṣaliṅgamiti punaruktaṃ prabaladoṣatrayaliṅgatvopadarśanārtham| iti saptamahākuṣṭhāni| mahattvaṃ caiṣāṃ śīghramuttarottaradhātvavagāhanabahudoṣajatvakriyābhūyastvayogāt||10-16||– saptamahākuṣṭhānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha– kṛṣṇetyādi| kṛṣṇāruṇā ye sphuṭitaghaṭyāḥ khaṇḍāstadvarṇam, anye kṛṣṇāruṇakapālaśarkarāvarṇamāhuḥ| rūkṣaṃ rūkṣasparśaṃ, paruṣaṃ kharasparśam| tanu tanutvak, todabahulaṃ todāḍhyaṃ, viṣamaṃ duścikitsyam| audumbaraṃ kuṣṭhamāha– rugityādi| rugdāharāgakaṇḍūbhiryuktaṃ, romapiñjaramiti romabhiḥ piñjaraṃ kapilaroma ityarthaḥ| udumbaraphalābhāsaṃ pakvodumbaravarṇam| maṇḍalakuṣṭhamāha– śvetamityādi| evaṃvidhaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ maṇḍalasañjñayocyate, śvetaṃ raktaṃ tadābhāsaṃ, sthiraṃ kaṭhinaṃ, styānaṃ sāndraṃ sadalaṃ vā, utsannamaṇḍalaṃ unnatamaṇḍalaṃ, kṛcchraṃ kṛcchrasādhyaṃ, anyonyasaṃsaktamiti, parasparairmilitam| ṛkṣajihvamāha– karkaśamityādi| karkaśaṃ kharasparśam| ṛkṣo nīlāṇḍo hariṇa iti, anye ṛkṣaḥ ‘rīcha’ ityāhuḥ, tajjihvākāram| puṇḍarīkamāha– saśvetamiti| puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalaṃ, tasyopamaṃ, tena saśvetaṃ raktaparyantaṃ madhye śvetaṃ prānteṣu raktam| sotsedhamunnatam| sarāgamiti prānte'dhikarāgapratipādakaṃ, sarāgamityatra ‘sadāham’ iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ| sidhmalakṣaṇamāha– śvetamityādi| śvetaṃ tāmramiti śvetalohitātmakaṃ, tanu aghanaṃ, yat ghṛṣṭaṃ sadrajaścūrṇaṃ muñcatīti| prāyaścorasītyādi| urasi bāhulyena bhavati, kaphapradhānatvāt| prāyograhaṇādanyatrāpi boddhavyam| kākaṇamāha– yadityādi| kākaṇantikā guñjā, tatsamavarṇatvena madhye kṛṣṇamante'tiraktam, athavā raktamante kṛṣṇaṃ, tathā sapākaṃ, tathā tīvravedanaṃ, tathā tridoṣaliṅgaṃ, tat kākaṇākhyaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ naiva sidhyati| kuṣṭhatvenaiva tridoṣaliṅgatve siddhe tridoṣaliṅgamiti punaruktaṃ tat prabaladoṣatrayaliṅgopadarśanārtham| iti sapta mahākuṣṭhāni| mahattvaṃ caiṣāṃ śīghramuttarottaradhātvavagāhanabahuladoṣajanyatvakriyābhūyastvayogāt||10-16||– asvedanaṃ mahāvāstu yanmatsyaśakalopamam ||17|| tadekakuṣṭhaṃ, carmākhyaṃ bahalaṃ hasticarmavat | śyāvaṃ kiṇakharasparśaṃ paruṣaṃ kiṭibhaṃ smṛtam ||18|| vaipādikaṃ pāṇipādasphuṭanaṃ tīvravedanam | kaṇḍūmadbhiḥ sarāgaiścaḥ gaṇḍairalasakaṃ citam ||19|| sakaṇḍūrāgapiḍakaṃ dadrumaṇḍalamudgatam | raktaṃ saśūlaṃ kaṇḍūmat sasphoṭaṃ yadgalatyapi | taccarmadalamākhyātaṃ saṃsparśāsahamucyate ||20|| (ca. ci. a. 7) | sūkṣmā bahvyaḥ piḍakāḥ srāvavatyaḥ pāmetyuktāḥ kaṇḍumatyaḥ sadāhāḥ | saiva sphoṭaistīvradāhairupetā jñeyā pāṇyoḥ kacchurugrā sphicośca ||21|| sphoṭāḥ śyāvāruṇābhāsā visphoṭāḥ syustanutvacaḥ | raktaṃ śyāvaṃ sadāhārti śatāruḥ syādbahuvraṇam ||22|| sakaṇḍūḥ piḍakā śyāvā bahusrāvā vicarcikā | (ca. ci. a. 7) | ataḥ paramekādaśakṣudrakuṣṭhānyucyante– asvedanamityādi| mahāvāstu mahāsthānam| matsyaśakalopamamiti matsyasya tvaksadṛśam| carmākhyaṃ carmakuṣṭham| bahalamapattalam| kiṭibhamāha– śyāvamityādi| kiṇakharasparśamiti kiṇo vraṇasthānam| paruṣaṃ rūkṣam| vaipādikamiti vipādikāyāḥ svārthe'ṇ| alasakamāha– kaṇḍūmadbhirityādi| gaṇḍairiti sphoṭaiḥ| dadrumaṇḍalamāha– kaṇḍvityādi| dadrumaṇḍalamiti maṇḍalarūpatayotpādāt dadrumaṇḍalamiti kīrtanam| nanu, kathamasya carake kṣudratvenābhidhānaṃ, suśrute mahākuṣṭhe dadroruktatvāt; tathā sidhma carake mahākuṣṭhe, suśrute kṣudrakuṣṭhe darśitam| ucyate– asitā dadruravagāḍhamūlā suśrute mahākuṣṭham, asitetaradadruścarake'navagāḍhamūlā kṣudrakuṣṭhaṃ, suśrute asitetaradadrvā visarpakuṣṭhe'ntarbhāvaḥ, visarpaṇayogāt; tathā'vagāḍhaṃ sidhma carake mahākuṣṭhaṃ, sidhmapuṣpikā tu tvaṅmātragatā suśrute kṣudrakuṣṭham; asitadadrau asitasidhmano'varodha iti gadādharaḥ| jejjaṭastvāha– carakoktaṃ sidhmaiva suśrute dadruśabdābhihitaṃ, nāmabhedaḥ kevalaṃ paraṃ na vastubhedaḥ, santi hyarthāntarāṇi samānaśabdābhihitānītyavirodhaḥ| kintviyamasādhvī vyākhyā, lakṣaṇavailakṣaṇyāt; kiñca carakasuśrutayoḥ kuṣṭhaṃ prati bahuprakāro virodhaḥ, tathāhi suśrutoktamaruṇaṃ na carake paṭhyate, maṇḍalaṃ carakoktaṃ na suśrute, kṣudrakuṣṭhe carakoktacarmākhyālasakaśatāruprabhṛtīni na suśrute, suśrutoktakṣudrakuṣṭhālasakādayaśca na carake; tasmādayaṃ samādhirucitaḥ– kuṣṭhānāmasaṅkhyeyatvamiti kecit carake, kecit suśrute kuṣṭhaprakārā ucyante| uktaṃ hi carake– “kuṣṭhaṃ saptavidham,
