karkaśaḥ)|’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . atra ‘atha vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 10 . ‘bhramaḥ’ ityatra ‘śramaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘śarkarāśakalam’ iti pā., ‘karkarāśakalam’ iti ca pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘audumbaramāha– rugityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 13 . ‘maṇḍalakuṣṭhamāha– śvetetyādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 14 . ‘styānaṃ sāndraṃ sadalaṃ vā|’ iti pā.| ↩ 15 . ‘ṛṣyajihvamāha– karkaśamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 16 . ‘‘robhu’ iti prasiddhaḥ,’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 17 . ‘puṇḍarīkamāha– saśvetamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 18 . ‘saśvetalohitamityarthaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 19 . ‘sidhmalakṣaṇamāha– śvetamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 20 . ‘kākaṇamāha– yadityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 21 . ‘tridoṣajalakṣaṇatve’ iti pā.| ↩ 22 . ayamevameva pāṭhamūrīkaroti| ↩ 23 . ‘aparāparairmilitam’ iti pā.| ↩ 24 . ‘yadṛkṣajihvasaṃsthānamṛkṣajihvam’ iti pā.| ↩ 25 . ‘tat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 26 . ‘kiṭṭibham’ iti pā., ‘kiṭṭimam’ iti pā., ‘kiṭimam’ iti vā pā. | ↩ 27 . ‘dalayatyapi’ iti pā. | ↩ 28 . ‘bahulamapattalam’ iti pā.| ↩ 29 . ‘kiṭibhamāha– śyāvamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 30 . ‘alasakamāha– kaṇḍūmadbhirityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 31 . ‘dadrumaṇḍalamāha– kaṇḍvityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 32 . ‘suśrutoktakṣudrakuṣṭhārakasādayaśca’ iti pā.| ↩ 33 . ‘carmadalamāha– raktamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 34 . ‘śatārumāha– raktetyādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 35 . ‘vicarcikāmāha– sakaṇḍvityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 36 . ‘kacchurna’ iti pā.| ↩ 37 . ‘tatraiva kuṣṭhamāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 38 . atra ‘yad’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 39 . ‘mahāsthānam’ iti pā.| ↩ 40 . etādṛśapāṭhābhiprāyeṇa| ↩ 41 . ‘pādayorbhavati’ iti pā.| ↩ 42 . ‘bhavati’ iti pā.| ↩ 43 . ‘na’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 44 . ‘prakuthitam’ iti pā. | ↩ 45 . upalabdhacarakasaṃhitāmūle ‘punaśca’ iti pā.| ↩ 46 . upalabdhacarakasaṃhitāmūle ‘tairheturhetustāṃśca’ iti pā., madhukośavyākhyāpratiṣu tu ‘tairhetubhistāṃśca’ iti pā., ‘te hetuṃ hetustāṃśca’ iti ca pā.| ↩ 47 . atra ‘vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 48 . ‘yuktaṃ ca kaphāt’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 49 . ‘viśeṣaṇam’ iti pā.| ↩ 50 . ‘vidhiranyatrāpyāśaṅkanīyaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 51 . ‘carmaikakuṣṭhaṃ kiṭibhādi varjyam’ iti pā.| ↩ 52 . ‘śukrasya tadgatasya ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 53 . yaduktam– “kuṣṭheṣu caiva sarveṣu pañcakarmāṇi kārayet| pakṣe pakṣe ca vamanaṃ, māsi māsi virecanam| ṣaṇmāsena sirāmokṣo, nasyaṃ saptadināntaram||” iti kvacitpustake'dhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | ↩ 54 . ‘carmaikakuṣṭhakiṭṭibha ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 55 . ‘prasrāvayuktaṃ śarīram’ iti pā.| ↩ 56 . ‘hetulabdhalakṣaṇa ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 57 . ‘dhātutrayamātratvenaikadoṣajatvena’ iti pā.| ↩ 58 . ‘varṇenāruṇatāmraśvetena’ iti pā.| ↩ 59 . atra ‘śukravidhāḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 60 . ‘sakaṇḍu ca’ iti pā.| ↩ 61 . ‘aśuklaromabahula ... ’ iti pā. | ↩ 62 . ‘anyathokta ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 63 . ‘yatparasparato'bhinnaṃ bahu yadraktalomavat’ iti vartamānacarakapratiṣu pāṭhaḥ| ↩ 64 . ‘aupasargikaromāḥ śītalikādayaḥ’ iti ḍalhaṇaḥ| ↩ 65 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ kuṣṭhanidānam||49||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 50. śītapittodardakoṭhanidānam
text: atha śītapittodarda-koṭhanidānam | śītamārutasaṃsparśāt praduṣṭau kaphamārutau | pittena saha sambhūya bahirantarvisarpataḥ ||1|| tvagduṣṭidoṣatrayajanyatvasāmānyāt kuṣṭhānantaraṃ śītapittodardādinidānam| tasya doṣatrayajanyatvamāha– śītamārutasaṃsparśādityādi| pittena saha sambhūyeti svahetūpacitena pittena sambhūya militvā| bahirantariti bahistvaci, antaḥ śoṇitādau; visarpataḥ prasarataḥ||1|| tvagduṣṭidoṣatrayajanyatvasāmānyātkuṣṭhānantaraṃ śītapittādinidānam| tasya doṣatrayajanyatvamāha– śītetyādi| praduṣṭau kupitau kaphamārutau svahetūpacitena pittena saha militvā, bahistvaci, antaḥ śoṇitādau, visarpataḥ prasarataḥ||1|| pipāsārucihṛllāsadehasādāṅgagauravam | raktalocanatā teṣāṃ pūrvarūpasya lakṣaṇam ||2|| pūrvarūpamāha– pipāsetyādi| raktalocanatā prabhāvāt| pūrvarūpasya lakṣaṇamiti pūrvarūpasya svarūpamityarthaḥ; na tu lakṣaṇamatra liṅgaṃ, pipāsādivyatiriktasya pūrvarūpasyābhāvāt||2|| tasya pūrvarūpamāha– pipāsetyādi| atra raktalocanatā prabhāvāt| pūrvarūpasya lakṣaṇamiti pūrvarūpasyopalambhanaṃ, na tu lakṣaṇaṃ liṅgaṃ; pipāsādivyatiriktasya pūrvarūpasyābhāvāt||2|| varaṭīdaṣṭasaṃsthānaḥ śothaḥ sañjāyate bahiḥ | sakaṇḍūstodabahulaśchardijvaravidāhavān ||3|| udardamiti taṃ vidyācchītapittamathāpare | vātādhikaṃ śītapittamudardastu kaphādhikaḥ ||4|| udardalakṣaṇamāha– varaṭītyādi| sakaṇḍūstodabahulaśchardijvaravidāhavāniti atra kaṇḍūḥ kaphāt, todo vātāt, chardijvaravidāhāḥ pittāditi doṣatrayaliṅgam| anayoḥ śītapittodardayoḥ samānasaṃsthānatve'pi vātādhikaṃ śītapittaṃ, kaphādhika udardaḥ||3-4|| udardalakṣaṇamāha– varaṭītyādi| varaṭī kīṭaviśeṣaḥ, taddaṣṭasadṛśākāraḥ, bahiḥ śarīre śotho jāyate| atra kaṇḍūḥ kaphāt, todo vātāt, chardijvaravidāhāḥ pittāditi doṣatrayaliṅgam; apare śītapittamityāhuḥ| anayordoṣadvayādhikatvamāha– vātādhikamityādi| anayoḥ śītapittodardayoḥ samānasaṃsthānatve'pi vātādhikaṃ śītapittaṃ, kaphādhika udardaḥ||3-4|| sotsaṅgaiśca sarāgaiśca kaṇḍūmadbhiśca maṇḍalaiḥ | śaiśiraḥ kaphajo vyādhirudarda iti kīrtitaḥ ||5|| udardasya dharmāntaramāha– sotsaṅgairityādi| utsaṅgaiḥ madhyanimnaiḥ| śaiśira iti śiśirasambhavaḥ||5|| udardasya dharmāntaramāha– sotsaṅgairityādi| madhyanimnaiḥ, śaiśiraḥ śiśirasambhavaḥ||5|| asamyagvamanodīrṇapittaśleṣmānnanigrahaiḥ | maṇḍalāni sakaṇḍūni rāgavanti bahūni ca | utkoṭhaḥ sānubandhaśca koṭha ityabhidhīyate ||6|| tvagduṣṭisāmyādatraiva koṭho'bhidhīyate– asamyagvamanetyādi| asamyaktvaṃ vamanasyāyogamithyāyogādinā, tathodīrṇānāṃ pittaśleṣmānnānāṃ nigraho vegavidhāraṇaṃ, tairmaṇḍalāni jāyante, sa koṭhaḥ| athavā'yamarthaḥ– asamyagvamanodīrṇau pittaśleṣmāṇau, tathā'nnanigraha upasthitavegasyānnasya nigrahaḥ chardinigrahaḥ iti yāvat, tairhetubhirbhavanti| vamanasya cāsamyaktvamayogamithyāyogābhyāṃ jñeyam, atiyogasya tu pittaśleṣmakoṭhākaratvāt| etena hetulakṣaṇabhedādbhinnaḥ koṭha udardāt| koṭho niranubandhaḥ| tathā coktam– “kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ|” iti sānubandha utkoṭho'bhidhīyate| sānubandhatā ca punaḥpunarbhavanena||6|| tvagdoṣasāmānyādatraiva koṭhaḥ procyate| sānubandha utkoṭho'bhidhīyate| asamyaktvaṃ vamanasyāyogamithyāyogādinā, udīrṇāni preritāni pittaśleṣmānnāni, teṣāṃ nigrahaiḥ śarīre maṇḍalāni vartulakamalādīni atikaṇḍumanti lauhityayuktāni bahūni ca jāyante, athavā'yamevārthaḥ– asamyagvamanenodīrṇau pittaśleṣmāṇau, tathā'nnanigrahaḥ upasthitavegasyānnasya nigrahaḥ chardinigraha iti yāvat, tairbhavanti| vamanasya cāsamyaktvamayogamithyāyogābhyāṃ jñeyam, atiyogasya pittaśleṣmakopakatvāt, etena hetulakṣaṇabhedādbhinnaḥ koṭha udardāditi| koṭho niranubandhaḥ, tathā coktam– “kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ” iti| sānubandha utkoṭho'bhidhīyate| sānubandhatā ca punaḥpunarbhavaneneti||6|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne śītapittodardakoṭhānidānaṃ samāptam ||50|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śītapittodardakoṭhanidānaṃ samāptam||50|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ śītapittodardakoṭhanidānam||50|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘pipāsādervyatiriktasya’ iti pā.| ↩ 2 . ‘pittaśleṣmakopakatvāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . atra ‘sānubandhatā ca punaḥpunarbhavatveneti| tathā coktam– “kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ” iti sānubandha utkoṭho'bhidhīyate|’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 4 . agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 5 . agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 6 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ śītapittodardakoṭhanidānam||50||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 51. amlapittanidānam
text: athāmlapittanidānam | viruddhaduṣṭāmlavidāhipittaprakopipānānnabhujo vidagdham | pittaṃ svahetūpacitaṃ purā yattadamlapittaṃ pravadanti santaḥ ||1|| koṭhahetau pittaśleṣmollekhāt pittaśleṣmamilanarūpasyāmlapittasya nidānam| nidānapūrvakamamlapittasya svarūpamāha– viruddhetyādi| viruddhaṃ kṣīramatsyādi, duṣṭaṃ vyāpannamannaṃ; vidāhisthāne vidagdheti pāṭhāntare vidagdhaṃ bharjitaṃ; pittaprakopipānānnabhuja iti pittaprakopi pānaṃ takrasurādi, annamāśudhānyamāṣādi; pittaprakopipānānnagrahaṇenaivāmlavidāhino grahaṇe siddhe tadabhidhānaṃ viśeṣārthaṃ; ‘pittaprakopaṇādyannabhuja’ iti pāṭhāntare ādiśabdāt kaphādiprakopaṇamannaṃ gṛhyate| evaṃvidhapānānnamupabhuñjānasya vidagdhaṃ kupitaṃ, svahetūpacitaṃ purā yaditi varṣāsu jalauṣadhigatavidāhādibhiḥ svahetubhirupacitaṃ sañcayamāpannam| yaduktam– “varṣāsvamlavipākitvādadbhirauṣadhibhistathā|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| vidāhādyamlaguṇodriktaṃ pittamamlapittam||1|| koṭhahetau pittakaphollekhāt pittakaphamilitarūpasyāmlapittasyāto'nantaraṃ nidānam| tatra nidānapūrvakamamlapittasya svarūpamāha– viruddhetyādi| viruddhaṃ kṣīramatsyādi, duṣṭaṃ vyāpannamannam| vidāhisthāne ‘vidagdha’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatra vidagdhaṃ bharjitam| pittaprakopipānānnabhuja iti pittaprakopi pānaṃ takrasurādi, annamāśudhānyamāṣādi, ‘pittaprakopaṇādyannabhujaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare ādiśabdāt kaphādiprakopaṇamannaṃ gṛhyate, evaṃvidhapānānnaṃ bhuñjānasya vidagdhaṃ kupitaṃ, svahetūpacitaṃ purā yaditi varṣāsu jalauṣadhigatavidāhādibhirhetubhiḥ upacitaṃ sañcayamāpannaṃ, yaduktam– “varṣāsvamlavipākitvādadbhiroṣadhibhistathā” iti| pittaprakopipānānnagrahaṇenaivāmlavidāhino grahaṇe siddhe tadabhidhānaṃ viśeṣārtham||1|| avipākaklamotkleśatiktāmlodgāragauravaiḥ | hṛtkaṇṭhadāhārucibhiścāmlapittaṃ vadedbhiṣak ||2|| tasya liṅgamāha– avipāketyādi| avipāka ityāhārāpākaḥ, klamo'nāyāsajaḥ śramaḥ| amlapitte pittaṃ pradhānaṃ, vātakaphāvapyatrānugau gauravodgārakampādinā jñeyau||2|| tasya liṅgamāha– avipāketyādi| avipākaḥ āhārāpākaḥ, klamo'nāyāsajaḥ śramaḥ, amlapitte pittaṃ pradhānaṃ, vātakaphāvapyatrānugau gauravodgārakampādinā jñeyau||2|| tṛḍdāhamūrchābhramamohakāri prayātyadho vā vividhaprakāram | hṛllāsakoṭhānalasādaharṣasvedāṅgapītatvakaraṃ kadācit ||3|| tasya kadācidadha-ūrdhvagamanabhedāddvividhasyādhogatiṃ tāvadāha– tṛḍdāhetyādi| mūrchā sarvathā jñānaśūnyatvaṃ, moho viparītajñānam| prayātyadho vetyatra vāśabdo bhāvyūrdhvagamanāpekṣayā| vividhaprakāramiti haritpītakṛṣṇaraktādibahuvarṇatvadurgandhitvayogānnānāvidham| kadāciditi na sarvakālam||3|| tasya kadācit kāyordhvādhogamanabhedādvividhasyādhogatiṃ tāvadāha– tṛḍityādi| adho vividhaprakāraṃ kadācitprayāti, tathā tṛḍdāhādikāri, tathā hṛllāsādikaraṃ, mūrchā sarvathā jñānaśūnyatvaṃ, moho'tra viparītaṃ jñānam| prayātyadho vetyatra vāśabdo bhāvyūrdhvagamanāpekṣayā; vividhaprakāramiti haritapītakṛṣṇaraktādibahuvarṇatvadurgandhitvayogānnānāvidham| kadāciditi na sarvakālam||3|| vāntaṃ haritpītakanīlakṛṣṇamāraktaraktābhamatīva cāmlam | māṃsodakābhaṃ tvatipicchilācchaṃ śleṣmānujātaṃ vividhaṃ rasena ||4|| bhukte vidagdhe tvathavā'pyabhukte karoti tiktāmlavamiṃ kadācit | udgāramevaṃvidhameva kaṇṭhahṛtkukṣidāhaṃ śiraso rujaṃ ca ||5|| karacaraṇadāhamauṣṇyaṃ mahatīmaruciṃ jvaraṃ ca kaphapittam | janayati kaṇḍūmaṇḍalapiḍakāśatanicitagātrarogacayam ||6|| ūrdhvagatimāha– vāntamityādi| nīlaṃ snigdhakṛṣṇaṃ, kṛṣṇaṃ mardanāñjanavadrūkṣakṛṣṇam, āraktamīṣallohitaṃ, raktamantarlohitam| māṃsodakābhamiti māṃsadhāvanatoyābhaṃ kṛṣṇalohitamityarthaḥ| vividhaṃ raseneti rasena lavaṇakaṭutiktākhyena nānārūpam| karoti tiktāmlavamimiti tiktasya amlasya vā vamiṃ vāntiṃ karoti| udgāramevaṃvidhameveti atra karotīti sambadhyate, evaṃvidhamiti amlatiktam| kaṇṭhahṛtkukṣidāhaṃ śiraso rujaṃ ceti atrāpi karotīti sambadhyate| karacaraṇetyādi– kaṇḍūmaṇḍalapiḍakāśatanicitagātrarogacayamiti kaṇḍvādinicitagātraṃ ca rogacayaṃ ceti dvandvaḥ, tena kaṇḍvādinicitagātraṃ rogacayaṃ karotītyarthaḥ; rogacayo'vipākotkleśādiḥ||4-6|| ūrdhvagatimāha– vāntamityādi| harit śākapatrābham, nīlaṃ cāṣapakṣaprabhaṃ snigdhakṛṣṇaṃ, kṛṣṇam añjanābham, āraktam īṣallohitaṃ, raktam atyantalohitaṃ, māṃsodakābhaṃ māṃsadhāvanatoyābham, acchaṃ nirmalam| vividhaṃ rasena lavaṇakaṭutiktākhyenānurūpaṃ karoti| āhārasyāvasthāmāha– bhukta ityādi| bhukte āhāre vidagdhe athavā kadācidabhukte'pi sati tiktāmlavamiṃ karotīti sambadhyate| amlapitte kaphapittavatsāmānyamāha– karetyādi| kaphapittaṃ karacaraṇadāhādikaṃ janayati, tathā kaṇḍūmaṇḍalapiḍakācitagātraroganicayamiti kaṇḍvādinicitagātraṃ ca roganicayaśceti dvandvaḥ| tena kaṇḍvādinicitagātraṃ rogacayaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| rogacayaḥ avipākotkleśādiḥ||4-6|| rogo'yamamlapittākhyo yatnāt saṃsādhyate navaḥ | cirotthito bhavedyāpyaḥ, kṛcchrasādhyaḥ sa kasyacit ||7|| sādhyatvādikamāha– roga ityādi| kṛcchrasādhyaḥ sa kasyaciditi ahitāhārācāraśīlinaḥ kasyaciccirotthito'pi kṛcchrasādhyaḥ||7|| sādhyatvādikamāha– roga ityādi| ayamamlapittākhyo rogo navaḥ san yatnātsaṃsādhyate, cirotthito yāpyo bhavet| kasyacidityādi| ahitāhārācāraśīlinaḥ kasyaciccirotthito'pi kṛcchrasādhya ityarthaḥ||7|| sānilaṃ sānilakaphaṃ sakaphaṃ tacca lakṣayet | doṣaliṅgena matimān bhiṣaṅmohakaraṃ hi tat ||8|| kampapralāpamūrchācimicimigātrāvasādaśūlāni | tamaso darśanavibhramavimohaharṣāṇyanilakopāt ||9|| kaphaniṣṭhīvanagauravajaḍatāruciśītasādavamilepāḥ | dahanabalasādakaṇḍūnidrāścihnaṃ kaphānugate ||10|| ubhayamidameva cihnaṃ mārutakaphasambhave bhavatyamle | tiktāmlakaṭukodgārahṛtkukṣikaṇṭhadāhakṛt ||11|| bhramo mūrchāruciśchardirālasyaṃ ca śirorujā | praseko mukhamādhuryaṃ śleṣmapittasya lakṣaṇam ||12|| tatraiva kevalānilakaphānilakaphamātrāṇāṃ saṃsargamāha– sānilamityādi| bhiṣaṅmohakaramiti tasyordhvādhaḥpravartamānatvena chardyatīsārābhyāṃ sakāśādbhedasya durjñeyatvāt vaidyamohakaratvam| kaphetyādi– sādavamilepā ityatra sādo'ṅgasādaḥ, lepaḥ śleṣmaliptāsyatā| dahanabalasādeti sādaśabdo dahanabalābhyāṃ sambadhyate||8-12|| tasminnanilakaphasaṃsargamāha– sānilamityādi| taccāmlapittaṃ sānilaṃ savātaṃ, sānilakaphaṃ savātakaphaṃ lakṣayet| doṣaliṅgena vātapittakaphaliṅgenetyarthaḥ| yatastadbhiṣaṅmohakaraṃ vaidyabhrāntijanakaṃ, tasyordhvādhaḥpravartamānatvena chardyatīsārābhyāṃ bhedasya durjñeyatvāt| sānilasyāmlapittasya lakṣaṇamāha– kampetyādi| vātayute'mle kampādayastathā tamodarśanādayo bhavanti| kaphānugatasya lakṣaṇamāha– kaphetyādi| kaphānugate'mle kaphaniṣṭhīvanādiliṅgaṃ syāt| sādavamilepā iti sādaḥ aṅgasādaḥ, lepaḥ kaphaliptāsyatā| dahanabalasādeti sādaśabdo dahanabalābhyāṃ sambandhyate, anyatsugamam||8-12|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne'mlapittanidānaṃ samāptam ||51|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāmlapittanidānaṃ samāptam||51|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāmamlapittanidānam||51|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘ ... roganicayam’ iti pā. | ↩ 2 . ‘raktābhamantarlohitam’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘vāntim’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 4 . ‘amlapittam’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘roganicayam’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘roganicayo ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘roganicayaḥ ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘roganicayaḥ ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘darśanavibhramapramohaharṣāṇyanilakopāt’ iti pā., ‘darśanavibhramaharṣaṇamohāśca vātayute’ iti vā pā. | ↩ 10 . ‘kevalānilakaphamilitānilakaphamātrāṇām’ iti pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘durjñānatvāt vaidyasya mohakaratvam|’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘kaphetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 13 . ‘durjñānatvāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 14 . ‘vibhramaharṣaṇamohāśca vātayute’ iti pā.| ↩ 15 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāmamlapittanidānam||51||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 52. visarpanidānam
text: atha visarpanidānam | lavaṇāmlakaṭūṣṇādisaṃsevādoṣakopataḥ | visarpaḥ saptadhā jñeyaḥ sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt ||1|| pṛthak trayastribhiścaiko visarpā dvandvajāstrayaḥ | vātikaḥ paittikaścaiva kaphajaḥ sānnipātikaḥ ||2|| catvāra ete vīsarpā vakṣyante dvandvajāstrayaḥ | āgneyo vātapittābhyāṃ granthyākhyaḥ kaphavātajaḥ ||3|| yastu kardamako ghoraḥ sa pittakaphasambhavaḥ |4| (ca. ci. a. 21) | amlapittasambhavacchardervegavidhāraṇādraktaduṣṭau satyāṃ visarpotpatterhetusāmyāt tadanantaraṃ visarpanidānam| chardivegavighātasya raktadūṣakatve carakavacanaṃ yathā– “ chardivegapratīghātāt kāle cānavasevanāt| śaratkālaprabhāvācca śoṇitaṃ sampraduṣyati||” (ca. sū. a. 24) iti| tasya nidānapūrvikāṃ saṅkhyāṃ niruktiṃ cāha– lavaṇāmletyādi| “visarpo na hyasaṃsṛṣṭo raktapittena lakṣyate|” iti vacanāt lavaṇāmlādikaṃ viśeṣeṇa raktapittanidānamuktam| saṃsevayā satatasevayā doṣakopaḥ saṃsevāddoṣakopastataḥ| atra, ādigrahaṇāt carakoktānāṃ haritaśākaśiṇḍākīprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam| saptadheti ulbaṇaikaikadoṣajāstrayaḥ, sannipātaja ekaḥ, trayo dvandvajāḥ, iti saptaprakāratvamuktam| sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāditi sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt parisarpaḥ, vividhaṃ sarpāṇādvisarpaḥ| yaduktaṃ carake– “vividhaṃ sarpati yato visarpastena sa smṛtaḥ| parisarpo'thavā nāmnā sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt||” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti||1-3||– amlapittasambhavacchardervegavighātādraktaduṣṭau satyāṃ visarpotpatterhetusāmānyāccānantaraṃ visarpanidānamāha– chardivegavighātasya ca raktadūṣakatve carakavacanaṃ yathā– “chardivegavighātāttu kāle cānavasevanāt| śaratkālasvabhāvācca śoṇitaṃ sampraduṣyati||” iti| tasya nidānapūrvikāṃ saṅkhyāṃ niruktiṃ cāha– lavaṇetyādi| lavaṇādibhirvisarpo rogo bhavati, sa saptadhā jñeyaḥ| “visarpo na hyasaṃsṛṣṭo raktapittena” iti vacanāllavaṇādikaṃ viśeṣeṇa raktapittanidānamuktam| eṣāṃ santatasevayā doṣakopaḥ| ādigrahaṇāccarakaktaharitaśākaśiṇḍākīprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam| sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt parisarpaḥ, vividhaṃ sarpatīti visarpaḥ| yaduktaṃ carake– “vividhaṃ sarpati yato visarpastena sa smṛtaḥ| parisarpo'tha vā nāmnā sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt||” iti| saṅkhyāsamprāptimāha– pṛthaktrayastribhiścaiko visarpā dvandvajāstraya ityādi sugamam| āgneya ityādisugamam||1-3|| raktaṃ lasīkā tvaṅmāṃsaṃ dūṣyaṃ doṣāstrayo malāḥ ||4|| visarpāṇāṃ samutpattau vijñeyāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ | (ca. ci. a. 21) tatra vātāt sa vīsarpo vātajvarasamavyathaḥ ||5|| śothasphuraṇanistodabhedāyāsārtiharṣavān | pittāddrutagatiḥ pittajvaraliṅgo'tilohitaḥ ||6|| kaphāt kaṇḍūyutaḥ snigdhaḥ kaphajvarasamānaruk | (vā. ni. a. 13) | sannipātasamutthaśca sarvaliṅgasamanvitaḥ ||7|| sarveṣāmeva raktādidūṣyacatuṣṭayadoṣatrayajanyatvamāha– raktamityādi| visarpasya samānasāmagrīkatve'pi kuṣṭhādbhedaḥ kuṣṭhādhyāye eva nirūpitaḥ| doṣaśabdenaiva vātādigrahaṇe siddhe malā iti yat kṛtaṃ, tadatyarthaduṣṭyā śarīramalinīkaraṇatvaṃ doṣāṇāṃ pratipādayitum| sannipātaje'sādhyatvamapi “sarvātmakaḥ kṣatakṛtaśca na siddhimeti|” (su. ni. a. 10) iti vacanāt| tena vikṛtiviṣamasamavetatvamasya| carake tvantarjabahirjabhedena visarpaḥ paṭhitaḥ| yadāha– “marmopaghātāt sammohādayanānāṃ vighaṭṭanāt| tṛṣṇātiyogādvegānāṃ viṣamaṃ ca pravartanāt|| vidyādvisarpamantarjamāśu cāgnibalakṣayāt| ato viparyayādbāhyamanyaṃ vidyāt svalakṣaṇaiḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti||4-7|| sarveṣāmeva raktādidūṣyacatuṣṭayajanyatvamāha– raktamityādi| visarpasya samānasāmagrīkatve'pi kuṣṭhādbhedaḥ kuṣṭhādhyāya eva nirūpitaḥ, doṣagrahaṇenaiva vātādigrahaṇe siddhe malā iti yat kṛtaṃ tadatyarthaduṣṭyā śarīramalinīkaraṇatvaṃ doṣāṇāṃ pratipādayitum| lasīkājalaṃ, tvakśabdenātra rasasya saptadhātuṣu klṛptatvāt| vātajaṃ visarpamāha– tatretyādi| vātajvarasamavyatha iti ‘vepathurviṣamo vegaḥ’ ityādikaḥ| nistodaḥ śūlena tudyata iva, bhedo vidīryata iva, artiḥ pīḍā, āyāmo vistāravān, harṣo romaharṣaḥ| paittikamāha– pittādityādi| drutagatiḥ śīghragatiḥ| pittajvaraliṅga iti “vegastīkṣṇo'tisāraḥ” ityādikaḥ| atilohito'tiriktaḥ| kaphajamāha– kaphādityādi| kaphajvarasamāna iti “staimityaṃ stimito vegaḥ” ityādikaḥ| sānnipātikamāha– sannipātetyādi| sarvadoṣalakṣaṇairyukta ityarthaḥ| sannipātaje'sādhyatvamuktaṃ “sarvātmakaḥ kṣatakṛtaśca na siddhimeti” iti vacanāt| tena vikṛtiviṣamasamavetatvamasya| carake tvantarjabahirjabhedena visarpaḥ paṭhitaḥ| yadāha– “marmopatāpātsammohādayanānāṃ ca ghaṭṭanāt| tṛṣṇātiyogādvegānāṃ viṣamaṃ ca pravartanāt| vidyādvisarpamantarjamāśu cāgnibalakṣayāt| ato viparyayādbāhyamanyadvidyātsvalakṣaṇaiḥ||” iti||4-7|| vātapittājjvaracchardimūrchātīsāratṛḍbhramaiḥ | granthibhedāgnisadanatamakārocakairyutaḥ ||8|| karoti sarvamaṅgaṃ ca dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavat | yaṃ yaṃ deśaṃ visarpaśca visarpati bhavet sa saḥ ||9|| śāntāṅgārāsito nīlo rakto vā''śu ca cīyate | agnidagdha iva sphoṭaiḥ śīghragatvāddrutaṃ sa ca ||10|| marmānusārī vīsarpaḥ syādvāto'tibalastataḥ | vyathate'ṅgaṃ haret sañjñāṃ nidrāṃ ca śvāsamīrayet ||11|| hikkāṃ ca sa gato'vasthāmīdṛśīṃ labhate na nā | kvaciccharmāratigrasto bhūmiśayyāsanādiṣu ||12|| ceṣṭamānastataḥ kliṣṭo manodehapramohavān | duṣprabodho'śnute nidrāṃ so'gnivīsarpa ucyate ||13|| (vā. ni. a. 13) | āgneyavisarpamāha– vātapittādityādinā| dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavaditi jvaladaṅgāreṇaiva vyāptamaṅgaṃ manyate| śāntāṅgārāsita iti nirvāṇāṅgāravat kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ sa deśo bhavati| nīlo rakto veti sa deśaḥ snigdhanīlo rakto vā bhavati| agnidagdha iveti agnidagdhadeśa iva| śīghragatvāditi śīghrakāritvāt| marmānusārī hṛdayādyanusārī| vyathate'ṅgamityatrāntarbhāvito ṇyarthaḥ, tena vyathayatītyarthaḥ| nidrāṃ cetyatra harediti sambadhyate| śarma sukham| duṣprabodho'śnute nidrāmiti nidrāṃ maraṇarūpāṃ prāpnoti||8-13|| vātapittajamāgneyākhyaṃ visarpamāha– vātapittāditi| vātapittajo'yaṃ sañjñeyaḥ| jvarādibhirupadravairyutaḥ| dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavaditi jvaladaṅgāreṇeva vyāptamaṅgaṃ manyate| śāntāṅgārāsita iti nirvāṇāṅgāravatkṛṣṇavarṇaḥ, nīlaḥ cāṣapakṣivadvā rakto vā sa deśo bhavati| agnidagdha iveti āśu śīghramagnidagdha iva sphoṭairupacīyate vṛddhiṃ nīyate, śīghragatvāt śīghrakāritvāt, drutaṃ śīghraṃ, sa visarpaḥ, marmānusārī hṛdayānusārī, atīva balavān vātaḥ| vyathate'ṅgamiti atrāntarbhāvito ṇyarthaḥ, tena vyathayatītyarthaḥ| nidrāṃ sañjñāṃ ca harennāśayet| śvāsaṃ hikkāṃ ca īrayet prakopayet| īdṛśīmavasthāṃ gato nā puruṣaḥ, kvaciccharma sukhaṃ na prāpnoti, keṣu bhūmiśayyāsanādiṣu, svataḥ ātmanaiva, kliṣṭaḥ pīḍitaḥ, ceṣṭamāno viddhatāṃ ceṣṭāṃ kuryāt, duḥkhaprabodhaḥ manodehaśramodbhavāṃ nidrāṃ maraṇarūpām, aśnute prāpnoti||8-13|| kaphena ruddhaḥ pavano bhittvā taṃ bahudhā kapham | raktaṃ vā vṛddharaktasya tvaksirāsnāyumāṃsagam ||14|| dūṣayitvā tu dīrghāṇuvṛttasthūlakharātmanām | granthīnāṃ kurute mālāṃ saraktāṃ tīvrarugjvarām ||15|| śvāsakāsātisārāsyaśoṣahikkāvamibhramaiḥ | mohavaivarṇyamūrchāṅgabhaṅgāgnisadanairyutām ||16|| ityayaṃ granthivīsarpaḥ kaphamārutakopajaḥ |17| (vā. ni. a. 13) | granthivisarpamāha– kaphena ruddha ityādi| kapheneti svahetukupitena, pavanaḥ svahetukupitaḥ, tena kaphamārutajatvamasyopapannaṃ bhavati| bhittvā taṃ bahudhā kaphamiti kaphaṃ vistārya| raktaṃ veti dūṣayitvetyanena vakṣyamāṇena sambadhyate| dīrghāṇuvṛttasthūlakharātmanāmiti vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, sthūlamucchūnaṃ, kharaṃ kaṭhinam, evaṃrūpāṇāṃ granthīnāṃ mālāṃ karoti, ayaṃ ca granthivisarpaḥ suśrute'pacīsañjñayā paṭhyate||14-16||– kaphamārutajaṃ granthivisarpamāha– kaphenetyādi| kaphena svahetukupitena, svahetukupitaḥ pavanaḥ, kaphaṃ bhittvā vidārya, raktaṃ ca dūṣayitvetyanena vakṣyamāṇena sambadhyate, vṛddharaktasya manuṣyasya| tvaksirāsnāyumāṃsagamiti raktaviśeṣaṇam| dīrghāṇuvṛttasthūlakharātmanāmiti aṇu sūkṣmaṃ, vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, sthūlamasūkṣmaṃ, kharaṃ kaṭhinam, evaṃrūpāṇāṃ granthīnāṃ mālāṃ karoti||14-16||– kaphapittājjvaraḥ stambho nidrā tandrā śirorujā ||17|| aṅgāvasādavikṣepau pralepārocakabhramāḥ | mūrchāgnihānirbhedo'sthnāṃ pipāsendriyagauravam ||18|| āmopaveśanaṃ lepaḥ srotasāṃ sa ca sarpati | prāyeṇāmāśayaṃ gṛhṇannekadeśaṃ na cātiruk ||19|| piḍakairavakīrṇo'tipītalohitapāṇḍuraiḥ | snigdho'sito mecakābho malinaḥ śothavān guruḥ ||20|| gambhīrapākaḥ prājyoṣmā spṛṣṭaḥ klinno'vadīryate | paṅkavacchīrṇamāṃsaśca spaṣṭasnāyusirāgaṇaḥ ||21|| śavagandhī ca vīsarpaḥ kardamākhyamuśanti tam |22| (vā. ni. a. 13) | kardamavisarpamāha– kaphapittādityādi| stambha iti gātrasya stabdhatā, āmopaveśanamāmasya varcasastyajanam| sa ca sarpati prāyeṇāmāśayaṃ gṛhṇannekadeśamiti kaphapittayorāmāśayasthatvāt prāyeṇāmāśaye bhavannekadeśavyāpī bhavatītyarthaḥ| piḍakairiti piḍakābhiḥ| malina iti maladigdhaḥ| gambhīrapāka ityantaḥpākaḥ, prājyoṣmā pracuroṣmā| spaṣṭasnāyusirāgaṇa iti pūtimāṃsagalanena snāyvādīnāṃ spaṣṭatā| kardamākhyamuśanti tamiti taṃ kardamasārūpyāt kardamākhyamicchanti||17-21||– kaphapittātmakaṃ kardamavisarpamāha– kaphapittādayaṃ jñeyaḥ| stambho gātrasya stabdhatā, aṅgāvasādaḥ aṅgakhedaḥ, vikṣepaḥ aṅgānāmitaścetaśca preraṇam| indriyagauravamiti cakṣurādīnāṃ gauravam| āmopaveśanamityādi| āmasya varcasastyajanam| lepaḥ srotasāṃ śuṣirāṇāṃ liptatā śleṣmādinā| prāyeṇāmāśayaṃ gṛhṇanniti kaphapittayorāmāśayasthānatvāt; prāyeṇāmāśaye bhinnaikadeśavyāpī bhavatītyarthaḥ| na cātipīḍākaraḥ| piḍakaiḥ piḍakābhiravakīrṇo vyāptaḥ, kimbhūtaiḥ atipītalohitapāṇḍuraiḥ| asitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ, mecakābhaḥ añjanābhaḥ, malino maladigdhaḥ| gambhīrapāka iti antaḥpākaḥ, prājyoṣmā pracuroṣmā| sphuṭasnāyusirāgaṇa iti pūtimāṃsāpagamena snāyvādīnāṃ sphuṭatā| kardamākhyamuśanti taṃ kardamasārūpyāt kardamākhyaṃ kathayanti||17-21|| bāhyahetoḥ kṣatāt kruddhaḥ saraktaṃ pittamīrayan ||22|| vīsarpaṃ mārutaḥ kuryāt kulatthasadṛśaiścitam | sphoṭaiḥ śothajvararujādāhāḍhyaṃ śyāvaśoṇitam ||23|| (vā. ni. a. 13) | jvarātisārau vamathustvaṅmāṃsadaraṇaṃ klamaḥ | arocakāvipākau ca visarpāṇāmupadravāḥ ||24|| kṣatavisarpamāha– bāhyahetorityādi| ayaṃ ca pittaje visarpe'ntarbhāvanīyaḥ, tena na saṅkhyādhikyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “śastraprahāraistaistaistu vyāḍadantanakhairapi| kṣate vā'pyathavā bhagne bahudoṣasya dehinaḥ|| raktaṃ pittaṃ ca kupitaṃ vraṇamāśu prapadyate| kurutaste samete tu vraṇotsedhaṃ sudāruṇam|| ācitaṃ tanuvisphoṭaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ pītakasannibhaiḥ| pittavīsarpavalliṅgaṃ tasya śeṣaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||22-24|| kṣatajamāha– bāhyahetorityādi| śyāvalohitaṃ varṇena| ayaṃ kṣatajo visarpaḥ pittaje'ntarbhāvanīyaḥ, tena na saṅkhyādhikyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “śastraprahāraistaistaistu vyāladantanakhairapi| kṣate vā'pyatha vā bhagne bahudoṣasya dehinaḥ|| raktaṃ pittaṃ ca kupitaṃ vraṇamāśu prapadyate| kurutaste samete tu vraṇotsedhaṃ sudāruṇam|| ācitaṃ vraṇavisphoṭaiḥ kṛṣṇapītasamanvitaiḥ| pittavīsarpavalliṅgaṃ tasya śeṣaṃ vinirdeśet||” iti| visarpopadravānāha– jvaretyādi| māṃsadaraṇaṃ māṃsavidaraṇam| śeṣaṃ sugamam||22-24|| sidhyanti vātakaphapittakṛtā visarpāḥ sarvātmakaḥ kṣatakṛtaśca na siddhimeti | pittātmako'ñjanavapuśca bhavedasādhyaḥ kṛcchrāśca marmasu bhavanti hi sarva eva ||25|| (su. ni. a. 10) | sādhyatvādikamāha– sidhyantītyādi| pittātmako'ñjanavapuriti atyantamudriktapitto'ñjanasamavarṇatanuḥ, agnivisarpākhyo na sādhya iti vyākhyānayanti| kṛcchrāśca marmasviti asādhyatvena kṛcchratvaṃ boddhavyam| yadāha bhojaḥ– “varjyastu kṣatajasteṣāṃ sannipātāttu yo bhavet| bhiṣajā jānatā tyājyāḥ sarva eva tu marmajāḥ||” iti||25|| sādhyāsādhyānāha– siddhyantītyādi| ekaikadoṣajanitāstrayaḥ sādhyāḥ, tridoṣajaḥ kṣatajaścāsādhyaḥ| pittātmako'ñjanavapuriti paittiko yo'tyantamudriktapittatvādañjanasavarṇaḥ so'sādhyaḥ, agnivīsarpo na sādhyaḥ; kṛcchrāśca marmasviti asādhyatvaṃ kṛcchratvena boddhavyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “tyājyastu kṣatajasteṣāṃ sannipātācca yo bhavet| bhiṣajā jānatā tyājyāḥ sarva eva tu marmajāḥ||” iti||25|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne visarpanidānaṃ samāptam ||52|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ visarpanidānaṃ samāptam||52|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ visarpanidānam||52|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘dvandvaśāstrataḥ’ iti pā. | ↩ 2 . ‘ ... vighātādraktaduṣṭau’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘ ... sāmānyāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘chardivegavighātāttu’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘śaratkālasvabhāvācca’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘ ... piṇḍākīprabhṛtīnām’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘ ... piṇḍākīprabhṛtīnām’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘yat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 9 . ‘asya tvagantare vraṇagatam’ ityādirbodhyaḥ| ↩ 10 . atra ‘tvageva’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘bhedārtyāyāmaharṣavān’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘tvasyāntarjabahirjabhedena’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘tataḥ’ ityatra ‘svataḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 14 . ‘vikṛtāṃ iti pā.| ↩ 15 . ‘ ... śirāgaṇaḥ’ iti pā. | ↩ 16 . ‘visarpati’ iti pā.| ↩ 17 . ‘ ... sthānatvāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 18 . ‘spaṣṭatā’ ityatra ‘sphuṭatā’ iti pā.| ↩ 19 . ‘vyāladanta...’ iti pā.| ↩ 20 . ‘vraṇaśothe’ iti pā.| ↩ 21 . ‘pittavīsarpaliṅgaṃ ca’ iti pā.| ↩ 22 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ visarpanidānam||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 53. visphoṭanidānam
text: atha visphoṭanidānam | kaṭvamlatīkṣṇoṣṇavidāhirūkṣakṣārairajīrṇādhyaśanātapaiśca | tathartudoṣeṇa viparyayeṇa kupyanti doṣāḥ pavanādayastu ||1|| tvacamāśritya te raktamāṃsāsthīni pradūṣya ca | ghorān kurvanti visphoṭān sarvān jvarapuraḥsarān ||2|| prāyeṇa doṣadūṣyacikitsāsāmyādvisphoṭanidānamāha– kaṭvityādi| ajīrṇādhyaśanātapaiśceti ajīrṇāśanamapakvadravyasyāśanam, adhyaśanamajīrṇe bhojanam; athavā ajīrṇaṃ svarūpato heturadhyaśanaṃ ca| ṛtudoṣeṇeti śītoṣṇādīnāmatiyogena| viparyayeṇeti ṛtuviparyayaśca ṛtusvabhāvasyānyathābhāvaḥ| ebhirhetubhiryathāsambhavaṃ pratyekaṃ doṣatrayaprakopo boddhavyaḥ| jvarapuraḥsarānityanena jvarasya pūrvarūpatāṃ darśayati||1-2|| prāyeṇa doṣadūṣyacikitsitatvatulyatvādato'nantaraṃ visphoṭanidānārambhaḥ, tasya nidānamāha– kaṭvityādi| ajīrṇāśanamapakvadravyāśanam| adhyaśanamajīrṇabhojanam| athartudoṣeṇa viparyayeṇeti śītoṣṇāderatiyogena ṛtudoṣaḥ, ṛtuviparyayaḥ ṛtusvabhāvasyānyathābhāvāt; ebhirhetubhiḥ yathāsambhavaṃ pratyekaṃ doṣatrayaprakopo boddhavyaḥ| visphoṭakasamprāptimāha– tvacamityādi| jvarapuraḥsarānityanena jvarasya pūrvarūpatāṃ darśayati||1-2|| agnidagdhanibhāḥ sphoṭāḥ sajvarā raktapittajāḥ | kvacit sarvatra vā dehe visphoṭā iti te smṛtāḥ ||3|| (su. ni. a. 13) | śiroruk śūlabhūyiṣṭhaṃ jvarastṛṭ parvabhedanam | sakṛṣṇavarṇatā ceti vātavisphoṭalakṣaṇam ||4|| jvaradāharujāsrāvapākatṛṣṇābhiranvitam | pītalohitavarṇaṃ ca pittavisphoṭalakṣaṇam ||5|| chardyarocakajāḍyāni kaṇḍūkāṭhinyapāṇḍutāḥ | avedanaścirātpākī sa visphoṭaḥ kaphātmakaḥ ||6|| vātapittakṛto yastu kurute tīvravedanām | kaṇḍūstaimityagurubhirjānīyāt kaphavātikam ||7|| kaṇḍūrdāho jvaraśchardiretaistu kaphapaittikaḥ |8| visphoṭasvarūpamāha– agnidagdhanibhā ityādi| raktapittajā iti sarvatraiva visphoṭe raktapittayoravyabhicāritvaṃ, yathā śūle vātasya; vātānubandho'pyatra boddhavyaḥ| yadāha bhojaḥ– “yadā raktaṃ ca pittaṃ ca vātenānugataṃ tvaci| agnidagdhanibhān sphoṭān kurutaḥ sarvadehagān|| sajvarān saparīdāhān vidyādvisphoṭakāṃstu tān||” iti||3-7||– visphoṭakasāmānyaliṅgamāha– agnītyādi| sajvarā iti jvarasteṣāṃ pūrvarūpatvena jñeyaḥ| raktapittajā iti sarvavisphoṭeṣu raktapittayoravyabhicāritvaṃ sūcitaṃ śūleṣu vātasyeva| yaduktaṃ bhoje– “yadā raktaṃ ca pittaṃ ca vātenānugataṃ tvaci| agnidagdhanibhān sphoṭānkurutaḥ sarvadehagān|| sajvarānsaparīdāhān vidyādvisphoṭakāṃstu tān|” iti| kvaciditi kvaciccharīradeśe| vātikavisphoṭamāha– śira ityādi| śūlaṃ śarīrasya todarūpaṃ, parvabhedanaṃ sandhisphuṭanam| paittikamāha– jvaretyādi| sugamam| ślaiṣmikamāha– chardītyādi| vātapaittikamāha– vātetyādi sugamam| kaphajaprasaṅgāt kaphapaittikamāha– kaṇḍūrityādi| etairlakṣaṇaiḥ kaphapaittiko jñeyaḥ| kaphavātikamāha– kaṇḍviti| staimityamiti niścalatvam||3-7|| madhye nimnonnato'nte ca kaṭhino'lpaprapākavān ||8|| dāharāgatṛṣāmohacchardimūrchārujājvarāḥ | pralāpo vepathustandrā so'sādhyaḥ syāttridoṣajaḥ ||9|| sānnipātikalakṣaṇamāha– madhya ityādi| madhye nimnonnato'nte ceti madhye nimno'nte connata ityarthaḥ| nimnonnata iti prayogo'siddhasyānityatvena| evaṃ sampūrṇalakṣaṇo yastridoṣajaḥ so'sādhyaḥ||8-9|| tridoṣajamāha– madhya iti| madhye nimnaḥ, ante connata ityarthaḥ| alpaprapākata iti alpapākavānityarthaḥ| moha indriyāṇām| evaṃ sampūrṇalakṣaṇo yastridoṣajaḥ so'sādhyaḥ||8-9|| raktā raktasamutthānā guñjāvidrumasannibhāḥ | veditavyāstu raktena paittikena ca hetunā ||10|| na te siddhiṃ samāyānti siddhairyogaśatairapi | ekadoṣotthitaḥ sādhyaḥ kṛcchrasādhyo dvidoṣajaḥ | sarvadoṣotthito ghorastvasādhyo bhūryupadravaḥ ||11|| raktajalakṣaṇamāha– raktā ityādi| raktasamutthānā iti lakṣyapadaṃ, veditavyāstu rakteneti lakṣaṇapadam, aśmarīhetuḥ tatpūrvamiti yathā; ayamarthaḥ– raktasamutthānāśca visphoṭā bhavanti te ca kathaṃ vijñeyā ityata uktam– veditavyāstu raktenati; athavā raktasamutthānā iti raktaṃ samutthāpayantīti nirucya raktacchardanamabhimatamācāryasya, veditavyāstu rakteneti padasya kāraṇadyotakasyāvyavasthānāt| ghoro'tyantaduḥkhadaḥ| bhūryupadrava iti atra visarpokta evopadravo jñeyaḥ||10-11|| raktajamāha– raktā ityādi| raktā raktavarṇāḥ, raktasamutthānā iti raktasamutthānāśca visphoṭā bhavantītyarthaḥ| te ca pittahetubhiḥ kupittena raktena veditavyāḥ, rakteneti lakṣaṇapadaṃ, yathā'śmarīhetu tatpūrvamiti| ghora iti atyantaduḥkhapradaḥ| bhūryupadrava iti bahūpadravaḥ, atra visarpoktā evopadravā jñeyāḥ||10-11|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne visphoṭanidānaṃ samāptam ||53|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ visphoṭanidānaṃ samāptam||53|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ visphoṭanidānam||53|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘tathartudoṣeṇa’ iti pā.| ↩ 2 . asmātpūrvaṃ kvacitpustake ‘kaṇḍūrdāho jvaraśchardiretaistu kaphapaittikaḥ’ iti paṅktiḥ upalabhyate ↩ 3 . kvacitpustake agrimapaṅktiḥ ekaślokapūrvaṃ upalabhyate ↩ 4 . ‘vātapaittikamāha– vātetyādi sugamam|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake ‘kaphajaprasaṅgāt kaphapaittikamāha– kaṇḍūrityādi| etairlakṣaṇaiḥ kaphapaittiko jñeyaḥ|’ etatpāṭhasya paścādupalabhyate | ↩ 5 . ‘kaphavātikamāha– kaṇḍviti| staimityamiti niścalatvam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 6 . ‘sampūrṇā lakṣaṇe’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ayametādṛśameva pāṭhaṃ manute| ↩ 8 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ visphoṭanidānam||53||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 54. masūrikānidānam
text: atha masūrikānidānam | kaṭvamlalavaṇakṣāraviruddhādhyaśanāśanaiḥ | duṣṭaniṣpāvaśākādyaiḥ praduṣṭapavanodakaiḥ ||1|| krūragrahekṣaṇāccāpi deśe doṣāḥ samuddhatāḥ | janayanti śarīre'smin duṣṭaraktena saṅgatāḥ ||2|| masūrākṛtisaṃsthānāḥ piḍakāḥ syurmasūrikāḥ | tāsāṃ pūrvaṃ jvaraḥ kaṇḍūrgātrabhaṅgo'ratirbhramaḥ ||3|| tvaci śothaḥ savaivarṇyo netrarāgaśca jāyate |4| visphoṭaprabhedatvāt prāyeṇa tulyanidānatvācca masūrikānidānam| tasyā nidānapūrvikāṃ samprāptimāha– kaṭvamletyādi| viruddhādhyaśanāśanairiti viruddhairannairadhyaśanaiśca, ‘viruddhādhyaśanena tu’ iti pāṭho vā| duṣṭaniṣpāvaśākādyairiti duṣṭaṃ vyāpannamannaṃ, niṣpāvaḥ śimbibījam, ādyaśabdānmadhvālukādigrahaṇam| praduṣṭapavanodakairiti viṣakusumādisaṃsparśāt praduṣṭaḥ pavanastathodakaṃ ca, taiḥ| krūragrahekṣaṇācceti śanaiścarādayo deśakṣobhakarāḥ krūragrahāsteṣāmīkṣaṇāt| duṣṭaraktena saṅgatā ityanena raktasya kaṭvamlādibhirhetubhirviśeṣeṇa kopaṃ darśayati| ata evoktaṃ tantrāntare– “pittaṃ śoṇitasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ yadā dūṣayati tvacam| tadā karoti piḍakāḥ sarvagātreṣu dehinām|| masūramudgamāṣāṇāṃ tulyāḥ kolopamā api| masūrikāstu tā jñeyāḥ pittaraktādhikā budhaiḥ||” iti||1-3||– sphoṭāḥ śyāvāruṇā rūkṣāstīvravedanayā'nvitāḥ ||4|| kaṭhināścirapākāśca bhavantyanilasambhavāḥ | sandhyasthiparvaṇāṃ bhedaḥ kāsaḥ kampo'ratiḥ klamaḥ ||5|| śoṣastālvoṣṭhajihvānāṃ tṛṣṇā cārucisaṃyutā |6| vātajāmāha– sphoṭā ityādi| cirapākā iti vikāraprabhāvāt||4-5||– raktāḥ pītāsitāḥ sphoṭāḥ sadāhāstīvravedanāḥ ||6|| bhavantyacirapākāśca pittakopasamudbhavāḥ | viḍbhedaścāṅgamardaśca dāhastṛṣṇā'rucistathā ||7|| mukhapāko'kṣirāgaśca jvarastīvraḥ sudāruṇaḥ |8| pittajāmāha– raktā ityādi| jvarastīvraḥ sudāruṇa iti tīvraścaṇḍavegaḥ, sudāruṇo bahuduḥkhenātiduḥsaha||6-7||– raktajāyāṃ bhavantyete vikārāḥ pittalakṣaṇāḥ ||8|| kaphaprasekaḥ staimityaṃ śirorug gātragauravam | hṛllāsaḥ sārucirnidrā tandrālasyasamanvitāḥ ||9|| śvetāḥ snigdhā bhṛśaṃ sthūlāḥ kaṇḍūrā mandavedanāḥ | masūrikāḥ kaphotthāśca cirapākāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||10|| raktajāmāha– raktajāyāmityādi| ete vikārāḥ pittalakṣaṇā iti pittajamasūrīlakṣaṇatvena uktāḥ| ‘ raktāḥ pītāsitāḥ sphoṭā’ ityādayo ye ye vikārāste raktajāyāṃ bhavanti| atra kaphajāmanuktvaiva pittajāyā anantaraṃ raktajāyā uktiḥ pittalakṣaṇasyātidiṣṭasyāvyavahitatvena sukhagrahaṇārthaṃ, raktarasasamatvāt raktamalatvādvā pittasya pittajāmabhidhāya asyāḥ kathanaṃ, sarvatra kṛtasya samarthanāya||8-10|| raktajāmāha– raktajāyāmityādi| ete vikārāḥ pittamasūrikālakṣaṇatvena ye uktāḥ ‘raktāḥ pītāsitāḥ sphoṭāḥ’ ityādayo ye vikārāḥ te raktajāyāṃ bhavanti| kaphajāmāha– śvetā ityādi| sugamam||8-10|| nīlāścipiṭavistīrṇā madhye nimnā mahārujāḥ | cirapākāḥ pūtisrāvāḥ prabhūtāḥ sarvadoṣajāḥ ||11|| kaṇṭharodhārucistambhapralāpāratisaṃyutāḥ | duścikitsyāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ piḍakāścarmasañjñitāḥ ||12|| sānnipātikalakṣaṇamāha– nīlā ityādi| cipiṭavistīrṇā iti cipiṭaḥ ‘ciuḍā’ iti khyātaḥ, tadvadvistṛtāḥ| carmasañjñitā iti ‘carmadala’ iti khyātāḥ||11-12|| sannipātajāmāha– nīlā ityādi| nīlāścāṣapakṣapratimāḥ| cipiṭavistīrṇā iti cipiṭāściuḍā iti khyātāḥ, tadvadvitatāḥ| madhye nimnā ityukte prāntonnatatvaṃ jñeyam| prabhūtāḥ pracurāḥ kaṇṭharodhaḥ kaṇṭhagrahaḥ, pralāpo'baddhabhāṣaṇaṃ, duścikitsyāḥ asādhyāḥ, carmasañjñitā iti ‘ cāmaghāṃsa’ iti khyātaḥ||11-12|| romakūponnatisamā rāgiṇyaḥ kaphapittajāḥ | kāsārocakasaṃyuktā romāntyo jvarapūrvikāḥ ||13|| masūrikāyāḥ prakāraṃ romāntikāmāha– romakūponnatisamā ityādi| rāgiṇya iti lohitāḥ, jvarapūrvikā iti jvarapūrvarūpāḥ||13|| masūrikāyāḥ prakārāntaraṃ romāntikāmāha– rometyādi| romakūpocchrāyāḥ, rāgiṇya iti lohitāḥ, jvarapūrvikā iti jvarapūrvarūpāḥ||13|| toyabudbudasaṅkāśāstvaggatāstu masūrikāḥ | svalpadoṣāḥ prajāyante bhinnāstoyaṃ sravanti ca ||14|| raktasthā lohitākārāḥ śīghrapākāstanutvacaḥ | sādhyā nātyarthaduṣṭāśca bhinnā raktaṃ sravanti ca ||15|| māṃsasthāḥ kaṭhināḥ snigdhāścirapākā ghanatvacaḥ | gātraśūlatṛṣākaṇḍūjvarāratisamanvitāḥ ||16|| medojā maṇḍalākārā mṛdavaḥ kiñcidunnatāḥ | ghorajvaraparītāśca sthūlāḥ snigdhāḥ savedanāḥ ||17|| sammohāratisantāpāḥ kaścidābhyo vinistaret | kṣudrā gātrasamā rūkṣāścipiṭāḥ kiñcidunnatāḥ ||18|| majjotthā bhṛśasammohavedanāratisaṃyutāḥ | chindanti marmadhāmāni prāṇānāśu haranti hi ||19|| bhramareṇeva viddhāni kurvantyasthīni sarvataḥ | pakvābhāḥ piḍakāḥ snigdhāḥ sūkṣmāścātyarthavedanāḥ ||20|| staimityāratisammohadāhonmādasamanvitāḥ | śukrajāyāṃ masūryāṃ tu lakṣaṇāni bhavanti hi ||21|| nirdiṣṭaṃ kevalaṃ cihnaṃ dṛśyate na tu jīvitam | doṣamiśrāstu saptaitā draṣṭavyā doṣalakṣaṇaiḥ ||22|| tvaggatā raktajāścaiva pittajāḥ śleṣmajāstathā | śleṣmapittakṛtāścaiva sukhasādhyā masūrikāḥ ||23|| rasādisaptadhātugatamasūrikāliṅgamāha– toyabudbudasaṅkāśā ityādi| atra duṣṭadūṣyaprabhāvāt toyabudbudasaṅkāśādīni doṣalakṣaṇāni ca bhavanti, doṣamantareṇa dūṣyaduṣṭerabhāvāt; ata eva vakṣyati– “doṣamiśrāśca saptaitā draṣṭavyā doṣalakṣaṇaiḥ|” iti| tvakśabdenātra raso'bhidhīyate, dhātugataprastāvāt| tvaggatāḥ sādhyāḥ, alpadoṣasambandhādraktajāyā api sādhyatvenābhidhānāt| māṃsasthāḥ kṛcchrasādhyāḥ, atyavagāḍhadoṣaduṣṭeḥ| medojāyāṃ kaścidābhyo vinistaredityanenātyantakṛcchrasādhyatvaṃ bodhayati, asthimadhyasthitatvānmajjñaḥ| kṣudrā ityādinā asthimajjagatayoḥ samānaṃ liṅgam| majjotthā ityatra majjagrahaṇādasthno'pi grahaṇam, ādhāratvāt; ata eva vakṣyati– “bhramareṇeva viddhāni kurvantyasthīni sarvataḥ|” iti| marmadhāmānīti marmasthānāni| pakvābhā ityādinā śukrajāyā liṅgam| dṛśyate na tu jīvitamiti gambhīradhātugatadoṣaduṣṭeḥ śukrajāyā asādhyatvam| asya nyāyasya samānatayā asthimajjagatayorapyasādhyatvaṃ boddhavyam||14-23|| rasādisaptadhātugatamasūrikāyā liṅgamāha– toyetyādi| atra duṣṭadūṣyaprabhāvāttoyabudbudasaṅkāśādīni lakṣaṇāni doṣalakṣaṇāni ca bhavanti, doṣamantareṇa dūṣyaduṣṭerabhāvāt| ata eva vakṣyati– “doṣamiśrāstu saptaitā draṣṭavyā doṣalakṣaṇaiḥ|” iti| tvakśabdenātra raso gṛhyate, dhātugataprastāvāt| tvaggatāḥ sādhyāḥ, svalpadoṣasambandhāt| raktajāmāha– raktotthā ityādi| atyarthaṃ cenna duṣṭā tadā sādhyā| atrāpi svalpadoṣānubandhatvena sādhyatvam| māṃsasthāmāha– māṃsasthā ityādi| māṃsasthāḥ kṛcchrasādhyāḥ, atyavagāḍhadoṣaduṣṭeḥ| medogatāmāha– medojā ityādi| mṛdavo mṛdusparśāḥ, ghorajvaraparītā iti dāruṇajvaro yataḥ| sammoha indriyāṇām| kaścidābhyo vinistaredityanenātyantaṃ kṛcchrasādhyatvaṃ bodhayati| asthimajjagatāmāha– kṣudrā ityādi| atra asthimajjāgatayoḥ samānaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| majjotthā ityatra majjagrahaṇādasthno'pi grahaṇamādhāratvāt, kṣudrāḥ tanvyaḥ, gātrasamāḥ śarīrasamavarṇāḥ, cipiṭāḥ ciuḍākārāḥ, ata eva vakṣyati– “bhramareṇeva viddhāni bhavantyasthīni sarvataḥ|” iti| marmadhāmāni marmasthānāni hṛdayādīni| śukragatāmāha– pakvābhā ityādi| pakvākārā ananupakvā| anye ‘paṅkābhāḥ’ iti paṭhanti, tatra kardamābhāḥ| ślakṣṇāḥ masṛṇāḥ| cihnaṃ dṛśyate na tu jīvitamiti| gambhīradhātugatadoṣaduṣṭeḥ śukrajāyāmasādhyatvaṃ boddhavyam| dhātugatānāṃ doṣajānāmapi sādhyatvamāha– tvaggatā ityādi| rasagatāḥ||14-23|| vātajā vātapittotthāḥ śleṣmavātakṛtāśca yāḥ | kṛcchrasādhyatamāstasmādyatnādetā upācaret ||24|| asādhyāḥ sannipātotthāstāsāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam | pravālasadṛśāḥ kāścit kāścijjambūphalopamāḥ ||25|| lohajālasamāḥ kāścidatasīphalasannibhāḥ | āsāṃ bahuvidhā varṇā jāyante doṣabhedataḥ ||26|| vātajā ityādi| vātajādayaḥ sannipātotthāntā asādhyāḥ| etāsāṃ sammūrchanaviśeṣajanitavakṣyamāṇapravālādivarṇayogādasādhyatvaṃ, tenaitadvarṇavirahe vātajāyāścikitsāvidhirapyukta upapadyata iti kecit| anye tu vātajādaya etāḥ svarūpata evāsādhyāḥ, cikitsoktistu vātajādīnāṃ mahātyayaniṣedhārthaṃ, liṅgāntarasambhavārthaṃ ca tāsāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇamityuktamityāhuḥ| tāsāmiti asādhyavātajādīnām| lohajālasamā iti jālaṃ jālakaṃ guḍakamiti yāvat, tadvatkṛṣṇavarṇāḥ| atasīphalasannibhā iti umāphalavarṇatulyavarṇāḥ| anuktavarṇāntarasaṅgrahārthamāha– āsāṃ bahuvidhā ityādi| doṣabhedata iti vātapittādidoṣaviśeṣāt, duṣṭiviśeṣādityanye||24-26|| kaṣṭasādhyā āha– vātajā ityādi| etā vātajādayaḥ svarūpata eva kaṣṭasādhyāḥ, cikitsitoktistu vātajāyā mahātyayaniṣedhārtham| asādhyā āha– asādhyā ityādi| tāsāmiti vātādīnām| doṣadūṣyasammūrchanādviśeṣavarṇatvena lakṣaṇamāha– pravāletyādi| lohajālanibhāḥ lohajālakaṃ lohagulikaṃ, tadvatkṛṣṇavarṇāḥ, kaścidatasīphalatulyavarṇāḥ| anuktavarṇāntarasaṅgrahārthamāha– āsāmityādi| āsāṃ masūrikāṇāṃ varṇā bahuvidhā jāyante| kathamityāha– doṣabhedata ityādi| vātapittādidoṣaviśeṣāt, duṣṭiviśeṣādityarthaḥ||24-26|| kāso hikkā pramehaśca jvarastīvraḥ sudāruṇaḥ | pralāpaścāratirmūrchā tṛṣṇā dāho'tighūrṇatā ||27|| mukhena prasravedraktaṃ tathā ghrāṇena cakṣuṣā | kaṇṭhe ghurghurakaṃ kṛtvā śvasityatyarthavedanam ||28|| masūrikābhibhūtasya yasyaitāni bhiṣagvaraiḥ | lakṣaṇāni ca dṛśyante na dadyādatra bheṣajam ||29|| sarvamasūrikāyā āvasthikaṃ liṅgamāha– kāsa ityādi| jvarastīvraḥ sudāruṇa iti, atra sudāruṇa iti pareṇa sambadhyate, tena sudāruṇaḥ pralāpaḥ| atighūrṇatā jihmāyanam| tathā ghrāṇena cakṣuṣetyatra raktaṃ sravediti sambadhyate| śvasitīti śvāso bhavati||27-29|| tāsāmāvasthikalakṣaṇamāha– kāsa ityādi| pramoha indriyāṇām| jvarastīvra iti tīvravegaḥ| sudāruṇo ghoraḥ; anye sudāruṇa iti pareṇa sambadhyata ityāhuḥ, tena sudāruṇaḥ pralāpaḥ| atighūrṇatā jihmāyanam| tathā ghrāṇena cakṣuṣeti atra raktaṃ prasravediti sambadhyate| śvasitīti śvāso bhavati||27-29|| masūrikābhibhūto yo bhṛśaṃ ghrāṇena niḥśvaset | sa bhṛśaṃ tyajati prāṇāṃstṛṣārto vāyudūṣitaḥ ||30|| sāmānyenāsādhyatvamāha– masūrikābhibhūto ya ityādi| ghrāṇena niḥśvasediti mukhavyatirekeṇa ghrāṇenaiva niḥśvaset, sarvavākyānāmavadhāraṇaphalatvāt||30|| sāmānyenāsādhyatāmāha– masūriketyādi| yo masūrikābhibhūto naro bhṛśaṃ ghrāṇena niḥśvasediti mukhavyatirekeṇa ghrāṇenaiva niḥśvaset, sarvavākyānāmavadhāraṇatvāt; tathā yaḥ pradūṣito masūrikābhiḥ pīḍito naro bhṛśaṃ tṛṣārto bhavati, sa tathāvidho naraḥ prāṇāṃstyajati||30|| masūrikānte śothaḥ syāt kūrpare maṇibandhake | tathāṃ'saphalake cāpi duścikitsyaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ||31|| masūrikāyā upadravamāha– masūrikānte ityādi| duścikitsya iti duḥśabdo'yaṃ niṣedhe, tena asādhya ityarthaḥ||31|| masūrikāyā upadravamāha– masūrikānta ityādi| kūrpare jānukūrpare, maṇibandhane ghuṭikāyām, aṃsaphalake pārśvayorupari, duścikitsya iti asādhya ityarthaḥ||31|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne masūrikānidānaṃ samāptam ||54|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ masūrikānidānaṃ samāptam||54|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ masūrikānidānam||54|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘pītāḥ sitāḥ’ iti pā. | ↩ 2 . ‘raktāḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 3 . ‘pītāḥ sitāḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ādyāḥ sārdhasaptaślokāḥ sugamatvānna vyākhyātāḥ, lekhakapramādādvā teṣāṃ vyākhyānaṃ paribhraṣṭamiti na niścīyate|| ↩ 5 . ‘pītāḥ sitāḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘cāghamāṃsa’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘ ... majjaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘sūkṣmāḥ’ ityatra ‘ślakṣṇāḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 9 . ‘kṛcchrasādhyā matās ... ’ iti pā. | ↩ 10 . ‘prāṇān tṛṣārto’ iti pā. | ↩ 11 . ‘vā pradūṣitaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘śothāḥ syādityādi|’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ masūrikānidānam||54||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 55. kṣudraroganidānam
text: atha kṣudraroganidānam | snigdhāḥ savarṇā granthitā nīrujo mudgasannibhāḥ | kaphavātotthitā jñeyā bālānāmajagallikāḥ ||1|| (su. ni. a. 13) | visarpādīnāmakṣudrahetulakṣaṇacikitsitānāmabhidhānena kṣudrahetulakṣaṇacikitsitānāṃ kṣudrarogāṇāṃ pāriśeṣyāt kṣudraroganidānam| nanu, yadi kṣudratvameṣāṃ hetulakṣaṇacikitsālpatvena tarhi agnirohiṇīvalmīkādīnāṃ tridoṣajatvena hetvādibāhulyāt kathaṃ kṣudratvaṃ? naivaṃ, bāhulyena tāvat, chatriṇo gacchantītivat; kiṃvā avāntarabhedavirahaḥ kṣudratvaṃ, yenātra vaktavyānāmajagallikādīnāṃ na doṣadūṣyādikṛtabhūrisaṅkhyābhedena vraṇajvarādivānnirdeśaḥ, kintu pratyekaṃ stokasaṅkhyayā'bhidhānaṃ teṣām| anyastvāha– kṣudraśabdo'lpe raudre ca vartate, tena yathāyogyaṃ sarvatra vyavasthā dṛśyate; raudre kṣudraśabdo yathā– “kṣudrā mṛgā yatra śāntāśceruranyaiḥ samaṃ mṛgaiḥ|” iti| kṣudrāṇāṃ bālānāṃ rogāḥ kṣudrarogā iti kecit| evamapyajagallikāhipūtanādīnāmeva parigraho na tvanyeṣām| saṅkṣepeṇa catuścatvāriṃśadvikārānatra vaktavyān krameṇa darśayati– snigdhetyādi| bhoje tu mūṣikākarṇamuṣkakośaphalārśaḥprabhṛtayo'dhikavikārāḥ paṭhyante, te ca suśrute vikārasyānantyādanumatā eva| bālānāmiti prāyobhāvitvāduktaṃ, tenābālānāmapi dṛśyamānāḥ saṅgacchante||1|| kṣudrarogāṇāṃ masūrikārambhakatvādato'nantaraṃ kṣudraroganidānārambhaḥ| kṣudrā laghavaḥ, tilakālakābhiprāyeṇa, agnirohiṇīvalmīkaprabhṛtīnāmabhiprāyeṇa kṣudrāḥ tīkṣṇāḥ; anyastvāha– kṣudraśabdaḥ svalpe raudre ca pravartate, tena yathāyogyaṃ sarvatra vyavasthā dṛśyate, raudre ca kṣudraśabdo yathā– “api kṣudrā mṛgā yatra śāntāśceruḥ samaṃ mṛgaiḥ” iti| kṣudrāṇāṃ bālānāṃ rogāḥ kṣudrarogā iti kecit| athavā pūrvācāryapaṭhitā pāribhāṣikīyaṃ sañjñā, kvāthapākyasañjñāvat| eṣāṃ saṅkṣepeṇa catuścatvāriṃśadvikārā atra vaktavyāḥ krameṇa darśayati| teṣvajagallikāmāha– snigdhetyādi| savarṇā śarīrasamavarṇā, grathitākāratvena vyavasthitā, prāyeṇa bālānāmanyeṣāmapyajagallikā bhavati||1|| yavākārā sukaṭhinā grathitā māṃsasaṃśritā | piḍakā kaphavātābhyāṃ yavaprakhyeti socyate ||2|| (su. ni. a. 13) | yavaprakhyāmāha– yavākāretyādi| yavākāreti yavavanmadhye sthūlā||2|| yavaprakhyāmāha– yavākāretyādi| yavavanmadhye sthūlā antarnimnā||2|| ghanāmavaktrāṃ piḍakāmunnatāṃ parimaṇḍalām | antrālajīmalpapūyāṃ tāṃ vidyāt kaphavātajām ||3|| (su. ni. a. 13) | antrālajīmāha– ghanāmityādi| antrālajī snāyugatā bhojavacanādavagantavyā| yaduktam– “śleṣmānilau śritau snāyuṃ piḍakāṃ parimaṇḍalām| duṣṭau janayato'vaktrāmalpapūyāmakaṇḍurām|| āmodumbarasaṅkāśāṃ vidyādantrālajīṃ tu tām||” iti||3|| antrālajīmāha– antrālajī bahirvakrarahitā| antarmukhī snāyvāśritā ca| yaduktaṃ bhojena– “kaphānilau śritau snāyuṃ piḍakāṃ parimaṇḍalām| duṣṭau janayato'vaktrāmalpapūyāmakaṇḍurām| āmodumbarasaṅkāśāṃ vidyādantrālajī tu tām||” iti||3|| vivṛtāsyāṃ mahādāhāṃ pakvodumbarasannibhām | vivṛtāmiti tāṃ vidyāt pittotthāṃ parimaṇḍalām ||4|| (su. ni. a. 13) | vivṛtāmāha– vivṛtāsyāmityādi| pittenādhikapākādvivṛtamukhatāyāṃ vivṛtāsañjñā||4|| vivṛtāmāha– vivṛtāsyāmityādi| pittenādhikapākādvivṛtamukhatayā vivṛteti sañjñā||4|| grathitāḥ pañca vā ṣaḍvā dāruṇāḥ kacchapopamāḥ | kaphānilābhyāṃ piḍakā jñeyāḥ kacchapikā budhaiḥ ||5|| (su. ni. a. 13) | kacchapikālakṣaṇamāha– grathitā ityādi| dāruṇāḥ kaṭhināḥ| madhyonnatatvena paryantālpatvena ca kacchapikāsañjñā||5|| kacchapikāmāha– grathitā ityādi| dāruṇāḥ kaṭhināḥ, madhye unnatatvena paryante natatvena ca kacchapikāsañjñā||5|| grīvāṃsakakṣākarapādadeśe sandhau gale vā tribhireva doṣaiḥ | granthiḥ sa valmīkavadakriyāṇāṃ jātaḥ krameṇaiva gataḥ pravṛddhim ||6|| mukhairanekaiḥ srutitodavadbhirvisarpavat sarpati connatāgraiḥ | valmīkamāhurbhiṣajo vikāraṃ niṣpratyanīkaṃ cirajaṃ viśeṣāt ||7|| valmīkalakṣaṇamāha– grīvāṃsetyādi| valmīkavadityanena pracuraśikharatvena samucchritatvaṃ dūrāvagāḍhamūlatvaṃ ca khyāpyate| ata eva cikitsāyāmavagāḍhamūlaśodhanārthamagnikṣārābhyāṃ cikitsedityuktam||6-7|| valmīkamāha– grīvetyādi| valmīkavadityanena pracuraśikharitvamucchritatvaṃ dūrāvagāḍhamūlatvaṃ ca khyāpyate, ata eva cikitsāyāmavagāḍhamūlaśodhanāya ‘agnikṣārābhyāmupacaret’ ityuktam| niṣpratyanīkamasādhyam||6-7|| padmakarṇikavanmadhye piḍakābhiḥ samācitām | indraviddhāṃ tu tāṃ vidyādvātapittotthitāṃ bhiṣak ||8|| (su. ni. a. 13) | indraviddhāmāha– padmakarṇikavadityādi| padmakarṇikavanmadhye iti padmavarāṭavat||8|| indraviddhāmāha– padmetyādi| padmakarṇikāvat madhye piḍakābhiḥ yuktām||8|| maṇḍalaṃ vṛttamutsannaṃ saraktaṃ piḍakācitam | rujākarīṃ gardabhikāṃ tāṃ vidyādvātapittajām ||9|| gardabhikāmāha– maṇḍalamityādi| gardabhikā yadyapi samānatantre na paṭhyate, tathā'pi sarvatra suśrute'bhidhīyate; avigītapāṭhena vyavasthitaiva||9|| gardabhikāmāha– maṇḍalamityādi| vṛttaṃ vartulam| utsannamunnatam||9|| vātaśleṣmasamudbhūtaḥ śvayathurhanusandhijaḥ | sthiro mandarujaḥ snigdho jñeyaḥ pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ ||10|| pāṣāṇagardabhalakṣaṇamāhaṭṭha vātetyādi| sthiraḥ kaṭhinaḥ, pāṣāṇavat kāṭhinyāt pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ| pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ loke ‘galavaṭṭa’ iti khyātaḥ||10|| pāṣāṇagardabhamāha– vātetyādi| sthiraḥ kaṭhinaḥ||10|| karṇasyābhyantare jātāṃ piḍakāmugravedanām | sthirāṃ panasikāṃ tāṃ tu vidyādvātakaphotthitām ||11|| panasikāmāha– karṇasyetyādi| eṣā bhoje ‘samantataḥ’ iti vacanāt karṇasya bahirapi bhavatīti kecidvyācakṣate| yaduktam– “kaphavātau prakupitau māṃsamāśritya karṇayoḥ| samantataḥ paristabdhāṃ kurutaḥ piḍakāṃ sthirām|| viṣamāṃ dāhasaṃyuktāṃ vidyāt panasikāṃ tu tām|” iti| tattu na samyak, samantata ityasya karṇābhyantara evopapannatvāt| dṛśyate bāhyarandhre śālūkākāreyamiti kecit| asyāṃ vātakaphajāyāṃ bhoje dāhapāṭho vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyādadhiṣṭhānabhūtaraktaprabhāvādvā'vagantavyaḥ||11|| panasikāmāha– karṇasyetyādi| bhoje ‘samantataḥ’ iti vacanāt karṇasya bahirapi bhavatīti vyācakṣate| yaduktam– “kaphavātau prakupitau māṃsamāśritya karṇayoḥ| samantataḥ parisrāvāṃ kurutaḥ piḍakāṃ sthirām|| viṣamāṃ dāhasaṃyuktāṃ vidyātpanasikāṃ tu tām|” iti||11|| visarpavat sarpati yaḥ śothastanurapākavān | dāhajvarakaraḥ pittāt sa jñeyo jālagardabhaḥ ||12|| (su. ni. a. 13) | jālagardabhalakṣaṇamāha– visarpavadityādi| apākavāniti īṣatpākavān, pittakṛtatvena sarvathā pākābhāvasyāyuktatvāditi cakraḥ; kintu pākarahita evāyamupalabhyate [ pittādityudbhūtapittāt, tena bhojoktaṃ pittolbaṇadoṣatrayajanyatvamasyāviruddhaṃ bhavati| sa yadāha– “pittotkaṭāstrayo doṣā janayanti tvagāśritāḥ| śyāvaṃ raktaṃ tanuṃ śothamapākaṃ bahuvedanam|| visarpiṇaṃ sadāhaṃ ca tṛṣṇājvarasamanvitam| visarpamāhustaṃ vyādhimapare jālagardabham||” iti| jatukarṇastvāha– “ pittādhikastatra tīvradāho raktapāko visarpajvarakaro jālagardabhaḥ|” iti| ayamagnivāta iti khyāto vikāraḥ||12|| jālagardabhamāha– apākavānityādi| īṣatpākavān, pittakṛtatvena; sarvathā pākābhāvasyāyuktatvāditi cakraḥ; kintu pākarahita evāyamupalabhyate, tena bhojaktaṃ pittolbaṇadoṣatrayajanyatvamasyāviruddhaṃ bhavati| sa yadāha– “pittotkaṭāstrayo doṣā janayanti tvagāśritāḥ| śyāvaṃ raktaṃ tanuṃ śothamapākaṃ bahuvedanam|| visarpiṇaṃ sadāhaṃ ca tṛṣṇājvarasamanvitam| visarpamāhustaṃ vyādhimapare jālagardabham|” iti||12|| piḍakāmuttamāṅgasthāṃ vṛttāmugrarujājvarām | sarvātmikāṃ sarvaliṅgāṃ jānīyādirivellikām ||13|| bāhupārśvāṃsakakṣeṣu kṛṣṇasphoṭāṃ savedanām | pittaprakopasambhūtāṃ kakṣāmityabhinirdiśet ||14|| (su. ni. a. 13) | irivellikālakṣaṇamāha– piḍakāmityādi| sarvātmikāṃ sarvaliṅgāmiti sarvātmikāṃ sarvadoṣajām| sarvātmikāmityanenaiva sarvaliṅgatve siddhe punaḥ sarvaliṅgāmiti vacanaṃ vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhaliṅgavyatirekeṇa pratyekadoṣaliṅgayuktatāṃ khyāpayati||13-14|| irivellikāmāha– piḍakāmityādi| uttamāṅgasthāṃ śirogatām| sarvātmikāmityanenaiva sarvaliṅgatvaṃ siddhaṃ, punaḥ sarvaliṅgāmiti grahaṇaṃ vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhaliṅgavyatirekeṇa pratyekadoṣaliṅgayuktatāṃ khyāpayati| kakṣāmāha– bāhvityādi| kakṣāmiti nāmataḥ prasiddhām||13-14|| ekāmetādṛśīṃ dṛṣṭvā piḍakāṃ sphoṭasannibhām | tvaggatāṃ pittakopena gandhamālāṃ pracakṣate ||15|| (su. ni. a. 13) | gandhamālāmāha– ekāmityādi| ekāmetādṛśīmiti kakṣoktaikakṛṣṇasphoṭasadṛśīm||15|| gandhamālānāmnīmāha– ekāmityādi| sphoṭasadṛśīm||15|| kakṣabhāgeṣu ye sphoṭā jāyante māṃsadāraṇāḥ | antardāhajvarakarā dīptapāvakasannibhāḥ ||16|| saptāhādvā daśāhādvā pakṣādvā hanti mānavam | tāmagnirohiṇīṃ vidyādasādhyāṃ sarvadoṣajām ||17|| (su. ni. a. 13) | agnirohiṇīlakṣaṇamāha– kakṣetyādi| saptāhādvā daśāhādvetyabhidhānamasādhyatvakhyāpakamanupakramādboddhavyam| upakramāt punariyaṃ sādhyaiva, ata evāsyāścikitsābhidhānaṃ; carakeṇāpyagnirohiṇīṃ pratyabhihitam– “santi hyevaṃvidhā rogāḥ sādhyā dāruṇasammatāḥ| ye hanyuranupakrāntā mithyārambheṇa vā punaḥ||” (ca. sū. a. 18) iti| tantrāntaramapi– “pittaraktotkaṭā doṣāḥ pradīptāṅgārasannibhān| kakṣabhāgeṣu kurvanti tīvradāharujājvarān|| māṃsāvadāraṇān sphoṭān ye hanyuranupakramāt| pakṣāddaśāhādarvāgvā sā jñeyā vahnirohiṇī||” iti| vātapittakaphādhikyādyathākramaṃ saptāhādivikalpaḥ||16-17|| agnirohiṇīmāha– kakṣetyādi| asyāmasādhyatvamanukramādboddhavyam, upakramātpunariyaṃ sādhyā; ata evāsyāścikitsābhidhānaṃ carakeṇāpyagnirohiṇī pratyabhihitam– “santi hyevaṃvidhā rogāḥ sādhyā dāruṇasammatāḥ| ye hanyuranupakrāntā mithyācāreṇa vā punaḥ||” iti| tantrāntaramapi– “raktapittotkaṭā doṣāḥ pradīptāṅgārasannibhān| kakṣābhāgeṣu kurvanti tīvradāharujājvarān|| māṃsāvadāraṇān sphoṭān ye hanyuranupakramāt| pakṣāddaśāhādarvāgvā sā jñeyā vahnirohiṇī||” iti| vātapittakaphādhikyādyathākramaṃ saptāhādivikalpaḥ; tena vātādhikaiḥ saptāhāt pittādhikairdaśāhātkaphādhikaiḥ pakṣādityūhyam||16-17|| nakhamāṃsamadhiṣṭhāya vāyuḥ pittaḥ ca dehinām | kurvate dāhapākau ca taṃ vyādhiṃ cippamādiśet ||18|| tadevālpatarairdoṣaiḥ paruṣaṃ kunakhaṃ vadet ||19|| (su. ni. a. 13) | cippamāha– nakhetyādi| taṃ vyādhiṃ cippamiti cippamaṅgulīveṣṭakamiti khyātam| carake tvakṣatanāmāyaṃ vikāraḥ| yaduktam– “rogo'kṣataścarmanakhāntare syānmāṃsāsradoṣī bhṛśadāhapākaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 12) iti||18-19|| cippamāha– nakhamāṃsetyādi| tantrāntare'ṅgulīveṣṭakamiti khyātam| carake tvakṣatanāmāyaṃ vikāraḥ| yaduktam– “rogo'kṣataścarmanakhāntare syānmāṃsāsradoṣādbhṛśadāhapākaḥ|” iti| anye tu “tamevākṣatarogākhyaṃ tathopanakhamityapi” ityadhikaṃ granthamadhīyate| tadeva cipyamiti| sugamam||18-19|| gambhīrāmalpasaṃrambhāṃ savarṇāmuparisthitām | pādasyānuśayīṃ tāṃ tu vidyādantaḥprapākinīm ||20|| (su. ni. a. 13) | anuśayīlakṣaṇamāha– gambhīrāmityādi| gambhīrāmityantaḥpākena| alpasaṃrambhāmityalpaśothām||20|| anuśayīmāha– gambhīrāmityādi| antaḥpākena gambhīrām| alpasaṃrabhāmiti svalpaśothām| “kaphādantaḥprapākāntāṃ vidyādanuśayīṃ bhiṣak” iti kecana pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti; tadā uparisthitāṃ mastake sthitāmiti vyācakṣate||20|| vidārīkandavadvṛttā kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu | vidārikā bhavedraktā sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇā ||21|| (su. ni. a. 13) | vidārīlakṣaṇamāha– vidārītyādi| ‘vidārikā bhavedraktā sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇā’ ityatra kecidasarvajā, asarvalakṣaṇeti ubhayatrāpi nañaḥ prayogamicchanti; tenāsarvajā iti sarvadoṣaiḥ sannipatitairna bhavati, asarvalakṣaṇeti sannipātalakṣaṇarahitetyarthaḥ| tena pratyekadoṣadvandvajatvena ṣaḍvidhā sannipātamātreṇa na bhavatīti vākyārthaḥ| kintvayaṃ pakṣo yadyabhimataḥ syādācāryasya, tadā vyaktyarthaṃ ‘ṣaḍvidhā dvyekadoṣajā’ iti padaṃ kṛtaṃ syāt; kiñca bahuprapañcatvena kṣudratvāsaṅgatiśca| apare ‘ sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇā’ iti paṭhanti; tadapi na saṅgataṃ, sarvairdoṣairna bhavati atha sarvadoṣalakṣaṇā bhavati hanta tarhi liṅginamantareṇa liṅgaprādurbhāvaprasaṅgaḥ| anye tūttarapada eva nañaḥ prayogāt ‘sarvajā'sarvalakṣaṇā’ iti vadanti; tatra yadi sarveṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni sarvalakṣaṇāni tānyavidyamānāni yasyāmiti, tadā kathaṃ liṅgamantareṇa liṅginaḥ parokṣasya paricchedodayaḥ| atha sarvāṇi ca tāni lakṣaṇāni avidyamānāni yasyāmiti, sannipātajatve'pyasampūrṇalakṣaṇetyarthaḥ| etadapi na saṅgataṃ, yadyayaṃ pakṣo'bhīṣṭaḥ syāttadā'sarvalakṣaṇeti na vaktavyamatra syāt, sarvatra nyāyasyāsya samānatvāt; hetvanurūpakopabalena hi sarvatra sarvārdhālpaliṅgasaṅgatiḥ; asampūrṇalakṣaṇatvena doṣāṇāṃ hīnabalatvaṃ samavṛddhānāmanārambhakatvaṃ vā śakyamevāsmin pakṣe vaktuṃ, kintu tannādriyante; tataścobhayatrāpi nañaḥ prayogaṃ vinā ‘sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇā’ iti pāṭho yuktaḥ| sarvajetyabhidhāyāpi sarvalakṣaṇeti vacanamirivellikāyāmiva prakṛtisamasamavāyajanyavātādilakṣaṇadarśanārthaṃ, tena vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyajanyāsādhyatvādilakṣaṇāni na bhavanti| asminnapi pāṭhe sarvajā sarvairekādiprakārairvātādibhirjanyate, evaṃ sarvalakṣaṇeti vaktuṃ pāryate, kintu kṣudrarogatvāddoṣabhedena gaṇanā na yuktā| carake tviyaṃ kaphamārutajā paṭhyate| yaduktam– “jvarānvitā vaṅkṣaṇakakṣasandhau vartirnirartiḥ kaṭhinā matā yā| vidārikā sā kaphamārutābhyām|” (ca. ci. a. 12) iti| tenātrāpyalpapittayuktakaphavātajatvena sarvajatvaṃ jñeyam| yathā– jvarayogenālpapittatvam| yaduktam– “ūṣmā pittādṛte nāsti jvaro nāstyūṣmaṇā vinā|” (vā. ci. a. 1) iti, “vidārīmiti tāṃ vidyāt sarvajāṃ sarvalakṣaṇām|” iti pāṭhāntare na kaścidvyākhyānaprapañcaḥ||21|| vidārikālakṣaṇamāha– vidārītyādi| sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇetyatra kecidasarvajā asarvalakṣaṇetyubhayatrāpi nañaḥ prayogamicchanti, tenāsarvajeti sarvairdoṣaiḥ sannipatitainaṃ bhavati, asarvalakṣaṇeti sannipātalakṣaṇarahitetyarthaḥ| tena pratyekadoṣadvandvajatvena ṣaḍvidhā na sannipātamātreṇa bhavatīti vākyārthaḥ| kintvayaṃ yadi pakṣo'bhimata ācāryasya syāt, tadā vyaktyarthaṃ ṣaḍvidhā dvyekadoṣajeti padaṃ kṛtaṃ syāt| kiñca, bahuprapañcatvena kṣudratvāsaṅgatiśca| apare “ (a)sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇā” iti paṭhanti, tadapi na saṅgataṃ na sarvairdoṣairbhavatīti| atha sarvadoṣalakṣaṇā bhavati hanta tarhi liṅginamantareṇa liṅgaprādurbhāvaprasaṅgaḥ| anye tu uttarapada eva nañaḥ prayogāt “sarvajā (a)sarvalakṣaṇā” iti paṭhanti| tatra yadi sarveṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni sarvalakṣaṇāni tānyavidyamānāni yasyāmiti; tadā kathaṃ liṅgamantareṇa liṅginaḥ parokṣasya paricchedodayaḥ| atha sarvāṇi ca tāni lakṣaṇāni ca tāni avidyamānāni yasyām| sannipātajatve'pyasampūrṇalakṣaṇetyarthaḥ| etadapi na saṅgataṃ, yadyapyayaṃ pakṣo'bhīṣṭaḥ syāttadā asarvalakṣaṇeti na vaktavyamatra syāt, sarvatra nyāyasya samānatvāt| taduktam– “doṣe vibaddhe naṣṭe'gnau sarvasampūrṇalakṣaṇāḥ|” iti| hetvanurūpakopabalena hi sarvatra sarvārdhālpaliṅgasaṅgatiḥ| asampūrṇalakṣaṇatvena doṣāṇāṃ hīnabalatvaṃ samavṛddhānāmanārambhakatvaṃ vā śakyamevāsminpakṣe vaktuṃ, kintu tannādriyante, tataścobhayatrāpi nañaḥ prayogaṃ vinā “sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇā” iti pāṭho yuktaḥ| sarvajetyabhidhāyāpi sarvalakṣaṇeti vacanamirivellikāyāmiva prakṛtisamasamavāyajanyavātādilakṣaṇadarśanārthaṃ, tena vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyajanyāsādhyatvādilakṣaṇāni na bhavanti| asminnapi pāṭhe sarvajā sarvairekādiprakārairvātādibhirjanyate, evaṃ sarvalakṣaṇeti ca vaktuṃ pāryate, kintu kṣudrarogatvāddoṣabhedena gaṇanā na yuktā| carake tviyaṃ kaphamārutajā paṭhyate| yaduktam– “jvarānvitā vaṅkṣaṇakakṣasandhau vartirnirartiḥ kaṭhinā matā vā| vidārikā sā kaphamārutābhyām” iti| tenātrāpyalpapittayuktakaphavātajatvena sarvajatvaṃ jñeyam| jvarayogenālpapittatvaṃ carake draṣṭavyam| yaduktam– “ūṣmā pitādṛte nāsti jvaro nāstyūṣmaṇā vinā” iti| “vidārīmiti tāṃ vidyātsarvajāṃ sarvalakṣaṇām” iti pāṭhāntare na kaścidvyākhyānaprasaṅgaḥ||21|| prāpya māṃsasirāsnāyūḥ śleṣmā medastathā'nilaḥ | granthiṃ karotyasau bhinno madhusarpirvasānibham ||22|| sravatyāsrāvamanilastatra vṛddhiṃ gataḥ punaḥ | māṃsaṃ saṃśoṣya grathitāṃ śarkarāṃ janayettataḥ ||23|| durgandhi klinnamatyarthaṃ nānāvarṇaṃ tataḥ sirāḥ | sravanti raktaṃ sahasā taṃ vidyāccharkarārbudam ||24|| (su. ni. a. 13) | śarkarāmāha– prāpyetyādi| iyameva śarkarārbudasya hetuḥ| asyāṃ kaphānilau doṣau, māṃsasirāsnāyumedāṃsi dūṣyāṇi| anilastatra vṛddhiṃ gata iti pūrvameva tāvadvṛddho'nilo dhātukṣayeṇa vṛddhimatiśayena gato māṃsaṃ viśoṣya kāṭhinyāt śarkarātulyāṃ śarkarāṃ janayati ataḥ śarkarāyāstulyaṃ śarkarārbudaṃ bhavati| durgandhi klinnamityādinā śarkarotpannaṃ śarkarārbudalakṣaṇaṃ, śarkarārbudaṃ ca śarkarāvasthaivetyeka evāyaṃ vikāraḥ; tena na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| nānāvarṇamiti ghṛtamedovasāvarṇaṃ raktam| tata iti śarkarārbudādeva| bhoje'pi paṭhyate– “tameva bhinnaṃ durgandhaṃ ghṛtamedonibhaṃ sirāḥ| sravanti srāvamaniśaṃ tadā syāccharkarārbudam||” iti| tameveti granthim||22-24|| śarkarāmāha– prāpyetyādi| asyāṃ kaphānilau doṣau, māṃsasirāsnāyumedāṃsi dūṣyāṇi, anilastatra vṛddhiṃ gata iti pūrvameva tāvadvṛddho'nilo dhātukṣayāt punarvṛddhimatiśayaṃ gataḥ māṃsaṃ viśoṣya kāṭhinyāt śarkarātulyāṃ śarkarāṃ janayati| śarkarā pāṣāṇakarkaraḥ| śarkarārbudamāha– durgandhītyādi| śarkarārbudaṃ śarkarairvārbudatvenāvasthitetyeka evāyaṃ vikāraḥ, tena na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| nānāvarṇamiti ghṛtamedovasāvarṇaṃ yuktam, tata iti śarkarārbudadeśe, atra saptamyarthe pañcamī, bhoje'pi paṭhyate– “tameva bhinnaṃ durgandhaṃ ghṛtamedonibhaṃ sirāḥ| sravanti srāvamaniśaṃ tadā syāccharkarārbudam||” iti| tameveti granthim||22-24|| parikramaṇaśīlasya vāyuratyartharūkṣayoḥ | pādayoḥ kurute dārīṃ pādadārīṃ tamādiśet ||25|| (su. ni. a. 13) | pādadārīmāha– parikramaṇaśīlasyetyādi| parikramaṇaṃ pādaviharaṇaṃ, dārī dāraṇamātraṃ, vipādikākuṣṭhaṃ tu piḍakā savidāraṇeti bhedaḥ||25|| pādadārīmāha– parikramaṇaśīlasyetyādi| pādaviharaṇaśīlasya dārī vidaraṇamātraṃ, vipādikākuṣṭhaṃ tu piḍakānāṃ vidaraṇamiti bhedaḥ||25|| śarkaronmathite pāde kṣate vā kaṇṭakādibhiḥ | granthiḥ kolavadutsanno jāyate kadaraṃ hi tat ||26|| (su. ni. a. 13) | kadaramāha– śarkaronmathita ityādi| kadaraṃ kolāṣṭhīti khyātam| ‘kolavat’ ityasya sthāne ‘kīlavat’ iti pāṭhāntaram| kadaraṃ haste'pi bhavati| tathāca bhojaḥ– “hastayoḥ pādayoścāpi gambhīrānugataṃ kharam| māṃsakīlaṃ janayataḥ kupitau kaphamārutau|| saśalyamiva taṃ deśaṃ manyate tena pīḍitaḥ| śarkarākadaraṃ kecinmanyante vātakaṇṭakam||” iti| kolavaditi badaravat||26|| kadaramāha– śarkaretyādi| pāde śarkarā ghaṭakarparakhaṇḍādayaḥ, tābhirunmathite pīḍite kaṇṭakādibhirvā kṣate kolavadutsanno granthirjāyate, tatkadaraṃ nāma; ‘kolavat’ iti sthāne ‘kīlavat’ iti pāṭhāntaram| kadaraṃ haste'pi bhavati| yaduktaṃ bhojena– “hastayoḥ pādayoścāpi gambhīrānugataṃ kharam| māṃsakīlaṃ janayataḥ kupitau kaphamārutau|| saśalyamiva taṃ deśaṃ manyate tena pīḍitaḥ| śarkarākadaraṃ kecinmanyante vātakaṇṭakam||” iti| kolavat badaravat||26|| klinnāṅgulyantarau pādau kaṇḍūdāharujānvitau | duṣṭakardamasaṃsparśādalasaṃ taṃ vibhāvayet ||27|| (su. ni. a. 13) | alasakalakṣaṇamāha– klinnetyādi| ayaṃ kapharaktajo vikāraḥ ‘pākuyā’ iti khyātaḥ| atra kaṇḍūḥ kaphasya, dāharuje raktasya||27|| alasakalakṣaṇamāha– klinnetyādi| ayaṃ ca kapharaktajo vikāraḥ; tatra kaṇḍūḥ kaphasya, dāharuje raktasya||27|| romakūpānugaṃ pittaṃ vātena saha mūrchitam | pracyāvayati romāṇi tataḥ śleṣmā saśoṇitaḥ ||28|| ruṇaddhi romakūpāṃstu tato'nyeṣāmasambhavaḥ | tadindraluptaṃ khālityaṃ ruhyeti ca vibhāvyate ||29|| (su. ni. a. 13) | indraluptasya lakṣaṇamāha– romakūpetyādi| etattribhirdoṣaiḥ saśoṇitaiḥ svabhāvānniyatakālavyāpārairbhavati| etacca strīṇāṃ na bhavatīti videhavacanādvyākhyānayanti| yaduktam– “atyantasukumārāṅgyo rajo duṣṭaṃ sravanti ca| avyāyāmaratā yasmāttasmānna khalitiḥ striyāḥ||” iti| avyāyāmādvātapittayorakopena nātiromacyutiḥ, rajaḥsrāveṇa ca sroto'varodhābhāvāccyutānāmapi romṇāṃ punarvirohaḥ; kintu strīṣvapi khalitidarśanāt prāyikaṃ videhavacanam| khālityaṃ ruhyeti ca tasya paryāyakathanam| tathāca bhojaḥ– “tadindraluptamityāhuḥ khallīṃ ruhyāṃ ca kecana|” iti| kārtikastvāha– “indraluptaṃ śmaśruṇi bhavati, khālityaṃ śirasyeva, ruhyā ca sarvadehe|” iti| āgamastvatra nāsti||28-29|| indraluptamāha– rometyādi| etattribhirdoṣaiḥ saśoṇitaiḥ svabhāvānniyatakālavyāpārairbhavati, mūrchitaṃ vṛddhigataṃ, pracyāvayati pātayati| tato'nyeṣāmasambhava iti anyeṣāṃ romṇāmaprādurbhāvaḥ| etacca strīṇāṃ na bhavati videhavacanāditi vyākhyānayanti, yaduktam– “atyantasukumārāṅgyo rajo duṣṭaṃ sravanti ca| avyāyāmaratā yasmāttasmānna khalitiḥ striyāḥ||” iti| khalvī ruhyāṃ ca kecana iti| khālityaṃ ruhyeti ca tasya paryāyakathanam| kārtikastvāha– “indraluptaṃ śmaśruṇi bhavati, khālityaṃ śirasyeva, ruhyā ca sarvadehe” iti| āgamastvatra nāsti||28-29|| dāruṇā kaṇḍurā rūkṣā keśabhūmiḥ prapāṭyate | kaphamārutakopena vidyāddāruṇakaṃ tu tam ||30|| (su. ni. a. 13) | dāruṇalakṣaṇamāha– dāruṇetyādi| dāruṇeti kaṭhinā| kaphamārutakopeneti yadyapyuktaṃ tathāpi pittaraktānubandho'pyatra draṣṭavyaḥ| tathāhi videhaḥ– “yadatra paṭalābhāsaṃ sarujaskaṃ śirastvaci| paruṣaṃ jāyate jantostasya rūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ|| todaiḥ samanvitaṃ vātāt sakaṇḍūgauravaṃ kaphāt| sapipāsaṃ sadāhārtirāgaṃ pittāsrajaṃ tathā||” iti| atra vacane sadāharāgaṃ ca pittāt, sārti tu raktāt, artirhi raktajā'pi bhavati| yaduktam– “raktaṃ hi vyamlatāṃ yāti taccennāsti na cāsti ruk|” iti| dāruṇaṃ ‘rukkhī’ iti loke||30|| dāruṇamāha– dāruṇetyādi| prapāṭyate puṭapuṭāyate, kaphamārutakopeneti yadyapyuktaṃ, tathāpi pittaraktānubandho'pyatra draṣṭavyaḥ| tathāhi videhaḥ– “yadatra paṭalābhāsaṃ sarujaskaṃ śirastvaci| paruṣaṃ jāyate jantostasya rūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ|| todaiḥ samanvitaṃ vātātsakaṇḍūgauravaṃ kaphāt| sapipāsaṃ sadāhārtirāgaṃ pittāsrajaṃ tathā||” iti| atra vacane sadāharāgaṃ ca pittāt, sārti tu raktāt, artirhi raktajā'pi bhavati| dāruṇakaṃ ‘rukkhī’ iti loke||30|| arūṃṣi bahuvaktrāṇi bahukledīni mūrdhni tu | kaphāsṛkkrimikopena nṛṇāṃ vidyādarūṃṣikām ||31|| (su. ni. a. 13) | arūṃṣikāmāha– arūṃṣītyādinā| arūṃṣīti vraṇāḥ||31|| arūṃṣikāmāha– arūṃṣītyādi| nṛṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ kaphā'sṛkkrimikopena mūrdhani mastake bahuvaktrāṇi tathā bahukledāni, arūṃṣīti vraṇā bhavanti, tāmarūṃṣikāṃ vidyāt||31|| krodhaśokaśramakṛtaḥ śarīroṣmā śirogataḥ | pittaṃ ca keśān pacati palitaṃ tena jāyate ||32|| (su. ni. a. 13) | palitamāha– krodhetyādi| śarīroṣmeti dehāgniḥ| pittaṃ ceti pittamapi śirogataṃ palitahetuḥ| nanu, pittamevāgniḥ, tatra tatra pittasya pācakatvenābhidhānāt; yaduktavān suśrutaḥ– “ na pākaḥ pittādṛte” (su. sū. a. 17) iti, tathā– “pitte tasmin pācako'gniriti sañjñā” (su. sū. a. 21) iti, tathā sa eva– “na khalu pittavyatirekeṇānyo'gnirupalabhyate, āgneye tu pitte dahanapacanadāraṇādiṣvabhivartamāne'gnidupacāraḥ kriyate antaragniriti, kṣīṇe hyagniguṇe tatsamānadravyopayogādativṛddhe śītakriyopayogādāgamācca paśyāmaḥ na khalu pittavyatirekeṇānyo'gniḥ|” (su. sū. a. 21) iti; carakācāryo'pyāha– “darśanaṃ paktirūṣmā ca kṣuttṛṣṇā dehamārdavam| prabhāprasādau medhā ca pittakarmāvikārajam|” (ca. sū. a. 18) iti; pākasyānyathānupapattyā cāgneraṅgīkāraḥ; kiñca mande'gnau pittakaramarīcādidravyopayogādagnervṛddhiḥ, pittapratikūlaśītamadhurādidravyopayogāccopaśama upalabhyate; yadi hi pittādbhinno'gniḥ syāttadā pittasya vṛddhihrāsānuvidhānamasyānupapannaṃ syāt, na hi tuhinakaramaṇḍale himabhāji ahimopalambhaḥ, atuhinamaṇḍale ahimabhāji bhagavati bhāskare abhimatahimopalambhaḥ, yadyato bhinnaṃ tattato bhedenopalabhyate, yathā sāgarādajagaraḥ, na caivaṃ pittādagniḥ, tat kutaḥ pittādagneḥ pṛthagupādānamiti? atra pratyabhidhīyate– na tāvadantaragniḥ pittādabhinnaḥ, bhedasādhakapramāṇasya bhūyaḥ sadbhāvāt; tathāhyabhede “samadoṣaḥ samāgniśca” (su. sū. a. 15) ityatra, “samaprakopau doṣāṇāṃ sarveṣāmagnisaṃśrayau” ityatra ca doṣapadalabdhatvādagneḥ pṛthagupādānamasaṅgataṃ; tīkṣṇaḥ pittena ceti svātmani kriyāvirodhādasaṅgataṃ; yat punaḥ “na khalu pittavyatirekeṇānyo'gniḥ” ityādyuktaṃ tadbhedameva sādhayati, upacārābhidhānāt; na hyabhede upacāraḥ sambhavati| yadapyagneḥ pittavṛddhihrāsānuvidhānamabhihitaṃ tadaprayojakaṃ, bhede'pi samānatvena tadupapatteḥ| yathā kaphavṛddhihrāsakarasaumyāgneyadravyābhyāṃ śukrasya vṛddhihrāsau dṛṣṭau, na ca kaphaśukrayoraikyaṃ; kiñca ghṛtaṃ pittaśamanamagneśca dīpanaṃ, pittasya sañcayādau nāgnervṛddhiḥ; peyādikaṃ cāgnikaraṃ, na pittakṛt; tataśca pittādvilakṣaṇo'ntaragniḥ| sa ca dravatejaḥsamudāyātmakasya pittasya tejobhāgo na bahiranalavadbhasmāṅgārākāraḥ, samudāyataśca samudāyī anya eva karacaraṇādibhya iva śarīram; atyantabhedena cāgrahaṇaṃ tasya nityasaṃśleṣaṇaśālitvāt| pittasya tejoṃ'śaḥ eva pāca(va)kaḥ, tadāha bhojaḥ– “dṛḍhamuṣṇocitaṃ hyetat pittoṣmā pacatīti yat| mūrchito rasavīryābhyāṃ samānavyānasaṃhitaḥ||” ityārabhya, “tasmāt tejomayaṃ pittaṃ pittoṣmā yaḥ sa paktimān| sa kāyāgniḥ sa kāyoṣmā sa paktā sa ca jīvanaḥ||” iti| pittaikadeśatvāttejasi pittopacāramāśritya suśrutenoktam– “ na pākaḥ pittādṛte|” iti, tathā “na khalu pittavyatirekeṇānyo'gniḥ|” iti| evamanyadapyagnerabhedasādhakaṃ vacanaṃ samādheyam| nanu, yadi tīkṣṇaḥ pittenetyuktaṃ, tat kathaṃ pittenaivāgneḥ praśamanamabhidhīyate| yaduktaṃ carake– “kaṭvajīrṇavidāhyamlakṣārādyaiḥ pittamulbaṇam| āplāvayaddhantyanalaṃ jalaṃ taptamivānalam||” (ca. ci. a. 15) iti; ucyate– yadā kaṭukena rūkṣoṣṇena pittaṃ vṛddhaṃ bhavati, tadā tejobhāgarūpāyāḥ pittasyāvasthāyā ulbaṇatvāttīkṣṇaḥ pitteneti saṅgataṃ; yadā amlalavaṇena snigdhoṣṇena kaphānugamanabhājā vṛddhaṃ pittaṃ tadā pittasya dravāvasthāyā udriktatvāt nirvāpaṇamagneruktamiti| jatukaṇe'pyuktam– “kupitena vāyunā dīpasyevāgnernirvāpaṇaṃ, pittenoṣṇajalavat, kaphenāmbuvat|” iti| tataśca yuktamagneḥ pṛthagupādānamiti| agniśca pittagatatvena krodhakṛto bhavatyeva, krodhena pittakopāt; śokaśramābhyāṃ tu janitavātena śarīroṣmaṇo'pi vikṣepaṇāt śirogatatvaṃ, tenānilo'pi labhyate, pittaṃ ca sākṣādupāttaṃ, cakāreṇa śleṣmā'pi keśaśuklatākaro gṛhyate| etena doṣatrayasahitaśarīroṣmā palitaheturiti vākyārthaścarakoktārthena saha saṃvādī bhavati| yadāha– “tejo'nilādyaiḥ saha keśabhūmiṃ dagdhvā tu kuryāt khalitaṃ narasya| kiñcittu dagdhvā palitāni kuryāddharitprabhatvaṃ ca śiroruhāṇām||” (ca. ci. a. 2) iti| etaccākālajapalitavyāpakaṃ lakṣaṇam| kālaje tu krodhādigrahaṇaṃ kāraṇāntaropalakṣaṇaṃ, tena vayaḥpariṇāmakṛtaścoṣmā doṣatrayayuktaḥ kālajapalitahetuḥ, anyathā kālajapalitasya saṅgraho na syāt| kiṃvā kālajaṃ svābhāvikatvādeva nocyate| anye tu pittagataśceccharīroṣmā tat kimubhayorupādānenetyabhidhāya śarīroṣmā pittaṃ ceti kartṛdvayamācakṣate; tena nātraikasmin viṣaye samuccayaḥ, kiṃ tarhi viṣayabhedāt| kartṛdvayaṃ; tatra śarīroṣmā vaikṛtaṃ palitaṃ karoti, pittaṃ ca prākṛtaṃ pittaprakṛteḥ palitaṃ karoti| yaduktam– “pittaprakṛtirakālajavalīpalitayuktaśca bhavati” iti| evaṃ svābhāvikajarāpalitamapi pittenaivāsya hetoḥ klṛptatvāt| na coṣmakṛtatvena palitasyādoṣajatvaprasaṅgaḥ, ūṣmaṇaḥ pittadharmatvena pitte'ntarbhāvāt||32|| palitamāha– krodhetyādi| krodhādikṛtena śarīroṣmaṇā śirogatena vaikṛtaṃ pittena vayaḥkṛtaṃ tu prāptenetyarthaḥ| anye tu pittāgnyorbhedavādina ubhābhyāṃ manyante kālajalakṣaṇam, anye'pi tribhireva doṣaiḥ syāditi kathayanti| śokaśramābhyāṃ janitavātena śarīroṣmaṇo vikṣepācchirogatatvaṃ, tenānilo'pi labhyate, pittaṃ ca sākṣādupāttaṃ, cakāreṇa śleṣmāpi keśaśuklatākārako gṛhyate| etena doṣatrayasahitaḥ śarīroṣmā palitaheturiti vākyārthaḥ| yadāha carakaḥ– “tejonilādyaiḥ saha keśabhūmiṃ dagdhvā tu kuryā| khalatiṃ narasya| kiñcittu dagdhvā palitāni kuryāddharitprabhatvaṃ ca śiroruhāṇām||” iti||32|| śālmalīkaṇṭakaprakhyāḥ kaphamārutaraktajāḥ | yuvānapiḍakā yūnāṃ vijñeyā mukhadūṣikāḥ ||33|| (su. ni. a. 13) |34| yuvānapiḍakālakṣaṇamāha– śālmalītyādi| yuvānapiḍakā loke ‘varaṇḍakā’ ucyate| yūnāmānanapiḍakā yuvānapiḍakā, pṛṣodarāditvānnakāralopaḥ; eṣā ca yūnāmeva, mukha eva, svabhāvāt||33|| yauvanapiḍakāmāha– śālmalītyādi| eṣā svabhāvādyūnāmeva mukhe bhavati| mukhe dūṣakā mukhakāntihārakāḥ, yuvānapiḍakāḥ yūnāmānanapiḍakāḥ| pṛṣodarāditvānnakārasya lopaḥ||33|| padminīkaṇṭakamāha– kaṇṭakairityādi| padminīkaṇṭakasadṛśaiḥ kaṇṭakairācitaṃ vṛttādilakṣaṇaṃ yanmaṇḍalaṃ bhavati, tattadākhyamiti padminīkaṇṭakākhyam||34|| samamutsannamarujaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kapharaktajam | sahajaṃ lakṣma caikeṣāṃ lakṣyo jatumaṇistu saḥ ||35|| (su. ni. a. 13) | jatumaṇimāha– samamityādi| samaṃ masṛṇam| utsannamudgatam| ayaṃ ‘jaṭula’ iti loke prasiddhaḥ| kapharaktajamiti prādhānyenoktaṃ, samamityādi| samaṃ masṛṇam, utsannamudgatam| ayaṃ ‘jaṭula’ iti loke prasiddhaḥ| kapharaktajamiti prādhānyenoktaṃ, tena carakeṇoktaṃ tridoṣajatvapyasya bhavati| yaduktaṃ tena– “kṛṣṇaḥ snigdho saha jātaṃ janmakālapravṛttamityarthaḥ||35|| avedanaṃ sthiraṃ caiva yasmin gātre pradṛśyate | māṣavatkṛṣṇamutsannamanilānmaṣakaṃ tu tat ||36|| (su. ni. a. 13) | maṣakaliṅgamāha– avedanamityādi| sthiraṃ kaṭhinamiti gayadāsaḥ; acalamiti yuktaṃ, bhoje mṛdviti pāṭhāt| maṣakamādiśediti māṣaśabdāt “ive pratikṛtau” iti kan, nairuktyena ca vidhinā hrasvatvam| atra cakāreṇa kaphamedasī samuccīyete| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “vāterite tvaci yadā dūṣyete kaphamedasī| ślakṣṇaṃ mṛdu savarṇaṃ ca kuruto maṣakaṃ vadet||” iti||36|| maṣakamāha– avedanamityādi| sthiramacalaṃ bhoje mṛdviti pāṭhāt| atra cakāreṇa kaphamedasī samuccīyete| tathāca bhojaḥ– “vāterite tvaci yadā dūṣyete kaphamedasī| ślakṣṇaṃ mṛdu savarṇaṃ ca kurute maṣakaṃ vadet||” iti||36|| kṛṣṇāni tilamātrāṇi nīrujāni samāni ca | vātapittakaphocchoṣāttān vidyāttilakālakān ||37|| (su. ni. a. 13) | tilakālakalakṣaṇamāha– kṛṣṇānītyādi| ‘vātapittakaphocchoṣāt’ iti pāṭhe vātapittābhyāṃ hetubhyāṃ kaphasyocchoṣaḥ śoṣaṇaṃ tasmāt| anye vāto'pyavagantavyaḥ, tenāpi śoṣasya kriyamāṇatvāt| anye'pi tantrāntaraṃ dṛṣṭvā ‘vātapittakaphotsekāt’ iti paṭhanti| utsekādityudrekāt| tathāhi tantrāntaram– “mārutaḥ pittamādāya kapharaktasamāśritaḥ| cinoti tilamātrāṇi tvaci te tilakālakāḥ||” iti; kintvasminnapi tantre kapharaktasamāśrita ityanena kapharaktayorāśritavātena pittasahitenocchoṣādeva tilakālake kārṣṇyasya sambhavo'vagamyate, tataśca ‘vātapittakaphocchoṣāt’ iti pāṭho yujyate| ‘vātapittarasodrekāt’ iti pāṭhāntaram||37|| tilakālakalakṣaṇamāha– nīlānītyādi| śarīratvaksamāni nodgatānītyarthaḥ| vātapittakaphodrekādityatra “vātapittakaphocchoṣāt” iti pāṭhe vātapittābhyāṃ hetubhyāṃ kaphasyocchoṣaḥ śoṣaṇaṃ, tasmāt| anye tu “vātapittāsṛgucchoṣāt” iti paṭhanti| tatra vātapittābhyāṃ raktasya śoṣādityarthaḥ| ata eva tilakālake kārṣṇyaṃ; tathāca carakaḥ– “yasya pittaṃ prakupitaṃ śoṇitaṃ prāpya śuṣyati| tilakā viplavo vyaṅgā nīlikā cāsya jāyate||” iti| asmin vacane vāto'pyavagantavyaḥ, tenāpi śoṣasya kriyamāṇatvāt| anye tantrāntaraṃ dṛṣṭvā “vātapittakaphotsekāt” iti paṭhanti| utsekāditi udrekāt| tathāhi tantrāntare– “mārutaḥ pittamādāya kapharaktasamāśritaḥ| cinoti tilamātrāṇi tvaci te tilakālakāḥ||” iti||37|| mahadvā yadi vā cālpaṃ śyāvaṃ vā yadi vā'sitam | nīrujaṃ maṇḍalaṃ gātre nyacchamityabhidhīyate ||38|| (su. ni. a. 13) | nyacchaliṅgamāha– mahadvetyādi| asitaṃ kṛṣṇam| ‘nīrujaṃ maṇḍalam’ ityasya sthāne ‘sahajaṃ maṇḍalam’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tena janmakālapravṛttaṃ nyacchamicchanti, ata eva nyacchasya paryāye lāñchanamiti taiḥ paṭhyate| yathā– “nyacchaṃ lāñchanamucyate” iti| lāñchanaṃ lakṣaṇam| atra bhojavacanāt pittaraktānvito vāyuḥ kāraṇam| yadāha– “raktapittānvito vāyustvakpradeśāśrito yadā| janayenmaṇḍalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śyāvaṃ vā nyacchamādiśet||” iti| atra śyāvatvapakṣe mukhetaradeśa eva sambhavena bahulatvena vyaṅgādbhedo'vagantavyaḥ||38|| nyacchamāha– mahadityādi| śyāvaṃ śuklānuviddhaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇam, asitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ, ‘nīrujaṃ maṇḍalam’ ityasya sthāne ‘sahajaṃ maṇḍalam’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tena janmakālapravṛttaṃ nyacchamicchanti, nyacchasya paryāyo lāñchanamiti taiḥ paṭhyate| abhidhāne– ‘nyacchaṃ lāñchanamucyate’ iti| atra bhojavacanāt pittaraktānvito vāyuḥ kāraṇam, yadāha– loke||39||– kṛṣṇamevaṅguṇaṃ gātre mukhe vā nīlikāṃ viduḥ ||40|| nīlikālakṣaṇamāha– kṛṣṇamevaṅguṇamityādi| evaṅguṇamiti nīrujatanukamaṇḍaladharmam| vyaṅgoktadoṣo'trāpi boddhavyaḥ, sammūrchanaviśeṣāttu
