iti kapharaktabhava ityarthaḥ||46|| ekavṛndamāha– vṛttetyādi| sadāhaḥ mandadāhaḥ, sahaśabda īṣadarthe apākī īṣatpākī, amṛdurīṣanmṛduḥ| anye ‘apākamṛduḥ’ iti paṭhanti, apākaścāsau mṛduśceti apākamṛduḥ| balāśakṣatajaprasūta iti kapharaktabhavaḥ||46|| samunnataṃ vṛttamamandadāhaṃ tīvrajvaraṃ vṛndamudāharanti | taccāpi pittakṣatajaprakopājjñeyaṃ satodaṃ pavanātmakaṃ tu ||47|| (su. ni. a. 16) | vṛndamāha– samunnatamityādi| vṛndameva pavanānuviddhaṃ satodaṃ syāt| nanu, saptadaśa kaṇṭhagatā uktāḥ; uktaṃ hi– “saptadaśāmayāḥ kaṇṭhe” iti, vṛndena sahāṣṭādaśa syuḥ? ucyate– ekavṛndasyāvasthāviśeṣa eva vṛndaḥ, tulyasthānākṛtito na saṅkhyātirekaḥ; yadyapyekavṛndaḥ kapharaktajaḥ, vṛndastu pittaraktajaḥ paṭhitaḥ, tathā vṛndasyaiva satodatvena vātātmakatvamuktaṃ, tathā'pyekavṛndasyāvasthāviśeṣatvena vṛndaḥ saṅgacchata eva; yathā kāmalāyāṃ tadbhinnahetulakṣaṇasyāpi halīmakasya saṅgrahaḥ, yathā vātamadātyayena dhvaṃsakavikṣepakayoratyantābhede'pi sa eva syānna punastena saṅgrahaḥ; bhoje'pyayamekavṛndaja eva paṭhitaḥ| yadāha– “śleṣmaraktasamutthānamekavṛndaṃ vibhāvayet| tulyasthānākṛtirvṛndo vṛndajo raktapittajaḥ||” iti| vṛndaja ityekavṛndajaḥ| gadādharastu kāraṇabhedāt dharmabhedācca utpannatvena caikakāryakāraṇayorabhedaprasaṅgamabhidhāya vṛndaśabdaṃ chando'nurodhādādilopādekavṛnda eva varṇayati, tathāca sati samunnatamityādinā pittānubandhasahitabahularaktakṛtaikavṛndasya lakṣaṇamucyate, satodaṃ pavanātmakaṃ cetyanena ca vātānubandhaikavṛndalakṣaṇamiti vyākhyeyam| parantu vṛndajo vṛnda iti bhojavacanenāsaṅgatamidaṃ vyākhyānam||47|| vṛndamāha– samunnatamityādi| nanu, saptadaśakaṇṭhagatā uktāḥ, uktaṃ hi– “saptadaśāmayāḥ kaṇṭhe” iti, vṛndena sahāṣṭādaśa syuḥ? ucyate– ekavṛndasyāvasthāviśeṣa eva vṛndaḥ, tulyasthānakṛtiścāto na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| bhoje'pyayamekavṛndaja eva paṭhitaḥ| yadāha– “śleṣmaraktasamutthānamekavṛndaṃ vibhāvayet| tulyasthānākṛtirvṛndo vṛndajo raktapittajaḥ||” iti| vṛndaje ityekavṛndaja iti||47|| vartirghanā kaṇṭhanirodhinī yā citā'timātraṃ piśitaprarohaiḥ | anekaruk prāṇaharī tridoṣājjñeyā śataghnī ca śataghnirūpā ||48|| (su. ni. a. 16) | śataghnīlakṣaṇamāha– vartirityādi| anekarugiti vātapittakaphajatodadāhakaṇḍvādivedanānvitetyarthaḥ| śataghnirūpeti ayaḥkaṇṭakācchannā mahatī śilā śataghnī, tattulyā| prāṇaharītyasādhyā| bhoje'pyuktam– “śaṅkuneva gale viddhā śataghnyeṣā na sidhyati|” iti||48|| śataghnīlakṣaṇamāha– vartirityādi| anekarugiti vātapittakaphajatodadāhakaṇḍvādivedanānvitetyarthaḥ| śataghnirūpeti ‘ayaḥkaṇṭakasañchannā śataghnī mahatī śilā’ tattulyā| prāṇaharītyasādhyā| bhoje'pyuktam “vātapittakaphā duṣṭā māṃsāṅkurasamācitām| madhyakaṇṭacayāṃ vartiṃ janayanti hyupekṣitāḥ|| śaṅkuneva gale viddhā śataghnyeṣā na sidhyati|” iti||48|| granthirgale tvāmalakāsthimātraḥ sthiro'tirugyaḥ kapharaktamūrtiḥ | saṃlakṣyate saktamivāśanaṃ ca sa śastrasādhyastu galāyusañjñaḥ ||49|| (su. ni. a. 16) | galāyulakṣaṇamāha– granthirityādi| kapharaktamūrtiriti kapharaktajaḥ| saktamiveti lagnamiva| aśanaṃ bhuktam||49|| galāyuliṅgamāha– granthirityādi| saktamiveti lagnamiva, aśanaṃ bhojanaṃ, saṃlakṣyate, sa galāyusañjño vikāraḥ, sa śastrasādhyaḥ||49|| sarvaṃ galaṃ vyāpya samutthito yaḥ śotho rujaḥ santi ca yatra sarvāḥ | sa sarvadoṣairgalavidradhistu tasyaiva tulyaḥ khalu sarvajasya ||50|| (su. ni. a. 16) | galavidradhiliṅgamāha– sarvamityādi| tasyaiva tulyaḥ khalu sarvajasyeti prāguktasya vidradheḥ sannipātajasya tulya ityarthaḥ| sa ca sthānaprabhāveṇa sannipātaja eva, cikitsābhedārthaṃ ca punaḥ paṭhitaḥ||50|| galavidradhimāha– sarvamityādi| tasyaivetyādiprāguktavidradheḥ sannipātajasya tulya ityarthaḥ| ayaṃ ca sthānaprabhāveṇa sannipātaja eva, cikitsābhedārthaṃ ca punaḥ paṭhitaḥ||50|| śotho mahānannajalāvarodhī tīvrajvaro vāyugaternihantā | kaphena jāto rudhirānvitena gale galaughaḥ parikīrtyate tu ||51|| (su. ni. a. 16) | galaughalakṣaṇamāha– śotha ityādi| vāyugaternihanteti atimahattvādudānavāyugatirodhaka ityarthaḥ||51|| galaughalakṣaṇamāha– śopha ityādi| vāyugaternihantetyādi| atimahattvādudānavāyugatirodhaka ityarthaḥ||51|| yastāmyamānaḥ śvasiti prasaktaṃ bhinnasvaraḥ śuṣkavimuktakaṇṭhaḥ | kaphopadigdheṣvanilāyaneṣu jñeyaḥ sa rogaḥ śvasanāt svaraghnaḥ ||52|| (su. ni. a. 16) | svaraghnalakṣaṇamāha– ya ityādi| tāmyamāna iti mūrchāṃ gacchan, athavā tamaḥ paśyan| śvasiti prasaktamiti nirantaraṃ śvasiti| śuṣkavimuktakaṇṭha iti śuṣko nīraso vimuktaścāsvādhīnaḥ kaṇṭho yasya sa tathā| asvādhīnatā ca kimapi gilitumaśakyatayā boddhavyā| anilāyaneṣviti anilamārgeṣu kapharuddheṣu satsu, vāyugatasrotasordvitve'pi bahuvacanaṃ pratānabahutvāt| śvasanāditi vātāt||52|| svaraghnalakṣaṇamāha– ya ityādi| prasaktamiti nirantaraṃ niḥśvasiti, śuṣkavimuktakaṇṭha iti śuṣko nīraso vimuktaścāsvādhīnaḥ kaṇṭho yasya sa tathā, asvādhīnatā ca kimapi gilitumaśakyatayā boddhavyā| keṣu satsu? anilāyaneṣviti anilamārgeṣu kaphopadigdheṣu kapharuddheṣu satsu, vāyuvahasrotasordvitve'pi bahuvacanaṃ pratānabahutvāt| sa rogaḥ śvasanāt vātāt svaraghno jñeyaḥ||52|| pratānavān yaḥ śvayathuḥ sukaṣṭo galoparodhaṃ kurute krameṇa | sa māṃsatānaḥ kathito'valambī prāṇapraṇut sarvakṛto vikāraḥ ||53|| (su. ni. a. 16) | māṃsatānaliṅgamāha– pratānavānityādi| pratānavāniti vistāravān| sukaṣṭa iti mahāduḥkhapradāyī; na tu kṛcchrasādhyaḥ, prāṇapraṇuditi vacanāt; athavā pākataḥ kaṣṭasādhyaḥ, samastagaloparodhe tu prāṇapraṇut| ‘sa māṃsatānaḥ kathito'valambī’ ityasya sthāne ‘sa māṃsatāneti bibharti sañjñām’ iti pāṭhāntare māṃsatānetyatra itiśabdena prātipadikārthasyoktatvādvibhaktyabhāvaḥ| ‘bibharti sañjñām’ ityasya sthāne ‘niruṇaddhi ceṣṭām’ iti kārtikaḥ| asmin vyākhyāne ‘sa māṃsatāna’ ityasyānantaraṃ ‘khyāta’ iti draṣṭavyam||53|| māṃsatānaliṅgamāha– pratānetyādi| pratānavāniti vistāravān, sukaṣṭaḥ mahāduḥkhadāyī natu kṛcchrasādhyaḥ, prāṇapraṇuditi vacanāt; athavā pākataḥ kaṣṭasādhyaḥ, samastagaloparodhe tu prāṇapraṇut| avalambī lambanaśīlaḥ||53|| sadāhatodaṃ śvayathuṃ sutāmramantargale pūtiviśīrṇamāṃsam | pittena vidyādvadane vidārīṃ pārśve viśeṣāt sa tu yena śete ||54|| (su. ni. a. 16) | vidārīlakṣaṇamāha– sadāhatodamityādi| vadana iti svarūpaparamidam, antargala ityanenaiva vadanaśabdasya labdhatvāt| pārśve viśeṣāt sa tu yena śete iti sa puruṣo yena pārśvena viśeṣādbāhulyena śete tasminneva pārśve vidārī bhavatītyarthaḥ| viśeṣagrahaṇādanyasmin pārśve'pi sambhavo'syāḥ| vidārīsañjñā ca māṃsavidāraṇena| bhoje'pyuktam– “pittena jāto vadane vikāraḥ pārśve viśeṣāt sa tu yena śete| snāyupratānaprabhavo viśeṣāddāhaprapākapracuro vidārī||” iti||54|| vidārīlakṣaṇamāha– sadāhetyādi| pūtiviśīrṇamāṃsaṃ durgandhaśaṭitamāṃsam| vadana iti svarūpaparamidaṃ, antargalamityanenaiva vadanasambandhasya labdhatvāt| pārśve ityādi sa puruṣo yena pārśvena viśeṣāt bāhulyena śete tasmin pārśve viśeṣeṇa bhavatītyarthaḥ; viśeṣagrahaṇādanyapārśve'pi sambhavo'syāḥ| vidārīsañjñā ca māṃsavidāraṇena, bhoje'pyuktam– “pittena jāto vadane vikāraḥ pārśve viśeṣāt sa tu yena śete| snāyupratānaprabhavo viśeṣāddāhaprapākapracuro vidārī||” iti||54|| sphoṭaiḥ satodairvadanaṃ samantādyasyācitaṃ sarvasaraḥ sa vātāt | raktaiḥ sadāhaistanubhiḥ sapītairyasyācitaṃ cāpi sa pittakopāt | avedanaiḥ kaṇḍuyutaiḥ savarṇairyasyācitaṃ cāpi sa vai kaphena ||55|| (su. ni. a. 16) | sarvasarāstrayo'bhidhīyante– sphoṭairityādinā| mukhagatoṣṭhādisaptasthānavyāpakatayā sarvasaratvaṃ jñeyam| sphoṭairiti vadanamiti ca uttaratra sambandhanīyam| ācitaṃ vyāptam| sarvasarā mukhapākā ucyante| kecidvidehaktaraktajasarvasaralakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti| yathā– “raktena pittodita eva cāpi kaiścit pradiṣṭo mukhapākasañjñaḥ|” iti| ayaṃ ca paittika evāntarbhūta iti neha darśita iti||55|| sarvasarāstrayo'bhidhīyante| tatra vātajaṃ sarvasaramāha– sphoṭairityādi| ācitaṃ vyāptam| mukhadantauṣṭhādisaptasthānavyāpakatayā teṣāṃ sarvasaratvaṃ jñeyam| sphoṭairiti vadanamiti cottaratra sambandhanīyam| pittajaṃ sarvasaramāha– raktairityādi| sugamam| kaphajasarvasaramāha– avedanairityādi| sugamam| sarvasarā mukhapākā ucyante| kecidvidehaktaraktajasarvasaralakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti| tadyathā– “raktena pittodita eva cāpi kaiścitpradiṣṭo mukhapākasañjñaḥ|” iti| ayaṃ ca paittikasarvasare pradiṣṭa eveti neha darśitaḥ||55|| oṣṭhaprakope varjyāḥ syurmāṃsaraktatridoṣajāḥ | dantamūleṣu varjyau ca triliṅgagatiśauṣirau ||56|| danteṣu ca na sidhyanti śyāvadālanabhañjanāḥ | jihvāroge balāśastu tālavyeṣvarbudaṃ tathā ||57|| svaraghno valayo vṛndo balāśaśca vidārikā | galaugho māṃsatānaśca śataghnī rohiṇī gale ||58|| asādhyāḥ kīrtitā hyete rogā nava daśaiva tu | teṣu cāpi kriyāṃ vaidyaḥ pratyākhyāya samācaret ||59|| (su. ni. a. 16) | oṣṭhaprakopādiṣvasādhyānāha– oṣṭhaprakope varjyāḥ syurityādi| triliṅgagatiśauṣirāviti tridoṣajanāḍī tridoṣajaśca mahāśauṣiro'sādhyaḥ| rohiṇī gala iti tridoṣajā rohiṇī||56-59|| asādhyānāha– oṣṭhetyādi| oṣṭhajāstrayaḥ, dantamūle dvau, dantabhaveṣu trayaḥ, jihvāgateṣvekaḥ, tālunyapyeka eva, svaraghnādayo nava gale, samudāyasaṅkhyā navadaśaiveti| triliṅgagatiśauṣirāviti tridoṣajanāḍī tridoṣajaśca mahāśauṣiro'sādhyaḥ| balāśaḥ saha dāriṇeti| vidāryā saha, chando'nurodhāddāriṇeti nirdeśaḥ, rohiṇī gala iti tridoṣajā rohiṇī||56-59|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne mukharoganidānaṃ samāptam ||56|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ mukharoganidānaṃ samāptam||56|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ mukharoganidānam||56|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘ekaṣaṣṭiścatuṣparā’ iti pā.| ↩ 2 . ‘ekaṣaṣṭiścatuṣparā’ iti pā.| ↩ 3 . ‘pittakṛtarujābhiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 4 . ‘sadāhapākapiḍakāviti? naivaṃ,’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 5 . ‘dāhapākāvatiśayadarśanārtham’ iti pā.| ↩ 6 . ‘saṃrohet mṛdutvam’ iti pā. | ↩ 7 . ‘ghṛtasyoparitanaḥ svacchabhāgo’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘oṣṭhau paryavadīryete’ iti pā. | ↩ 9 . ‘grathītau ca samākhyātāvoṣṭhau’ iti pā. | ↩ 10 . ‘oṣṭhau paryavadīryete ityādinā’ iti pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘dantayostriṣvityādinā’ iti pā.| ↩ 12 . ‘yasminniti’ iti pā.| ↩ 13 . ‘yasminniti’ iti pā.| ↩ 14 . asmātpūrvaṃ kvacitpustake ‘aghaṭṭitāḥ prasravanti śoṇitaṃ mandavedanāḥ ādhmāyante srute rakte mukhaṃ prati ca jāyate’ iti ślokaḥ paṭhitaḥ ↩ 15 . ‘āghaṭṭitā ācālitāḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 16 . ‘nirdiśo'siddhatvānityatvātsādhuḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 17 . atra ‘jāte’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 18 . ‘suśrute'nuktaḥ adhikaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 19 . ‘suśrutokte pañca ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 20 . ‘mahān śotho’ iti pā. | ↩ 21 . ‘hanukūhare’ iti pā.| ↩ 22 . ‘pañca dantanāḍīrāha’ iti pāṭhaḥ pustakeṣu nopalabhyate | ↩ 23 . ‘yathoktavāta ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 24 . ‘ ... mityanyaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 25 . ‘sa saṃrambhaḥ śvayathuḥ|’ iti pā.| ↩ 26 . ‘dantabhañjalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 27 . ‘kecit’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 28 . ayaṃ ‘rūkṣa’ ityatra ‘bhakṣya’ ityeva pāṭhaṃ mukhyaṃ manute| ↩ 29 . cakṣiṅo ṅitkaraṇenā'nudāttettvalakṣaṇā''tmanepadasyā'nityatve'pi “bhāvakarmaṇoḥ” iti vihitātmanepadasyāpyanityatvenātra sādhutvasādhanaṃ sādhvasādhu veti sudhībhirevānusandheyam; kaṇḍvāderākṛtigaṇatvādetatsūpapādamiti pare| ↩ 30 . ‘jihvātale yaḥ śvayathurityādinā’ iti pā.| ↩ 31 . ‘mṛdurityādi|’ iti pā., ‘mṛduḥ śothaḥ’ ityatra ‘śophaḥ stabdhaḥ’ iti vā pā.| ↩ 32 . ‘rakto jñeyaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 33 . ‘bhavenmadhye’ iti pā.| ↩ 34 . ‘ ... rdīrghairlālām’ iti pā.| ↩ 35 . ‘deśe| tāluni puppuṭaḥ tālupuppuṭaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 36 . ‘kṣveḍasaṃyute’ iti pā.| ↩ 37 . ‘praduṣya’ iti pā. | ↩ 38 . ‘vātapittakapharaktānyekaśaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 39 . ‘ucyate’ iti pā.| ↩ 40 . ‘sa jahyāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 41 . ‘dagdhau’ iti pā.| ↩ 42 . atra ‘tathā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 43 . ‘galopasaṃrodhakarairasūnnihanti’ iti pā.| ↩ 44 . ‘samastā iti ekā sannipātāt,’ iti pā.| ↩ 45 . ‘kaṇṭhavirodhinaḥ syuḥ’ iti pā., ‘kaṇṭhavirodhinaḥ ye’ iti ca pā. | ↩ 46 . ‘srotonirodhi ... ’ iti pā. | ↩ 47 . atra ‘katham’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 48 . ‘apiravadhāraṇe’ iti pā.| ↩ 49 . ‘apiravadhāraṇe’ iti pā.| ↩ 50 . ‘balāsa’ iti pā. | ↩ 51 . ‘balāsa’ iti pā.| ↩ 52 . ‘balāsa’ iti pā.| ↩ 53 . atra ‘ātmanaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 54 . atra ‘gale’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 55 . ‘pākamṛduḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 56 . atra ‘apākyamṛduḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 57 . ‘ ... ratyantabhede hi’ iti pā.| ↩ 58 . ‘śataghnī mahatī śilā’ iti pā.| ↩ 59 . ‘hyapekṣitāḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 60 . atra ‘prāṇaprerakaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 61 . ayameva pāṭhamūrīkaroti| ↩ 62 . ‘viśeṣaṇāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 63 . ‘pārśvairviśeṣāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 64 . ‘sphoṭaiḥ satodairityādinā’ iti pā.| ↩ 65 . ‘mukhadantoṣṭhādi ... ’ iti pā.| ↩ 66 . ‘prayukto’ iti pā.| ↩ 67 . ‘pittam’ iti pā.| ↩ 68 . ‘kaphasarvasaramāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 69 . ‘balāśaśca vidārikā’ ityatra ‘balāśaḥ saha dāriṇā’ iti pā.| ↩ 70 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ mukharoganidānam||56||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 57. karṇaroganidānam
text: atha karṇaroganidānam | samīraṇaḥ śrotragato'nyathācaran samantataḥ śūlamatīva karṇayoḥ | karoti doṣaiśca yathāsvamāvṛtaḥ sa karṇaśūlaḥ kathito durācaraḥ ||1|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20) | mukharoge jihvāśrayarogo'bhihitaḥ, jihvā cendriyādhiṣṭhānam, ata indriyādhiṣṭhānaduṣṭisāmyāt karṇaroganidānamucyate; karṇaśabdena ca karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnamadṛṣṭopagṛhītaṃ śrotramucyate, tatra yadyapyekadeśagato rogastathā'pyavayave'pi samudāyopacārataḥ karṇavyapadeśaḥ| tatra karṇaśūlaṃ kaṣṭatvāt prāgāha– samīraṇa ityādi| atrānayaiva samprāptyā'rthato nidānasañcayādyākṣiptaṃ; yato nidānāt sañcayaḥ, sañcayāt prakopaḥ, prakopāt prasaraḥ, prasarāt sthānasaṃśrayaḥ, tato vyaktiḥ, tato bheda iti| karṇaśūlasya ca kaṣṭatvaṃ mūrchādyupadravayogāt| yadāha videhaḥ– “mūrchā dāho jvaraḥ kāso hṛllāso vamathustathā| upadravāḥ karṇaśūle bhavantyete mariṣyataḥ||” iti| anyathācaranniti pratilomaṃ caran| doṣairiti kaphapittaraktaiḥ; rakte'pi rujākartṛtvāt sāmānyena doṣavyapadeśaḥ| yathāsvamāvṛta iti svanidānakupitadoṣairyathāsvīyalakṣaṇairāvṛto na tu kopitairvāyunā; “ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvāneva prakopayet” iti nyāyāt; yataḥ svatantrakupitā doṣāḥ saṃsargabhājo bhavanti, paratantrakupitāstvanubandharūpā bhavanti; athavā yathāsvamiti śūlaviśeṣaṇaṃ, yathāsvīyamityarthaḥ| durācāra iti duḥkhenācaryate iti durācaraḥ||1|| mukharoge jihvāśrayā rogā abhihitāḥ, jihvā cendriyādhiṣṭhānam, ata indriyādhiṣṭhānaduṣṭisāmyātkarṇaroganidānamucyate| karṇaśabdena karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnamadṛṣṭopagṛhītaṃ śrotramucyate| atra yadyapyekadeśe rogaḥ, tathā'pyavayave'pi samudāyopacārātkarṇarogavyapadeśaḥ| atra karṇaśūlaṃ kaṣṭasādhyatvātprāgāha– samīraṇa ityādi| atrānayaiva samprāptyā'rthato nidānasañcayādyākṣiptaṃ boddhavyam| yato nidānāt sañcayaḥ, sañcayāt prakopaḥ, prakopātprasaraḥ, prasarāt sthānasaṃśrayaḥ, tato vyaktiḥ, tato bheda iti| karṇaśūlasya ca kaṣṭatvaṃ mūrchādyupadravayogāt| yadāha videhaḥ– “mūrchā dāho jvaraḥ kāsaḥ kutsā'nne vamathuḥ satṛṭ| upadravāḥ karṇaśūle bhavantyete mariṣyataḥ||” iti| śrotragataḥ śrotraṃ śaṣkulīparicchinnamākāśaḥ, samīraṇo vāyuḥ, śrotragataḥ śrotraprāptaḥ, anyathā caranniti pratilomaṃ caran vimārgaga iti vā; caran samantataḥ karṇayoratīva śūlaṃ karotīti sambandhanīyam| kathambhūto vāyuḥ? doṣairiti pittakapharaktaiḥ, rakte'pi rujādikartṛtvena doṣasāmyāddoṣavyapadeśaḥ| yathāsvamāvṛta iti yathāsvamatra svasya doṣasyānatikrameṇa yathāsvaṃ, tena svanidānakupitairdoṣairyathātmīyalakṣaṇāvṛto na tu kupitena vāyunā kopitaiḥ, atha vā yathāsvamiti śūlaviśeṣaṇaṃ, yathātmīyamityarthaḥ| sa tathāvidho rogaḥ karṇaśūlaḥ kathitaḥ| kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ? durāsado durvāraḥ, ‘durācaraḥ’ iti pāṭhe duḥkhena caryate upacaryata iti durācaraḥ||1|| karṇasrotaḥ sthite vāte śṛṇoti vividhān svarān | bherīmṛdaṅgaśaṅkhānāṃ karṇanādaḥ sa ucyate ||2|| yadā śabdavahaṃ vāyuḥ srota āvṛtya tiṣṭhati | śuddhaḥ śleṣmānvito vā'pi bādhiryaṃ tena jāyate ||3|| karṇanādamāha– karṇasrotaḥsthita ityādi| yadā karṇasrotasi vividhaprakāreṇāvasthito vāyurbhavati tadā tasya vividhābhihananāduktavividhaśabdaśravaṇaṃ, bherīmṛdaṅgaśaṅkhānāmityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena bhṛṅgārādiśabdaśravaṇaṃ ca bhavati| yaduktaṃ videhe– “śirogato yadā vāyuḥ śrotrayoḥ pratipadyate| tadā tu vividhān śabdān samīrayati karṇayoḥ|| bhṛṅgārakrauñcanādaṃ vā maṇḍūkakākayostathā| tantrīmṛdaṅgaśabdaṃ vā sāmatūryasvanaṃ tathā|| gītādhyayanavaṃśānāṃ nirghoṣaṃ kṣveḍanaṃ tathā| apāmiva patantīnāṃ śakaṭasyeva gacchataḥ|| śvasatāmiva sarpāṇāṃ sadṛśaḥ śrūyate svanaḥ|” iti||2-3|| karṇanādamāha– karṇetyādi| bherīmṛdaṅgaśaṅkhānāmityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena bhṛṅgārādiśabdagrahaṇaṃ ca bhavati| yaduktaṃ videhe– “śirogato yadā vāyuḥ śrotrayoḥ pratipadyate| tadā tu vividhāñchabdānsamīrayati karṇayoḥ|| bhṛṅgārakrauñcanādaṃ vā maṇḍūkakākayostathā| tantrīmṛdaṅgaśabdaṃ vā sāmatūryasvanaṃ tathā|| gītādhyayanavaṃśānāṃ nirghoṣaṃ kṣveḍanaṃ tathā| apāmiva patantīnāṃ śakaṭasyeva gacchataḥ|| śvasatāmiva sarpāṇāṃ sadṛśaḥ śrūyate svanaḥ|” iti| praṇādasyāpīḍākaratve'pi rogākhyā, tilakālakavanmanoduḥkhajanakatvāt| bādhiryamāha– yadetyādi| śabdavahaṃ srotaḥ karṇaśaṣkulīparicchinnamākāśaṃ, tadgatavātajanitamatra bādhiryam, apiśabdādraktapittāvaraṇayorupagraha iti||2-3|| vāyuḥ pittādibhiryukto veṇughoṣopamaṃ svanam | karoti karṇayoḥ kṣveḍaṃ karṇakṣveḍaḥ sa ucyate ||4|| karṇakṣveḍamāha– vāyurityādi| kṣveḍameva vyākaroti– veṇughoṣopamaṃ svanamiti| nanu, karṇanādāt kathamasya bhedaḥ? ucyate– karṇanāde kevalānilaje nānāśabdān śṛṇoti, atra tu veṇuśabdameva niyamena; tathā'yaṃ pittādisaṃsṛṣṭavātajanya iti| tathāha videhaḥ– “mārutaḥ kaphapittābhyāṃ saṃsṛṣṭaḥ śoṇitena ca| karṇakṣveḍaṃ sañjanayet kṣveḍanaṃ veṇughoṣavat||” iti||4|| karṇakṣveḍamāha– vāyurityādi| nanu? karṇanādakarṇakṣveḍayoḥ ko bhedaḥ? ucyate– karṇanāde kevalānilaje nānāśabdān śṛṇoti, atra tu veṇuśabdameva niyamena, tathā'yaṃ pittādisaṃsṛṣṭavātajanyaḥ| tathāca videhaḥ– “mārutaḥ kaphapittābhyāṃ saṃsṛṣṭaḥ śoṇitena ca| karṇakṣveḍaṃ sañjanayetkṣveḍanaṃ veṇughoṣavat||” iti||4|| śiro'bhighātādathavā nimajjato jale prapākādathavā'pi vidradheḥ | sraveddhi pūyaṃ śravaṇo'nilārditaḥ sa karṇasaṃsrāva iti prakīrtitaḥ ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20) | karṇasrāvamāha– śiro'bhighātādityādi| sraveddhi pūyamityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena raktajale ca sravata iti mantavyaṃ, śiro'bhighātajalamajjanamātreṇa pūyasyāsambhavāt; athavā prapākāditi sarvatra sambadhyate; tarhi na pākāt pṛthak srāva uktaḥ, sarvatra pākasyāviśiṣṭatvāditi kārtikaḥ| nanu, pākāt vidradheḥ srāvasambhavo'stu, vidradhau tu vātetaradoṣasyāpi sambhavāt kathamanilārdita ityuktam? ucyate– atisrāveṇātrānilakopādanilārditatvaṃ boddhavyam||5|| karṇasrāvamāha– śiro'bhighātādityādi| atra pūyamityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena raktajale ca sravata iti mantavyam| atra prapākāditi sarvatra sambadhyate, tarhi na pākātpṛthak srāva uktaḥ syāt, sarvatra pākasyāviśiṣṭatvāditi kārtikaḥ| nanu, pākādvidradheḥ srāvasambhavo'stu, vidradhau tu vātetaradoṣasyāpi sadbhāvāttatkathamanilārdita ityuktaṃ? ucyate, atisrāveṇātrānilakopādanilārditatvaṃ boddhavyam| śiro'bhighātāt, athavā jale nimajjataḥ, athavā vidradheḥ karṇavidradheḥ prapākādanilārditaḥ śravaṇaḥ pūyaṃ sravet, sa karṇasaṃsrāvākhyo roga uktaḥ||5|| mārutaḥ kaphasaṃyuktaḥ karṇakaṇḍūṃ karoti ca | pittoṣmaśoṣitaḥ śleṣmā kurute karṇagūthakam ||6|| sa karṇagūtho dravatāṃ gato yadā vilāyito ghrāṇamukhaṃ prapadyate | tadā sa karṇapratināhasañjñito bhavedvikāraḥ śiraso'rdhabhedakṛt ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20) | karṇapratināhamāha– sa karṇagūtho dravatāmityādi| vilāyita iti snehasvedābhyāṃ vilīnīkṛtaḥ san| ghrāṇamukhamiti dvandvatvādekavadbhāvaḥ, tena ghrāṇaṃ ca mukhaṃ ca pratipadyate ityarthaḥ| anye ‘ghrāṇamukhāt’ iti paṭhanti, tadā ghrāṇamukhāt nāsāsakāśāt pratipadyate gacchatītyarthaḥ| ayaṃ kaphajo vikāraḥ; athavā karṇagūthaśoṣe mārutapittavyāpārāttrayāṇāmapi sambandho'sti, tena sannipātajo'yaṃ; tathāca videhaḥ– “kaphādvā mārutādvā'pi sannipātena vā punaḥ|” iti| śiraso'rdhabhedakṛditi ardhāvabhedaśirorogakṛt||6-7|| karṇakaṇḍūmāha– māruta ityādi| sugamam| karṇagūthamāha– pittetyādi| sugamam| karṇapratināhamāha– sa ityādi| yadā sa karṇagūtho vilāyita iti snehasvedābhyāṃ vilīnīkṛto dravatāṃ gataḥ san| ghrāṇamukhamiti dvandvaikavadbhāvaḥ, tena ghrāṇaṃ mukhaṃ ca pratipadyata ityarthaḥ| anye ‘ghrāṇamukhād’ iti paṭhanti, tadā ghrāṇamukhātsakāśātpratipadyate gacchatītyarthaḥ| tadā sa karṇapratināhasañjñito vikāro bhavet| ayaṃ kaphajo vikāraḥ; athavā karṇagūthaśothe mārutapittavyākhyāpārāttayorapyatra sambandho'sti, tena sannipātajo'yam| tathāhi videhaḥ– “kaphādvā mārutādvā'pi saha pittena vā punaḥ|” iti| śiraso'rdhabhedakṛditi ardhāvabhedaśirorogakṛt||6-7|| yadā tu mūrchantyathavā'pi jantavaḥ sṛjantyapatyānyathavā'pi makṣikāḥ | tadvyañjanatvācchravaṇo nirucyate bhiṣagbhirādyaiḥ krimikarṇako gadaḥ ||8|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20) | krimikarṇakamāha– yadā tu mūrchantītyādi| mūrchanti ucchritā bhavanti| jantavaḥ krimayaḥ| krimimūrchanaṃ ca māṃsaśoṇitakothe sati jñeyaṃ, tadantareṇa krimīṇāmasambhavāt| apatyānīti ḍimbhakān| tadvyañjanatvāditi krimilakṣaṇatvāt| śravaṇo nirucyate iti krimikarṇako gada iti āśrayāśritayorabhedopacārācchravaṇaḥ krimikarṇako gado bhaṇyate| śravaṇaśabdaḥ puṃliṅgo'pyastītyasmādeva nirdeśāt pratīyate| ayaṃ vikārastridoṣajo mantavyaḥ| tathā ca nimiḥ– “śleṣmapittajalonmiśre kothe śoṇitamāṃsaje| mūrchanti jantavastatra kṛṣṇāstāmrāḥ sitāruṇāḥ|| bhakṣayantīva te karṇaṃ kurvanto vividhā rujaḥ| krimikarṇaṃ tu taṃ vidyāt sannipātaprakopajam||” iti||8|| kṛmikarṇakamāha– yadetyādi| mūrchanti ucchritā bhavanti, jantavaḥ kṛmayaḥ, kṛmimūrchanaṃ ca māṃsaśoṇitakothe sati jñeyaṃ, tamantareṇa kṛmīṇāmasambhavāt| apatyāni ḍimbhakān sūkṣmakṛmīniti yāvat| makṣikā mammaṇākhyā nīlavarṇāḥ| ādyairgbhiṣabhirvidehādibhiḥ, tadvyañjanatvāditi kṛmilakṣaṇatvāt, āśrayāśritayorabhedopacārāt śravaṇaḥ kṛmikarṇako gado bhaṇyate| śravaṇaśabdaḥ puṃlliṅgo'pyastītyasmādeva nirdeśātpratīyate| ayaṃ vikārastridoṣajo mantavyaḥ| tathāca nimiḥ– “śleṣmapittajalonmiśre kothe śoṇitamāṃsaje| jāyante jantavastatra kṛṣṇāstāmrāḥ sitāruṇāḥ|| bhakṣayantīva te karṇaṃ kurvanto vividhā rujaḥ| kṛmikarṇaṃ tu taṃ vidyātsannipātaprakopajam||” iti||8|| pataṅgāḥ śatapadyaśca karṇasrotaḥ praviśya hi | aratiṃ vyākulatvaṃ ca bhṛśaṃ kurvanti vedanām ||9|| karṇo nistudyate tasya tathā pharapharāyate | kīṭe carati ruk tīvrā niṣpande mandavedanā ||10|| karṇapraviṣṭapataṅgakīṭādiliṅgamāha– pataṅgā ityādi| śatapadya iti kāraṇḍikāḥ| niṣpande iti sthire||9-10|| karṇapraviṣṭakīṭapataṅgādiliṅgamāha– pataṅgā ityādi| śatapadyaḥ kāraṇḍikāḥ| nistudyate prājaneneva| anyat sugamam||9-10|| kṣatābhighātaprabhavastu vidradhirbhavettathā doṣakṛto'paraḥ punaḥ | saraktapītāruṇamasramāsravet pratodadhūmāyanadāhacoṣavān ||11|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20) | karṇavidradhimāha– kṣatābhighātaprabhavastvityādi| kṣataprabhavo'bhighātaprabhavaśca, kṣatābhighātaprabhavayorāgantukatvādekatvam, evaṃ vātādijasyāpi doṣajatvādekatvam| saraktapītāruṇamasramāsravediti asramāsrāvaṃ, saraktapītāruṇavarṇatvaṃ cāsrāvasya vātapittakaphasambhavāt||11|| karṇavidradhimāha– kṣatetyādi| kṣataprabhavaścābhighātaprabhavaśca, kṣatābhighātaprabhavayorāgantukatvādaikyam| evaṃ vātādijasyāpi doṣajatvādekatvam| kṣatavidradherlakṣaṇamāha– setyādi| asraṃ āsrāvaṃ, raktapītāruṇavarṇatvaṃ cāsrāvasya vātapittaraktasambhavatvāt| dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmodvamanamiva vedanāviśeṣaḥ, coṣa ācūṣyata iva vedanāviśeṣaḥ| doṣavidradherlakṣaṇaṃ taireva jñātavyam||11|| karṇapākastu pittena kothavikledakṛdbhavet | karṇavidradhipākādvā jāyate cāmbupūraṇāt ||12|| karṇapākalakṣaṇamāha– karṇapāka ityādi| kothavikledakṛditi kothaḥ pūtibhāvaḥ, vikleda ārdratā| nanu, karṇagūthalakṣaṇe pittena śoṣaṇamuktaṃ, tatkathamārdratā? naivam, evaṃvikārajanakakarmasahakāriṇā dravāṃśodriktena pittenārdratā, tatra tvetadviparītatvena śoṣaḥ||12|| karṇapākalakṣaṇamāha– karṇetyādi| kothavikledakṛditi kothaḥ pūtibhāvaḥ, vikleda ārdratā| karṇavidradhipākāt, athavā ambupūraṇāt karṇapāko jāyate| nanu, karṇagūthalakṣaṇe pittena śoṣaṇamuktaṃ, tatkathamārdratā? maivam, etadvikārajanakakarmasahakāriṇā dravāṃśodriktena pittenārdratā, tatra tvetadviparītena śoṣaḥ||12|| pūyaṃ sravati pūti vā sa jñeyaḥ pūtikarṇakaḥ |13| pūtikarṇalakṣaṇamāha– pūyamityādi| pūyaṃ sravati vā pūtīti kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ, vāśabdo'tra samuccaye; tenāvedanatvaṃ, savedanatvaṃ vā, ghanasrāvitvaṃ ca samuccīyate| ghanasrāvaniyamācca karṇasrāvādasya bhedaḥ| tathācoktaṃ suśrute– “srotaḥsthite śleṣmaṇi pittatejasā vilīyamāne bhṛśasampratāpite| avedano vā'tha savedano vā ghanaṃ sravet pūti ca pūtikarṇaḥ||” iti| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20)| pūtimān karṇaḥ pūtikarṇaḥ|13|– pūtikarṇalakṣaṇamāha– pūyamityādi| pūtīti kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ, vāśabdo'tra samuccaye; tenāvedanatvaṃ savedanatvaṃ vā, ghanasrāvitvaṃ ca samuccīyate| ghanasrāvaniyamācca karṇasrāvādasya bhedaḥ| tathācoktaṃ suśrute– “ śrotaḥsthite śleṣmaṇi pittatejasā vilīyamāne bhṛśasampratāpite| avedano vā'pyathavā savedano ghanaṃ sravetpūti ca pūtikarṇaḥ||” iti| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20)| pūtimān karṇaḥ pūtikarṇakaḥ|13|– karṇaśothārbudārśāṃsi jānīyāduktalakṣaṇaiḥ ||13|| idānīṃ saṅkhyāpūraṇārthaṃ karṇagataśothārbudārśasāmatideśena lakṣaṇamāha– karṇaśothetyādi| karṇaśothāścatvāro vātapittakapharaktajatvena; evamarśaścaturvidhaṃ, sahajasannipātajārśasoḥ sannipātāgantujaśothayoścātrāsambhūtirādhāraprabhāvāt| arbudaṃ ca saptavidhaṃ vātapittakapharaktamāṃsamedaḥsirānimittabhedāt; sirājasya vātajāvaruddhasyātra pṛthaggaṇanaṃ śālākyasiddhāntasaṃvādāditi kārtikaḥ| yathā suśrute eva karṇarogānantaram– “doṣaistribhistaiḥ pṛthagekaśaśca brūyāttathā'rśāṃsi tathaiva śothān| śālākyasiddhāntamavekṣya cāpi sarvātmakaṃ saptamamarbudaṃ tu||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) iti| nāsāroge'bhidhāsyati, tathehāpi yujyate; tena raktajasya pittasamānaliṅgatvāt pittaje'ntarbhāvaḥ, tathā''gantujasyāpi raktapittaliṅgatvāt pittaja evāntarbhāvaḥ; tena śothaḥ sannipātajo'tra agaṇanīyaḥ, evaṃ sahajaraktajayordoṣaja evāntarbhāvāt sannipātajamarśo'pṛthaggaṇanīyam, arbudaṃ ca sannipātajaṃ saptamiti, evamebhiḥ sahāṣṭāviṃśatiḥ suśrutoktāḥ karṇarogā bhavanti||13|| karṇagataśophārbudārśasāmatītāvekṣaṇena lakṣaṇamāha– karṇetyādi| yadyapi śophādayaḥ prāṅnirdiṣṭāḥ, tathāpi karṇarogasaṅgrahārthaṃ sādhyāsādhyavibhāgārthaṃ ca punarnirdiṣṭāḥ karṇaśophāścatvāraḥ, vātapittakapharaktajatveneti; evamarśaścaturvidham| sahajasannipātajārśasoḥ sannipātajāgantujaśophayoścātrāsambhūtirādhāraśca prabhāvāt| arbudaṃ ca saptavidhaṃ vātapittakapharaktamāṃsamedaḥsirānimittabhedāt; sirājanyasya vātajāvaruddhasyātra pṛthagdarśanaṃ śālākyasiddhāntasaṃvādāditi kārtikaḥ| yadāha suśruta eva karṇarogānantaram– “doṣaistribhistaiḥ pṛthagekaśaśca bhūyāttathā'rśāṃsi tathaiva śophān| śālākyasiddhāntamavekṣya cāpi sarvātmakaṃ saptamamarbudaṃ syāt||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) iti| nāsāroge'bhidhāsyati, tathehāpi yujyate; tena raktajasya pittaliṅgatvāt pittaje'ntarbhāvaḥ, āgantujasyāpi raktapittaliṅgatvāt pittaja evāntarbhāvaḥ; tena śophaḥ sannipātajo'trāgaṇanīyaḥ, evaṃ sahajaraktajayordoṣaja evāntarbhāvāt sannipātajamarśaso'pṛthaggaṇanīyam, arbudaṃ ca sannipātajaṃ saptamiti, evamebhiḥ sahāṣṭāviṃśatiḥ suśrutoktāḥ karṇarogā bhavanti||13|| nādo'tiruk karṇamalasya śoṣaḥ srāvastanuścāśravaṇaṃ ca vātāt | śothaḥ sarāgo daraṇaṃ vidāhaḥ sapītapūtisravaṇaṃ ca pittāt ||14|| vaiśrutyakaṇḍūsthiraśothaśuklasnigdhasrutiḥ svalparujaḥ kaphācca | sarvāṇi rūpāṇi ca sannipātāt srāvaśca tatrādhikadoṣavarṇaḥ ||15|| (ca. ci. a. 26) | idānīṃ carakoktaṃ karṇarogacatuṣṭayaṃ vātapittakaphasannipātajabhedādāha– nādo'tirugityādi| aśravaṇamiti aśabdaśrutiḥ| vaiśrutyamiti viruddhaśravaṇam||14-15|| idānīṃ carakoktakarṇarogacatuṣṭayaṃ vātapittakaphasannipātajabhedādāha– nāda ityādi| sugamam| vaiśrutyeti vaiśrutyaṃ viruddhaṃ śravaṇaṃ, srutiḥ srāvaḥ, snigdhā syāt||14-15|| saukumāryāccirotsṛṣṭe sahasā'tipravardhite | karṇaśotho bhavet pālyāṃ sarujaḥ paripoṭavān | kṛṣṇāruṇanibhaḥ stabdhaḥ sa vātāt paripoṭakaḥ ||16|| (su. ci. a. 25) | karṇāvayavatvāt karṇapālyāstadvikārānāha– saukumāryādityādi| saukumāryāddhetościraṃ vardhanena tyakte sahasā ca vardhayitumārabdhe karṇe śothaḥ, paripoṭavān manāktvagavadaraṇavānityarthaḥ||16|| karṇāvayavatvāt karṇapālyāstadvikārānāha– saukumāryādityādi| saukumāryāddhetościrotsṛṣṭe ściraṃvardhanena parityakte sahasā ca vardhayitumārabdhe karṇe śophaḥ, paripoṭaka iti paripoṭavān manāktvagavadaraṇavānityarthaḥ| atha ḍallanābhiprāyaḥ– karṇe cirotsṛṣṭe bahukālamupekṣite sahasā jhaṭiti pravardhite sati saukumāryāt pālyāṃ śophaḥ sarugityādilakṣaṇayuktaḥ syāt sa vātāt paripoṭako rogaḥ syāt; cirotsṛṣṭatve saukumāryaṃ hetuḥ||16|| gurvābharaṇasaṃyogāttāḍanādgharṣaṇādapi | śothaḥ pālyāṃ bhavecchyāvo dāhapākarujānvitaḥ ||17|| rakto vā raktapittābhyāmutpātaḥ sa gado mataḥ | (su. ci. a. 25) | utpātalakṣaṇamāha– gurvityādi| śyāvatvaṃ vyādhiprabhāvāt, pittaraktayoḥ śyāvatvājanakatvāt; kiṃvā vātānubandhādatra śyāvatvam||17||– utpātalakṣaṇamāha– gurvityādi| śyāvatvaṃ vyādheḥ prabhāvāt, pittaraktayoḥ śyāvatvajanakatvābhāvāt; kiñca vātānubandhādatra śyāvatvam||17||– karṇaṃ balādvardhayataḥ pālyāṃ vāyuḥ prakupyati ||18|| kaphaṃ saṅgṛhya kurute śothaṃ stabdhamavedanam | unmanthakaḥ sakaṇḍūko vikāraḥ kaphavātajaḥ ||19|| saṃvardhyamāne durviddhe kaṇḍūpākarujānvitaḥ | śotho bhavati pākaśca tridoṣo duḥkhavardhanaḥ ||20|| (su. ci. a. 25) | unmanthakamāha– karṇamityādi| stabdhatvaṃ vātakṛtaṃ, kaṇḍūḥ kaphāt, iti vātakaphaliṅgam||18-20|| unmanthakamāha– karṇamityādi| karṇaṃ balādvardhayataḥ pālyāṃ vāyuḥ kopaṃ yāti, sa vāyuḥ kupitaḥ san kaphaṃ saṅgṛhya stabdhaṃ tathā avedanaṃ śophaṃ kurute, sa kaphavātajaḥ unmanthakākhyo rogaḥ syāt| sa kiṃlakṣaṇaḥ? sakaṇḍūkaḥ kaṇḍūyuktaḥ, stabdhatvaṃ vātakṛtaṃ, kaṇḍūḥ kaphāditi vātakaphaliṅgam| duḥkhavardhanamāha– saṃvardhamāna ityādi| karṇe durviddhe daivakṛtacchidramatikramya viddhe saṃvardhamāne sati kaṇḍvādiyuktaḥ śopho bhavati, pākaścātra doṣatrayotthaḥ| duḥkhavardhanāt duḥkhavardhanako nāma rogaḥ||18-20|| kaphāsṛkkrimayaḥ kruddhāḥ sarṣapābhā visarpiṇaḥ | kurvanti pālyāṃ piḍakāḥ kaṇḍūdāharujānvitāḥ ||21|| kaphāsṛkkrimisambhūtaḥ sa visarpannitastataḥ | lihet saśaṣkulīṃ pālīṃ parilehīti sa smṛtaḥ ||22|| (su. ci. a. 25) | parilehīmāha– kaphāsṛgityādi| sa visarpanniti sa iti piḍakātmako vikāra; ‘visarpānvitaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare visarpeṇānvitaḥ| lihediti nirmāṃsīṃ karoti ācchādayedvā||21-22|| parilehīmāha– kaphetyādi| lihediti nirmāṃsīṃ karoti utsādayati vā, ‘savisarpānvitaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare visarpeṇānvitaḥ||21-22|| iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne karṇaroganidānaṃ samāptam ||57|| iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ karṇaroganidānaṃ samāptam||57|| iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ karṇaroganidānam||57|| pāṭhāntarāḥ 1 . ‘karṇaśabdena ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 2 . asyāyameveṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ| ↩ 3 . ‘karṇavardha āha’ iti pā.| ↩ 4 . ‘karṇapratinādamāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 5 . ‘mūrchantītyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 6 . ‘ḍimbakān’ iti pā.| ↩ 7 . ‘jāyante’ iti pā.| ↩ 8 . ‘yathā’ iti pā. | ↩ 9 . ‘karṇagūthanidāne’ iti pā.| ↩ 10 . atra ‘atha vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ↩ 11 . ‘vā pūti’ iti pā. | ↩ 12 . ‘pūyaṃ sravati vā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ↩ 13 . ‘srotaḥsthite’ iti pā.| ↩ 14 . ‘sa pūtikarṇakaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 15 . ‘śirājasya’ iti pā.| ↩ 16 . ‘yadāha’ iti pā.| ↩ 17 . ‘tathā''gantujasyāpi’ iti pā.| ↩ 18 . ‘sannipātajamarśaḥ pṛthaggaṇanīyam’ iti pā.| ↩ 19 . ‘prāg nirdiṣṭāḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 20 . ‘ ... śirānimittabhedāt’ iti pā.| ↩ 21 . ‘śirājanyavātajāvaruddhasyātra’ iti pā.| ↩ 22 . ‘āgantujasya ca’ iti pā.| ↩ 23 . ‘sannipātajo'tra gaṇanīyaḥ’ iti pā.| ↩ 24 . ‘sannipātajamarśasaḥ pṛthaggaṇanīyam’ iti pā.| ↩ 25 . ‘ityukte’ iti pā.| ↩ 26 . ‘vā’ iti pā.| ↩ 27 . ‘tṛḍiti’ iti pā.| ↩ 28 . etacca– ‘saṃvardhamāne’ iti pā.| ↩ 29 . ‘ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ karṇaroganidānam||57||’ iti pā.| ↩

title: 58. nāsāroganidānam
text: atha nāsāroganidānam | ānahyate yasya viśuṣyate ca praklidyate dhūpyati cāpi nāsā | na vetti yo gandharasāṃśca janturjuṣṭaṃ vyavasyediha pīnasena | taṃ cānilaśleṣmabhavaṃ vikāraṃ brūyāt pratiśyāyasamānaliṅgam ||1|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) | indriyādhikaraṇavikārādhikārānnāsāroganidānam| tatrādāvapīnasamāha– ānahyata ityādi| ānahyata ityābadhyate, vātaśoṣitakaphena| praklidyate ārdrībhavati| dhūpyatīti santāpamanubhavati; divāderākṛtigaṇatvāt dhūpyatīti rūpam| gandharasāniti gandhān surabhyasurabhīn, ābaddhatvena nāsāyāḥ; nāsārogārambhakadoṣeṇa rasanāyā api duṣṭeḥ rasān madhurādīnna vetti| taṃ cānilaśleṣmabhavamiti vātakaphajam| nanu, anyatra pittakaphajo'sadṛśaliṅgaśca paṭhyate; tadyathā– “mastuluṅgocitaḥ śleṣmā yadā pittādvidahyate| tadā'sṛk picchilaṃ nāsā bahusiṃhāṇakaṃ sravet|| sakaṇḍūdāhapākaṃ ca taṃ tu vidyādapīnasam|” iti, tat kathaṃ na virodhaḥ? naivaṃ, samprāptiviśeṣeṇāsya tathābhāva iti kārtikaḥ| tantrāntarapratyayāt pittasambandho liṅgaviśeṣaścātra boddhavya ityarthaḥ| gadādharastu tatsaṃvādāt ‘analaśleṣmabhavam’ iti paṭhitvā śleṣmapittaja eva nyāyya ityāha| pratiśyāyasamānaliṅgamiti kaphavātajapratiśyāyatulyaliṅgam||1|| indriyādhikaraṇādhikārānnāsāroganidānārambhaḥ| tatraikatriṃśannāsārogāḥ, tatrāpīnasamāha– ānahyata ityādi| ānahyate ābadhyate, viśuṣyate vātaśoṣitakaphena, praklidyate ārdrībhavati, dhūpyati santāpamanubhavati, gandhān surabhyasurabhīn, ānaddhatvena nāsāyāḥ; nāsārogārambhakadoṣeṇa rasanāyāśca duṣṭeḥ| rasān madhurādīnna vetti| taṃ cānilaśleṣmabhavamiti vātakaphajaṃ brūyāt| nanvanyatra pittaśleṣmajo'nyādṛśaśca paṭhyate, tadyathā– “mastuluṅgocitaḥ śleṣmā yadā pittādvidahyate| tadā'sṛkpicchilaṃ nāsā bahusiṃhāṇakaṃ sravet|| sakaṇḍūdāhapākaṃ ca taṃ tu vidyāddhi pīnasam” iti, tatkathaṃ na virodhaḥ? maivaṃ, samprāptiviśeṣeṇāsya tathābhāva iti kārtikaḥ| tantrāntarapratyayāt pittasambandho liṅgaviśeṣaśca boddhavya ityarthaḥ| pratiśyāyasamānaliṅgamiti kaphavātajapratiśyāyatulyaliṅgam||1|| doṣairvidagdhairgalatālumūle sammūrchito yasya samīraṇastu | nireti pūtirmukhanāsikābhyāṃ taṃ pūtinasyaṃ pravadanti rogam ||2|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) | pūtinasyamāha– doṣairityādi| doṣairiti pittakapharaktaiḥ, raktasyāpi doṣatulyarūpatvāddoṣatvam| vidagdhairiti pittaśleṣmaṇoḥ saraktayorūṣmaṇā viruddhalavaṇāmlarasapākena pūtibhāvamāpannaiḥ| sammūrchita iti ucchrāyaṃ nītaḥ| niretīti samīraṇa eva, anyasya kartṛpadasyābhāvāt| taṃ pūtinasyamiti nāsikābhavo nasyaḥ, pūtirnasyo vāyuryatra taṃ pūtinasyam| ihaiva videhaḥ– “kaphapittamasṛṅmiśraṃ sañcitaṃ mūrdhni dehinām| vidagdhamūṣmaṇā gāḍhaṃ rujāṃ kṛtvā'kṣiśaṅkhajām|| tataḥ prasyandate ghrāṇāt saraktaṃ pūtipītakam| pūtinasyaṃ tu taṃ vidyād ghrāṇakaṇḍūjvarapradam||” iti||2|| pūtinasyamāha– doṣairityādi| doṣaiḥ pittakapharaktaiḥ, raktasyāpi tulyadoṣatvāddoṣatvam, ato bahuvacanaṃ; vidagdhairiti pittaśleṣmaṇoḥ saraktayorūṣmaṇā viruddhalavaṇāmlarasapākena pūtibhāvamāpannaiḥ| sammūrchita ucchrāyaṃ nītaḥ, nireti nirgacchati, samīraṇa eva, taṃ pūtinasyamiti nāsikābhavo nasyaḥ, pūtirnasyo vāyuryatra| tathāca videhe– “kaphapittamasṛṅmiśraṃ sañcitaṃ mūrdhni dehinām| vidagdhamūṣmaṇā gāḍhaṃ rujāṃ kṛtvā'kṣiśaṅkhajām|| tena prasyandate ghrāṇātsaraktaṃ pūtipītakam| pūtinasyaṃ tu taṃ vidyād ghrāṇakaṇḍūjvarapradam||” iti||2|| ghrāṇāśritaṃ pittamarūṃṣi kuryādyasmin vikāre balavāṃśca pākaḥ | taṃ nāsikāpākamiti vyavasyedvikledakothāvathavā'pi yatra ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) | nāsāpākamāha– ghrāṇāśritamityādi| arūṃṣīti vraṇān| yasmin vikāra iti yasyāṃ vikṛtau satyām| vyavasyet jānīyāt| vikledaḥ ārdratā, kothaḥ, pūtibhāvaḥ||3|| nāsāpākamāha– ghrāṇāśritamityādi| arūṃṣi vraṇān, yasminniti yasminvikāre, dṛṣṭau darśanaṃ gatau||3|| doṣairvidagdhairathavā'pi jantorlalāṭadeśe'bhihatasya taistaiḥ | nāsā sravet pūyamasṛgvimiśraṃ taṃ pūyaraktaṃ pravadanti rogam ||4|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) | doṣāgantujaṃ pūyaraktamāha– doṣairityādi| vidagdhairiti pittaraktādhikatvādviruddhāṃ pariṇatiṃ prāptaiḥ, lalāṭābhighātena vā pākaṃ prāptaiḥ| taistariti prahārapīḍanādibhiḥ||4|| doṣāgantujaṃ pūyaraktamāha– doṣairityādi| vidagdhairiti pittaraktādhikatvāt viruddhāṃ gatiṃ prāptaiḥ lalāṭābhighātena vā pākaṃ prāptaiḥ, taistairiti prahārapīḍanādibhiḥ||4|| ghrāṇāśrite marmaṇi sampraduṣṭo yasyānilo nāsikayā nireti | kaphānujāto bahuśo'tiśabdastaṃ rogamāhuḥ kṣavathuṃ vidhijñāḥ ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) | kṣavathurdoṣāgantubhedāddvividho bhavati; tatra doṣajaṃ prāgāha– ghrāṇāśrita ityādi| marmaṇīti śṛṅgāṭake, ‘nastakayoḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare nāsāpuṭayoḥ, ‘tadāśritaḥ san’ iti śeṣaḥ||5|| kṣavathurdoṣāgantubhedād dvividho bhavati, tatra doṣajamāha– ghrāṇāśrita ityādi| marmaṇi śṛṅgāṭakākhye, ‘nastakayoḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare nāsāpuṭayoḥ, tadāsthitaḥ sanniti śeṣaḥ||5|| tīkṣṇopayogādabhijighrato vā bhāvān kaṭūnarkanirīkṣaṇādvā | sūtrādibhirvā taruṇāsthimarmaṇyudghāṭite'nyaḥ kṣavathurnireti ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) | āgantujamāha– tīkṣṇopayogādityādi| tīkṣṇopayogādrājikāditīkṣṇadravyabhakṣaṇāt| bhāvān kaṭūniti kaṭūni dravyāṇi| abhijighrato bhṛśaṃ jighrataḥ| arkanirīkṣaṇādvā kaphavilayanakarāt| taruṇāsthimarmaṇīti taruṇāsthi nāsāvaṃśāsthi tadeva marma tasmin phaṇāmarmaṇītyarthaḥ, abhighātādinā marmavyathājanakatvāt; athavā taruṇāsthni ca marmaṇi ca śṛṅgāṭake, dvandvaikavadbhāvanirdeśāt| udghāṭite cālite| anya āgantujaḥ||6|| āgantujamāha– tīkṣṇetyādi| tīkṣṇopayogāt rājikādibhakṣaṇāt, bhāvān kaṭūniti kaṭudravyāṇi, atijighrato bhṛśaṃ jighrataḥ, arkanirīkṣaṇādvā kaphavilayanakaratvād, athavā sūtrādibhiḥ, taruṇāsthimarmaṇīti taruṇāsthi nāsāvaṃśāsthi, tadeva marma, abhighātādinā marmavadvyathājanakatvāt, udghāṭite'rdhacālite, anyaḥ āgantujaḥ, doṣajāgantureka eva gaṇanīyaḥ||6|| prabhraśyate nāsikayā tu yasya sāndro vidagdho lavaṇaḥ kaphastu | prāksañcito mūrdhani sūryataptastaṃ bhraṃśathuṃ rogamudāharanti ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) | bhraṃśathumāha– prabhraśyata ityādi| prabhraśyate galati| vidagdho lavaṇa iti svarūpākhyānaṃ, vidagdhatvādeva kaphasya lavaṇatvasiddheḥ| prāksañcita ityanena sañcayapūrvakaṃ kopaṃ darśayati, hetubhūyastvena cayamantareṇāpi kopadarśanāt| yaduktam– “na kevalaṃ cayaṃ prāpya doṣāḥ kupyanti dehinām| anyato'pi hi kupyanti hetubāhulyato balāt||” iti||7|| bhraṃśathumāha– prabhraśyata ityādi| vidagdho lavaṇa iti svarūpākhyānaṃ, vidagdhatvādeva kaphasya lavaṇatvasiddheḥ, ‘pittatapta’ iti suśrutapāṭhaḥ||7|| ghrāṇe bhṛśaṃ dāhasamanvite tu viniḥsareddhūma iveha vāyuḥ | nāsā pradīpteva ca yasya jantorvyādhiṃ tu taṃ dīptamudāharanti ||8|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) | dīptamāha– ghrāṇe bhṛśamityādi| pradīpteveti prajvaliteva||8|| dīptamāha– ghrāṇa ityādi| pradīpteveti prajvaliteva, videhe'sya lakṣaṇam– “dhūmāyate yadā nāsā calatkṛṣyati dīpyate| niścarettama ucchvāsaṃ taṃ vyādhiṃ dīptamādiśet||” iti||8|| ucchvāsamārgaṃ tu kaphaḥ savāto rundhyāt pratīnāhamudāharettam |9| (ca. ci. a. 26) | pratīnāhamāha– ucchvāsamārgamityādi|9|– pratīnāhamāha– ucchvāsamārgamityādi|9|– ghrāṇādghanaḥ pītasitastanurvā doṣaḥ sravet srāvamudāharettam ||9|| (ca. ci. a. 26) | nāsāsrāvamāha– ghrāṇādityādi| doṣa iti kaphaḥ||9|| nāsāsrāvamāha– doṣa iti kaphaḥ| asya lakṣaṇaṃ videhe– “srotaḥśṛṅgāṭake śleṣmā| citaḥ kledita ūṣmaṇā| viśeṣātsyandate rātrau nāsāsrāvaṃ tu tadviduḥ||” iti||9|| ghrāṇāśrite srotasi mārutena gāḍhaṃ pratapte pariśoṣite ca | kṛcchrācchvasedūrdhvamadhaśca janturyasmin sa nāsāpariśoṣa uktaḥ ||10|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) | nāsāśoṣamāha– ghrāṇāśrite srotasītyādi| atra ca vāyukṛtasrotaḥśoṣaṇena tadgataśleṣmaśoṣo boddhavyaḥ| pratapta ityanena pittamapi gamyate, pratapanasya pittamantareṇāsambhavāt| tathāca kaścit paṭhati– “ghrāṇāśrite śleṣmaṇi mārutena pittena gāḍhaṃ pariśoṣite ca||” iti| pratapta ityasya sthāne ‘pradīpte’ iti pāṭhāntare sa evārthaḥ| kṛcchrācchvasedūrdhvamadhaśca yasminniti kaṣṭenocchvāsaniḥśvāsau karoti yatretyarthaḥ||10|| nāsāśoṣamāha– ghrāṇetyādi| nāsāśoṣastu vāyukṛtasrotaḥśoṣaṇena tadgataśleṣmaśoṣo jñeyaḥ| pratapta ityanena ca pittamapi gamyate, pratapanasya pittamantareṇāsambhavāt| pratapta ityasya sthāne ‘pradīpte’ iti pāṭhāntare sa evārthaḥ| kṛcchrācchvasitīti kaṣṭenocchvasiti śvāsaṃ karoti yatretyarthaḥ| vaidehe'sya lakṣaṇam– “vātapittau yadā ghrāṇakapharaktaṃ viśoṣayet| tadā syāducchvasennāsā tasya śuṣkaṃ vidhīyate|| bhṛśaśuṣkāvacūrṇena nāsāśoṣaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ|” iti||10|| śirogurutvamarucirnāsāsrāvastanuḥ svaraḥ | kṣāmaḥ ṣṭhīvatyathābhīkṣṇamāmapīnasalakṣaṇam ||11|| āmaliṅgānvitaḥ śleṣmā ghanaḥ kheṣu nimajjati | svaravarṇaviśuddhiśca paripakvasya lakṣaṇam ||12|| cikitsābhedārthaṃ pīnasasyāmapakvalakṣaṇamāha– śirogurutvamityādi| tanuraghanaḥ| svaraḥ kṣāma iti avispaṣṭaṃ vacanam| ṣṭhīvatyathābhīkṣṇamiti muhurmuhurnāsikayā śleṣmāṇaṃ nirasyatītyarthaḥ| āmarasānvitena doṣeṇa śirogurutvādayaḥ| “āmaliṅgānvitaḥ śleṣmā ghanaḥ kheṣu nimajjati” ityādi pakvalakṣaṇam| āmaliṅgaiḥ śirogurutvādibhiranvitaḥ śleṣmā nimajjatīti līno bhavati| ayamarthaḥ– śleṣmā tāvallīno bhavati, āmaliṅgānyapi līnāni bhavanti, tathāca ‘tanutvamāmaliṅgānām’ iti suśrutaḥ| ‘na sajjati’ iti pāṭhāntare na sakto bhavati, na tiṣṭhatīti yāvat; tadā''maliṅgānvitaḥ stokenāmaliṅgenānvitaḥ| ghanaḥ styānaḥ| kheṣu nāsārandhreṣu, ‘sthitaḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ; vyaktyapekṣayā bahuvacanam| svaraviśuddhiḥ svarabhedābhāvaḥ, varṇaviśuddhiḥ prakṛtisavarṇatā||11-12|| cikitsābhedārthaṃ pīnasasyāmapakvalakṣaṇaṃ kathayannāha– śira ityādi| tanuḥ aghanaḥ, svaraḥ kṣāmaḥ avispaṣṭavacanaḥ, ṣṭhīvettathā'bhīkṣṇamiti murhurmuhurnāsayā śleṣmāṇaṃ nirasyatītyarthaḥ| pakvalakṣaṇamāha– āmetyādi| āmaliṅgaiḥ śirogurutvādibhiranvitaḥ śleṣmā, nimajjati līno bhavatīti, ayamarthaḥ– śleṣmā vilīno bhavati, āmaliṅgānyapi, tathāca– “tanutvaṃ cāmaliṅgānām” iti suśrute| ‘na sajjati’ iti pāṭhāntare na sakto bhavati, na tiṣṭhatīti yāvat| svaraviśuddhiḥ svarabhedābhāvaḥ, varṇaviśuddhiḥ prakṛtivarṇatā||11-12|| sandhāraṇājīrṇarajotibhāṣyakrodhartuvaiṣamyaśirobhitāpaiḥ | prajāgarātisvapanāmbuśītairavaśyayā maithunabāṣpadhūmaiḥ | saṃstyānadoṣe śirasi pravṛddho vāyuḥ pratiśyāyamudīrayettu ||13|| (ca. ci. a. 26) | cayaṃ gatā mūrdhani mārutādayaḥ pṛthak samastāśca tathaiva śoṇitam | prakupyamāṇā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇaistataḥ pratiśyāyakarā bhavanti hi ||14|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) | pratiśyāyaḥ pañcavidho bhavati, vātapittakaphasannipātaraktajabhedāt; tasya nidānaṃ dvividham– ekaṃ sadyojanakaṃ, tacca balavattvena cayaṃ nāpekṣata eva; aparaṃ cayādikrameṇa janakaṃ, cayādikramotpannaśca doṣo garīyān sakalaśarīrasambhāvanayā baddhamūlatvāt| tatra sadyojanakanidānapūrvikāṃ tasya samprāptimāha– sandhāraṇetyādi| sandhāraṇaṃ purīṣādivegadhāraṇaṃ, rajo dhūliḥ, śirobhitāpaḥ śiro'bhitapyate yena sa śirobhitāpo dhūmādiḥ; rajodhūmādayaśca nāsāpraviṣṭāḥ santo hetavaḥ| atisvapanaṃ divāsvapanamityarthaḥ| avaśyayā tuṣāreṇa| saṃstyānadoṣe śirasīti ghanībhūtaśleṣmaṇi śirasi| suśrutenāpi sadyojanakaṃ nidānaṃ paṭhitaṃ; tadyathā– “nārīprasaṅgaḥ śiraso'bhitāpo dhūmo rajaḥ śītamatipratāpaḥ| sandhāraṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayośca sadyaḥ pratiśyāyanidānamuktam||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) iti| cayādikrameṇa janakamapi doṣaṃ darśayannāha– cayaṃ gatā ityādi| cayaṃ gatā iti sāmarthyāt sve sve sthāne, “svasthānavṛddhirdoṣāṇāṃ caya ityabhidhīyate|” iti vacanāt| tathaiva śoṇitamiti cayaṃ gatam| nanu, yadi svasthānasthitā doṣāḥ tat kathaṃ mūrdhni pratiśyāyasambhavaḥ? ityāha– prakupyamāṇā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇairiti| vividhairiti balavadvigrahadivāsvapnādibhiḥ| prakopaviśeṣaśca prasaraḥ| yaduktam– “prakupitānāṃ paryuṣitakiṇvodakapiṣṭasamavāya ivodriktānāṃ prasaro bhavati|” (su. sū. a. 21) iti| ata eva, “cayaprakopapraśamāḥ pittādīnāṃ yathākramam|” ityatra prakopamātramupāttam| etena prasareṇa śiraḥsamprāptā doṣāḥ pratiśyāyakarāḥ| anye tu cayaṃ gatā mūrdhanīti yathāsthitameva yojayanti, udānavāyorūrdhvagatitvācchirasyapi sambhavāt, tvaksirāśritatvāt pittāsṛjoḥ kaphasya ca nisargataḥ śirovasthiteḥ śirasi caya iti| tata iti prakopaviśeṣāt prasarādanantaram| pratiśyāya iti vātaṃ prati abhimukhaṃ śyāyo gamanaṃ kaphādīnāṃ yatra sa pratiśyāyaḥ| ‘śaiṅ’ gatau, ityasya prayogaḥ| tathāca carakaḥ– “ghrāṇamūle sthitaḥ śleṣmā rudhiraṃ pittameva vā| mārutādhmātaśirasaḥ śyāyate mārutaṃ prati||” (ca. ci. a. 8)||13-14|| evaṃ nāsārogā daśa śrīkaṇṭhoktāḥ kathitāḥ| pratiśyāyaḥ pañcavidho bhavati, vātapittakaphasannipātaraktajabhedāt, tasya samprāptimāha– sandhāraṇetyādi| nidānaṃ dvividham– ekaṃ sadyojanakam, aparaṃ cayādikramajātaṃ, tatredaṃ sadyonidānam| sandhāraṇaṃ purīṣādivegavidhāraṇaṃ, rajo dhūliḥ, śirobhitāpaḥ śiro'bhitāpyate yena sa śirobhitāpaḥ dhūmādiḥ, rajodhūmādayaśca nāsāpraviṣṭāḥ pratiśyāyahetavaḥ, atisvapnaṃ divāsvapnamityarthaḥ| avaśyayā tuṣāreṇa| saṃstyānadoṣe śirasīti saṃhatakaphe śirasi| suśrutenāpi sadyojanakaṃ nidānaṃ paṭhitam| tadyathā– “nārīprasaṅgaḥ śiraso'bhitāpo dhūmo rajaḥ śītamatipratāpaḥ| sandhāraṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayośca sadyaḥpratiśyāyanidānamuktam||” iti| cayādikramajasya nidānamāha– cayamityādi| cayaṃ gatāḥ iti sve sve sthāne sañcayaṃ prāptāḥ “svasthānavṛddhirdoṣāṇāṃ cayaḥ” iti vacanāt| mārutādaya iti vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ ete, tathaiva śoṇitamapi cayaṃ gataṃ tato mūrdhni pratiśyāyakaraṃ bhavatīti yojyam| nanu, yadi sve sve sthāne sthitā doṣāstatkathaṃ mūrdhni pratiśyāyasambhavaḥ ityāha– prakopyamāṇā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇairiti, balavadvigrahādikrodhādidivāsvapnādibhiśca kopanaiḥ prakopyamāṇāḥ; prakopaviśeṣaśca prasaraḥ| yaduktam– “kupitānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ kiṇvodakapiṣṭasamavāya ivodgatānāṃ prasaro bhavati” iti| ata evāha– “cayaprakopopaśamāḥ pittādīnāṃ yathākramam” iti| ata eva prakopamātramupāttam| evaṃ ca prasaraṇasthānasaṃśrayeṇa śiraḥsamprāptā doṣāḥ pratiśyāyakarāḥ| anye tu cayaṃ gato mūrdhnīti yathāvasthitameva manyante, udānavāyorūrdhvagatitvāt, śirasyapi vātasamudbhavatvāt| tvaksirāsṛtatvātpittāsṛjoḥ kaphasya ca nisargataḥ śirovasthiteḥ śirasi caya iti| athavā sarvaśarīracarāstu vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ saraktāḥ, sarvatraitatkāryadarśanāt| tata iti prakopaviśeṣāt prasarādanantaram| pratiśyāya iti vātaṃ prati abhimukhaṃ śyāyo gamanaṃ kaphādīnāṃ yatra sa pratiśyāyaḥ| ‘śyaiṅ’ gatau ityasya prayogaḥ| tathā carakaḥ– “ghrāṇamūle sthitaḥ śleṣmā rudhiraṃ pittameva ca| mārutādhmānaśirasaḥ śyāyate mārutaṃ prati|| pratiśyāyastato ghoro jāyate dehakarṣaṇaḥ|” iti||13-14|| kṣavapravṛttiḥ śiraso'tipūrṇatā stambho'ṅgamardaḥ parihṛṣṭaromatā | upadravāścāpyapare pṛthagvidhā nṛṇāṃ pratiśyāyapuraḥsarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||15|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) | tasya pūrvarūpamāha– kṣavapravṛttirityādi| upadravāścāpyapare iti upadravāstatkālabhāvino rogāḥ, natu pāribhāṣikāḥ paścātkālabhāvinaḥ; te ca ghrāṇadhūmāyanamanthādayaḥ| yadāha videhaḥ– “pūrvarūpāṇi dṛśyante pratiśyāye bhaviṣyati| ghrāṇadhūmāyanaṃ manthaḥ kṣavathustāludāraṇam|| kaṇṭhadhvaṃso mukhasrāvaḥ śirasaḥ pūraṇaṃ tathā|” iti| puraḥsarā iti pūrvarūpāṇi||15|| tasya pūrvarūpamāha– kṣavetyādi| upadravāḥ tatkālabhāvino rogāḥ| apare iti ghrāṇadhūmāyanamanthādayaḥ| yaduktaṃ videhe– “pūrvarūpāṇi dṛśyante pratiśyāye bhaviṣyati| ghrāṇadhūmāyanaṃ manthaḥ kṣavathustāludāraṇam| kaṇṭhadhvaṃso mukhasrāvaḥ śirasaḥ pūraṇaṃ tathā||” iti| puraḥsarā iti pūrvarūpāṇi||15|| ānaddhā pihitā nāsā tanusrāvaprasekinī | galatālvoṣṭhaśoṣaśca nistodaḥ śaṅkhayostathā ||16|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) | kṣavapravṛttiratyarthaṃ vaktravairasyameva ca | bhavet svaropaghātaśca pratiśyāye'nilātmake ||17|| uṣṇaḥ sapītakaḥ srāvo ghrāṇāt sravati paittike | kṛśo'tipāṇḍuḥ santapto bhaveduṣṇābhipīḍitaḥ ||18|| sadhūmamagniṃ sahasā vamatīva sa mānavaḥ | ghrāṇāt kaphaḥ kaphakṛte śītaḥ pāṇḍuḥ sravedbahuḥ | śuklāvabhāsaḥ śuklākṣo bhavedguruśirā naraḥ ||19|| kaṇṭhatālvoṣṭhaśirasāṃ kaṇḍūbhirabhipīḍitaḥ | (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) | vātādipratiśyāyaliṅgānyāha– ānaddhetyādi| ānaddhā vibaddhā| pihitā sapidhāneva| nistodaḥ sūcivyadhanavadvyathā| śaṅkhayoriti bhrūpucchāntayoḥ| sapītaka iti īṣat pītaḥ| pittapratiśyāyavān mānavaḥ kṛśo bhavati| atipāṇḍurdhūsaraḥ| uṣṇābhipīḍita iti uṣṇaguṇenābhipīḍita ityarthaḥ||16-19||– teṣu vātikamāha– ānaddhetyādi| ānaddhā vibaddhā, ādhmānāpūriteveti yāvat| pihitā sapidhāneva, tathā galatālvoṣṭhaśoṣādayo bhavanti, nistodaḥ śūlavyadhanavadvyathā, śaṅkhayoriti bhrūpucchāntayoḥ| paittikamāha– sapītaka ityādi| īṣatpītakaḥ| pittapratiśyāyavānmānavaḥ kṛśo bhavati| atipāṇḍurdhūsaraḥ, uṣṇābhipīḍita iti uṣṇaguṇenābhipīḍitaḥ|
